en.s: The Battle of Qantish (5 November 1009) was a battle of the Fitna of al-Andalus that took place in the mountainous region of Qantish, east of Córdoba. The battle was fought between the forces of Caliph Muhammad II of Córdoba and his general Wadih al-Siqlabi against those of Prince Sulayman ibn al-Hakam, whose army was primarily composed of Berbers of al-Andalus who had been persecuted by the caliph and the people of Córdoba.

zh.s: 坎蒂什之战发生于1009年11月5日，是安达卢斯内战的一场战役，地点在科尔多瓦以东的坎蒂什山区。科尔多瓦哈里发穆罕默德二世及其将领瓦迪赫·西格拉比率军，与苏莱曼·伊本·哈卡姆王子的军队交战。苏莱曼的军队主要由安达卢斯的柏柏尔人组成；他们曾遭哈里发和科尔多瓦居民迫害。

en.t: Lý Anh Tông was enthroned as the emperor of Đại Việt at the age of two, beginning a 37-year reign
en.s: Emperor Lý Anh Tông (1136 – 14 August 1175) of Đại Việt (lit. 'Great Viet') was the sixth emperor of the later Lý dynasty in Vietnamese history, from 1138 until his death in 1175.

zh.t: 李英宗两岁登基成为大越皇帝，开启37年统治
zh.s: 大越皇帝李英宗（1136年—1175年8月14日）是越南历史上后李朝第六位皇帝，自1138年即位，统治至1175年去世。

en.s: The Second Battle of Panipat was fought on November 5, 1556, between the forces of Hemu, the Hindu general and Chief Minister of Adil Shah Suri, and the army of the Mughal emperor, Akbar. Hemu had conquered Delhi a month earlier by defeating the Mughals led by Tardi Beg Khan at the Battle of Delhi and proclaimed himself Raja Vikramaditya. Akbar and his guardian, Bairam Khan, had immediately marched to Delhi to reclaim the city. The two armies clashed at Panipat not far from the site of the First Battle of Panipat of 1526.

zh.s: 帕尼帕特第二次战役于1556年11月5日打响，交战双方是印度教将领、阿迪勒·沙阿·苏里首相赫穆，以及莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴的军队。一个月前，赫穆在德里战役中击败塔尔迪·贝格·汗率领的莫卧儿军队，攻占德里，并自称毗俱罗摩帝。阿克巴和他的监护人拜拉姆·汗随即率军前往德里，试图夺回这座城市。双方在帕尼帕特交战，战场距1526年的帕尼帕特第一次战役遗址不远。

en.s: The siege of Stettin occurred from 19 September to 5 November 1659 during the Second Northern War of 1655–1660 in the Swedish city of Stettin (modern-day Szczecin, Poland) and resulted in a Swedish victory. In mid-September 1659, an Austrian/Imperial army of 5,000 men under General Jean-Louis Raduit de Souches crossed the Reglitz and Oder rivers to besiege the city of Stettin.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次北方战争期间，瑞典城市斯德丁（今波兰什切青）于1659年9月19日至11月5日遭围攻，最终瑞典获胜。1659年9月中旬，让-路易·拉杜伊·德·苏什将军率领5000名奥地利及神圣罗马帝国军队渡过雷格利茨河和奥得河，围攻斯德丁。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Rossbach took place on 5 November 1757 during the Third Silesian War (1756–1763, part of the Seven Years' War) near the village of Rossbach (Roßbach), in the Electorate of Saxony. It is sometimes called the Battle of, or at, Reichardtswerben, after a different nearby town. In this 90-minute battle, Frederick the Great, king of Prussia, defeated an Allied army composed of French forces augmented by a contingent of the Reichsarmee (Imperial Army) of the Holy Roman Empire.

zh.s: 罗斯巴赫会战于1757年11月5日爆发，发生在第三次西里西亚战争期间（1756年至1763年，属于七年战争的一部分），地点在萨克森选侯国罗斯巴赫村附近。由于附近另一个城镇，这场战役有时也称为赖夏茨韦尔本会战或赖夏茨韦尔本之战。在这场持续90分钟的战斗中，普鲁士国王腓特烈大帝击败了由法国军队和神圣罗马帝国帝国军一支部队组成的联军。

en.s: The Treaty of Fort Stanwix was a treaty signed between representatives from the Haudenosaunee and Great Britain (accompanied by negotiators from New Jersey, Virginia and Pennsylvania) in 1768 at Fort Stanwix. It was negotiated between Sir William Johnson, his deputy George Croghan, and representatives of the Haudenosaunee. The treaty established a Line of Property following the Ohio River that ceded the Kentucky portion of the Virginia Colony to the British Crown, as well as most of what is now West Virginia.

zh.s: 1768年，豪德诺索尼联盟与英国代表在斯坦威克堡签署条约，新泽西、弗吉尼亚和宾夕法尼亚也派出谈判代表。谈判由威廉·约翰逊爵士、其副手乔治·克罗根和豪德诺索尼代表进行。条约沿俄亥俄河划定土地边界，将弗吉尼亚殖民地的肯塔基地区割让给英国王室，也割让了现今西弗吉尼亚州的大部分地区。

en.s: The Battle of Amstetten was a minor engagement during the War of the Third Coalition between the First French Empire and the alliance of Austria and Russia. It occurred on 5 November 1805, when the retreating Russo-Austrian troops, led by Mikhail Kutuzov, were intercepted by Marshal Joachim Murat's cavalry and a portion of Marshal Jean Lannes' corps. Pyotr Bagration defended against the advancing French troops and allowed the Russian troops to retreat. This was the first fight in which a major part of the Russian Army opposed a significant number of French troops in the open.

zh.s: 阿姆施泰滕战役是第三次反法同盟战争期间法兰西第一帝国与奥地利、俄罗斯联军之间的一场小规模交战。1805年11月5日，米哈伊尔·库图佐夫率领的俄奥联军正在撤退，遭到约阿希姆·缪拉元帅的骑兵和让·拉纳元帅麾下一支部队拦截。彼得·巴格拉季昂抵挡法军推进，掩护俄军撤退。这是俄罗斯军队主力首次在开阔地与数量可观的法军交战。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Valmaseda took place on 5 November 1808, during Lieutenant-General Blake's retreat from superior French armies in Cantabria. Reinforced by veteran regular infantry from General La Romana's Division of the North (Spanish: Division del Norte), Blake suddenly turned on his pursuers to rescue a trapped detachment and defeated a division of General Victor's army at Valmaseda (Biscay).

zh.s: 1808年11月5日，布莱克中将率军在坎塔布里亚撤退，躲避兵力占优的法国军队。布莱克得到拉罗马纳将军北方师（西班牙语：Division del Norte）的老兵步兵增援后，突然反击追兵，以解救一支被困分队，并在比斯开省瓦尔马塞达击败维克托将军麾下的一支师。

en.s: The Battle of Bornos on 5 November 1811 saw a Spanish force led by Francisco Ballesteros attack an Imperial French column under Jean-Baptiste Pierre de Semellé. The action was part of a larger operation in which the French tried to trap Ballesteros but failed. Instead, the Spanish general lashed out at one of the French columns. The French escaped disaster when they fought their way out, but a French-allied Spanish battalion either surrendered or switched sides. Bornos is about 40 miles (64 km) northeast of Jerez de la Frontera on Route 342. The battle occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 1811年11月5日，弗朗西斯科·巴列斯特罗斯率领的西班牙部队袭击了让-巴蒂斯特·皮埃尔·德·塞梅莱指挥的一支法兰西帝国纵队。博尔诺斯战役是一次更大规模行动的一部分，法军原想围困巴列斯特罗斯，但未能成功。西班牙将军转而袭击其中一支法军纵队。法军奋力突围，避免惨败；一支与法军结盟的西班牙营则投降或倒戈。博尔诺斯位于赫雷斯-德拉弗龙特拉东北约40英里（64公里），在342号公路沿线。这场战役是半岛战争的一部分，而半岛战争属于拿破仑战争。

en.s: The 1811 Independence Movement (Spanish: Movimiento de Independencia de 1811), known in El Salvador as the First Shout of Independence (Primer Grito de Independencia), was the first of a series of revolts in Central America in modern-day El Salvador against Spanish rule and dependency on the Captaincy General of Guatemala. The independence movement was led by prominent Salvadoran and Central American figures such as José Matías Delgado, Manuel José Arce, and Santiago José Celis.
en.n: Salvadoran priest José Matías Delgado rings the bells of La Merced church in San Salvador, calling for insurrection and launching the 1811 Independence Movement.

zh.s: 1811年独立运动（西班牙语：Movimiento de Independencia de 1811），在萨尔瓦多也称“第一次独立呼声”（Primer Grito de Independencia），是中美洲一系列起义的开端。起义发生在今萨尔瓦多，旨在反抗西班牙统治以及危地马拉都督区的管辖。何塞·马蒂亚斯·德尔加多、曼努埃尔·何塞·阿尔塞和圣地亚哥·何塞·塞利斯等萨尔瓦多及中美洲知名人士领导了这场独立运动。
zh.n: 萨尔瓦多神父何塞·马蒂亚斯·德尔加多敲响圣萨尔瓦多拉梅塞德教堂的钟声，号召起义并开启1811年独立运动。

en.s: The Action of 5 November 1813 was a brief naval clash during the Napoleonic Wars, between part of the British Mediterranean Fleet led by Vice-Admiral Sir Edward Pellew, and a French force under Rear-Admiral Julien Cosmao-Kerjulien. The engagement took place outside the French port of Toulon. The clash occurred when a French fleet under Vice-Admiral Maxime Julien Émeriau de Beauverger took advantage of a favourable wind and the temporary absence of the British blockading force, to leave port to carry out exercises. Émeriau abandoned the exercises when the wind changed, but while returning to port his rear came under attack from the recently returned British inshore squadron.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，英国地中海舰队的一部分在爱德华·佩卢爵士中将率领下，与朱利安·科斯毛-凯尔居利安少将指挥的一支法国部队发生短暂海战。交战地点在法国港口土伦外海。马克西姆·朱利安·埃梅里欧·德·博韦尔热中将率领的法国舰队趁风向有利、英国封锁舰队暂时离开之机出港演习。风向改变后，埃梅里欧放弃演习返航；返港途中，法国舰队后队遭到刚刚返回的英国近海分舰队袭击。

en.s: The 1813 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1813, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic-Republican candidate and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Georgia's at-large congressional district Peter Early defeated fellow Democratic-Republican candidate John Clark in a Georgia General Assembly vote.

zh.s: 1813年佐治亚州州长选举于1813年11月5日举行，选出佐治亚州州长。民主共和党候选人彼得·厄利曾任佐治亚州联邦众议员，他在佐治亚州议会投票中击败同党候选人约翰·克拉克。

en.s: The Battle of Temalaca was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred on 5 November 1815 in the area around Temalaca, Puebla. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The Mexican insurgents were commanded by José María Morelos and the Spanish by Manuel de la Concha. The battle resulted in a victory for the Spanish Royalists. At the end of the battle, Morelos was captured by Spanish forces under whose control he was soon after executed ending the second phase of the Mexican War of Independence.

zh.s: 特马拉卡战役是墨西哥独立战争中的一场战斗，于1815年11月5日在普埃布拉州特马拉卡一带发生。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室的保皇派和争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军。起义军由何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯指挥，西班牙军队由曼努埃尔·德·拉孔查指挥。战斗以西班牙保皇派获胜告终。莫雷洛斯在战后被西班牙军队俘虏，不久后遭处决；这也结束了墨西哥独立战争的第二阶段。

en.s: The Battle of Khadki,also known as Battle of Kirkee or Ganesh Khind, took place at Khadki, India on November 5, 1817 between the forces of the British East India Company and the Maratha Empire. Khadki is situated near Pune in Maharashtra, India under leadership of Baji Rao II. It later became a military cantonment.

zh.s: 卡德基战役又称基尔基战役或加内什·欣德战役，于1817年11月5日在印度卡德基爆发，交战双方是英国东印度公司军队和马拉塔帝国军队，马拉塔军由巴吉·拉奥二世领导。卡德基位于印度马哈拉施特拉邦浦那附近。此地后来成为军事驻地。

en.s: The Third Anglo-Maratha War (1817–1819) was the final and decisive conflict between the British East India Company and the Maratha Empire. The war left the Company in control of most of India. It began with an invasion of Maratha territory by East India Company troops, and although the British were outnumbered, the Maratha army was decimated. The troops were led by Governor General Hastings, supported by a force under General Thomas Hislop.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第三次英马拉塔战争（1817—1819年）是英国东印度公司与马拉塔帝国之间最后一场决定性冲突。战争使东印度公司控制了印度大部分地区。战争始于东印度公司军队入侵马拉塔领土；尽管英军人数处于劣势，马拉塔军队仍遭到重创。部队由总督黑斯廷斯率领，托马斯·希斯洛普将军指挥的一支部队提供支援。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1819 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1819, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic-Republican candidate John Clark defeated fellow Democratic-Republican candidate and former United States Senator for Georgia George Troup in a Georgia General Assembly vote.

zh.s: 1819年佐治亚州州长选举于1819年11月5日举行，选出佐治亚州州长。民主共和党候选人约翰·克拉克在佐治亚州议会投票中击败同党候选人、佐治亚州前联邦参议员乔治·特鲁普。

en.s: The Morea expedition (French: Expédition de Morée) is the name given to the land intervention of the French Army in the Peloponnese between 1828 and 1833, at the time of the Greek War of Independence, with the aim of expelling the Ottoman-Egyptian occupation forces from the region. It was also accompanied by a scientific expedition mandated by the French Academy.
en.n: Greek War of Independence: The French Morea expedition to recapture Morea (now the Peloponnese) ends when the last Ottoman forces depart the peninsula.

zh.s: 莫里亚远征（法语：Expédition de Morée）是指1828年至1833年间，法国陆军在伯罗奔尼撒半岛进行的陆上军事干预。当时正值希腊独立战争，法军的目标是驱逐奥斯曼—埃及占领军。法国科学院还组织了一支科学考察队随行。
zh.n: 希腊独立战争：莫里亚远征结束，最后一批奥斯曼军队撤离半岛。

en.t: 1832 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 5, 1832, as part of the 1832 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the incumbent president Andrew Jackson and the U.S. minister to Great Britain Martin Van Buren defeated the National Republican ticket of the junior U.S. senator from Kentucky Henry Clay and the former U.S. representative from Pennsylvania's 2nd congressional district John Sergeant.

zh.t: 1832年美国总统选举在印第安纳州举行
zh.s: 1832年美国总统选举在印第安纳州的投票于11月5日举行，是1832年美国总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、时任总统安德鲁·杰克逊和美国驻英国公使马丁·范布伦，击败了国家共和党候选人、肯塔基州资浅联邦参议员亨利·克莱和宾夕法尼亚州第二国会选区前联邦众议员约翰·萨金特。

en.t: 1832 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1832 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 5, 1832, as part of the 1832 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. There were two Andrew Jackson tickets in Georgia representing the two different local parties. The Troup party won with 13,881 votes, beating the Union party (formally Clark party) which got 7,367 votes.

zh.s: 1832年佐治亚州美国总统选举于1832年11月5日举行，是1832年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出11名代表或选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。佐治亚州有两组选举人支持安德鲁·杰克逊，分别代表当地两个政党。特鲁普派以13,881票获胜，击败获得7,367票的联邦派（正式名称为克拉克派）。

en.t: Honduras: Declared, as Honduras, from the Federal Republic of Central America
en.s: Honduras, officially the Republic of Honduras, is a country in Central America. It is bordered to the west by Guatemala, to the southwest by El Salvador, to the southeast by Nicaragua, to the south by the Pacific Ocean at the Gulf of Fonseca, and to the north by the Gulf of Honduras, a large inlet of the Caribbean Sea. Its capital and largest city is Tegucigalpa.

zh.t: 洪都拉斯脱离中美洲联邦共和国，以洪都拉斯之名宣布成立
zh.s: 洪都拉斯正式名称为洪都拉斯共和国，是中美洲国家。该国西邻危地马拉，西南接萨尔瓦多，东南与尼加拉瓜接壤；南临太平洋的丰塞卡湾，北面濒临加勒比海的大型海湾洪都拉斯湾。首都兼最大城市为特古西加尔巴。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1844 United States presidential election in Tennessee was held on November 5, 1844, as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Despite being Polk's home state and despite Polk previously serving as the state's governor, Tennessee voted for the Whig candidate, Henry Clay, albeit by a very narrow margin of 123 votes (0.10%), making it the closest state in the election.

zh.s: 1844年美国总统选举于11月5日在田纳西州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。尽管田纳西州是詹姆斯·K·波尔克的家乡，波尔克此前也曾任该州州长，田纳西州仍以123票（0.10%）的微弱优势支持辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。这也是该次选举中结果最接近的一个州。

en.s: The 1844 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1844. Whig Governor William B. Cooper was unable to seek re-election to a second term. Thomas Stockton, the former New Castle County Register in Chancery, ran as the Whig nominee to succeed Cooper. He faced former State Senator William Tharp, the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 1844年特拉华州州长选举于11月5日举行。辉格党籍州长威廉·B·库珀不能竞选连任第二个任期。新卡斯尔县衡平法院登记官托马斯·斯托克顿作为辉格党提名人参选接替库珀，对手是民主党提名人、前州参议员威廉·索普。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Louisiana on November 5, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Louisiana voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay. Polk won Louisiana by a narrow margin of 2.6%.

zh.t: 1844年美国总统选举在路易斯安那州举行
zh.s: 1844年美国总统选举在路易斯安那州的投票于11月5日举行，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。路易斯安那州支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。波尔克以2.6个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: A presidential election was held in New Jersey on November 5, 1844 as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Jersey voted for the Whig candidate, Henry Clay, over Democratic candidate James K. Polk.

zh.t: 1844年美国总统选举在新泽西州举行
zh.s: 1844年美国总统选举在新泽西州的投票于11月5日举行，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。新泽西州支持辉格党候选人亨利·克莱，击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in New York
en.s: A presidential election was held in New York on November 5, 1844, as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose 36 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New York voted for the Democratic candidate, James K. Polk, over Whig candidate Henry Clay. Polk won New York by a narrow margin of 1.05%, making the state the second-closest in the country.

zh.t: 1844年美国总统选举在纽约州举行
zh.s: 1844年美国总统选举在纽约州的投票于11月5日举行，是1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出36名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。纽约州支持民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克，击败辉格党候选人亨利·克莱。波尔克以1.05个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州，这是全美竞争第二激烈的州。

en.s: The 1844 New York state elections was held on November 5, 1844, to elect the Governor, the Lieutenant Governor and four Canal Commissioners, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and eight members of the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1844年纽约州选举于1844年11月5日举行，选出州长、副州长、4名运河委员、纽约州众议院全体议员以及8名州参议员。

en.s: The 1844 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1844. Incumbent Governor William C. Bouck lost his bid for nomination to U.S. Senator Silas Wright. In the general election, Wright defeated former U.S. Representative and future President of the United States Millard Fillmore. Both Wright and Fillmore had been candidates for the vice presidency earlier in the year, but Wright declined the nomination by the Democratic National Convention, while Fillmore's active efforts were blocked by party boss Thurlow Weed.

zh.s: 1844年纽约州州长选举于1844年11月5日举行。现任州长威廉·C·布克未能赢得提名，提名由联邦参议员塞拉斯·赖特获得。普选中，赖特击败了前联邦众议员、后来的美国总统米勒德·菲尔莫尔。赖特和菲尔莫尔在当年早些时候都曾获提名竞选副总统，但赖特拒绝了民主党全国代表大会的提名，而菲尔莫尔积极争取提名的努力被党内领袖瑟洛·威德阻止。

en.s: The 1849 Louisiana gubernatorial election was the last of two elections to take place under the Louisiana Constitution of 1845. The new constitution abolished the provision in the 1812 constitution that required a gubernatorial candidate to win a vote of the legislature to get elected, leaving the final decision up to the people.

zh.s: 1849年路易斯安那州州长选举是依据1845年路易斯安那州宪法举行的两次选举中的最后一次。新宪法废除了1812年宪法中要求州长候选人必须获得州议会投票才能当选的规定，将最终决定权交给选民。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1850 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 5, 1850. Democrat George Franklin Fort defeated Whig nominee John Runk with 53.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 1850年新泽西州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党人乔治·富兰克林·福特击败辉格党提名人约翰·朗克，得票率为53.84%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1850 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1850. Incumbent Democratic Governor William Tharp was unable to seek re-election. Banker William H. H. Ross ran as the Democratic nominee to succeed Tharp and he faced former State Representative Peter F. Causey, the 1846 Whig nominee, and Temperance nominee Thomas Lockwood. Ross defeated Causey by a narrow margin, winning by just 23 votes and falling short of a majority.

zh.s: 1850年特拉华州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长威廉·索普不能竞选连任。银行家威廉·H·H·罗斯作为民主党提名人参选接替索普，对手包括前州众议员、1846年辉格党提名人彼得·F·考西，以及禁酒党提名人托马斯·洛克伍德。罗斯以微弱优势击败考西，仅领先23票，且未获得过半选票。

en.s: An election for Mayor of New York City was held on November 5, 1850. Whig Ambrose Kingsland defeated Democratic nominee Fernando Wood. This was the first of Wood's seven campaigns for mayor; he would serve three non-consecutive terms in office.

zh.s: 纽约市市长选举于1850年11月5日举行。辉格党候选人安布罗斯·金斯兰击败民主党候选人费尔南多·伍德。这是伍德7次竞选市长中的第一次；他后来曾三度出任市长，任期并不连续。

en.s: The 1850 New York state election was held on Tuesday November 5, 1850, to elect the Governor, the Lieutenant Governor, a Canal Commissioner, an Inspector of State Prisons and the Clerk of the Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly.

zh.s: 1850年纽约州选举于1850年11月5日星期二举行，选出州长、副州长、运河委员、州监狱视察员、上诉法院书记员以及纽约州众议院全体议员。

en.s: The Battle of Inkerman was fought during the Crimean War on 5 November 1854 by the allied armies of Britain and France against the Imperial Russian Army. The battle broke the will of the Russian Army to defeat the allies in the field, and was followed by the siege of Sevastopol. The role of troops fighting mostly on their own initiative due to the foggy conditions during the battle has earned the engagement the name "The Soldier's Battle."

zh.s: 因克曼战役于1854年11月5日在克里米亚战争期间爆发，交战双方是英国和法国联军与俄罗斯帝国军队。战役打垮了俄军在战场上击败联军的信心，之后塞瓦斯托波尔遭到围攻。由于雾大，士兵在战斗中大多自行作战，这场战役因此被称为“士兵之战”。

en.s: The 1855 Louisiana gubernatorial election was the second election to take place under the Louisiana Constitution of 1852. As a result of this election Robert C. Wickliffe became Governor of Louisiana.

zh.s: 1855年路易斯安那州州长选举是根据1852年《路易斯安那州宪法》举行的第二次选举。罗伯特·C.·威克利夫在此次选举后成为路易斯安那州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Canton was fought between British and Chinese forces at the city of Canton (Guangzhou), Guangdong province, China on 23 October to 5 November 1856 during the Second Opium War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次鸦片战争期间，英军与清军于1856年10月23日至11月5日在中国广东省广州交战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The siege of Gaeta was the concluding event of the war between the Kingdom of Sardinia and the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, part of the unification of Italy. It started on 5 November 1860 and ended on 13 February 1861, and took place in Gaeta, in today's Southern Lazio (Italy).

zh.s: 加埃塔围城战是撒丁王国与两西西里王国战争的最后一场战事，也是意大利统一进程的一部分。围城战于1860年11月5日开始，1861年2月13日结束，发生在今天意大利拉齐奥大区南部的加埃塔。

en.s: The 1861 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1861, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Attorney General Gordon E. Cole defeated Democratic nominee Wheeler Hazard Peckham.

zh.t: 1861年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1861年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人、现任总检察长戈登·E·科尔击败民主党提名人惠勒·哈扎德·佩卡姆。

en.s: The 1861 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1861, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Ignatius L. Donnelly defeated Democratic nominee Thomas Cowan.

zh.s: 1861年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人、现任副州长伊格内修斯·L·多内利击败民主党提名人托马斯·考恩。

en.s: The 1861 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1861, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State James H. Baker defeated Democratic nominee Daniel Buck.

zh.s: 1861年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人、现任州务卿詹姆斯·H·贝克击败民主党提名人丹尼尔·巴克。

en.s: The 1861 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1861. Republican Party candidate Louis P. Harvey won the election with 54% of the vote, defeating Democratic candidate Benjamin Ferguson. This was the first Wisconsin gubernatorial election to take place after the outbreak of the American Civil War, and Wisconsin Republicans joined War Democrats to form the Union Party during the war.

zh.s: 1861年威斯康星州州长选举于1861年11月5日举行。共和党候选人路易斯·P·哈维以54%的得票率当选，击败民主党候选人本杰明·弗格森。这是美国内战爆发后威斯康星州举行的首场州长选举。战争期间，威斯康星州共和党人与主战民主党人联合组成联邦党。

en.s: The 1861 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 5. Governor John Albion Andrew was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic Mayor of Worcester Isaac Davis.

zh.s: 1861年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月5日举行。州长约翰·阿尔比恩·安德鲁击败民主党候选人、伍斯特市长艾萨克·戴维斯，连任第二届。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Orange Free State on 5 November 1863. The result was a victory for Johannes Brand, who was inaugurated as the fourth President of the country on 2 February 1864.

zh.s: 奥兰治自由邦于1863年11月5日举行总统选举。约翰内斯·布兰德获胜，并于1864年2月2日就任该国第四任总统。

en.s: The 1867 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1867. Incumbent Republican Party Governor Lucius Fairchild won re-election with nearly 52% of the vote, defeating Democratic candidate John J. Tallmadge. This was the last election until 1894 in which a Republican carried Fond du Lac County.

zh.s: 1867年威斯康星州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长卢修斯·费尔柴尔德以近52%的得票率成功连任，击败民主党候选人约翰·J·塔尔米奇。这是1894年之前共和党最后一次赢得丰迪拉克县。

en.s: The 1867 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1867, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Thomas H. Armstrong defeated Democratic nominee Arba Maynard.

zh.s: 1867年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人、现任副州长托马斯·H·阿姆斯特朗击败民主党提名人阿尔巴·梅纳德。

en.s: The 1867 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1867. Incumbent Governor Thomas Swann did not run for re-election. Democratic Party candidate Oden Bowie defeated Republican candidate Hugh Lennox Bond. Bowie took his oath of office on January 8, 1868, but by a provision of the 1867 State Constitution, he did not actually become Governor until January 13, 1869.

zh.s: 1867年马里兰州州长选举于11月5日举行。现任州长托马斯·斯旺没有竞选连任。民主党候选人奥登·鲍伊击败共和党候选人休·伦诺克斯·邦德。鲍伊于1868年1月8日宣誓就职，但根据1867年州宪法的一项条款，他直到1869年1月13日才正式成为州长。

en.s: The 1867 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1867, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Henry C. Rogers defeated Democratic nominee and former Speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives Amos Coggswell.

zh.s: 1867年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人、现任州务卿亨利·C·罗杰斯击败民主党提名人、明尼苏达州众议院前议长阿莫斯·科格斯韦尔。

en.s: The 1867 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1867, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Francis R. E. Cornell defeated Democratic nominee and former Justice of the Supreme Court of Minnesota Territory Andrew G. Chatfield.

zh.t: 1867年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1867年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人、明尼苏达州众议院前议员弗朗西斯·R·E·康奈尔击败民主党提名人、明尼苏达领地最高法院前法官安德鲁·G·查特菲尔德。

en.s: The 1867 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1867, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent governor William Rainey Marshall was reelected to a second term.

zh.s: 1867年明尼苏达州州长选举于1867年11月5日举行，选出明尼苏达州州长。现任州长威廉·雷尼·马歇尔连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1867 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 5. Governor Alexander Bullock was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Democrat John Quincy Adams II.

zh.s: 1867年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月5日举行。州长亚历山大·布洛克击败民主党候选人约翰·昆西·亚当斯二世，连任第三届。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1872
en.s: The 1872 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 5, 1872. All contemporary 37 states were part of the 1872 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 35 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Ulysses S. Grant of Illinois and his running mate Senator Henry Wilson of Massachusetts. Grant and Wilson defeated the Liberal Republican and Democratic nominees, former Congressman Horace Greeley of New York and his running mate former Senator and Governor Benjamin Gratz Brown of Missouri.

zh.s: 1872年纽约州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。美国当时的37个州都参加了总统选举。纽约州选民选出35名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、伊利诺伊州籍现任总统尤利西斯·S·格兰特及其竞选搭档、马萨诸塞州参议员亨利·威尔逊赢得纽约州。格兰特和威尔逊击败了自由共和党与民主党共同提名的候选人、纽约州前联邦众议员霍勒斯·格里利及其竞选搭档、前参议员兼密苏里州前州长本杰明·格拉茨·布朗。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1872
en.s: The 1872 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 5, 1872. Texas voters chose 8 electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which chose the President and Vice President. Texas voted for the Liberal Republican nominee Horace Greeley, who received 57% of the vote. Greeley died before Congress could certify the results, leaving Texas electors (and the electors of five other states) free to vote for whoever they chose. All 8 electors voted for Thomas A. Hendricks.

zh.t: 1872年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1872年得克萨斯州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。得克萨斯州选出8名选举人，由他们代表该州投票选出总统和副总统。得克萨斯州支持自由共和党候选人霍勒斯·格里利，他获得57%的选票。格里利在国会认证结果前去世，得克萨斯州和另外五个州的选举人因此可以自行选择投票对象。8名选举人全部投给了托马斯·A·亨德里克斯。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1872
en.s: The 1872 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 5, 1872, as part of the 1872 United States presidential election. Voters chose eleven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Republican candidate, incumbent President Ulysses S. Grant over the Democratic and Liberal Republican candidate, former U.S. Representative Horace Greeley. This was the first presidential election that Virginia participated in after the events of the U.S. Civil War. It was also the first presidential election in which the state voted for a Republican candidate and would not occur again until 1928.

zh.t: 1872年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1872年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出11名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持共和党候选人、现任总统尤利西斯·S·格兰特，他击败了民主党与自由共和党候选人、前联邦众议员霍勒斯·格里利。这是美国内战后弗吉尼亚州首次参加总统选举，也是该州首次支持共和党总统候选人。此后直到1928年，该州才再次支持共和党总统候选人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1872 was the 22nd quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 5, 1872. The incumbent President Ulysses S. Grant was easily elected to a second term in office, with Senator Henry Wilson of Massachusetts as his running mate. Grant's decisive re-election was achieved in the face of a split within the Republican Party that resulted in a third party of Liberal Republicans nominating Horace Greeley to oppose Grant. This action caused the Democratic Party to cancel its convention, support Greeley as well, and not nominate a candidate of its own.

zh.s: 1872年美国总统选举是美国第22次四年一度的总统选举，于11月5日（星期二）举行。现任总统尤利西斯·S·格兰特轻松连任，参议员亨利·威尔逊担任竞选搭档。共和党内部分裂，催生了自由共和党这个第三党，并提名霍勒斯·格里利与格兰特竞争。自由共和党此举促使民主党取消本党大会，转而支持格里利，没有另行提名候选人。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1872
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1872 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 5, 1872. California gained one seat as a result of the 1870 Census, which the Republicans won. The Democrats, however, gained a Republican-held district.

zh.t: 1872年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1872年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，是联邦众议院大选的一部分。1870年人口普查后，加利福尼亚州增加了一个席位，该席位由共和党赢得。不过，民主党也从共和党手中夺下一个选区。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1872
en.s: The 1872 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 5, 1872. Wisconsin voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate and incumbent President Ulysses S. Grant won the state with 55% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's ten electoral votes.

zh.t: 1872年美国总统选举在威斯康星州举行
zh.s: 1872年美国总统选举在威斯康星州的投票于11月5日举行。选民选出10名选举人，组成选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任总统尤利西斯·S·格兰特赢得该州55%的普选票，并获得威斯康星州的10张选举人票。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1872
en.s: The 1872 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 5, 1872, as part of the 1872 United States presidential election. Voters chose 29 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican candidate, Ulysses S. Grant, over the Liberal Republican candidate, Horace Greeley. Grant won Pennsylvania by a margin of 24.42%.

zh.t: 1872年美国总统选举在宾夕法尼亚州举行

en.s: The 1872 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1872, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Republican David P. Lewis, a former Democrat and Confederate deputy, narrowly defeated former Confederate Army officer Thomas H. Herndon of the Democratic party by a margin of 4.48%. Alabama became the only state in the former Confederacy where Republicans regained power during Reconstruction after the state had been "redeemed" by the Democrats.

zh.s: 1872年阿拉巴马州州长选举于1872年11月5日举行，选出阿拉巴马州州长。共和党候选人大卫·P·刘易斯曾是民主党人，也是邦联军的一名副官。他以4.48个百分点的微弱优势击败民主党候选人、前邦联军军官托马斯·H·赫恩登。阿拉巴马州成为重建时期前邦联各州中唯一一个共和党重新执政的州；在此之前，该州曾由民主党重新控制。

Oglesby defeated the Democratic and Liberal Republican nominee Gustavus Koerner. B. G. Wright represented Independent Democrats unwilling to ally with Liberal Republicans. en.s: The Garnier Expedition was a French expedition in Tonkin between November 1873 and January 1874. Lieutenant Francis Garnier, who had been sent by France on the demand of Vietnamese Imperial authorities to bring back Jean Dupuis, an unruly French trader who was causing trouble in Hanoi, instead decided to side with Dupuis and captured the city of Hanoi, the capital of the Tonkin region.

en.s: The Hagi Rebellion (萩の乱, Hagi no ran) was an uprising against the Meiji government of Japan that occurred in Hagi from 28 October 1876 to 5 November 1876. Maebara Issei, a disillusioned hero of the Meiji Restoration and former samurai of the Chōshū Domain, planned an attack on Yamaguchi Prefecture officials inspired by the Shinpūren rebellion four days earlier.

zh.s: 萩之乱是1876年10月28日至11月5日在萩发生的一场反对日本明治政府的起义。明治维新功臣、长州藩前武士前原一诚对此感到失望；他受到四天前神风连之乱的影响，计划袭击山口县官员。

en.s: The 1878 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1878. Republican nominee John St. John defeated Democratic nominee John R. Goodin with 53.52% of the vote.

en.s: The 1878 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1878. Incumbent Democratic Governor John P. Cochran was unable to seek re-election. Former State Senator John W. Hall ran as the Democratic nominee to succeed Cochran. The Republican Party, chastened by its long string of defeats, failed to run a statewide candidate. Instead, the Greenback Party stepped in, and Kensey Johns Stewart ran as the Greenback nominee.

zh.s: 1878年特拉华州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·P·科克伦不能竞选连任。前州参议员约翰·W·霍尔作为民主党提名人参选接替科克伦。共和党在一连串长期败选后没有推出全州候选人，改由绿背党参选，其提名人是肯西·约翰斯·斯图尔特。

en.s: The 1878 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 5, 1878, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Orlan P. Whitcomb defeated Democratic nominee and former Mayor of Stillwater Mahlon Black, Greenback nominee Orin H. Page and Prohibition nominee Theodore G. Carter.

zh.s: 1878年明尼苏达州审计长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人、现任州审计长奥兰·P·惠特科姆击败民主党提名人、斯蒂尔沃特前市长马隆·布莱克、绿背党提名人奥林·H·佩奇和禁酒党提名人西奥多·G·卡特。

en.s: The November 1878 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1878. Republican nominee Nathaniel Head defeated Democratic nominee Frank A. McKean with 50.26% of the vote.

zh.t: 1878年11月新罕布什尔州州长选举
zh.s: 1878年11月新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人纳撒尼尔·黑德以50.26%的得票率击败民主党提名人弗兰克·A·麦基恩。

en.s: The 1878 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1878. Incumbent Republican governor Silas Garber did not seek reelection. This election featured Republican nominee Albinus Nance, the Speaker of the Nebraska House of Representatives, defeating Democratic nominee Colonel William H. Webster, a lawyer from Merrick County, Nebraska, and Greenback Party nominee Levi G. Todd, a former member of the Nebraska Territorial House of Representatives from Cass County, Nebraska.

zh.s: 1878年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长西拉斯·加伯没有竞选连任。共和党提名人、内布拉斯加州众议院议长阿尔比努斯·南斯击败民主党提名人、来自梅里克县的律师威廉·H·韦伯斯特和绿背党提名人、内布拉斯加领地众议院前议员利瓦伊·G·托德，当选州长。

en.s: The 1878 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 5. Former acting Governor Thomas Talbot, a Republican, defeated Benjamin Butler, who ran as an independent Greenback candidate with Democratic support. Butler's supporters secured a majority of delegates to the Democratic state convention, but his nomination was rejected by the state party committee after his supporters voted to exclude anti-Butler delegates from the convention hall.

zh.s: 1878年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人、前代理州长托马斯·塔尔博特击败民主党支持的独立绿背党候选人本杰明·巴特勒。巴特勒的支持者在民主党州代表大会上获得多数代表，但他们投票排除反对巴特勒的代表进入会场后，州党委员会拒绝提名巴特勒。

en.s: The 1878 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Democratic candidate and Chief Justice of the Texas Supreme Court Oran Milo Roberts defeated Greenback William H. Hamman and Republican Anthony Banning Norton by a wide margin.

zh.s: 1878年得克萨斯州州长选举选出该州州长。民主党候选人、得克萨斯州最高法院首席法官奥兰·米洛·罗伯茨以较大优势击败绿背党候选人威廉·H·哈曼和共和党候选人安东尼·班宁·诺顿。

en.s: The Battle of Shaykan was fought between Egyptian forces under the command of Hicks Pasha and the forces of Muhammad Ahmad, the self-proclaimed Mahdi, in the woods of Shaykan near Kashgil near the town of El Obeid during 3–5 November 1883.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

Gibson.

en.s: The 1895 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1895. It was the first gubernatorial election in the state of Utah and it was held before it became a state on the 4th of January, 1896, to set up the machinery for the new state. Republican Heber M. Wells defeated Democratic nominee John T. Caine with 50.32% of the vote.

zh.s: 1895年犹他州州长选举于11月5日举行。这是犹他州首次举行州长选举，当时该州还未正式建州；选举旨在为1896年1月4日建州做好准备。共和党人希伯·M·威尔斯以50.32%的得票率击败民主党提名人约翰·T·凯恩。

en.s: The 1895 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1895, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat John Marshall Stone was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 1895年密西西比州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·马歇尔·斯通受任期限制，不能竞选连续第二个任期。

en.s: In the 1895 Iowa State Senate elections Iowa voters elected state senators to serve in the twenty-sixth Iowa General Assembly. Elections were held in 31 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1895 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here. en.s: The 1895 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1895. Incumbent Governor Frank Brown did not seek re-election. Republican candidate Lloyd Lowndes Jr. defeated Democratic candidate John E. Hurst.

zh.s: 1895年马里兰州州长选举于11月5日举行。现任州长弗兰克·布朗没有竞选连任。共和党候选人小劳埃德·朗兹击败民主党候选人约翰·E·赫斯特。

en.s: The 1895 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 5, 1895, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland, held in the United States. Republican nominee Harry M. Clabaugh defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Maryland Senate Charles C. Crothers, Prohibition nominee William Frank Tucker and Independent candidate Bernard W. Monett.

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 5, 1901, in six states. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year. New Jersey at this time held gubernatorial elections every 3 years. It would abandon this practice in 1949. Massachusetts and Rhode Island at this time held gubernatorial elections every year.

zh.s: 1901年11月5日，美国6个州举行州长选举。当时弗吉尼亚州每四年在总统选举后的奇数年举行州长选举。新泽西州当时每三年举行一次州长选举，这一做法于1949年废止。当时马萨诸塞州和罗得岛州每年举行州长选举。

en.s: The 1901 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1901. Republican nominee Albert B. Cummins defeated Democratic nominee T. J. Phillips with 58.09% of the vote.

zh.s: 1901年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人阿尔伯特·B·卡明斯以58.09%的得票率击败民主党提名人T·J·菲利普斯。

en.s: The 1901 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1901. Incumbent Republican George K. Nash defeated Democratic nominee James Kilbourne with 52.70% of the vote.

zh.s: 1901年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长乔治·K·纳什以52.70%的得票率击败民主党提名人詹姆斯·基尔伯恩。

en.s: In the 1901 Iowa State Senate elections Iowa voters elected state senators in 21 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators traditionally serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. However, under the Biennial Elections law enacted in 1904 by the Iowa General Assembly, the senators elected in 1901 served an additional fifth year (until the 1906 elections) to accommodate the transition to holding elections on even-numbered years. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1901 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly. The 1901 elections occurred before primary elections were established in Iowa by the Primary Election Law in 1907. The general election took place on November 5, 1901.

zh.s: 1901年艾奥瓦州参议院选举于11月5日举行，选出该州50个州参议院选区中21个选区的州参议员。州参议员通常任期为四年，但根据艾奥瓦州议会1904年通过的两年一度选举法，1901年当选的参议员额外任职一年，至1906年选举，以配合改为偶数年举行选举。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1901年全州50个州参议院选区的地图。艾奥瓦州1907年通过初选选举法前，还没有初选。

en.s: The 1907 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1907, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat James K. Vardaman was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term.

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 5 November 1907, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 11 of the corporation's 34 seats were up for election, although only 2 were contested. This election saw the first municipal contests in Aberdeen with a candidate supported by the Aberdeen Labour Representation Committee (LRC). While unaffiliated with the national body that had formed in 1900, this local group was modeled and named the same.

zh.s: 1907年11月5日，苏格兰各地举行市政选举，阿伯丁市政公司也举行选举。该公司34个席位中有11席改选，但只有2席存在竞争。这是阿伯丁首次有由阿伯丁劳工代表委员会（LRC）支持的候选人参加市政选举。这个地方团体虽未加入1900年成立的全国组织，但采用了相同的模式和名称。

en.s: The 1907 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 5, 1907, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former comptroller Joshua W. en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1912
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in New Mexico was the first Federal Presidential Election in which New Mexico participated. It took place on November 5, 1912, and all 48 States participated in the election. New Mexico voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by New Jersey Governor Woodrow Wilson, in what was perhaps the most politically diverse election in United States history. Running for reelection against the reformist policies of Wilson was William H. Taft, who secured the Republican nomination over Theodore Roosevelt.

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1912 was the 32nd quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 5, 1912. The election was a rare four-way contest. It nominated Roosevelt and ran candidates for other offices in major states.

Idaho was won by New Jersey Governor Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with Indiana Governor Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在爱达荷州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊赢得爱达荷州。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by the 26th president of the United States Theodore Roosevelt (P–New York), running with governor of California Hiram Johnson, with 35.22% of the popular vote against the Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–New Jersey), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在华盛顿州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。华盛顿州支持进步党提名人、前总统西奥多·罗斯福；他与加利福尼亚州州长海勒姆·约翰逊搭档，获得35.22%的普选票。罗斯福的对手包括民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.s: The 1912 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, Missouri Attorney General Elliott Woolfolk Major, over the Republican candidate, former Lt. Gov. John C. McKinley, Progressive Albert D. Nortoni, and candidates representing the Socialist, Prohibition, and Socialist Labor parties. Major defeated former representative William S.

zh.s: 1912年密苏里州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党提名人、密苏里州总检察长埃利奥特·伍尔福克·梅杰击败共和党候选人、前副州长约翰·C·麦金利，进步党候选人阿尔伯特·D·诺托尼，以及社会党、禁酒党和社会主义工党候选人，当选州长。原文后续有关威廉·S.的句子残缺，未译入。

en.s: The 1912 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912, and featured Republican nominee Samuel Roy McKelvie defeating Democratic nominee Herman Diers as well as Socialist Party nominee W. T. Jeffryes and Prohibition Party nominee Theodore J. Shrode. On May 2, 1911, incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Melville R. Hopewell died while in office. After the death of Hopewell, John H.

zh.t: 1912年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1912年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人塞缪尔·罗伊·麦凯尔维击败民主党提名人赫尔曼·迪尔斯、社会党提名人W. T. 杰弗里斯和禁酒党提名人西奥多·J·施罗德。时任副州长梅尔维尔·R·霍普韦尔于1911年5月2日在任内去世。

en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Kansas was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–New Jersey), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在俄勒冈州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。俄勒冈州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1912, in 33 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 5, 1912 (except in Arkansas, Georgia, Maine and Vermont). In addition, there was a special election in Georgia on January 10, 1912. In Rhode Island, the governor was elected to a two-year term for the first time, instead of a one-year term.

zh.s: 1912年11月5日，美国33个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、参议院和总统选举同时举行，但阿肯色州、佐治亚州、缅因州和佛蒙特州除外。佐治亚州还于1912年1月10日举行了特别选举。罗得岛州州长任期首次改为两年，此前为一年。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举：内布拉斯加州
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在内布拉斯加州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。内布拉斯加州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1912 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1912 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on November 5, 1912, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the State of Oklahoma, one from each of the state's congressional districts and three at-large. The primary elections for the Republican, Democratic, and Socialist parties' nominations took place on August 6, 1912.

zh.t: 1912年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1912年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，选出该州8名联邦众议员，其中每个国会选区选出1人，另有3人通过全州单一选区选出。共和党、民主党和社会主义党的初选于1912年8月6日举行。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举：西弗吉尼亚州
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在西弗吉尼亚州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。西弗吉尼亚州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. During the Third Party System, Connecticut was one of a small number of critical swing states due to its opposing Democratic Catholic and Republican Yankee populations being closely matched at the polls.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在康涅狄格州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在康涅狄格州的投票于11月5日举行，与当时全部48个州的选举同日进行。选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。在第三政党体系时期，康涅狄格州是少数几个关键摇摆州之一，因为天主教民主党选民与共和党扬基人选民人数接近。

en.s: The 1912 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Democratic nominee George H. Hodges narrowly defeated Republican nominee Arthur Capper with 46.55% of the vote, winning by 29 votes or .01%.

zh.s: 1912年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党提名人乔治·H·霍奇斯以46.55%的得票率击败共和党提名人阿瑟·卡珀，仅领先29票，得票率差距为0.01个百分点。

en.s: The 1912 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1912, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Cornelius Roach defeated Republican nominee James J. Alford, Progressive nominee Frederick W. Niedermeyer, Socialist nominee Ernest T. Behrens, Prohibition nominee William H. Guenther and Socialist Labor nominee Clifton Holbrook.

zh.s: 1912年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月5日举行。民主党提名人、现任州务卿科尼利厄斯·罗奇击败共和党提名人詹姆斯·J·阿尔福德、进步党提名人弗雷德里克·W·尼德迈耶、社会主义党提名人欧内斯特·T·贝伦斯、禁酒党提名人威廉·H·冈瑟和社会主义劳工党提名人克利夫顿·霍尔布鲁克。

en.s: The 1912 Massachusetts gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1912. Democratic Governor Eugene Foss defeated the Republican candidate Joseph H. Walker and Progressive candidate Charles S. Bird.

zh.s: 1912年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍州长尤金·福斯击败共和党候选人约瑟夫·H·沃克和进步党候选人查尔斯·S·伯德。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose twelve representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在田纳西州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在田纳西州的投票于11月5日举行。田纳西州选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。南北战争结束后一个多世纪里，田纳西州的政治一直受战争时期形成的政治忠诚划分影响。

en.s: The 1912 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Incumbent Republican Aram J. Pothier defeated Democratic nominee Theodore F. Green with 43.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年罗得岛州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长阿拉姆·J·波蒂尔以43.67%的得票率击败民主党提名人西奥多·F·格林。

en.s: The 1912 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Incumbent second-term Republican governor Charles S. Deneen was defeated by the Democratic nominee, former mayor of Chicago Edward Fitzsimmons Dunne. Dunne was the first Democratic Governor of Illinois elected since 1892, and only the second since 1852. To date, this is the first and only time that a former mayor of Chicago (Illinois’ largest city) was elected governor of Illinois.

zh.s: 1912年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍连任两届的现任州长查尔斯·S·德宁败给民主党提名人、芝加哥前市长爱德华·菲茨西蒙斯·邓恩。邓恩是自1892年以来首位当选伊利诺伊州州长的民主党人，也是自1852年以来第二位民主党州长。截至目前，这也是芝加哥前市长首次且唯一一次当选伊利诺伊州州长。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Like all former Confederate states, North Carolina would during its “Redemption” develop a politics based upon Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在北卡罗来纳州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在北卡罗来纳州的投票于11月5日举行，是1912年美国总统选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。与其他前邦联州一样，北卡罗来纳州在“重建”结束后形成了一种政治格局，其基础是吉姆·克劳法、剥夺非洲裔美国人的选举权，以及民主党的主导地位。

en.t: 1912 United States House of Representatives election in Arizona
en.s: The 1912 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona was held on Tuesday November 5, 1912 to elect the state's sole at-large representative. incumbent democrat, Carl Hayden won re-election with 48% of the vote. Primary elections were held on September 10, 1912.

zh.t: 1912年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1912年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举于11月5日星期二举行，选出该州全州单一选区的联邦众议员。民主党籍现任众议员卡尔·海登以48%的得票率成功连任。初选于1912年9月10日举行。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island was won by the Democratic Party nominees, New Jersey Governor Woodrow Wilson and Indiana Governor Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在罗得岛州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊赢得罗得岛州。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by governor of New Jersey Woodrow Wilson (D), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在密苏里州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出18名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密苏里州支持民主党提名人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina was won by the Democratic nominees, New Jersey Governor Woodrow Wilson and Indiana Governor Thomas R.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举：南卡罗来纳州
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在南卡罗来纳州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。当时美国本土48州都参加了这次选举。该州选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊赢得南卡罗来纳州。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire was won by the Democratic nominees, New Jersey Governor Woodrow Wilson and Indiana Governor Thomas R.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举：新罕布什尔州
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在新罕布什尔州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。当时美国本土48州都参加了这次选举。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊赢得新罕布什尔州。

en.s: The 1912 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1912. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate J. A. A. Burnquist defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Winn Powers, Public Ownership Party candidate D. M. Robertson, and Prohibition Party candidate George H. Andrews.

zh.s: 1912年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月5日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人J. A. A. 伯恩奎斯特击败明尼苏达州民主党候选人温·鲍尔斯、公共所有权党候选人D. M. 罗伯逊和禁酒党候选人乔治·H·安德鲁斯。

en.s: The 1912 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1912, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Julius A. Schmahl defeated Democratic nominee Harvey W. Grimmer, Socialist nominee John Alvin Johnson, Progressive nominee Marion S. Norelius and Prohibition nominee Charles L. Johnson.

zh.s: 1912年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月5日举行，以选出州务卿。共和党候选人、现任州务卿朱利叶斯·A·施马尔击败民主党候选人哈维·W·格里默、社会主义党候选人约翰·阿尔文·约翰逊、进步党候选人马里恩·S·诺雷柳斯和禁酒党候选人查尔斯·L·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1912 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Incumbent Governor Albert W. Gilchrist was term-limited. Democratic nominee Park Trammell was elected with 80.42% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月5日举行。时任州长阿尔伯特·W·吉尔克里斯特受任期限制，无法再次参选。民主党候选人帕克·特拉梅尔以80.42%的得票率当选。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在肯塔基州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。肯塔基州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.s: The 1912 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1912, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee John T. Barker defeated Republican nominee James H. Mason, Progressive nominee and incumbent mayor of Princeton Arthur M. Hyde, Socialist nominee Walter Bundy, Prohibition nominee Richard B. Wilcox and Socialist Labor nominee George H. Bloebaum.

zh.s: 1912年密苏里州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。民主党候选人约翰·T·巴克击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·H·梅森、进步党候选人兼普林斯顿市现任市长阿瑟·M·海德、社会主义党候选人沃尔特·邦迪、禁酒党候选人理查德·B·威尔科克斯和社会主义劳工党候选人乔治·H·布洛鲍姆。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Ohio took place on November 5, 1912 as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose 24 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Ohio was won by the Democratic nominee Woodrow Wilson and his running mate Thomas R. Marshall.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在俄亥俄州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在俄亥俄州的投票于11月5日举行。该州选民选出24名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人伍德罗·威尔逊及其竞选搭档托马斯·R·马歇尔赢得俄亥俄州。

en.s: The 1912 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Democratic nominee James M. Cox defeated Republican nominee Robert B. Brown with 42.38% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·M·考克斯击败共和党候选人罗伯特·B·布朗，得票率为42.38%。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在怀俄明州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。怀俄明州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oklahoma was won by the Democratic nominees, governor of New Jersey Woodrow Wilson and governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举：俄克拉何马州
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在俄克拉何马州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊赢得俄克拉何马州。

en.s: The 1912 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1912, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent acting attorney general Lyndon A. Smith defeated Democratic nominee William F. Donohue and Prohibition nominee J.H. Morse.

zh.s: 1912年明尼苏达州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。共和党候选人、代理检察长林登·A·史密斯击败民主党候选人威廉·F·多诺休和禁酒党候选人J. H. 莫尔斯。

en.s: The 1912 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Incumbent Republican Governor Chester Hardy Aldrich was defeated for re-election by Democratic nominee John H. Morehead.

zh.s: 1912年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长切斯特·哈代·奥尔德里奇未能连任，败给民主党候选人约翰·H·莫雷黑德。

en.s: The 1912 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Democratic nominee Samuel D. Felker defeated Republican nominee Franklin Worcester with 41.07% of the vote. Former president Theodore Roosevelt's Progressive Party did make a strong third-party showing and may have swung the election in disfavour of the Republican ticket.

zh.s: 1912年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人塞缪尔·D·费尔克以41.07%的得票率击败共和党候选人富兰克林·伍斯特。前总统西奥多·罗斯福的进步党也取得了显著的第三党成绩，可能因此改变了选情，使共和党候选人失利。

en.s: The 1912 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Incumbent Republican governor Ben W. Hooper defeated former Democratic governor Benton McMillin with 50.10% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年田纳西州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长本·W·胡珀以50.10%的得票率击败前民主党籍州长本顿·麦克米林。

en.s: The 1912 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 5, 1912, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor John Pemberton Gordon defeated Republican nominee William J. Mauthe, Progressive nominee A. J. Reynolds, Socialist nominee Philip Wagner, Prohibition nominee Orlando V. Wager and Socialist Labor nominee John W. Neumann.

zh.s: 1912年密苏里州审计长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长约翰·彭伯顿·戈登击败共和党候选人威廉·J·莫瑟、进步党候选人A. J. 雷诺兹、社会主义党候选人菲利普·瓦格纳、禁酒党候选人奥兰多·V·韦格和社会主义劳工党候选人约翰·W·诺伊曼。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in California took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Theodore Roosevelt received 11 electors by winning 174 more votes than Woodrow Wilson, who received 2 electors. This was the closest presidential election in California history.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在加利福尼亚州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在加利福尼亚州的投票于11月5日举行。该州选民选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。西奥多·罗斯福领先伍德罗·威尔逊174票，赢得11名选举人；威尔逊获得2名选举人。这是加利福尼亚州历史上差距最小的一次总统选举。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举：北达科他州
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在北达科他州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。北达科他州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arkansas was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在阿肯色州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.s: The 1912 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Democratic nominee Samuel M. Ralston defeated Progressive nominee Albert J. Beveridge and Republican nominee Winfield T. Durbin with 42.95% of the vote. The vote splitting between the Republican and Progressive nominees benefited Democrat Ralston tremendously in this election.

zh.s: 1912年印第安纳州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人塞缪尔·M·拉尔斯顿以42.95%的得票率击败进步党候选人阿尔伯特·J·贝弗里奇和共和党候选人温菲尔德·T·德宾。共和党和进步党候选人分散了选票，大大有利于拉尔斯顿。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following the Panic of 1893 and the Populist movement, Michigan would turn from a competitive Republican-leaning state into a rigidly one-party polity dominated by the Republican Party.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在密歇根州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在密歇根州的投票于11月5日举行。该州选民选出15名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。1893年恐慌和民粹主义运动之后，密歇根州逐渐从一个倾向共和党的竞争州变成由共和党主导的一党州。

en.t: 1912 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1912 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 63rd United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 5, 1912, while Maine and Vermont held theirs in September. They coincided with the election of President Woodrow Wilson.

zh.s: 1912年美国联邦众议院选举是为选出第63届国会众议员而举行的选举。大部分选举于1912年11月5日举行，缅因州和佛蒙特州则在9月举行。选举与伍德罗·威尔逊当选总统同日进行。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the governor of New Jersey Woodrow Wilson and the governor of Indiana Thomas R. Marshall defeated the Progressive ticket of the former president of the United States Theodore Roosevelt and the governor of California Hiram Johnson.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在印第安纳州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在印第安纳州的投票于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊及其竞选搭档、印第安纳州州长托马斯·R·马歇尔，击败了进步党候选人、前美国总统西奥多·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州州长海勒姆·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1912 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Primary elections were held on September 3, 1912. Incumbent Republican Governor Francis E. McGovern defeated Democratic nominee John C. Karel and Socialist nominee Carl D. Thompson, with 45.54% of the vote. This was the closest gubernatorial election in Wisconsin during the Fourth Party System and one of only two decided by single digits during that era.

zh.s: 1912年威斯康星州州长选举于11月5日举行，初选于同年9月3日举行。共和党籍现任州长弗朗西斯·E·麦戈文击败民主党候选人约翰·C·卡雷尔和社会主义党候选人卡尔·D·汤普森，得票率为45.54%。这是第四政党体系时期威斯康星州差距最小的一次州长选举，也是这一时期仅有的两场得票率差距为个位数的州长选举之一。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Texas voters chose 20 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Texas was won by Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举：得克萨斯州
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在得克萨斯州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出20名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。得克萨斯州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In Arizona, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a state, as in the other states.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在亚利桑那州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在亚利桑那州的投票于11月5日举行。该州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。与其他州不同，亚利桑那州选民是分别投票选举每一名选举人。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Mississippi voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi was won by the Princeton University President Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举：密西西比州
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在密西西比州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密西西比州支持民主党提名人伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine was won by the Democratic nominees, New Jersey Governor Woodrow Wilson and Indiana Governor Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在缅因州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊赢得缅因州。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 5, 1912. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the disfranchisement of black Americans at the beginning of the 1890s, Florida had been a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在佛罗里达州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在佛罗里达州于11月5日举行。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。自19世纪90年代初剥夺非裔美国人选举权后，佛罗里达州一直是由民主党执政的一党州。

en.s: The 1912 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Republican nominee George W. Clarke defeated Democratic nominee Edward G. Dunn with 39.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人乔治·W·克拉克以39.93%的得票率击败民主党候选人爱德华·G·邓恩。

en.s: The 1912 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Republican nominee L. B. Hanna defeated Democratic nominee Frank O. Hellstrom with 45.45% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年北达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人L. B. 汉纳以45.45%的得票率击败民主党候选人弗兰克·O·赫尔斯特罗姆。

en.s: The 1912 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Though Republican Governor Simeon S. Pennewill was eligible for re-election, State Senator Charles R. Miller was nominated by the state Republican convention. With the nationwide rise of the Progressive Party, Delaware Republicans were keen to not lose the race due to a strong showing by a Progressive candidate; Miller was seen as amenable to all factions of the Republican Party and to Progressives.

zh.s: 1912年特拉华州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍州长西缅·S·彭纽威尔虽符合连任资格，但州共和党大会提名了州参议员查尔斯·R·米勒。进步党在全国兴起后，特拉华州共和党人担心强劲的进步党候选人会导致他们败选；他们认为米勒能得到共和党内各派和进步党人的支持。

en.s: The 1912 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Democratic nominee Locke Craig defeated Progressive nominee Iredell Meares with 61.35% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人洛克·克雷格以61.35%的得票率击败进步党候选人艾雷德尔·米尔斯。

en.s: The 1912 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Incumbent Democrat Simeon E. Baldwin defeated Republican nominee J. P. Studley with 41.11% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长西缅·E·鲍德温以41.11%的得票率击败共和党候选人J. P. 斯塔德利。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by governor of New Jersey Woodrow Wilson (D–New Jersey), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在马里兰州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党提名人、新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊赢得马里兰州。

en.s: The 1912 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 5, 1912, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives Edwin P. Deal defeated Republican nominee Daniel H. Hoefer, Progressive nominee John Ball, Socialist nominee W. W. McAllister, Prohibition nominee Leonard R. Woods and Socialist Labor nominee Otto Schwitzgebel.

zh.t: 1912年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1912年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月5日举行，以选出州财政部长。民主党候选人、密苏里州众议员埃德温·P·迪尔击败共和党候选人丹尼尔·H·霍弗、进步党候选人约翰·鲍尔、社会主义党候选人W. W. 麦卡利斯特、禁酒党候选人伦纳德·R·伍兹和社会主义劳工党候选人奥托·施维茨格贝尔。

en.s: The 1912 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Democratic nominee Woodbridge N. Ferris defeated Republican candidate Amos S. Musselman and Progressive candidate Lucius Whitney Watkins with 35.35% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年密歇根州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人伍德布里奇·N·费里斯以35.35%的得票率击败共和党候选人阿莫斯·S·穆塞尔曼和进步党候选人卢修斯·惠特尼·沃特金斯。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose twelve representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Over the preceding twenty years, Alabama had become effectively a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在阿拉巴马州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在阿拉巴马州的投票于11月5日举行。阿拉巴马州选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。在此之前的20年里，阿拉巴马州已基本成为由民主党执政的一党州。

en.s: The 1912 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Republican nominee John M. Haines defeated Democratic incumbent James H. Hawley with 33.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年爱达荷州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人约翰·M·海恩斯以33.24%的得票率击败民主党籍现任州长詹姆斯·H·霍利。

en.s: The 1912 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Incumbent Republican Governor Robert S. Vessey declined to run for re-election to a third term. Lieutenant Governor Frank M. Byrne won the Republican primary to succeed Vessey, and then faced State Senator Edwin S. Johnson, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Byrne only narrowly defeated Johnson, winning just 49% of the vote to Johnson's 46%, the closest gubernatorial election since 1898.

zh.s: 1912年南达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·S·维西拒绝竞选第三个任期。副州长弗兰克·M·伯恩在共和党初选中获胜，成为维西的接班人候选人，并在大选中对阵民主党候选人、州参议员埃德温·S·约翰逊。伯恩仅以微弱优势击败约翰逊，得票率为49%，约翰逊为46%，这是自1898年以来差距最小的一次州长选举。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Utah was held on November 5, 1912 as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. After being overwhelmingly carried by William Jennings Bryan in its first presidential election from its statehood year of 1896, Utah was to vote Republican by increasing margins in the following three elections, with only Washington County in the Dixie region voting Democratic in 1904 and 1908.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在犹他州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在犹他州于11月5日举行。该州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。犹他州于1896年建州并首次参加总统选举时，威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩在当地获得压倒性支持；此后连续三届选举中，共和党在犹他州的优势不断扩大。1904年和1908年，只有迪克西地区的华盛顿县投票支持民主党。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana became a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在路易斯安那州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在路易斯安那州的投票于11月5日举行。该州选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。1898年新宪法通过后，路易斯安那州成为由民主党主导的一党州。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by Princeton University President and governor of New Jersey Woodrow Wilson (D–Virginia), running with governor of Indiana Thomas R.

zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举于11月5日在特拉华州举行。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。特拉华州支持民主党提名人、时任新泽西州州长伍德罗·威尔逊。

en.s: The 1912 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912, in order to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic governor Oscar Branch Colquitt easily won re-election to a second term, defeating his token opposition from various other parties.

zh.s: 1912年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出州长。民主党籍现任州长奥斯卡·布兰奇·科尔奎特轻松连任，开始第二个任期，其他政党的候选人都没有构成有力挑战。

en.s: The 1912 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Democratic nominee William Rock Painter defeated Republican nominee Hiram Lloyd, Progressive nominee James M. Burrus, Socialist nominee Richard Hatham, Prohibition nominee Julius C. Hughes and Socialist Labor nominee Sidney Johnson.

zh.s: 1912年密苏里州副州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出副州长。民主党候选人威廉·罗克·佩因特击败共和党候选人海勒姆·劳埃德、进步党候选人詹姆斯·M·伯勒斯、社会主义党候选人理查德·哈瑟姆、禁酒党候选人朱利叶斯·C·休斯和社会主义劳工党候选人西德尼·约翰逊。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by Woodrow Wilson with 39.7% of the vote. Theodore Roosevelt followed with 27.94%, Eugene V. Debs 16.47%, and Taft 15.89%.

zh.t: 1912年美国总统选举在内华达州举行
zh.s: 1912年美国总统选举在内华达州的投票于11月5日举行。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。伍德罗·威尔逊在内华达州以39.7%的得票率获胜。西奥多·罗斯福得票率为27.94%，尤金·V·德布斯为16.47%，塔夫脱为15.89%。

en.s: The 1912 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Incumbent Republican William Spry defeated Democratic nominee John Franklin Tolton with 38.17% of the vote against his 32.36% in a four-way race, with Progressive nominee Nephi L. Morris winning 21.16% of the vote, and Socialist nominee Homer P. Burt winning 7.89% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年犹他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长威廉·斯普赖以38.17%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·富兰克林·托尔顿，后者得票率为32.36%。这是一场四方竞争；进步党候选人尼菲·L·莫里斯和社会主义党候选人霍默·P·伯特分别获得21.16%和7.89%的选票。

en.s: The 1912 Montana gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Democratic nominee Sam V. Stewart defeated Republican nominee Harry L. Wilson, Progressive nominee Frank J. Edwards and Socialist nominee Lewis Johnstone Duncan with 31.81% of the vote.

zh.s: 1912年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人萨姆·V·斯图尔特以31.81%的得票率击败共和党候选人哈里·L·威尔逊、进步党候选人弗兰克·J·爱德华兹和社会主义党候选人刘易斯·约翰斯通·邓肯。

en.t: 1912 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1912 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 5, 1912, as part of the 1912 United States presidential election. Georgia voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1912年佐治亚州美国总统选举于1912年11月5日举行，是1912年美国总统选举的一部分。佐治亚州选民选出14名代表或选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。自19世纪80年代以来，除北佐治亚州少数历史上支持联邦的一些县外，佐治亚州一直由民主党主导，实行一党执政；其中以范宁县最为明显，皮肯斯县、吉尔默县和汤斯县的情况则没有那么突出。

en.s: The 1912 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1912. Democratic nominee Ernest Lister defeated Republican incumbent Marion E. Hay with 30.55% of the vote. Lister was voted in with the smallest percentage of the vote in a gubernatorial election in the 1900s. This was the first election in Washington in which women had the right to vote.

zh.s: 1912年华盛顿州州长选举于1912年11月5日举行。民主党候选人欧内斯特·利斯特以30.55%的得票率击败共和党现任州长马里昂·E·海伊。这是20世纪得票率最低的州长选举，利斯特以最低得票率当选。这也是华盛顿州女性首次拥有投票权的选举。

en.s: The 1912 Iowa Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1912 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 29 of the senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1912 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1912年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是1912年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在参议院50个选区中的29个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期为4年。艾奥瓦州议会网站提供了1912年选举所采用的50个州参议院选区地图。

en.s: The Battle of Prilep in the First Balkan War took place on 3-5 November 1912 when the Serbian army encountered Ottoman troops near the town of Prilep, in today's North Macedonia. The clash lasted for three days. Eventually the Ottoman army was overwhelmed and forced to retreat. Bad weather and difficult roads hampered the 1st Army’s pursuit of the Ottomans after the battle of Kumanovo, forcing the Morava Division to move ahead of the Drina Division.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次巴尔干战争期间，塞尔维亚军队于1912年11月3日至5日在普里莱普附近与奥斯曼军队交战。战斗持续三天，最终奥斯曼军队被击败并被迫撤退。科曼诺沃战役后，恶劣天气和道路状况阻碍了第一集团军追击奥斯曼军队，迫使摩拉瓦师先于德里纳师前进。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。
