en.t: King Otto of Bavaria is deposed by his cousin, Prince Regent Ludwig, who assumes the title Ludwig III
en.s: Otto (German: Otto Wilhelm Luitpold Adalbert Waldemar; 27 April 1848 – 11 October 1916) was King of Bavaria from 1886 until 1913. However, he never actively ruled because of severe mental illness. His uncle, Luitpold, and his cousin, Ludwig, served as regents. Ludwig deposed him in 1913, a day after the legislature passed a law allowing him to do so, and became king in his own right as Ludwig III.

zh.t: 巴伐利亚国王奥托遭废黜，摄政王路德维希继位为路德维希三世
zh.s: 奥托（德语全名：Otto Wilhelm Luitpold Adalbert Waldemar，1848年4月27日—1916年10月11日）自1886年至1913年担任巴伐利亚国王。由于患有严重精神疾病，他从未实际执政。他的叔父利奥波德和堂弟路德维希担任摄政王。1913年，路德维希在议会通过授权其废黜奥托的法律次日将奥托废黜，并以路德维希三世之名自行登基。

en.s: The Battle of Tanga, also known as the Battle of the Bees, was an unsuccessful invasion of the Port of Tanga in German East Africa by the British Indian Expeditionary Force "B" on 3–5 November 1914 during World War I. Under the command of the Major-General Arthur Aitken, British forces attacked Tanga in concert with Indian Expeditionary Force "C", which concomitantly attempted to capture Longido.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，英国印度远征军“B”部队于1914年11月3日至5日进攻德属东非坦噶港，试图入侵该地，但未能成功。这场战役也称“蜜蜂之战”。亚瑟·艾特肯少将指挥英军进攻坦噶；印度远征军“C”部队同时试图攻占隆吉多。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Niš was a military engagement between the army of the Kingdom of Bulgaria with support from the German Empire against the Kingdom of Serbia in November 1915, during the Central Powers Morava Offensive of World War I. City of Niš, serving as a capital of Serbia after the fall of Belgrade, was captured between 4 and 5 November 1915 by the forces of 9th Pleven Division of Bulgarian First Army.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，在中央同盟国摩拉瓦攻势中，保加利亚王国军队在德意志帝国支援下，与塞尔维亚王国军队交战。贝尔格莱德陷落后，尼什成为塞尔维亚首都。1915年11月4日至5日，保加利亚第一军第九普列文师攻占了这座城市。

en.s: The Everett Massacre (also known as Bloody Sunday) was an armed confrontation between local authorities and members of the Industrial Workers of the World (IWW) union, commonly called "Wobblies". It took place in Everett, Washington on Sunday, November 5, 1916. The event marked a time of rising tensions in Pacific Northwest labor history.

zh.s: 埃弗里特大屠杀又称“血腥星期日”，是当地执法部门与世界产业工人联盟（IWW，成员通常被称为“摇摆族”）成员之间的一场武装冲突。事件于1916年11月5日星期日在华盛顿州埃弗里特发生，是太平洋西北地区劳工史上紧张局势加剧的一个标志。

en.s: The action of 5 November 1916 was a naval engagement of the First World War. The action was fought between a Royal Navy submarine and a dreadnought squadron of the Imperial German Navy. This action took place in the months after the Battle of Jutland and is significant in that it signalled a major shift in German naval policy.

zh.s: 1916年11月5日海战是第一次世界大战期间的一次海上交战，参战双方为一艘英国皇家海军潜艇和一支德国帝国海军无畏舰分舰队。战斗发生在日德兰海战后的几个月，并促使德国海军政策发生重大转变。

en.s: The 1918 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1918 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched incumbent Republican James Withycombe against Democratic State Senator Walter M. Pierce. Withycombe's reelection campaign capitalized on his wartime acts, portraying him as a wartime Governor actively protecting the state and aiding the defense of the United States. Withycombe died in office in March 1919, just two months into his second term. As prescribed by Oregon law, Oregon Secretary of State Ben Olcott succeeded Withycombe in office.

zh.s: 1918年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出州长。共和党籍现任州长詹姆斯·威西康比与民主党州参议员沃尔特·M·皮尔斯竞争。威西康比在竞选中强调自己在战时保护俄勒冈州、协助美国国防的表现，并以此争取连任。他于1919年3月在第二个任期开始仅两个月后去世。根据俄勒冈州法律，州务卿本·奥尔科特接任州长。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1918
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent United States Senator Thomas J. Walsh, who was first elected to the Senate in 1912, ran for re-election. He won the Democratic primary uncontested, and was opposed in the general election by Oscar M. Lanstrum, a former State Representative and the Republican nominee, and Jeannette Rankin, the United States Congresswoman from Montana's at-large congressional district and the National Party nominee. Ultimately, Walsh narrowly won his second term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1918年蒙大拿州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1918年蒙大拿州美国联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。1912年首次当选的现任参议员托马斯·J·沃尔什竞选连任。他在民主党初选中没有对手；大选对手包括前州众议员、共和党候选人奥斯卡·M·兰斯特鲁姆，以及蒙大拿州单一联邦众议院选区的联邦众议员、国家党候选人珍妮特·兰金。沃尔什最终以微弱优势赢得第二个参议员任期。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 1918
en.s: The U.S. House election, 1918 was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 5, 1918, which occurred in the middle of President Woodrow Wilson's second term. With the country now in World War I (contrary to previous promises by Wilson), and Wilson's personal popularity ebbing, the Republican Party was able to gain 25 seats and take over control of the House from Wilson's Democratic Party. Internal divide among Democratic leadership over aspects related to payment of the war also decreased the unity of the party, which had been the organization's strength during the decade.

zh.s: 1918年美国联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，正值伍德罗·威尔逊第二个总统任期中段。当时美国已参加第一次世界大战，这与威尔逊此前的承诺相反，他本人的支持度也在下降。共和党因此增加25席，从威尔逊所属的民主党手中夺回众议院控制权。民主党领导层内部在战争开支等问题上存在分歧，进一步削弱了该党在此前十年间赖以团结的基础。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1918
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1918 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 5, 1918. Democrats and Republicans swapped seats, leaving California's House delegation unchanged at 6 Republicans, 4 Democrats, and 1 Prohibition incumbent.

zh.t: 1918年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1918年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，是联邦众议院大选的一部分。民主党和共和党互换席位后，加州联邦众议院代表团席位分布未变：共和党6席、民主党4席，另有1名禁酒党籍现任议员。

en.s: The 1918 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1918. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate J. A. A. Burnquist defeated Farmer–Labor Party challenger David H. Evans. This is the first gubernatorial election in Minnesota with a Farmer–Labor candidate.

zh.s: 1918年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月5日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人J·A·A·伯恩奎斯特击败农工党挑战者戴维·H·埃文斯。这是明尼苏达州州长选举中首次有农工党候选人参选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1918 occurred on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican governor Martin Brumbaugh was not a candidate for re-election. Republican candidate William Sproul defeated Democratic candidate Eugene C. Bonniwell to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1918年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长马丁·布伦博没有参选连任。共和党候选人威廉·斯普劳尔击败民主党候选人尤金·C·邦尼韦尔，当选州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1918 took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Horace F. Graham, per the "Mountain Rule", did not run for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Percival W. Clement defeated Democratic candidate William B. Mayo to succeed him.

zh.s: 1918年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月5日举行。根据“山地规则”，共和党籍现任州长霍勒斯·F·格雷厄姆没有竞选连任第二个任期。共和党候选人珀西瓦尔·W·克莱门特击败民主党候选人威廉·B·梅奥，接任州长。

zh.s: 1918年加利福尼亚州州长选举于1918年11月5日举行。

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1918
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1918 in Massachusetts was held on November 5, 1918 with Democrat David I. Walsh defeating incumbent John W. Weeks.

zh.t: 1918年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1918年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党人戴维·I·沃尔什击败共和党籍现任参议员约翰·W·威克斯。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1918, in 32 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 5, 1918. Elections took place on September 9 in Maine.

zh.s: 1918年11月5日，美国32个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行。缅因州的州长选举于9月9日举行。

en.s: The 1918 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918, and featured Republican nominee Pelham A. Barrows defeating Democratic nominee William B. Banning as well as Prohibition Party nominee David B. Gilbert. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Edgar Howard decided not to seek reelection to the office of lieutenant governor in order to run for US Senate, but he was defeated in the Democratic primaries by John H.

zh.t: 1918年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1918年副州长选举于11月5日在内布拉斯加州举行。共和党提名人佩勒姆·A·巴罗击败民主党提名人威廉·B·班宁以及禁酒党提名人大卫·B·吉尔伯特，当选副州长。时任副州长埃德加·霍华德没有寻求连任，转而竞选联邦参议员，但在民主党初选中败给约翰·H.。

en.s: The 1918 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Governor Peter Norbeck ran for re-election to a second term. He won the Republican primary unopposed and faced Nonpartisan League candidate Mark P. Bates, a farmer, and Democratic nominee James E. Bird in the general election. Norbeck's share of the vote decreased from 1916 to 53%, but he benefited from the split field.

zh.s: 1918年南达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长彼得·诺贝克竞选连任第二个任期。他在共和党初选中无人挑战，随后在大选中面对无党派联盟候选人、农民马克·P·贝茨，以及民主党候选人詹姆斯·E·伯德。诺贝克的得票率从1916年下降至53%，但得益于对手分散，他仍然获胜。

en.s: The 1918 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Primary elections were held on September 3, 1918. Incumbent Republican Governor Emanuel L. Philipp won the election with 46.99% of the vote, winning his third and last term as governor. Philipp defeated Democratic Party candidate Henry A. Moehlenpah and Socialist candidate Emil Seidel.

zh.s: 1918年威斯康星州州长选举于11月5日举行，初选于同年9月3日举行。共和党籍现任州长伊曼纽尔·L·菲利普以46.99%的得票率获胜，开始自己第三个也是最后一个州长任期。他击败了民主党候选人亨利·A·默伦帕和社会主义党候选人埃米尔·塞德尔。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 5, 1918, concurrently with the United States Senate elections in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator John K. Shields won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican candidate Henry Clay Evans.

zh.t: 1918年美国参议院选举在田纳西州举行
zh.s: 1918年美国参议院选举在田纳西州于11月5日举行，与其他州的参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及多项州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员约翰·K·希尔兹击败共和党候选人亨利·克莱·埃文斯，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 5, 1918. It was the second direct U.S. Senate election in Colorado following the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment, and the first for the Class 2 Senate seat. Democratic senator John F. Shafroth ran for re-election to a second term, and was opposed by Denver businessman Lawrence C. Phipps, the Republican nominee, in the general election.

zh.t: 1918年美国参议院选举在科罗拉多州举行
zh.s: 1918年美国参议院选举在科罗拉多州于11月5日举行。这是美国宪法第十七修正案获批准后，科罗拉多州举行的第二次参议员直选，也是首次选举第二区参议员。民主党籍参议员约翰·F·沙夫罗斯竞选连任第二个任期，在大选中面对共和党候选人、丹佛商人劳伦斯·C·菲普斯。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Michigan took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Senator William Alden Smith did not seek re-election to a third term in office. In the race to succeed him, Republican former Secretary of the Navy Truman Handy Newberry defeated the automobile industrialist Henry Ford. Ford first challenged Newberry in the Republican primary and lost and then faced Newberry again, running as the Democratic nominee in the general election.

zh.t: 1918年美国参议院选举在密歇根州举行
zh.s: 1918年美国参议院选举在密歇根州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员威廉·奥尔登·史密斯没有竞选第三个任期。共和党前海军部长杜鲁门·汉迪·纽伯里在选举中击败汽车业实业家亨利·福特，接替他的席位。福特先在共和党初选中挑战纽伯里但落败，随后以民主党候选人身份在大选中再次与纽伯里对决。

en.s: The 1918 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Democratic Governor Charles Hillman Brough won re-election to a second term, defeating Socialist nominee Clay Fulks with 93.43% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年阿肯色州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长查尔斯·希尔曼·布劳连任第二个任期，以93.43%的得票率击败社会主义党候选人克莱·富尔克斯。

en.s: The 1918 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Democrat James M. Cox defeated Republican nominee Frank B. Willis in their third consecutive contest with 50.62% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯以50.62%的得票率击败共和党候选人弗兰克·B·威利斯。这是两人的第三次连续对决。

en.s: The 1918 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat James B. A. Robertson defeated Republican Horace G. McKeever. Also on the ballot was Patrick S. Nagle of the Socialist Party.

zh.s: 1918年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·B. A. 罗伯逊击败共和党候选人霍勒斯·G·麦基弗。社会主义党候选人帕特里克·S·内格尔也参加了选举。

en.s: The 1918 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Robert Livingston Beeckman defeated Democratic nominee Alberic A. Archambault with 53.11% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年罗得岛州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·利文斯顿·比克曼以53.11%的得票率击败民主党候选人阿尔贝里克·A·阿尚博。

en.s: The 1918 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Lynn Frazier defeated Democratic nominee S. J. Doyle with 59.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年北达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长林恩·弗雷泽以59.74%的得票率击败民主党候选人S. J. 多伊尔。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 5, 1918. It was the first election for Minnesota's Class 2 seat in the United States Senate, and the second U.S. Senate election in Minnesota overall, held after the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution, which established the popular election of United States senators. Incumbent U.S.

zh.t: 1918年美国明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1918年联邦参议员选举于11月5日在明尼苏达州举行。这是明尼苏达州联邦参议院第二组席位的首次选举，也是该州根据美国宪法第十七修正案举行的第二次联邦参议员普选。该修正案确立了由选民直接选举联邦参议员的制度。原文在介绍时任联邦参议员时中断。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Democratic Senator William H. Thompson ran for re-election to a second term in the first popular election for this seat after the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment. Thompson was challenged by Governor Arthur Capper, the Republican nominee. Amid a nationwide Republican wave, Thompson lost to Capper in a landslide, winning just 34% of the vote to Capper's 64%.

zh.t: 1918年美国参议院选举在堪萨斯州举行
zh.s: 1918年美国参议院选举在堪萨斯州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员威廉·H·汤普森竞选连任第二个任期。这是美国宪法第十七修正案获批准后，该席位首次由选民直接投票选举。共和党候选人、州长阿瑟·卡珀向汤普森发起挑战。在共和党席卷全国的选举中，汤普森以34%的得票率惨败给得票率为64%的卡珀。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Senator William S. Kenyon was re-elected to a second term in office over Democrat Charles Rollin Keyes.

zh.t: 1918年美国参议院选举在艾奥瓦州举行
zh.s: 1918年美国参议院选举在艾奥瓦州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员威廉·S·肯扬击败民主党候选人查尔斯·罗林·凯斯，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1918 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Governor Henry W. Keyes opted to run for the U.S. Senate rather than seek re-election. Republican State Representative John H. Bartlett and Democratic State Representative Nathaniel E. Martin both won their party nominations unopposed and advanced to the general election. Bartlett ultimately defeated Martin by a wide margin, winning 54 percent of the vote to Martin's 46 percent.

zh.s: 1918年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长亨利·W·基斯决定竞选联邦参议员，而不寻求连任。共和党州众议员约翰·H·巴特利特和民主党州众议员纳撒尼尔·E·马丁均在无人竞争的情况下赢得党内提名，进入大选。最终，巴特利特以54%的得票率大幅领先马丁的46%，赢得选举。

en.s: The 1918 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1918, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Julius A. Schmahl defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Edward Indrehus.

zh.s: 1918年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月5日举行，以选出州务卿。共和党候选人、现任州务卿朱利叶斯·A·施马尔击败民主党候选人、明尼苏达州众议院现任议员爱德华·因德雷胡斯。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Senator Robert L. Owen, a Democrat, sought re-election in his first popular election. He won the Democratic primary in a landslide and faced former U.S. Attorney W. B. Johnson in the general election. Owen won re-election by a wide margin.

zh.t: 1918年美国参议院选举在俄克拉何马州举行
zh.s: 1918年美国参议院选举在俄克拉何马州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员罗伯特·L·欧文竞选连任，这是该州首次以普选方式选举参议员。他在民主党初选中大胜，随后在大选中面对前联邦检察官W. B. 约翰逊。欧文最终以较大优势连任。

en.s: The 1918 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1918, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent acting attorney general Clifford L. Hilton defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Tom E. Davis, Democratic nominee Bjorn B. Gislason and National nominee Lars Haug.

zh.s: 1918年明尼苏达州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。共和党候选人、代理检察长克利福德·L·希尔顿击败农工党候选人汤姆·E·戴维斯、民主党候选人比约恩·B·吉斯拉森和国家党候选人拉尔斯·豪格。

en.s: The 1918 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Marcus H. Holcomb defeated Democratic nominee Thomas J. Spellacy with 50.72% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长马库斯·H·霍尔科姆以50.72%的得票率击败民主党候选人托马斯·J·斯佩拉西。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Democrat J. Hamilton Lewis lost reelection to Republican Medill McCormick. The primaries and general election coincided with those for House and those for state elections. The primaries were held September 11, 1918. This was the first election for this U.S.

zh.t: 1918年美国伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1918年联邦参议员选举于11月5日在伊利诺伊州举行。民主党籍时任参议员J·汉密尔顿·刘易斯未能连任，败给共和党人梅迪尔·麦考密克。初选和大选与众议院选举及州级选举同期举行；初选于1918年9月11日举行。原文最后一句在介绍这次“美国……”选举时中断。

en.s: The 1918 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1918, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Connecticut House of Representatives Frank E. Healy defeated Democratic nominee Harrison Hewitt.

zh.s: 1918年康涅狄格州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。共和党候选人、康涅狄格州众议院现任议员弗兰克·E·希利击败民主党候选人哈里森·休伊特。

en.s: The 1918 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Republican nominee Oliver Henry Shoup defeated Democratic nominee Thomas J. Tynan with 51.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人奥利弗·亨利·舒普以51.15%的得票率击败民主党候选人托马斯·J·泰南。

en.t: 1918 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1918 House election in Wyoming was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Congressman Frank Wheeler Mondell ran for re-election to a twelfth term in the U.S. House of Representatives. He was opposed by Democratic nominee Hayden M. White, the former Johnson County Prosecuting Attorney and the 1908 Democratic nominee for Congress. Owing in large part to the Republican landslide in 1918, Mondell handily defeated White to win re-election.

zh.t: 1918年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1918年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任联邦众议员弗兰克·惠勒·蒙德尔竞选连任第12个任期。民主党候选人海登·M·怀特曾任约翰逊县检察官，也是1908年民主党国会候选人。由于共和党在1918年大胜，蒙德尔轻松击败怀特，成功连任。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Morris Sheppard was re-elected to a second term in office easily.

zh.t: 1918年美国参议院选举在得克萨斯州举行
zh.s: 1918年美国参议院选举在得克萨斯州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员莫里斯·谢泼德轻松连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1918 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Republican nominee William L. Harding defeated Democratic nominee Claude R. Porter with 50.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人威廉·L·哈丁以50.55%的得票率击败民主党候选人克劳德·R·波特。

en.s: The 1918 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918, and featured former lieutenant governor Samuel R. McKelvie, a Republican, defeating incumbent Democratic governor, Keith Neville.

zh.s: 1918年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党前副州长塞缪尔·R·麦凯尔维击败民主党籍现任州长基思·内维尔。

en.s: The 1918 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1918. Following the election of Governor John B. Kendrick to the U.S. Senate in 1916, Secretary of State Frank L. Houx served as acting Governor. He ran for re-election and faced a stiff challenge in the Democratic primary from attorney William B. Ross. After defeating Ross by a decisive margin, he faced Robert D.

zh.s: 1918年州长选举于11月5日在怀俄明州举行。州务卿弗兰克·L·霍克斯在约翰·B·肯德里克于1916年当选联邦参议员后担任代理州长。霍克斯竞选连任，并在民主党初选中受到律师威廉·B·罗斯有力挑战。霍克斯以明显优势击败罗斯后，原文开始介绍另一名候选人罗伯特·D.，但句子残缺。

en.s: The 1918 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Republican State Assemblyman C. C. Young defeated Democratic State Assemblyman Jo V. Snyder with 67.28% of the vote.

zh.t: 1918年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1918年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党州众议员C. C. 杨以67.28%的得票率击败民主党州众议员乔·V·斯奈德。

en.s: The 1918 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Republican nominee D. W. Davis defeated Democratic nominee H. F. Samuels with 59.95% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年爱达荷州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人D. W. 戴维斯以59.95%的得票率击败民主党候选人H. F. 塞缪尔斯。

en.s: The 1918 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Republican nominee Henry Justin Allen defeated Democratic nominee W. C. Lansdon with 66.39% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人亨利·贾斯汀·艾伦以66.39%的得票率击败民主党候选人W. C. 兰斯顿。

en.t: 1918 United States House of Representatives election in Arizona
en.s: The 1918 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona was held on Tuesday November 5, 1918 to elect the state's sole at-large representative. incumbent democrat, Carl Hayden won re-election to a fifth term with 60 percent of the vote. Primary elections were held on September 10, 1918.

zh.t: 1918年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1918年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举于11月5日星期二举行，选出该州唯一一名全州选区众议员。民主党籍现任众议员卡尔·海登以60%的得票率连任第五个任期。初选于1918年9月10日举行。

en.s: The 1918 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Albert E. Sleeper defeated Democratic candidate John W. Bailey with 61.41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年密歇根州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长阿尔伯特·E·斯利珀以61.41%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·W·贝利。

en.s: The 1918 New Mexico gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Governor Washington Ellsworth Lindsey lost the Republican nomination. Republican nominee Octaviano Ambrosio Larrazolo defeated Democratic nominee Felix Garcia with 50.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长华盛顿·埃尔斯沃思·林赛未能赢得共和党提名。共和党候选人奥克塔维亚诺·安布罗西奥·拉腊索洛以50.50%的得票率击败民主党候选人费利克斯·加西亚。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Senator Thomas Sterling sought re-election in his first popular election. He defeated former Governor Frank M. Byrne in the Republican primary and then faced former State Representative Orville Rinehart, the 1916 Democratic nominee for Governor, in the general election. Sterling defeated Rinehart, along with independent candidate W. T.

zh.t: 1918年美国南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1918年联邦参议员选举于11月5日在南达科他州举行。共和党籍时任参议员托马斯·斯特林首次参加普选，争取连任。他在共和党初选中击败前州长弗兰克·M·伯恩；大选中，他对阵前州众议员奥维尔·莱因哈特。原文提到独立候选人W. T.后中断。

en.t: 1918 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1918 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Republican Senator Francis E. Warren ran for re-election to his fifth consecutive term in the Senate, in his first popular election. He was opposed by former Governor John E. Osborne, the Democratic nominee, who had until recently served as the U.S. Assistant Secretary of State.

zh.t: 1918年美国参议院选举在怀俄明州举行
zh.s: 1918年美国参议院选举在怀俄明州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员弗朗西斯·E·沃伦竞选连任第五个连续任期，这也是该州首次以普选方式选举参议员。他的对手是民主党候选人、前州长约翰·E·奥斯本，后者不久前曾任美国助理国务卿。

en.s: The 1918 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Democrat Emmet D. Boyle defeated Republican nominee Tasker Oddie with 52.08% of the vote.

zh.s: 1918年内华达州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长埃米特·D·博伊尔以52.08%的得票率击败共和党候选人塔斯克·奥迪。

en.s: The 1918 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 5, 1918, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor J. A. O. Preus defeated Democratic nominee Larke W. Huntley and National nominee Fremont R. McManigal.

zh.s: 1918年明尼苏达州审计长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州审计长。共和党候选人、现任审计长J. A. O. 普鲁斯击败民主党候选人拉克·W·亨特利和国家党候选人弗里蒙特·R·麦克马尼格尔。

en.s: The 1918 New York gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1918, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York, concurrently with elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Al Smith, president of the New York City aldermen, was elected to the first of his four two-year terms as governor.

zh.s: 1918年纽约州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出州长和副州长，并与其他州的美国参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及多项州和地方选举同时进行。时任纽约市市议员会主席阿尔·史密斯当选，开始四个两年州长任期中的第一个。

en.s: The 1918 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1918. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor Thomas Frankson of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Charles H. Helweg and National Party candidate George D. Haggard.

zh.s: 1918年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任副州长托马斯·弗兰克森击败明尼苏达州民主党候选人查尔斯·H·赫尔韦格和国家党候选人乔治·D·哈加德。

en.s: The 1918 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1918, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Incumbent Democratic Governor Hugh Dorsey ran unopposed in both the primary and general election and subsequently won re-election.

zh.s: 1918年佐治亚州州长选举于1918年11月5日举行，选出佐治亚州州长。民主党现任州长休·多尔西在初选和普选中都没有对手，随后成功连任。

en.s: The 1918 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1918 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 23 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1918 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

en.s: The 1918 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 5, to elect the next Governor of Temnessee, Democratic candidate Albert H. Roberts defeated Republican candidate Hugh B. Lindsay In the primary election, Roberts defeated Austin Peay narrowly by around 12,000 votes.

zh.s: 1918年田纳西州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出下一任田纳西州州长。民主党候选人艾伯特·H·罗伯茨击败共和党候选人休·B·林赛，当选。初选中，罗伯茨以约12,000票的优势险胜奥斯汀·皮伊。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Poland on 5 November 1922, with Senate elections held a week later on 12 November. The elections were governed by the March Constitution of Poland, and saw the Christian Union of National Unity coalition emerge as the largest bloc in the Sejm with 163 of the 444 seats.

zh.s: 波兰于1922年11月5日举行议会选举，参议院选举则在一周后的11月12日举行。选举依据《波兰三月宪法》进行，民族团结基督教联盟在众议院成为最大阵营，在444个席位中获得163席。

en.t: Secret agent Sidney Reilly, the first "super-spy" of the 20th century, is executed by the OGPU, the secret police of the Soviet Union
en.s: Sidney George Reilly (; c. 1873 – 5 November 1925), fictionalized as the "Ace of Spies", was a Russian-born adventurer and secret agent employed by Scotland Yard's Special Branch and later by the Foreign Section of the British Secret Service Bureau, the precursor to the modern British Secret Intelligence Service (MI6/SIS).

zh.t: 苏联特工机构OGPU处决“超级间谍”西德尼·赖利
zh.s: 西德尼·乔治·赖利（Sidney George Reilly，约1873年—1925年11月5日）被小说改编为“间谍之王”，是一名出生于俄罗斯的冒险家和秘密特工。他先后受雇于苏格兰场特别处，以及英国秘密情报局（Secret Service Bureau）外国处；后者是现代英国秘密情报局（MI6/SIS）的前身。

en.s: The Ikhwan raid on Busayya in Iraq occurred on November 5th, 1927. Elements of the Ikhwan, mainly consisting of the Mutair tribe under al-Dawish, raided southern Iraq, clashing with Iraqi troops near Busayya, resulting in some 20 casualties on both sides. This attack later became known as the beginning of the Ikhwan rebellion.

zh.s: 1927年11月5日，伊拉克布赛亚发生伊赫万袭击。伊赫万武装人员主要来自穆泰尔部落，由达维什率领，袭击伊拉克南部，并在布赛亚附近与伊拉克军队交战，双方约有20人伤亡。这次袭击后来被视为伊赫万起义的开端。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 5, 1928. Incumbent Democratic Senator William Cabell Bruce ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated by Republican former Governor Phillips Lee Goldsborough, who had been a failed candidate for Senate in 1916.

zh.t: 1928年美国参议院选举在马里兰州举行
zh.s: 1928年美国参议院选举在马里兰州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员威廉·卡贝尔·布鲁斯竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党前州长菲利普·李·戈尔兹伯勒。戈尔兹伯勒曾在1916年竞选参议员，但未能当选。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1929 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 5, 1929. Incumbent Republican mayor Charles H. Kline was re-elected over Thomas A. Dunn, who ran on the Democratic and Good Government party tickets. Until this election, no mayor of Pittsburgh had won consecutive terms since Henry A. Weaver in 1858, owing in part to a prior long-standing law prohibiting a mayor from succeeding himself.

zh.s: 1929年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1929年11月5日星期二举行。共和党籍现任市长查尔斯·H·克莱因击败同时代表民主党和良政党的托马斯·A·邓恩，成功连任。在此次选举之前，自1858年亨利·A·韦弗以来，还没有匹兹堡市长连续当选过，这部分是因为长期以来有禁止市长连任的法律。

en.s: The 1929 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1929 to elect the governor of Virginia.

zh.s: 1929年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出该州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1929 occurred on Tuesday, November 5, 1929. Former Mayor of Boston James Michael Curley defeated two other candidates to be elected mayor for the third time. In 1918, the Massachusetts state legislature had passed legislation making the Mayor of Boston ineligible to serve consecutive terms. Thus, incumbent Malcolm Nichols was unable to run for re-election. Curley was sworn on Monday, January 6, 1930.

zh.s: 1929年波士顿市长选举于11月5日星期二举行。波士顿前市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利击败另外两名候选人，第三次当选市长。1918年，马萨诸塞州议会通过法律，规定波士顿市长不能连续任职，因此时任市长马尔科姆·尼科尔斯无法竞选连任。柯利于1930年1月6日星期一宣誓就职。

en.s: The 1929 Indianapolis mayoral election took place on November 5, 1929, and saw Democrat Reginald H. Sullivan winning in a landslide victory. Incumbent mayor, Democrat Lemuel Ertus Slack, had been appointed mayor in 1927 following the resignation of Republican John L. Duvall after he was convicted of corruption. Duvall had been elected mayor in 1925 with the support of the Ku Klux Klan, and the Marion County Republican Party had close Klan ties.

zh.t: 1929年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1929年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于11月5日举行，民主党人雷金纳德·H·沙利文大获全胜。民主党籍时任市长勒缪尔·埃尔图斯·斯莱克于1927年获任市长；此前共和党籍市长约翰·L·杜瓦尔因贪污罪被定罪后辞职。杜瓦尔曾在三K党支持下于1925年当选，马里恩县共和党与三K党关系密切。

en.s: Elections were held to elect the New York City Board of Aldermen on November 5, 1929, in concert with other such contests as the Mayor, the Comptroller, the President of the Board of Aldermen, Borough presidents, County Sheriffs, and other miscellaneous questions. Democrats won a majority of 61 seats while Republicans won 4 seats, all in Manhattan.

zh.s: 1929年11月5日举行选举，选出纽约市议员委员会成员。选举还包括市长、审计长、议员委员会主席、各行政区区长、县警长等职位，以及其他议题。民主党获得61席多数，共和党获得4席，全部来自曼哈顿。

en.s: The 1929 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1929, to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Virginia House of Delegates James Hubert Price defeated Republican nominee C. B. Jones.

zh.s: 1929年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出副州长。民主党候选人、弗吉尼亚州众议院现任议员詹姆斯·休伯特·普莱斯击败共和党候选人C. B. 琼斯。

en.s: An election for the New York City Comptroller was held on November 5, 1929, the same day as other such contests as the mayoralty, aldermen, President of the Board of Aldermen, Borough presidents, and County sheriffs. Incumbent Charles W. Berry was reelected, defeating Republican candidate Harold G. Aron, Socialist candidate Charles Solomon, and Square Deal Party candidate George E. Polhemus to win reelection.

zh.s: 纽约市审计长选举于1929年11月5日举行，与市长、议员委员会、议员委员会主席、各行政区区长和县警长等职位的选举同日进行。时任审计长查尔斯·W·贝里击败共和党候选人哈罗德·G·阿伦、社会主义党候选人查尔斯·所罗门和公平交易党候选人乔治·E·波勒姆斯，成功连任。

en.t: 1929 New York City aldermanic presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 5, 1929, to elect the President of the New York City Board of Aldermen, in concert with other such contests as the mayoralty, Comptroller, the remainder of the Board of Aldermen, County Sheriffs, Borough presidents, and other miscellaneous questions on the ballot. Democratic incumbent Joseph V. McKee of The Bronx defeated Republican candidate Bird Sim Coler of Brooklyn, himself an independent Democrat, 890,655 votes to 385,514.

zh.t: 1929年纽约市议员委员会主席选举
zh.s: 纽约市议员委员会主席选举于1929年11月5日举行，与市长、审计长、其他议员委员会成员、县警长、各行政区区长等职位的选举及其他投票议题同时进行。民主党籍现任主席、来自布朗克斯区的约瑟夫·V·麦基以890,655票击败共和党候选人、来自布鲁克林区的伯德·西姆·科勒；科勒本人也是独立民主党人。科勒获得385,514票。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1929, in the state of Virginia. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year.

zh.s: 1929年美国州长选举在弗吉尼亚州举行。弗吉尼亚州每四年举行一次州长选举，安排在总统选举年份之后的奇数年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1929 New York City mayoral election was held on November 5 in concert with other municipal elections. Democratic incumbent Jimmy Walker defeated Republican challenger Fiorello H. La Guardia in what was considered "a Crushing Defeat to [the] City G.O.P. [delivered]" by Tammany Hall. Socialist candidate Norman Thomas also ran, as did Socialist Labor candidate Olive M. Johnson and former Police Commissioner Richard Edward Enright for the Square Deal Party.

zh.s: 1929年纽约市市长选举于11月5日举行，与其他市政选举同期进行。民主党现任市长吉米·沃克击败共和党挑战者菲奥雷洛·H·拉瓜迪亚。塔马尼协会被认为给纽约市共和党带来了“惨败”。社会主义党候选人诺曼·托马斯、社会主义劳工党候选人奥利夫·M·约翰逊和方圆党候选人、前警察局长理查德·爱德华·恩赖特也参加了选举。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 5, 1934. Incumbent Republican Senator Phillips Lee Goldsborough did not seek re-election to a second term in office, preferring to run for Governor of Maryland again. In the open race to succeed him, Democratic Maryland Secretary of State George L. P. Radcliffe defeated former Senator Joseph I. France.

zh.t: 1934年美国参议院选举在马里兰州举行
zh.s: 1934年美国参议院选举在马里兰州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员菲利普·李·戈尔兹伯勒没有竞选连任第二个任期，而是再次竞选马里兰州州长。在这场开放席位的选举中，民主党籍马里兰州州务卿乔治·L. P. 拉德克利夫击败前参议员约瑟夫·I·弗朗斯。

en.s: The 1935 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1935, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Martin S. Conner was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election; therefore, the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 1935年密西西比州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长马丁·S·康纳受任期限制，无法竞选连任第二个任期。按照当时的惯例，民主党候选人在大选中无人挑战，因此真正的竞争是在民主党初选中，赢得初选也就被视为当选。

en.s: Elections were held to fill the 65 seats of the New York City Board of Aldermen on November 5, 1935. They would be the final elections to the Board of Aldermen, which would be abolished in 1937 in favor of the New York City Council, which was elected via borough-based proportional representation (single transferable voting). Democrats gained 13 seats compared to the 1933 result.

zh.s: 纽约市于1935年11月5日举行选举，选出市议员委员会的65名成员。这是议员委员会废除前的最后一次选举；该委员会于1937年被废除，改由纽约市议会取代，市议员通过各行政区比例代表制（单记可让渡投票制）选出。与1933年相比，民主党增加了13个席位。

en.s: The 1935 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1935. Democratic nominee Happy Chandler defeated Republican nominee King Swope with 54.45% of the vote. Ruby Laffoon, the incumbent Democratic Party Governor, was term limited.

zh.s: 1935年肯塔基州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人“快乐”钱德勒以54.45%的得票率击败共和党候选人金·斯沃普。民主党籍现任州长鲁比·拉丰受任期限制，无法竞选连任。

en.s: The 1935 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 5, 1935. Incumbent mayor Angelo Joseph Rossi was re-elected with 53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1935年旧金山市长选举于1935年11月5日举行。现任市长安杰洛·约瑟夫·罗西以53%的得票率连任。

en.s: Elections are currently held every four years to elect the mayor of Hartford, Connecticut. From 1947 until 1969, rather than being individually elected, a mayor was chosen from among the members of Hartford's city council. Both prior and subsequent to this, partisan direct elections have been held to sleet the city's mayor. Elections were originally to two year terms.

zh.s: 哈特福德目前每四年举行一次市长选举。1947年至1969年间，市长并非由选民单独选出，而是从哈特福德市议会成员中产生。在此之前和之后，市长均通过党派直接选举产生。最初，市长任期为两年。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1935 saw Harold Hitz Burton defeat former mayor Ray T. Miller.

zh.s: 1935年克利夫兰市长选举中，哈罗德·希茨·伯顿击败前市长雷·T·米勒，当选市长。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 5, 1940 as part of the 1940 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont voted for the Republican nominee, corporate lawyer Wendell Willkie of Indiana, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York. Willkie's running mate was Senate Minority Leader Charles L. McNary of Oregon, while Roosevelt ran with Secretary of Agriculture Henry A. Wallace of Iowa.

zh.s: 1940年佛蒙特州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年在美国全部48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持共和党候选人、印第安纳州企业律师温德尔·威尔基，击败民主党候选人、纽约州籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福。威尔基的竞选搭档是俄勒冈州参议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里；罗斯福则与爱荷华州农业部长亨利·A·华莱士搭档。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 17 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York, over the Republican nominee, corporate lawyer Wendell Willkie of Indiana. Roosevelt ran with Secretary of Agriculture Henry A. Wallace of Iowa, while Willkie's running mate was Senate Minority Leader Charles L. McNary of Oregon.

zh.t: 1940年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1940年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年在美国全部48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出17名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州支持民主党候选人、纽约州籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福，击败共和党候选人、印第安纳州企业律师温德尔·威尔基。罗斯福与农业部长亨利·A·华莱士搭档；威尔基的竞选搭档是参议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 5, 1940. All 48 States were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt in a 13-point landslide against Republican businessman Wendell Willkie. This was the only election in United States history where a President was elected to serve a third full term.

zh.t: 1940年新墨西哥州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1940年新墨西哥州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。当时美国全部48个州都参加了总统选举。新墨西哥州选出3名选举人，由他们代表该州投票选出总统和副总统。现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以13个百分点的优势大胜共和党商人温德尔·威尔基。这是美国历史上唯一一次总统当选并开始第三个完整任期的选举。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 5, 1940 in Minnesota as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. The Democratic candidate, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt won the state over dark horse Republican nominee Wendell Willkie of New York by a margin of 47,922 votes, or 3.83%. Nationally, Roosevelt was re-elected to an unprecedented third term as President, with 449 electoral votes and a 9.97% lead over Willkie in the popular vote. Roosevelt was the only President of the United States who was elected to more than two quadrennial terms.

zh.t: 1940年明尼苏达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1940年明尼苏达州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人、现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以47,922票、即3.83%的优势击败共和党意外提名的温德尔·威尔基，赢得明尼苏达州。全国范围内，罗斯福以449张选举人票和领先威尔基9.97%的普选票优势，史无前例地连任第三个总统任期。他是美国唯一一位当选超过两个四年任期的总统。

en.s: The 1940 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Governor of Montana Roy E. Ayers, who was first elected governor in 1936, ran for re-election. He narrowly won the Democratic primary by just over a thousand votes to win renomination, and advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by Sam C. Ford, a former Associate Justice of the Montana Supreme Court and the Republican nominee. Ultimately, in spite of the fact that then-President Franklin D. Roosevelt comfortably won the state in that year's presidential election, Ford narrowly defeated Ayers to win his first of two terms as governor.

zh.s: 1940年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月5日举行。1936年首次当选州长的现任州长罗伊·E·艾尔斯竞选连任。他在民主党初选中以略多于1,000票的优势险胜，获得提名。大选中，他的对手是前蒙大拿州最高法院副法官、共和党提名人萨姆·C·福特。尽管时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福在该州轻松胜出，福特还是以微弱优势击败艾尔斯，赢得他的第一个州长任期；他后来又当选连任。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1940 was the 39th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 5, 1940. The election was fought in the shadow of World War II in Europe, as the United States was emerging from the Great Depression. Incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, the Democratic candidate, broke with tradition and ran for a third term, which became a major issue. The surprise Republican candidate was maverick businessman Wendell Willkie, a dark horse who crusaded against Roosevelt's perceived failure to end the Depression and his supposed eagerness for war.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举是美国第39次四年一度的总统选举，于11月5日（星期二）举行。当时欧洲正处于第二次世界大战中，美国则刚走出大萧条。现任总统、民主党候选人富兰克林·D·罗斯福打破惯例，竞选第三个任期，这成为选举的重要议题。共和党意外提名了敢言的商人温德尔·威尔基。他反对罗斯福被认为未能结束大萧条，也批评他被认为急于参战。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 5, 1940. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1940 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 47 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York, who was running against Republican businessman Wendell Willkie of Indiana. Roosevelt ran with incumbent Vice President Henry A. Wallace of Iowa, and Willkie ran with Senator Charles L. McNary of Oregon.

zh.s: 1940年纽约州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。当时美国全部48个州都参加了总统选举。纽约州选民选出47名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。纽约州籍民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福击败共和党商人温德尔·威尔基，赢得该州。罗斯福与现任副总统、爱荷华州人亨利·A·华莱士搭档；威尔基则与俄勒冈州参议员查尔斯·L·麦克纳里搭档。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 5, 1940. All contemporary 48 states, were part of the 1940 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 16 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Democratic nominees, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York and his running mate Secretary of Agriculture Henry A. Wallace of Iowa. Roosevelt and Wallace defeated the Republican nominees, corporate lawyer Wendell Willkie of Indiana and his running mate Senate Minority Leader Charles L. McNary of Oregon.

zh.s: 1940年新泽西州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。当时美国全部48个州都参加了总统选举。新泽西州选民选出16名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、纽约州籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福及其竞选搭档、爱荷华州农业部长亨利·A·华莱士赢得新泽西州。两人击败了共和党候选人、印第安纳州企业律师温德尔·威尔基及其竞选搭档、参议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 5, 1940. Incumbent United States Senator Burton K. Wheeler, who was first elected to the Senate in 1922, and was re-elected in 1928 and 1934, ran for re-election. Though he faced a serious challenger in the Democratic primary, he emerged victorious, and advanced to the general election, where he faced E. K. Cheadle, a state district judge and the Republican nominee. Just like in 1934, Wheeler won re-election in a landslide, winning his fourth term in the Senate.

zh.s: 1940年蒙大拿州美国联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。现任参议员伯顿·K·惠勒于1922年首次当选，并在1928年和1934年连任，这次再次竞选。他在民主党初选中遭遇强劲挑战，但仍胜出并进入大选，对手是共和党提名人、州地区法院法官E·K·奇德尔。和1934年一样，惠勒以压倒性优势连任，赢得第四个参议员任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 5, 1940 throughout the continuous 48 states. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana voted overwhelmingly to give Democratic nominee, President Franklin D. Roosevelt an unprecedented third term, over the Republican nominee, corporate lawyer Wendell Willkie, a dark horse candidate that had never before run for a political office. Roosevelt won Montana by a landslide margin of 18.61%.

zh.s: 1940年蒙大拿州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。美国当时全部48个州都参加了选举。蒙大拿州选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。蒙大拿州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人、现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福，帮助他史无前例地赢得第三个总统任期。共和党候选人温德尔·威尔基是一名此前从未竞选公职的企业律师。罗斯福在蒙大拿州以18.61个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1940
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Republican Warren Austin successfully ran for re-election to another term in the United States Senate, defeating Democratic candidate Ona S. Searles. Austin would resign in August 1946 to become United States Ambassador to the United Nations; Ralph Flanders was appointed to replace him and went on to win election to a full term in 1946.
