North Dakota was won by Wendell Willkie (R–New York), running with Minority Leader Charles L. McNary, with 55.06% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举：北达科他州
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在北达科他州举行。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自纽约州的温德尔·威尔基与众议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里搭档，以55.06%的普选票击败民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D.。

en.s: The 1940 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic governor Prentice Cooper defeated Republican nominee C. Arthur Bruce with 72.1% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年田纳西州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长普伦蒂斯·库珀以72.1%的得票率击败共和党候选人C. 阿瑟·布鲁斯。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在肯塔基州举行。该州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得肯塔基州。竞选搭档的姓名在原文中断。

en.t: 1940 North Carolina Secretary of State election
en.s: The North Carolina secretary of state election of 1940 took place on November 5, 1940. The incumbent Secretary of State, Thad A. Eure, chose to run for reelection and defeated A. I. Ferree with 75.71% of the vote. Eure won his second of thirteen terms.

zh.t: 1940年北卡罗来纳州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1940年北卡罗来纳州州务卿选举于11月5日举行。时任州务卿萨德·A·尤尔决定竞选连任，并以75.71%的得票率击败A. I. 费里。这是尤尔第13个任期中的第二个任期。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other states.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在阿拉巴马州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在阿拉巴马州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。阿拉巴马州选民选出11名选举人，由选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。与其他州不同，阿拉巴马州选民分别投票选举每一名选举人，而不是对整组候选人投票。

en.t: 1940 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: Elections were held on the islands of St. Thomas and St. John in the United States Virgin Islands on November 5, 1940, to elect 7 members of the Municipal Council. The Progressive Guide won in a landslide, electing 6 of the 7 members. The People's Civic League only won one seat, St. John, as the Progressive Guide did not contest it. Elections were also held in St.

zh.s: 圣托马斯岛和圣约翰岛于1940年11月5日举行选举，选出市政委员会7名成员。进步指引党（Progressive Guide）大获全胜，赢得7席中的6席。人民公民联盟只在圣约翰岛赢得1席，因为进步指引党没有在该岛参选。

en.s: The 1940 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Before the primary, incumbent governor Henry Horner, a Democrat, opted not to seek a third term. In October, before the general election, his death in office made John Henry Stelle assume the governorship. However, Stelle had previously failed to win the Democratic nomination in the primary. Republican former Attorney Dwight H.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在伊利诺伊州举行。民主党籍时任州长亨利·霍纳决定不竞选第三个任期。州长选举前的10月，霍纳在任内去世，由约翰·亨利·斯特尔接任州长。不过，斯特尔此前未能在民主党初选中获得提名。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Tom Connally was re-elected to his third term in office, with only minor opposition in the Democratic primary and general elections.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在得克萨斯州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在得克萨斯州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员汤姆·康纳利再次当选，开始第三个任期。他在民主党初选和大选中都只遇到较弱的对手。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Until the rise of Huey P. Long, post-disenfranchisement Louisiana politics was dominated by the New Orleans-based “Choctaw Club”, which overcame Socialist, Wobbly, and Progressive challenges from the outlying upcountry, Imperial Calcasieu and Acadiana regions between the late 1900s and early 1920s.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在路易斯安那州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在路易斯安那州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。直到休伊·P·朗崛起，路易斯安那州在剥夺选举权后的政治一直由新奥尔良的“乔克托俱乐部”主导。20世纪初至20年代初，该俱乐部击退了来自州内偏远地区、帝国卡尔克苏和阿卡迪亚地区的社会主义者、世界产业工人组织成员和进步党人的挑战。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 5, 1940. Incumbent U.S. Senator Henrik Shipstead defected to the Republican Party of Minnesota from the Farmer–Labor Party of Minnesota, and defeated former Governor Elmer Benson of the Farmer–Labor Party and John E. Regan of the Minnesota Democratic Party to win a fourth term.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在明尼苏达州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在明尼苏达州于11月5日举行。时任联邦参议员亨里克·希普斯特德脱离明尼苏达州农工党，转而加入明尼苏达州共和党。他击败农工党前州长埃尔默·本森和明尼苏达州民主党候选人约翰·E·里根，赢得第四个任期。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Republican candidate, business man Wendell Willkie, running with Senate Minority Leader Charles L. McNary, with 57.19% of the popular vote, against incumbent Democratic President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举：内布拉斯加州
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在内布拉斯加州举行。该州选民选出7名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、商人温德尔·威尔基与众议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里搭档，以57.19%的普选票赢得内布拉斯加州，击败民主党籍时任总统。

en.t: 1940 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1940 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 77th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 5, 1940, while Maine held theirs on September 9. They coincided with President Franklin D. Roosevelt's re-election to an unprecedented third term.

zh.s: 1940年美国联邦众议院选举是为选出第77届国会议员而举行的选举。大部分选举于1940年11月5日举行，缅因州则在9月9日举行。选举与富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统史无前例地第三次当选同时进行。

en.s: The 1940 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Governor Robert Taylor Jones ran for reelection but was defeated in the Democratic primary by former Secretary of State Sidney Preston Osborn, whom Jones had previously defeated in 1938. Sidney Preston Osborn defeated Jerrie W. Lee in the general election, and was sworn into his first term as Governor on January 6, 1941, becoming Arizona's seventh Governor.

zh.s: 1940年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·泰勒·琼斯竞选连任，但在民主党初选中败给了前州务卿西德尼·普雷斯顿·奥斯本；琼斯曾在1938年击败奥斯本。奥斯本随后在大选中击败杰里·W·李，并于1941年1月6日宣誓就任第七任亚利桑那州州长。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in California took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose 22 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Democratic incumbent, Franklin Roosevelt, over the Republican challenger, businessman Wendell Willkie.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在加利福尼亚州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在加利福尼亚州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出22名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州支持民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·罗斯福，击败了共和党挑战者、商人温德尔·威尔基。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John G. Townsend Jr. ran for re-election to a third term in office, but was defeated by Democrat James M. Tunnell. This was the only seat that Democrats flipped during this cycle. This was the last time Democrats won Delaware's Class 1 Senate seat until Tom Carper's victory over Senator William Roth in 2000.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在特拉华州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在特拉华州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员约翰·G·汤森德二世竞选连任第三个任期，但败给了民主党人詹姆斯·M·塔内尔。这是本轮选举中民主党唯一翻转的席位。直到2000年汤姆·卡珀击败参议员威廉·罗斯，这才是民主党上次赢得特拉华州第一区参议员席位。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在密苏里州举行。该州选民选出15名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得密苏里州。

en.s: The 1940 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Democratic nominee J. Melville Broughton defeated Republican nominee Robert H. McNeill with 75.70% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人J·梅尔维尔·布劳顿以75.70%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伯特·H·麦克尼尔。

en.s: The 1940 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic Governor Richard McMullen originally ran for re-election to a second term, and was renominated by the Democratic Party. However, less than a month before the election, McMullen suffered a heart attack and he dropped out of the race. The state party named Secretary of State Josiah Marvel Jr., as McMullen's replacement on the ballot.

zh.s: 1940年特拉华州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长理查德·麦克马伦原本竞选连任第二个任期，并再次获得民主党提名。但在选举前不到一个月，麦克马伦突发心脏病，退出竞选。州民主党指定州务卿小约西亚·马维尔接替他，列入选票。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary Henry A.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举：西弗吉尼亚州
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在西弗吉尼亚州举行。西弗吉尼亚州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得该州。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在内华达州举行。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得内华达州。

en.s: The 1940 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Democratic incumbent Frank Gaines Harris defeated Republican nominee William P. Elmer with 51.95% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年密苏里州副州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任副州长弗兰克·盖恩斯·哈里斯以51.95%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·P·埃尔默。

en.s: The 1940 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 5, 1940, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee Wilson Bell defeated Republican nominee Scott Peters and Socialist nominee Lucy Henschel.

zh.t: 1940年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1940年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月5日举行，以选出州财政部长。民主党候选人威尔逊·贝尔击败共和党候选人斯科特·彼得斯和社会主义党候选人露西·亨舍尔。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1940 in New Jersey was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Republican Senator William Warren Barbour was re-elected over Democrat James H. R. Cromwell, who had recently been appointed United States Ambassador to Canada.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在新泽西州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在新泽西州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员威廉·沃伦·巴伯击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·H. R. 克伦威尔，成功连任。克伦威尔不久前刚被任命为美国驻加拿大大使。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 5, 1940. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. South Carolina was won by incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York, who was running against Republican businessman Wendell Willkie of New York.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在南卡罗来纳州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在南卡罗来纳州于11月5日举行。当时美国的48个州都参加了这次总统选举。南卡罗来纳州选民选出8名选举人，由选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。来自纽约州的民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福击败了来自纽约州的共和党商人温德尔·威尔基，在该州获胜。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary of Agriculture Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在爱达荷州举行。该州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得爱达荷州。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. All contemporary forty-eight states took part, and state voters selected four voters to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah, like every other state west of the Continental Divide, voted for Franklin D. Roosevelt over Wendell Willkie by a substantial margin.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在犹他州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在犹他州于11月5日举行。当时美国的48个州都参加了这次总统选举，犹他州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。犹他州与大陆分水岭以西的其他各州一样，以较大优势支持富兰克林·D·罗斯福，击败温德尔·威尔基。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate special election in Illinois
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate special election in Illinois took place on November 5, 1940. The election was triggered by the vacancy left by the death in office of Democrat J. Hamilton Lewis. After Lewis' death, James M. Slattery was appointed to fill the seat in the interim period until the individual elected in the special election would be sworn in.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院伊利诺伊州特别选举
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院伊利诺伊州特别选举于11月5日举行。民主党人J·汉密尔顿·刘易斯在任内去世，造成席位空缺，因而举行特别选举。刘易斯去世后，詹姆斯·M·斯莱特里获任命暂时填补席位，直到特别选举中当选的人宣誓就职。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Delaware voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在特拉华州举行。特拉华州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得该州。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate special election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate special election in Kentucky took place on November 5, 1940, to complete the unexpired term of M. M. Logan. Interim appointee Happy Chandler was re-elected to complete the term, defeating Republican Walter B. Smith.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院肯塔基州特别选举
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院肯塔基州特别选举于11月5日举行，以补完M. M. 洛根尚未结束的任期。临时获任参议员的“快乐”钱德勒再次当选，完成该任期，并击败共和党候选人沃尔特·B·史密斯。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado was won by Wendell Willkie (R–New York), running with Minority Leader Charles L. McNary, with 50.92% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举：科罗拉多州
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在科罗拉多州举行。该州选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人温德尔·威尔基与众议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里搭档，以50.92%的普选票赢得科罗拉多州，击败民主党籍时任总统。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Mississippi voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary Henry A.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举：密西西比州
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在密西西比州举行。密西西比州选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得该州。

en.s: The 1940 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1940, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Joseph A. A. Burnquist defeated Farmer–Labor nominee David J. Erickson and Democratic nominee John D. Sullivan.

zh.s: 1940年明尼苏达州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。共和党候选人、现任检察长约瑟夫·A. A. 伯恩奎斯特击败农工党候选人大卫·J·埃里克森和民主党候选人约翰·D·沙利文。

en.s: The 1940 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1940, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Roy McKittrick defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate Ray Mabee and Socialist nominee Edward J. Flynn.

zh.s: 1940年密苏里州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。民主党候选人、现任检察长罗伊·麦基特里克击败共和党候选人、密苏里州参议院现任议员雷·梅比，以及社会主义党候选人爱德华·J·弗林。

en.s: The 1940 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Primary elections were held on September 17, 1940. Incumbent Republican Governor Julius P. Heil defeated Progressive nominee Orland Steen Loomis and Democratic nominee Francis E. McGovern with 40.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年威斯康星州州长选举于11月5日举行，初选于同年9月17日举行。共和党籍现任州长朱利叶斯·P·海尔以40.67%的得票率击败进步党候选人奥兰德·斯廷·卢米斯和民主党候选人弗朗西斯·E·麦戈文。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by Wendell Willkie (R–New York), running with Minority Leader Charles L. McNary, with 52.03% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在艾奥瓦州举行。艾奥瓦州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人温德尔·威尔基与众议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里搭档，以52.03%的普选票赢得该州，击败民主党籍时任总统。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose 23 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, Texas had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American and Mexican-American populations, and single-party Democratic rule outside local governments in a few Unionist German-American counties (chiefly Gillespie and Kendall) of Central Texas.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在得克萨斯州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在得克萨斯州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出23名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。得克萨斯州曾是南方邦联的一州，历史上有吉姆·克劳法、剥夺非裔和墨西哥裔居民选举权，以及民主党长期一党执政等情况；少数中部德裔美国人居住的亲联邦县（主要是吉莱斯皮县和肯德尔县）除外。

en.t: 1940 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1940 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 5, 1940 to elect the state's at-large representative to serve in the 77th United States Congress. Incumbent John J. Dempsey chose to run for the US Senate instead of seeking a fourth term in congress. Clinton Anderson won the open seat by 17.52% outperforming Franklin D.

zh.t: 1940年美国新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1940年美国新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于11月5日在新墨西哥州举行。该州选出一名联邦众议员，任期从第77届美国国会开始。时任众议员约翰·J·邓普西没有竞选第四个任期，转而竞选联邦参议员。克林顿·安德森赢得这个空缺席位，领先17.52%。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The United States Senate election in California of 1940 was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Republican Senator Hiram Johnson was re-elected to his fifth term in office, though he would die in office in 1945. By cross-filing and winning the Democratic and Progressive primaries, Johnson eliminated his strongest competition and handily won the general election with only nominal opposition from the Prohibition Party.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在加利福尼亚州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在加利福尼亚州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员海勒姆·约翰逊再次当选，开始第五个任期；他于1945年在任内去世。约翰逊同时参加并赢得民主党和进步党的初选，排除了最有力的竞争者，随后在大选中轻松获胜，仅遇到禁酒党候选人的象征性反对。

en.s: The 1940 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Governor Leverett Saltonstall sought a second term. He narrowly defeated Democrat Paul Dever, who would be elected governor in 1948.

zh.s: 1940年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月5日举行。现任州长莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔竞选连任第二个任期，并以微弱优势击败民主党人保罗·德弗。德弗后来于1948年当选州长。

en.s: The 1940 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee Isaac J. MacCollum defeated Republican nominee Earle D. Willey and Liberal Democratic nominee David A. Waxman.

zh.s: 1940年特拉华州副州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出副州长。民主党候选人艾萨克·J·麦科勒姆击败共和党候选人厄尔·D·威利和自由民主党候选人大卫·A·韦克斯曼。

en.s: The 1940 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Democratic nominee Robert A. Hurley defeated incumbent Republican Raymond E. Baldwin with 49.54% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人罗伯特·A·赫尔利以49.54%的得票率击败共和党籍现任州长雷蒙德·E·鲍德温。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary of Agriculture Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在俄勒冈州举行。该州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得俄勒冈州。

en.s: The 1940 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Democratic nominee Reginald L. Harris defeated Republican nominee Halsey B. Leavitt with 75.64% of the vote.

zh.t: 1940年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1940年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人雷金纳德·L·哈里斯以75.64%的得票率击败共和党候选人哈尔西·B·利维特。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas was won by Wendell Willkie (R–New York), running with Minority Leader Charles L. McNary, with 56.86 percent of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在堪萨斯州举行。选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人温德尔·威尔基与众议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里搭档，以56.86%的普选票赢得堪萨斯州，击败民主党籍时任总统。

en.s: The 1940 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic Governor Carl E. Bailey was defeated in the Democratic primary. Democratic nominee Homer Adkins defeated Republican nominee Harley C. Stump with 91.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年阿肯色州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长卡尔·E·贝利在民主党初选中落败。民主党候选人霍默·阿德金斯以91.36%的得票率击败共和党候选人哈利·C·斯塔普。

en.s: The 1940 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Republican Ralph Lawrence Carr defeated Democratic nominee George E. Saunders with 54.37% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长拉尔夫·劳伦斯·卡尔以54.37%的得票率击败民主党候选人乔治·E·桑德斯。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oklahoma was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary Henry A.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举：俄克拉何马州
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在俄克拉何马州举行。选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得该州。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Progressive U.S. Senator Robert La Follette Jr. was elected to a third term in office over Republican Fred H. Clausen and Democrat James E. Finnegan.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在威斯康星州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在威斯康星州于11月5日举行。进步党籍现任联邦参议员小罗伯特·拉福莱特击败共和党候选人弗雷德·H·克劳森和民主党候选人詹姆斯·E·芬尼根，赢得第三个任期。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose 26 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was won by the Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, with 52.20% of the popular vote. The Republican Party candidate, Wendell Willkie, garnered 47.80% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在俄亥俄州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在俄亥俄州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出26名选举人，由选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以52.20%的得票率在俄亥俄州获胜，共和党候选人温德尔·威尔基获得47.80%的选票。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 5, 1940. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Rhode Island was won by incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York, who was running against Republican businessman Wendell Willkie of New York.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在罗得岛州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在罗得岛州于11月5日举行。当时美国的48个州都参加了这次总统选举。该州选民选出4名选举人，由选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。来自纽约州的民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福击败了来自纽约州的共和党商人温德尔·威尔基，在罗得岛州获胜。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在华盛顿州举行。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得华盛顿州。

en.s: The 1940 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 5, 1940, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Forrest Smith defeated Republican nominee J. T. Waddill and Socialist nominee Helen Nichols.

zh.s: 1940年密苏里州审计长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人、现任审计长福雷斯特·史密斯击败共和党候选人J. T. 沃迪尔和社会主义党候选人海伦·尼科尔斯。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 5, 1940. Democratic Senator Joseph C. O'Mahoney ran for re-election to a second full term. He faced Republican Milward Simpson, a member of the University of Wyoming Board of Trustees and a former State Representative, in the general election. Though the presidential election in Wyoming was relatively close, O'Mahoney outperformed President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1940年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1940年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月5日在怀俄明州举行。民主党籍参议员约瑟夫·C·奥马奥尼竞选连任，争取第二个完整任期。他在大选中对阵共和党人米尔沃德·辛普森；辛普森是怀俄明大学董事会成员，也曾任州众议员。关于奥马奥尼与总统选举结果的最后一句在“Franklin D.”处中断。

en.s: The 1940 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Republican nominee Robert O. Blood defeated Democratic nominee F. Clyde Keefe with 50.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人罗伯特·O·布拉德以50.74%的得票率击败民主党候选人F. 克莱德·基夫。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在北卡罗来纳州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在北卡罗来纳州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。作为前南方邦联的一州，北卡罗来纳州曾实行吉姆·克劳法，剥夺非裔美国人的选举权，州政治也长期由民主党主导。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 5, 1940, as part of the concurrent United States presidential election. Florida voters chose seven electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Florida had been one of the most solid members of the "Solid South" ever since the 1889 poll tax disfranchised almost all blacks and most poor whites.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在佛罗里达州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在佛罗里达州于11月5日举行，与其他总统选举同时进行。佛罗里达州选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。自1889年人头税剥夺几乎所有黑人和大多数贫困白人的选举权后，佛罗里达州一直是“稳固南方”中民主党优势最明显的州之一。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 5, 1940. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. New Hampshire was won by incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York, who was running against Republican businessman Wendell Willkie of New York.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在新罕布什尔州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在新罕布什尔州于11月5日举行。当时美国的48个州都参加了这次总统选举。该州选民选出4名选举人，由选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。来自纽约州的民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福击败了来自纽约州的共和党商人温德尔·威尔基，在新罕布什尔州获胜。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic Senator Vic Donahey did not run for re-election to a second term. In the open race to succeed him, Republican Mayor of Cleveland Harold Hitz Burton defeated Democratic U.S. Representative John McSweeney.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在俄亥俄州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在俄亥俄州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员维克·多纳希没有竞选连任第二个任期。在这场开放席位的选举中，共和党人、克利夫兰市长哈罗德·希茨·伯顿击败民主党联邦众议员约翰·麦克斯威尼。

en.s: The 1940 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Republican John W. Bricker defeated Democratic nominee Martin L. Davey with 55.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长约翰·W·布里克以55.55%的得票率击败民主党候选人马丁·L·戴维。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt, running with the 11th Secretary of Agriculture, Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在怀俄明州举行。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得怀俄明州，他与第11任农业部长搭档。

en.s: The 1940 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Democratic nominee Herbert B. Maw defeated Republican nominee Don B. Colton with 52.07% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年犹他州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人赫伯特·B·莫以52.07%的得票率击败共和党候选人唐·B·科尔顿。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Sherman Minton ran for re-election to a second term, but lost narrowly to Republican Raymond E. Willis.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在印第安纳州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在印第安纳州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员谢尔曼·明顿竞选连任第二个任期，但以微弱差距败给共和党人雷蒙德·E·威利斯。

en.s: The 1940 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Democratic nominee J. Howard McGrath defeated incumbent Republican William Henry Vanderbilt III with 55.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年罗得岛州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人J·霍华德·麦格拉思以55.84%的得票率击败共和党籍现任州长威廉·亨利·范德比尔特三世。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 5, 1940. Primaries were held April 9, 1940. While the Democratic ticket of Franklin D. Roosevelt and Henry A. Wallace won the state's electors in the presidential election, the election overall saw significant victories for the Republican Party.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1940年11月5日星期二举行选举，初选于同年4月9日举行。民主党总统候选人富兰克林·D·罗斯福和竞选搭档亨利·A·华莱士赢得了该州的选举人票，但共和党在整场选举中取得了显著胜利。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic Senator Kenneth D. McKellar was re-elected to a fifth term in office, defeating Republican Howard Baker.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在田纳西州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在田纳西州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员肯尼斯·D·麦凯勒击败共和党候选人霍华德·贝克，连任第五个任期。

en.s: The 1940 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Republican Payne Ratner defeated Democratic nominee William H. Burke with 49.63% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长佩恩·拉特纳以49.63%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·H·伯克。

en.s: The 1940 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Democratic nominee Henry F. Schricker narrowly defeated Republican nominee Glenn R. Hillis with 49.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1940年印第安纳州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人亨利·F·施里克以微弱优势击败共和党候选人格伦·R·希利斯，得票率为49.92%。

en.s: The 1940 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democrat John Moses defeated Republican nominee Jack A. Patterson with 63.11% of the vote. This election marked the first time since 1910 that an incumbent Democratic Governor was re-elected or won re-election.

zh.s: 1940年北达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·摩西以63.11%的得票率击败共和党候选人杰克·A·帕特森。这是自1910年以来，民主党籍现任州长首次成功连任或再次当选。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic Senator George L. P. Radcliffe was re-elected to a second term in office, fending off an intra-party challenge from businessman Howard Bruce and easily winning the general election over Republican ex-Governor Harry Nice. This was, since the start of direct popular election of senators, the first election for the Class 1 Senate seat in Maryland when an incumbent senator was re-elected.

zh.t: 1940年美国参议院选举在马里兰州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国参议院选举在马里兰州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员乔治·L. P. 拉德克利夫连任第二个任期，击退了商人霍华德·布鲁斯的党内挑战，并在大选中轻松击败共和党前州长哈里·尼斯。自参议员改由选民直接选举以来，这是马里兰州第一区参议员首次成功连任。

en.s: The 1940 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1940, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Dwight H. Brown defeated Republican nominee Loyd Miller, Socialist nominee Henry Siroky and Socialist Labor nominee Henry W. Genck.

zh.s: 1940年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月5日举行，以选出州务卿。民主党候选人、现任州务卿德怀特·H·布朗击败共和党候选人洛伊德·米勒、社会主义党候选人亨利·西罗基和社会主义劳工党候选人亨利·W·根克。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在田纳西州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在田纳西州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出11名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。南北战争结束后一个多世纪里，田纳西州一直受战争时期形成的政治忠诚分歧影响。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota was won by Wendell Willkie (R–New York), running with Minority Leader Charles L. McNary, with 57.41% of the popular vote, against incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举：南达科他州
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在南达科他州举行。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人温德尔·威尔基与众议院少数党领袖查尔斯·L·麦克纳里搭档，以57.41%的普选票赢得南达科他州，击败民主党籍时任总统。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Secretary of Agriculture Henry A.

zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在马里兰州举行。马里兰州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福赢得该州。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Except for the Unionist Ozark counties of Newton and Searcy where Republicans controlled local government, Arkansas since the end of Reconstruction had been a classic one-party Democratic “Solid South” state.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举在阿肯色州举行
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举在阿肯色州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。除纽顿县和瑟西县这两个由共和党控制地方政府的亲联邦奥扎克山区县外，重建时期结束后，阿肯色州一直是民主党主导的典型“稳固南方”一党州。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 5, 1940, as part of the 1940 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the president of the Commonwealth & Southern Corporation Wendell Willkie and the senior U.S. senator from Oregon Charles L. McNary defeated the Democratic ticket of the incumbent president of the United States Franklin D. Roosevelt and the U.S. secretary of agriculture Henry A.

zh.t: 1940年美国总统选举：印第安纳州
zh.s: 1940年美国总统选举于11月5日在印第安纳州举行。共和党竞选组合由大型电力控股公司Commonwealth & Southern Corporation总裁温德尔·威尔基和俄勒冈州资深联邦参议员查尔斯·L·麦克纳里组成，击败了民主党竞选组合：时任美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福和农业部长亨利·A.。

en.s: The 1940 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor William E. Johnson, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee and Speaker of the Nebraska Legislature William H. Diers.

zh.t: 1940年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1940年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任副州长威廉·E·约翰逊击败民主党候选人、内布拉斯加州议会议长威廉·H·迪尔斯。

en.t: 1940 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1940 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 5, 1940, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1940年佐治亚州美国总统选举于1940年11月5日举行，是美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名代表或选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。除北佐治亚州少数历史上支持联邦的一些县外，佐治亚州自19世纪80年代以来一直由民主党主导，实行一党执政；其中以范宁县最为明显，皮肯斯县、吉尔默县和汤斯县的情况则没有那么突出。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democrat Lewis Schwellenbach did not run for a second term in office. He was succeeded by Democratic U.S. Representative Monrad C. Wallgren, who defeated Republican Stephen Foster Chadwick for the open seat.

zh.t: 1940年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1940年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举于1940年11月5日举行。民主党现任参议员刘易斯·施韦伦巴赫没有竞选连任。民主党联邦众议员蒙拉德·沃尔格伦接替他，并击败共和党候选人斯蒂芬·福斯特·查德威克，当选该空缺席位。

en.s: The 1940 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1940. Republican nominee Arthur B. Langlie narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Clarence Dill with 50.24% of the vote. Langlie's 0.74% margin of victory is the third-closest in state history. This is the only gubernatorial election in Washington in which King County has voted for the losing candidate.

zh.s: 1940年华盛顿州州长选举于1940年11月5日举行。共和党候选人阿瑟·B·兰利以微弱优势击败民主党候选人克拉伦斯·迪尔，获得50.24%的选票。兰利的胜选优势为0.74个百分点，是该州历史上第三接近的州长选举。这是华盛顿州唯一一次金县投票支持最终落败的候选人。

en.t: 1940 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1940 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 5, 1940. Incumbent Democratic Senator James M. Mead, first elected in 1938 to fill vacancy caused by the death of Royal S. Copeland, was re-elected to a full term in office, defeating Republican Bruce Barton.

zh.s: 1940年纽约州联邦参议院选举于1940年11月5日举行。民主党现任参议员詹姆斯·M·米德于1938年首次当选，填补皇家·S·科普兰去世后留下的空缺。他击败共和党候选人布鲁斯·巴顿，赢得完整任期。

en.s: The 1940 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday November 5, to elect next the Governor of Nebraska. Republican candidate and featured newspaper publisher and former state representative Dwight Griswold defeating Democratic candidate and former United States Representative for Nebraska's 5th congressional district Terry Carpenter. Griswold became the first Republican to win the governorship since 1928.

zh.s: 1940年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月5日星期二举行，选出该州下一任州长。共和党候选人、报业出版人兼前州众议员德怀特·格里斯沃尔德以50.48%的得票率击败民主党候选人、前内布拉斯加州第5国会选区联邦众议员特里·卡彭特。格里斯沃尔德是自1928年以来首位当选州长的共和党人。

en.s: The 1940 United States Senate elections coincided with the election of Franklin D. Roosevelt to his third term as president. The 32 seats of Class 1 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies. Although Roosevelt was re-elected to an unprecedented third term, support for his administration had dropped somewhat after eight years, and the Republican opposition gained three seats from the Democrats.

zh.s: 1940年美国联邦参议院选举与富兰克林·D·罗斯福当选第三个总统任期同期举行。第一类的32个席位举行常规选举，另举行特别选举填补空缺。虽然罗斯福史无前例地连任第三届总统，但执政满8年后，公众对其政府的支持有所下降，共和党从民主党手中增加了3个席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1940 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1940 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 29 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1940 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1940年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是1940年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的29个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期为4年。艾奥瓦州议会网站提供了1940年选举所采用的50个州参议院选区地图。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1940 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 5. Democratic nominee Chase Clark defeated incumbent Republican C. A. Bottolfsen with 50.48% of the vote. The next election in 1942 was a rematch, also close, with different results.

zh.s: 1940年爱达荷州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人蔡斯·克拉克以50.48%的得票率击败共和党现任州长C·A·博托尔夫森。1942年的选举中，两人再次交锋，结果仍然接近，但胜负互换。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Convoy HX 84 was the 84th of the numbered series of Allied North Atlantic HX convoys of merchant ships from Halifax, Nova Scotia, and Bermuda to Liverpool, England, during the Battle of the Atlantic. Thirty-eight ships escorted by the armed merchant cruiser HMS Jervis Bay departed from Halifax on 28 October 1940, eastbound to Liverpool.

zh.s: HX 84号船队是盟军北大西洋HX系列编号商船队中的第84支，航线从加拿大新斯科舍省哈利法克斯和百慕大前往英格兰利物浦。1940年10月28日，38艘船只在武装商船巡洋舰“杰维斯湾”号（HMS Jervis Bay）护航下从哈利法克斯启航，向东驶往利物浦。

en.s: Operation Title was an unsuccessful Allied attack on the German battleship Tirpitz during the Battle of the Atlantic in World War II. It involved two British Chariot manned torpedoes that were transported close to the battleship's anchorage in Trondheimsfjorden (the Trondheim Fjord) in occupied Norway, by a Norwegian-crewed boat between 26 and 31 October 1942. The attack was abandoned following the accidental loss of both Chariots during the evening of 31 October.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，盟军曾发动“提尔皮茨”号行动，试图袭击德国战列舰“提尔皮茨”号，但行动失败。两艘英国“战车”载人鱼雷由一艘挪威船员驾驶的船只运送，船只在1942年10月26日至31日间将鱼雷带至被占领的挪威特隆赫姆峡湾附近、战列舰停泊处。10月31日晚，两枚鱼雷意外脱落，袭击因此取消。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: Operation Cockade was a series of deception operations designed to alleviate German pressure on Allied operations in Sicily and on the Soviets on the Eastern Front by feinting various attacks into Western Europe during World War II. The Allies hoped to use Cockade to force the Luftwaffe into a massive air battle with the Royal Air Force and US Eighth Air Force to give the Allies air superiority over Western Europe.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，盟军实施了一系列名为Cockade的欺骗行动，试图通过佯攻西欧，减轻德国对盟军西西里作战以及苏联东线作战的压力。盟军希望借此引诱德国空军与英国皇家空军和美国陆军第八航空队展开大规模空战，从而取得西欧制空权。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1944 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the thirteenth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1944 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Antrim were the first Ulster team to reach the final, but disappointed on the day, failing to score as Dublin finished a three-in-a-row.

zh.t: 1944年全爱尔兰女子曲棍球高级锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1944年全爱尔兰女子曲棍球高级锦标赛决赛是该赛事第13场全爱尔兰决赛，也是1944年高级锦标赛的决胜赛。阿尔斯特省球队安特里姆队首次闯入决赛，但当天表现不佳，未能得分；都柏林队则连续第三年夺冠。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Bombing of Singapore (1944–1945) was a military campaign conducted by the Allied air forces during World War II. United States Army Air Forces (USAAF) long-range bomber units conducted 11 air raids on Japanese-occupied Singapore between November 1944 and March 1945. Most of these raids targeted the island's naval base and dockyard facilities, and minelaying missions were conducted in nearby waters.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，盟军空军对新加坡展开轰炸行动。1944年11月至1945年3月，美国陆军航空军的远程轰炸机部队对日军占领下的新加坡发动了11次空袭。大部分空袭针对岛上的海军基地和船坞设施，盟军还在附近水域执行布雷任务。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件开始日期。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1946
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1946 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 5, 1946. Republicans captured control of Congress for the first time since 1928 due to the extreme unpopularity of President Harry Truman. California was indicative of the results as Republicans gained seven seats, one of which was won by a recently returned WWII veteran named Richard Nixon. Democrats would not regain a majority of the delegation until after the 1958 election.

zh.t: 1946年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1946年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举是加州代表该州进入联邦众议院的选举，于11月5日举行。由于总统哈里·杜鲁门极不受欢迎，共和党自1928年以来首次控制国会。加利福尼亚州的结果反映了这一趋势：共和党增加7席，其中一席由刚从第二次世界大战归来的老兵理查德·尼克松赢得。直到1958年选举后，民主党才重新取得加州代表团的多数席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: An election for a seat in the United States House of Representatives took place in California's 12th congressional district on November 5, 1946, the date set by law for the elections for the 80th United States Congress. In the 12th district election, the candidates were five-term incumbent Democrat Jerry Voorhis, Republican challenger Richard Nixon, and former congressman and Prohibition Party candidate John Hoeppel. Nixon was elected with 56% of the vote, starting him on the road that would, almost a quarter century later, lead to the presidency. First elected to Congress in 1936, Voorhis had defeated lackluster Republican opposition four times in the then-rural Los Angeles County district to win re-election.

zh.t: 1946年加利福尼亚州第12国会选区选举
zh.s: 1946年11月5日，加利福尼亚州第12国会选区举行联邦众议员选举，选出第80届国会的代表。候选人包括连任五届的民主党现任议员杰里·沃里斯、共和党挑战者理查德·尼克松，以及前联邦众议员、禁酒党候选人约翰·赫普尔。尼克松以56%的选票当选，开启了他的政治道路；近四分之一世纪后，他成为总统。沃里斯1936年首次当选联邦众议员，此后在当时属洛杉矶县乡村地区的选区，四次击败实力较弱的共和党对手并连任。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1946
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent United States Senator Burton K. Wheeler, who was first elected to the Senate in 1922, and was re-elected in 1928, 1934, and 1940, ran for re-election. He was challenged in the Democratic primary by Leif Erickson, the Chief Justice of the Montana Supreme Court, and, following a close election, was narrowly defeated by Erickson. In the general election, Erickson faced State Senator Zales Ecton, the Republican nominee. Ultimately, Ecton defeated Erickson by a fairly wide margin, and won his first and only term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1946年蒙大拿州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1946年蒙大拿州美国联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。现任参议员伯顿·K·惠勒于1922年首次当选，此后在1928年、1934年和1940年连任，这次再次竞选。他在民主党初选中遭遇蒙大拿州最高法院首席法官莱夫·埃里克森挑战，经过一场势均力敌的选举后，惠勒以微弱差距败给埃里克森。大选中，埃里克森对阵共和党提名人、州参议员扎莱斯·埃克顿。埃克顿最终以较大优势获胜，赢得他唯一一个参议员任期。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1946 took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican Mortimer R. Proctor ran unsuccessfully for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont, losing to Ernest W. Gibson, Jr. in the Republican primary. Gibson defeated Democratic candidate Berthold C. Coburn in the general election.

zh.s: 1946年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长莫蒂默·R·普罗克特竞选连任第二个任期，但在共和党初选中败给小欧内斯特·W·吉布森。吉布森随后在大选中击败民主党候选人伯托尔德·C·科本。

en.s: The 1946 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1946, to elect the governor of Alabama.

zh.s: 1946年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出该州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1946
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Joseph F. Guffey sought re-election to another term, but was defeated by Republican nominee Edward Martin.

zh.t: 1946年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1946年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员约瑟夫·F·古菲竞选连任，但被共和党提名人爱德华·马丁击败。

en.s: The 1946 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Republican Robert F. Bradford defeated Democratic incumbent Maurice J. Tobin, Socialist Labor candidate Horace Hillis, and Prohibition candidate Guy S. Williams. In the race for Lieutenant Governor, Republican Arthur W. Coolidge defeated Democratic candidate Paul A. Dever, Socialist Labor candidate Francis A. Votano, and Prohibition candidate Alfred Erickson.

zh.s: 1946年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党人罗伯特·F·布拉德福德击败民主党籍现任州长莫里斯·J·托宾、社会主义劳工党候选人霍勒斯·希利斯和禁酒党候选人盖伊·S·威廉斯，当选州长。在副州长选举中，共和党人阿瑟·W·柯立芝击败民主党候选人保罗·A·德弗、社会主义劳工党候选人弗朗西斯·A·沃塔诺和禁酒党候选人阿尔弗雷德·埃里克森。
