en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1946
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican Ralph Flanders successfully ran for re-election to a full term in the United States Senate, defeating Democratic candidate Charles P. Mcdevitt.

zh.t: 1946年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1946年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员拉尔夫·弗兰德斯成功竞选完整任期，击败民主党候选人查尔斯·P·麦克德维特。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate special election in Virginia, 1946
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate special election in Virginia was held on November 5, 1946. Appointed Democratic Senator Thomas G. Burch retired after filling the vacany caused by the death of Senator Carter Glass. Absalom Willis Robertson defeated Republican Robert H. Woods and was elected to finish Glass' term in office.

zh.t: 1946年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1946年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍临时参议员托马斯·G·伯奇在填补卡特·格拉斯参议员去世后留下的空缺后退休。阿布萨隆·威利斯·罗伯逊击败共和党人罗伯特·H·伍兹，当选以完成格拉斯的剩余任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1946
en.s: The 1946 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 1946 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. Five incumbents were re-elected, but Butler B. Hare of the 3rd congressional district was defeated in the Democratic primary by W.J. Bryan Dorn. The seat remained with the Democrats and the composition of the state delegation remained solely Democratic.

zh.t: 1946年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1946年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，为该州选出6名任期两年的联邦众议员。5名现任议员成功连任，但代表第三区的巴特勒·B·黑尔在民主党初选中败给W·J·布莱恩·多恩。该席位仍由民主党保住，南卡罗来纳州代表团也继续全部由民主党人组成。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1946 was held on November 5, 1946. Republican Party nominee James H. Duff defeated Democratic Party nominee John S. Rice to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1946年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党提名人詹姆斯·H·达夫击败民主党提名人约翰·S·赖斯，当选宾夕法尼亚州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1946
en.s: The 1958 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Senator Harry F. Byrd, Sr. was re-elected to a third term after defeating Republican Lester S. Parsons.

zh.t: 1946年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于1946年11月5日举行。时任参议员哈里·F·伯德（Sr.）击败共和党人莱斯特·S·帕森斯，连任第三届。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1946 was held on November 5, 1946. It is notable in that the incumbent, Governor Earl Warren, was nominated by both the Republican and Democratic parties, as well as the Progressive party. Warren subsequently was reelected in the general election with more than 90% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月5日举行。现任州长厄尔·沃伦同时获得共和党、民主党和进步党的提名，这是这场选举的一个特点。沃伦随后在大选中获得超过90%的选票，成功连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1946 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1946. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Luther Youngdahl defeated Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party challenger Harold H. Barker.

zh.s: 1946年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月5日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人卢瑟·杨达尔击败明尼苏达民主农民劳工党挑战者哈罗德·H·巴克。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1946 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 5, 1946. Republican Alfred E. Driscoll defeated Democratic nominee Lewis G. Hansen with 57.08% of the vote. For the last time, the Governor of New Jersey was elected to a 3-year term. Afterwards, New Jersey gubernatorial elections, would be for terms of 4 years.

zh.s: 1946年新泽西州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党人阿尔弗雷德·E·德里斯科尔以57.08%的得票率击败民主党提名人刘易斯·G·汉森。这是新泽西州州长最后一次通过选举获得三年任期；此后州长选举产生的任期均为四年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1946
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1946 in Massachusetts was held on November 5, 1946. Republican Henry Cabot Lodge, Jr. defeated incumbent David I. Walsh.

zh.t: 1946年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1946年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党人小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇击败现任参议员戴维·I·沃尔什。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1946 United States Senate elections were held November 5, 1946, in the middle of Democratic President Harry S. Truman's first term after Roosevelt's death. The 32 seats of Class 1 were contested in regular elections, and four special elections were held to fill vacancies. The Republicans took control of the Senate by picking up twelve seats, mostly from the Democrats.

zh.s: 1946年美国联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行，当时民主党籍总统哈里·S·杜鲁门正处于罗斯福去世后开始的第一个任期中。常规选举改选第1类的32个席位，另举行4场特别选举填补空缺。共和党增加12席，主要从民主党手中夺得控制权。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1946, in 34 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 5, 1946. Elections took place on September 9 in Maine. In Idaho, the governor was elected to a 4-year term for the first time, instead of a 2-year term. In New Jersey, this was the last election on a 3-year cycle, before switching to a 4-year term for governors from 1949.

zh.s: 1946年11月5日，美国34个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行。缅因州的州长选举于9月9日举行。爱达荷州州长在此次选举中首次当选四年任期，此前任期为两年。新泽西州这次是最后一次按三年周期举行州长选举；从1949年起，该州州长任期改为四年。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic Senator George L. P. Radcliffe ran for a third consecutive term in office, but lost the Democratic primary to Governor of Maryland Herbert O'Conor. O'Conor narrowly defeated Republican D. John Markey to win the open seat. O'Conor's general election victory and the subsequent recount by a federal Senate Subcommittee were controversial, with each party claiming partisan manipulation by the other.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在马里兰州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在马里兰州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员乔治·L. P. 拉德克利夫竞选连任第三个连续任期，但在民主党初选中败给马里兰州州长赫伯特·奥康纳。奥康纳以微弱优势击败共和党人D·约翰·马基，赢得这一开放席位。他在大选中获胜以及随后联邦参议院小组委员会进行的重新计票引发争议，双方都指责对方操纵选举。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Tom Connally was re-elected to his fourth term in office, with only minor opposition in the Democratic primary and general elections.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在得克萨斯州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在得克萨斯州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员汤姆·康纳利再次当选，开始第四个任期。他在民主党初选和大选中都只遇到较弱的对手。

en.s: The 1946 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1946, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Frances Delaney.

zh.s: 1946年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月5日举行，以选出州务卿。共和党候选人、现任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败民主党—农工党候选人弗朗西斯·德莱尼。

en.s: The 1946 Alabama lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Alabama. The primary election was held on May 7, and the primary runoff was held on June 4. James C. Inzer was elected to a four-year term.

zh.s: 1946年阿拉巴马州副州长选举于11月5日举行。初选于5月7日举行，初选决选于6月4日举行。詹姆斯·C·因泽尔当选，任期四年。

en.s: The 1946 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter Samuel Goodland defeated Democratic nominee Daniel Hoan in a rematch of the 1944 election with 59.78% of the vote. Goodland was the last Republican until Tommy Thompson in 1990 to win Milwaukee County.

zh.s: 1946年威斯康星州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长沃尔特·塞缪尔·古德兰以59.78%的得票率击败民主党候选人丹尼尔·霍恩。这是两人继1944年之后再次对决。直到1990年汤米·汤普森当选前，古德兰是最后一位赢得密尔沃基县的共和党人。

en.s: The 1946 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democrat John Pastore defeated Republican nominee John G. Murphy with 54.27% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年罗得岛州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·帕斯托雷以54.27%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·G·墨菲。

en.s: The 1946 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1946, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and incumbent acting Attorney General William L. Hadden defeated Democratic nominee James J. O'Connell.

zh.s: 1946年康涅狄格州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。共和党候选人、代理检察长威廉·L·哈登击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·J·奥康奈尔。

en.s: The 1946 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 5, 1946, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee Hall Hammond defeated Republican nominee George Cochran Doub.

zh.s: 1946年马里兰州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。民主党候选人霍尔·哈蒙德击败共和党候选人乔治·科克伦·多布。

en.s: The 1946 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor C. Elmer Anderson of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party challenger Frank McGinn.

zh.s: 1946年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任副州长C. 埃尔默·安德森击败明尼苏达州民主党—农工党候选人弗兰克·麦金。

en.s: The 1946 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic Governor Lester C. Hunt ran for re-election to a second term. Former Republican Governor Nels H. Smith, whom Hunt defeated in 1942, announced that he would challenge Hunt for re-election, but he was defeated in the Republican primary by State Treasurer Earl Wright.

zh.s: 1946年怀俄明州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长莱斯特·C·亨特竞选连任第二个任期。共和党前州长内尔斯·H·史密斯曾于1942年败给亨特，他宣布再次挑战亨特，但在共和党初选中败给州财政部长厄尔·赖特。

en.s: The 1946 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican Robert D. Blue defeated Democratic nominee Frank Miles with 57.40% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·D·布鲁以57.40%的得票率击败民主党候选人弗兰克·迈尔斯。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic Senator Kenneth D. McKellar was re-elected to a sixth term in office. He defeated a primary challenge by Edward W. Carmack Jr. and easily won the general election against Republican William B. Ladd, and Independent candidate John Randolph Neal Jr.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在田纳西州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在田纳西州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员肯尼斯·D·麦凯勒连任第六个任期。他击退了小爱德华·W·卡马克的初选挑战，并在大选中轻松击败共和党候选人威廉·B·拉德和独立候选人小约翰·伦道夫·尼尔。

en.s: The 1946 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic Governor Benjamin Travis Laney won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee W. T. Mills with 84.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年阿肯色州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长本杰明·特拉维斯·莱尼以84.14%的得票率击败共和党候选人W. T. 米尔斯，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1946 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 5, 1946, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. The election used the same districts first drawn by the Alabama Constitution of 1901. 32 of the 35 Democratic nominees did not face any opposition in the general election. As the Democratic Party was dominant in the state, state legislative seats were generally decided at the Democratic primary election.

zh.s: 1946年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于11月5日星期二举行，选出35名州参议员，任期四年。选举沿用《1901年阿拉巴马州宪法》首次划定的选区。35名民主党候选人中有32人没有大选对手。由于民主党在该州占主导地位，州议会席位通常由民主党初选决定。

en.s: The 1946 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Republican nominee Kim Sigler defeated Democratic nominee Murray Van Wagoner with 60.28% of the vote. This was one of only two gubernatorial elections since 1928 in which Wayne County voted Republican.

zh.s: 1946年密歇根州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人金·西格勒以60.28%的得票率击败民主党候选人默里·范瓦根纳。这是自1928年以来仅有的两次韦恩县支持共和党的州长选举之一。

en.s: The 1946 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture election was held on November 5, 1946, to elect the Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture to a four-year term. The primary election was held on May 7, 1946.

zh.t: 1946年阿拉巴马州农业专员选举
zh.s: 1946年阿拉巴马州农业专员选举于11月5日举行，以选出任期四年的州农业专员。初选于1946年5月7日举行。

en.s: The 1946 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Roy J. Turner defeated Republican Olney F. Flynn and three Independents, Mickey Harrell, R. M. Funk, and Bruno Miller. Dixie Gilmer unsuccessfully sought the Democratic nomination. Harrell was the first woman to run for Governor of Oklahoma.

zh.s: 1946年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出州长。民主党人罗伊·J·特纳击败共和党人奥尔尼·F·弗林，以及三名独立候选人米奇·哈雷尔、R. M. 芬克和布鲁诺·米勒。迪克西·吉尔默竞选民主党提名但未能获提名。哈雷尔是首位竞选俄克拉何马州州长的女性。

en.s: The 1946 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican Fred G. Aandahl defeated Democratic nominee Quentin Burdick with 68.88% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年北达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长弗雷德·G·安达尔以68.88%的得票率击败民主党候选人昆廷·伯迪克。

en.s: The 1946 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Republican nominee James L. McConaughy defeated Democratic nominee Charles Wilbert Snow with 54.38% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人詹姆斯·L·麦康诺吉以54.38%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·威尔伯特·斯诺。

en.s: The 1946 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 5, 1946, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee James J. Lacy defeated Republican nominee Alexander T. Grier.

zh.s: 1946年马里兰州审计长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州审计长。民主党候选人詹姆斯·J·莱西击败共和党候选人亚历山大·T·格里尔。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate elections in Connecticut
en.s: Two United States Senate elections in Connecticut were held on November 5, 1946, to determine the next United States senator from Connecticut. One election determined who would complete the remainder of deceased Senator Francis T. Maloney's term and the other was for the regularly scheduled term from 1947 to 1953. Republican governor of Connecticut Raymond E. Baldwin won both elections.

zh.t: 1946年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1946年11月5日举行了两场美国参议院选举，以选出下一任参议员。一场选举用于补完已故参议员弗朗西斯·T·马洛尼尚未结束的任期，另一场选举则是定期选举，任期为1947年至1953年。共和党籍康涅狄格州州长雷蒙德·E·鲍德温在两场选举中都获胜。

en.s: The 1946 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1946, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat John J. Dempsey was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a third consecutive term. Former lieutenant governor William Duckworth unsuccessfully sought the Republican nomination. Sandoval County voted for a Democratic candidate for the first time since 1916.

zh.s: 1946年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出州长。民主党籍现任州长约翰·J·邓普西受任期限制，无法竞选连续第三个任期。前副州长威廉·达克沃思竞选共和党提名，但未能获提名。桑多瓦尔县自1916年以来首次支持民主党候选人。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate elections in Arizona took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Ernest McFarland ran for reelection to a second term, easily defeating his Republican challenger Ward S. Powers in the general election.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在亚利桑那州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在亚利桑那州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员欧内斯特·麦克法兰竞选连任第二个任期，并在大选中轻松击败共和党挑战者沃德·S·鲍尔斯。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 5, 1946. Primaries were held April 9, 1946.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1946年11月5日星期二举行选举。初选于1946年4月9日举行。

en.t: 1946 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1946 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 5, 1946 to elect the states two at-large representatives. Due to the 1940 Census New Mexico has 2 representatives, both elected at-large. Incumbent Democrat Clinton Anderson resigned to become United States Secretary of Agriculture.

zh.t: 1946年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1946年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于1946年11月5日星期二举行，选出该州两名全州选区众议员，进入第77届国会。根据1940年人口普查，新墨西哥州有两个联邦众议院席位，均由全州选举产生。民主党籍现任众议员克林顿·安德森辞职，转任美国农业部长。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 5, 1946. Democratic senator Joseph C. O'Mahoney ran for re-election to a third term. In the general election, he faced Republican Harry B. Henderson, the former chairman of the Republican Party of Wyoming and a former state senator.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在怀俄明州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在怀俄明州于11月5日举行。民主党参议员约瑟夫·C·奥马奥尼竞选连任第三个任期。在大选中，他面对共和党候选人哈里·B·亨德森；亨德森曾任怀俄明州共和党主席和州参议员。

en.s: The 1946 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic governor Jim Nance McCord defeated Republican nominee William O. Lowe with 65.4% of the vote. In the primary campaign, McCord faced a primary challenge from former governor Gordon Browning (who was in Germany and did not actively campaign).

zh.s: 1946年田纳西州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长吉姆·南斯·麦科德以65.4%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·O·洛。麦科德在初选中面对前州长戈登·布朗宁的挑战；当时布朗宁在德国，没有积极参选。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Robert La Follette, Jr. (who had until 1946 been a member of the Progressive Party) narrowly lost the primary election to Joseph McCarthy. McCarthy would go on to win the general election against Rep. Howard McMurray of Milwaukee in a landslide.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在威斯康星州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在威斯康星州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员小罗伯特·拉福莱特在1946年前一直是进步党成员。他在初选中以微弱差距败给约瑟夫·麦卡锡。麦卡锡随后在大选中以压倒性优势击败来自密尔沃基的联邦众议员霍华德·麦克默里。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate elections in Ohio
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate elections in Ohio was held on November 5, 1946, alongside a concurrent special election to the same seat. Former Republican Governor of Ohio and 1944 nominee for the U.S. vice presidency John W. Bricker defeated Democratic interim senator James W. Huffman, who had been appointed to fill the vacant seat left by Supreme Court Justice Harold Hitz Burton.

zh.t: 1946年俄亥俄州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 俄亥俄州于1946年11月5日举行美国参议院选举，并同时举行同一席位的特别选举。共和党前州长、1944年副总统候选人约翰·W·布里克击败民主党临时参议员詹姆斯·W·赫夫曼。赫夫曼获任填补哈罗德·希茨·伯顿离任后留下的空缺；伯顿当时已成为最高法院大法官。

en.s: The 1946 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Republican Superior Court Judge Goodwin Knight safely defeated Democratic State Senator John F. Shelley with 56.39% of the vote.

zh.t: 1946年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1946年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党高等法院法官古德温·奈特以56.39%的得票率轻松击败民主党州参议员约翰·F·谢利。

en.s: The 1946 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican Governor Merrell Q. Sharpe ran for re-election to a third term, but was defeated in the Republican primary by Attorney General George T. Mickelson. In the general election, Mickelson faced farmer Richard Haeder, the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 1946年南达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长梅雷尔·Q·夏普竞选连任第三个任期，但在共和党初选中败给州检察长乔治·T·米克尔森。米克尔森随后在大选中面对民主党候选人、农民理查德·海德。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate elections in California
en.s: The two 1946 United States Senate elections in California were held concurrently on November 5, 1946. After incumbent Republican Senator Hiram Johnson died in office in August 1945, Governor Earl Warren appointed U.S. Army Major and former State Senator William F. Knowland to finish Johnson's term until a successor could be duly elected. Knowland won both the special election to complete Johnson's term, and the regularly scheduled 1946 election, over former U.S.

zh.t: 1946年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1946年美国联邦参议员选举于11月5日在加利福尼亚州举行。共和党籍时任参议员海勒姆·约翰逊于1945年8月在任内去世后，州长厄尔·沃伦任命美国陆军少校、前州参议员威廉·F·诺兰接替约翰逊，暂任该席位直至正式选出继任者。诺兰在补选中赢得约翰逊未完成任期的席位，也赢得了当年的常规选举。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 5, 1946. Republican Senator Arthur Vandenberg was re-elected to a fourth consecutive term in a landslide over Democrat James H. Lee.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在密歇根州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在密歇根州于11月5日举行。共和党籍参议员阿瑟·范登堡以压倒性优势击败民主党人詹姆斯·H·李，连续第四次当选。

en.s: The 1946 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Republican nominee Frank Carlson defeated Democratic nominee Harry Hines Woodring with 53.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人弗兰克·卡尔森以53.50%的得票率击败民主党候选人哈里·海因斯·伍德林。

en.s: The 1946 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democrat Vail Pittman defeated Republican nominee Melvin E. Jepson with 57.42% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年内华达州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长维尔·皮特曼以57.42%的得票率击败共和党候选人梅尔文·E·杰普森。

en.t: 1946 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1946 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 80th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 5, 1946, while Maine held theirs on September 9. November 1946 was 19 months after President Harry S. Truman assumed office upon the death of Franklin D. Roosevelt.

zh.s: 1946年美国联邦众议院选举是为选出第80届国会议员而举行的选举。大部分选举于1946年11月5日举行，缅因州则在9月9日举行。1946年11月距离哈里·S·杜鲁门在富兰克林·D·罗斯福去世后接任总统已有19个月。

en.s: The 1946 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Roy W. Johnson lost to Robert B. Crosby in the Republican primaries after the Nebraska Republican Pre-Primary Convention refused to endorse him for reelection. Thus, the general election featured Robert B. Crosby as the Republican nominee who defeated Democratic nominee Robert J. Swanson.

zh.t: 1946年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1946年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任副州长罗伊·W·约翰逊在共和党预选大会拒绝支持他连任后，于共和党初选中败给罗伯特·B·克罗斯比。因此，大选中由共和党候选人克罗斯比击败民主党候选人罗伯特·J·斯旺森。

en.s: The 1946 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 5, 1946, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Stafford King defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Bernie M. Olson.

zh.s: 1946年明尼苏达州审计长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州审计长。共和党候选人、现任审计长斯塔福德·金击败民主党—农工党候选人伯尼·M·奥尔森。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Raymond E. Willis did not run for re-election. Former interim Senator William E. Jenner was elected over Governor of Indiana M. Clifford Townsend.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在印第安纳州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在印第安纳州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员雷蒙德·E·威利斯没有竞选连任。曾任临时参议员的威廉·E·詹纳击败印第安纳州州长M·克利福德·汤森德，当选参议员。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 5, 1946. It was the first election to either of Minnesota's seats in the United States Senate held since the Minnesota Democratic Party and the Farmer-Labor Party of Minnesota merged in 1944, to form the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party. Incumbent U.S.

zh.t: 1946年美国明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1946年美国联邦参议员选举于11月5日在明尼苏达州举行。这是自1944年明尼苏达州民主党与农民—劳工党合并、成立明尼苏达州民主—农民—劳工党以来，该州两个联邦参议员席位中首次举行的选举。时任联邦参议员的后续信息在原文中断。

en.s: The 1946 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Governor Sidney Preston Osborn ran for reelection, easily winning the Democratic primary, as well as defeating Republican challenger Bruce Brockett in the general election, and was sworn into his fourth term as Governor on January 7, 1947. Osborn died in office a year later.

zh.s: 1946年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长西德尼·普雷斯顿·奥斯本竞选连任，轻松赢得民主党初选，并在大选中击败共和党挑战者布鲁斯·布罗克特。奥斯本于1947年1月7日宣誓就任第四个州长任期，一年后在任内去世。

en.s: The 1946 Alabama House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 5, 1946, to elect 106 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama House of Representatives. Nearly every single representative elected was a member of the Democratic Party, with one Republican, John B. Weaver, being re-elected from Winston County. 89 of the 106 Democratic nominees did not face any opposition in the general election.

zh.t: 1946年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1946年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举于11月5日星期二举行，选出106名州众议员，任期四年。几乎所有当选者都属于民主党，只有共和党人约翰·B·韦弗在温斯顿县连任。106名民主党候选人中有89人没有大选对手。

en.s: The 1946 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic Governor Coke R. Stevenson did not seek re-election. Democratic Governor nominee Beauford H. Jester defeated Republican nominee Eugene Nolte, Jr. with 91.23% of the vote. To date, this was the last election in which a candidate for Governor of Texas won more than 90% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长科克·R·史蒂文森没有寻求连任。民主党州长候选人博福德·H·杰斯特以91.23%的得票率击败共和党候选人小尤金·诺尔特。截至目前，这是得克萨斯州州长选举中候选人得票率超过90%的最后一次。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator James M. Tunnell ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated in a landslide by Republican John J. Williams, a businessman and member of the Millsboro Town Council.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在特拉华州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在特拉华州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员詹姆斯·M·塔内尔竞选连任第二个任期，但被共和党人约翰·J·威廉姆斯以压倒性优势击败。威廉姆斯是商人，也是米尔斯伯勒镇议会成员。

en.s: The 1946 Alabama State Treasurer election was held on November 5, 1946, to elect the State Treasurer of Alabama to a four-year term. The primary election was held on May 7, 1946.

zh.t: 1946年阿拉巴马州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1946年阿拉巴马州州财政部长选举于11月5日举行，以选出任期四年的州财政部长。初选于1946年5月7日举行。

en.s: The 1946 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946, and featured former school superintendent and newspaper publisher Val Peterson, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, state Senator Frank Sorrell.

zh.s: 1946年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党人瓦尔·彼得森曾任学校督学和报纸出版人，他击败了民主党候选人、州参议员弗兰克·索雷尔。

en.s: The 1946 Alabama Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1946, to elect the Attorney General of Alabama to a four-year term. Albert A. Carmichael was elected to a second non-consecutive term.

zh.s: 1946年阿拉巴马州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出任期四年的检察长。阿尔伯特·A·卡迈克尔当选，开始第二个非连续任期。

en.s: The 1946 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican Charles M. Dale defeated Democratic nominee F. Clyde Keefe with 63.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长查尔斯·M·戴尔以63.14%的得票率击败民主党候选人F. 克莱德·基夫。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 5, 1946. Republican incumbent H. Alexander Smith, who had been elected in a 1944 special election to complete the unexpired term of the late William Warren Barbour, was re-elected over Democrat George Brunner, the mayor of Camden. As of 2026, this is the most recent time New Jersey held multiple elections for statewide office on the same day; Alfred E.

zh.t: 1946年美国新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1946年美国新泽西州联邦参议员选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍时任参议员H·亚历山大·史密斯再次当选；他在1944年特别选举中当选，接替已故的威廉·沃伦·巴伯，完成其未届满任期。史密斯击败了民主党候选人、卡姆登市长乔治·布伦纳。截至2026年，这是新泽西州最近一次在同一天举行多项全州公职选举。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate special election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate special election in Kentucky was held on November 5, 1946, to complete the unexpired term of Senator Happy Chandler, who resigned to become Commissioner of Baseball. Interim Senator William A. Stanfill did not run for the full term. Republican John Sherman Cooper defeated Democratic former U.S. Representative John Y. Brown to complete the term.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院肯塔基州特别选举
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院肯塔基州特别选举于11月5日举行，以补完参议员“快乐”钱德勒尚未结束的任期。钱德勒辞职后出任美国职业棒球大联盟专员。临时参议员威廉·A·斯坦菲尔没有竞选完整任期。共和党人约翰·谢尔曼·库珀击败民主党前联邦众议员约翰·Y·布朗，接任该席位。

en.s: The 1946 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Republican nominee Thomas J. Herbert defeated Democratic incumbent Frank Lausche with 50.64% of the vote.

zh.s: 1946年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人托马斯·J·赫伯特以50.64%的得票率击败民主党籍现任州长弗兰克·劳施。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 5, 1946. The incumbent Senator, Hugh A. Butler, was re-elected to a second term in a landslide, defeating John E. Mekota.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在内布拉斯加州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在内布拉斯加州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员休·A·巴特勒以压倒性优势连任第二个任期，击败约翰·E·梅科塔。

en.s: The 1946 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1946, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Joseph A. A. Burnquist defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Walter C. Boland.

zh.s: 1946年明尼苏达州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。共和党候选人、现任检察长约瑟夫·A. A. 伯恩奎斯特击败民主党—农工党候选人沃尔特·C·博兰。

en.s: The 1946 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946. Democratic nominee William Lee Knous defeated Republican nominee Leon Lavington with 52.11% of the vote, becoming the first Democrat to win the governorship since 1936.

zh.s: 1946年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人威廉·李·诺斯以52.11%的得票率击败共和党候选人利昂·拉文顿，并成为自1936年以来首位当选州长的民主党人。

en.s: The 1946 Alabama Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1946, to elect the Secretary of State of Alabama to a four-year term. The primary election was held on May 7, 1946.

zh.s: 1946年阿拉巴马州州务卿选举于11月5日举行，以选出任期四年的州务卿。初选于1946年5月7日举行。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democratic Senator Frank P. Briggs, who was appointed to fill the vacancy left by President Harry S. Truman, ran for election to a full term in office, but was defeated by Republican James P. Kem.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在密苏里州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在密苏里州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员弗兰克·P·布里格斯由哈里·S·杜鲁门总统任命，以填补空缺。他竞选完整任期，但败给共和党人詹姆斯·P·凯姆。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Florida Senator Charles O. Andrews did not run for re-election and died on September 18. Former Governor Spessard Holland, who served from 1941 to 1945, had already won the May Democratic primary (usually tantamount to victory in the solidly Democratic South), and was appointed to the vacant seat by Governor Millard Caldwell.

zh.t: 1946年美国参议院选举在佛罗里达州举行
zh.s: 1946年美国参议院选举在佛罗里达州于11月5日举行。佛罗里达州参议员查尔斯·O·安德鲁斯没有竞选连任，并于9月18日去世。前州长斯佩萨德·霍兰德（1941年至1945年任州长）已在5月赢得民主党初选；在民主党占主导地位的南方州，初选通常就等同于当选。州长米勒德·考德威尔随后任命霍兰德填补空缺席位。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Republican Senator William Langer ran for re-election to a second term. Langer defeated State Senator Joseph Bridston in the Republican primary, who challenged Langer over his isolationist views. In the general election, he was opposed by Abner Larson, the Democratic nominee, and former State Superintendent of Public Instruction Arthur E.

zh.t: 1946年美国北达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1946年美国联邦参议员选举于11月5日在北达科他州举行。共和党籍时任参议员威廉·兰格竞选连任，争取第二个任期。他在共和党初选中击败州参议员约瑟夫·布里德斯顿；后者因反对兰格的孤立主义立场而挑战他。大选中，兰格的对手包括民主党提名人阿布纳·拉森和前州公共教育主管。

en.s: The 1946 Massachusetts general election was held on November 5, 1946, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on June 18. At the federal level, Republican Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. was elected to the United States Senate over incumbent Senator David I. Walsh, and Republicans won nine of fourteen seats in the United States House of Representatives. Future President of the United States John F.

zh.s: 1946年马萨诸塞州普选于11月5日举行，州内各地均参与投票。初选于6月18日举行。在联邦层面，共和党人小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇击败时任参议员戴维·I·沃尔什，当选联邦参议员；共和党还赢得了联邦众议院14个席位中的9席。

en.s: The 1946 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1946 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. Republican incumbent Earl Snell defeated Democratic nominee and former U.S. District Attorney Carl C. Donaugh to win the election. Snell once again swept every county in the state, albeit with a slightly reduced (though still commanding) majority from the previous election.

zh.s: 1946年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州州长。共和党籍现任州长厄尔·斯内尔击败民主党候选人、前美国联邦地区检察官卡尔·C·多诺，成功连任。斯内尔再次赢得该州所有县的支持，但多数优势略低于上次选举，仍然十分明显。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 5, 1946.

zh.s: 1946年纽约州联邦参议院选举于1946年11月5日举行。

en.s: The 1946 New York state election was held on November 5, 1946, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, a U.S. senator, the chief judge and an associate judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1946年纽约州选举于1946年11月5日举行，选出州长、副州长、州主计长、州检察长、一名联邦参议员、纽约州上诉法院首席法官和一名副法官，以及纽约州众议院和参议院全体议员。

en.s: The 1946 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946, in order to elect the first lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee Melvin E. Thompson ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.s: 1946年佐治亚州副州长选举于1946年11月5日举行，选出该州首任副州长。民主党候选人梅尔文·E·汤普森没有对手，随后当选。

en.t: 1946 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1946 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 5, 1946. Incumbent Democrat Hugh Mitchell, who had been appointed to fill the unexpired term of Monrad Wallgren, ran for a full term in office, but was defeated by Republican Mayor of Tacoma Harry Cain. After this election, no Republican would be elected to either of Washington's U.S.

zh.t: 1946年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1946年美国华盛顿州联邦参议员选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍时任参议员休·米切尔原是由任命接替蒙拉德·沃尔格伦；他竞选完整任期，但败给共和党人、塔科马市长哈里·凯恩。此后，直到1980年斯莱德·戈顿击败时任参议员沃伦·马格努森，共和党人才再次当选华盛顿州的联邦参议员；直到1983年丹尼尔·J.·埃文斯在凯恩的继任者亨利·M.·杰克逊去世后举行的特别选举中击败迈克·洛瑞，共和党人才再次赢得这一席位。

en.s: The 1946 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1946, to elect the Governor of New York. Incumbent Republican governor Thomas E. Dewey was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating U.S. Senator James M. Mead.

zh.s: 1946年纽约州州长选举于1946年11月5日举行，选出纽约州州长。共和党现任州长托马斯·E·杜威击败联邦参议员詹姆斯·M·米德，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1946 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 5. Republican nominee C. A. Robins defeated Democratic incumbent Arnold Williams with 56.37% of the vote. Idaho changed the term for governor from two to four years starting with this election, and the winner was not allowed to run for a second term (self-succession) until 1958.

zh.s: 1946年爱达荷州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人C·A·罗宾斯以56.37%的得票率击败民主党现任州长阿诺德·威廉姆斯。自本次选举起，州长任期由2年延长为4年；直到1958年，胜选者才可再次竞选连任。

en.s: The 1946 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 5, to elect next the Governor of Maryland. Democratic candidate William Preston Lane Jr. defeated Republican candidate and former mayor of Baltimore and Future Governor of Maryland Theodore McKeldin.

zh.s: 1946年马里兰州州长选举于11月5日星期二举行，选出下一任州长。民主党候选人威廉·普雷斯顿·莱恩二世击败了共和党候选人西奥多·麦凯尔丁。麦凯尔丁曾任巴尔的摩市长，后来也担任过马里兰州州长。

en.s: The 1946 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1946 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 23 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1946 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1946年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院50个选区中的23个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期为四年。爱荷华州议会提供了1946年选举中这50个州参议院选区的全州地图。

en.t: Autumn Offensive of 1947 in Northeast China
en.s: The Autumn Offensive of 1947 in Northeast China (Chinese: 東北1947年秋季戰役) was a series of battles initiated by the communists against the nationalists during the Chinese Civil War after World War II.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1947年中国东北秋季攻势（中文：東北1947年秋季戰役）是第二次世界大战后中国内战期间，共产党对国民党发动的一系列战役。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1948 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1948 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 29 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1948 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1948年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院50个选区中的29个选区选出参议员。州参议员任期为四年。爱荷华州议会提供了1948年这50个州参议院选区的全州地图。

en.s: The Battle of Pakchon (5 November 1950), also known as the Battle of Bochuan (Chinese: 博川战斗; pinyin: Bó Chuān Zhàn Dòu), took place ten days after the start of the Chinese First Phase Offensive, following the entry of the People's Volunteer Army into the Korean War. The offensive reversed the United Nations (UN) advance towards the Yalu River which had occurred after their intervention in the wake of the North Korean invasion of South Korea at the start of the war. The battle was fought between British and Australian forces from the 27th British Commonwealth Brigade with American armour and artillery in support, and the Chinese 117th Division, around the village of Pakchon on the Taeryong River.

zh.s: 博川战役发生于1950年11月5日，也称博川之战，距离中国人民志愿军入朝、发起第一次战役攻势十天。中国军队的攻势扭转了联合国军在介入朝鲜战争、支援韩国抵抗朝鲜入侵后向鸭绿江推进的局势。交战双方是英澳军队组成的第27英联邦旅（有美军装甲部队和炮兵支援）与中国人民志愿军第117师，战斗地点在泰龙江畔的博川村附近。

en.s: The Invasion of Ambon (Indonesian: Invasi Ambon) was a combined Indonesian military operation which aimed to seize and annex the self-proclaimed Republic of South Maluku (Republik Maluku Selatan, abbreviated RMS).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安汶岛入侵（印度尼西亚语：Invasi Ambon）是印度尼西亚发动的一次联合军事行动，目标是夺取并吞并自行宣布成立的南马鲁古共和国（简称RMS）。

en.s: The 1952 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1952. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Ancher Nelsen defeated Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party challenger Arthur Hansen.

zh.s: 1952年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月5日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人安彻·尼尔森击败明尼苏达州民主党—农工党候选人阿瑟·汉森。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1957 occurred on Tuesday, November 5, 1957, with incumbent Democratic Mayor Robert F. Wagner, Jr. going on to decisively win a re-election victory for a second term in office. Wagner easily defeated the Republican nominee, Hotel Astor manager Robert K. Christenberry. The popular incumbent, supported by the powerful Tammany Hall political machine, easily secured a decisive re-election victory. Wagner received 69.23% of the vote to Christenberry's 26.86%, a landslide Democratic victory margin of 42.37%. In a distant third was the United Taxpayers candidate Vito P. Battista, who received 3.08% of the vote.

zh.s: 1957年纽约市市长选举于11月5日（星期二）举行。民主党籍现任市长罗伯特·F·瓦格纳二世成功连任，开启第二个任期。他轻松击败共和党候选人、阿斯特酒店经理罗伯特·K·克里斯滕伯里。得到强大的坦慕尼协会政治机器支持的瓦格纳广受欢迎，以压倒性优势获胜，得票率为69.23%，克里斯滕伯里为26.86%，两人差距为42.37个百分点。远远落后的第三名是纳税人联合会候选人维托·P·巴蒂斯塔，得票率为3.08%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1957 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 5, 1957. The incumbent mayor, David Lawrence of the Democratic Party won an unprecedented fourth term. Lawrence defeated former Court of Common Pleas Judge John Drew. For the third straight election, the powerful mayor gained quiet support from the Republican business community for his urban renewal projects, which compromised the GOP candidate's position.

zh.s: 1957年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1957年11月5日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长戴维·劳伦斯赢得史无前例的第四个任期，击败前普通诉讼法院法官约翰·德鲁。连续第三次选举中，这位有影响力的市长都获得共和党商界人士的低调支持，他们认可他的城市更新项目；这使共和党候选人的处境受到影响。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1957 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 5, 1957. Incumbent Democrat Robert B. Meyner defeated Republican nominee Malcolm Forbes with 54.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1957年新泽西州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长罗伯特·B·迈纳以54.55%的得票率击败共和党提名人马尔科姆·福布斯。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1957 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1957, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Allie Edward Stakes Stephens defeated Republican nominee Horace E. Henderson and Independent candidate J. B. Brayman.

zh.s: 1957年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出副州长。民主党候选人、现任副州长阿利·爱德华·斯泰克斯·斯蒂芬斯击败共和党候选人霍勒斯·E·亨德森和独立候选人J. B. 布雷曼。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 5, 1957, in two states, New Jersey and Virginia.

zh.s: 美国于1957年11月5日在新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1957 saw the second re-election of Anthony J. Celebrezze. Mayor Celebrezze again ran unopposed in the general election by virtue of having captured a majority of votes in the primary election, under the laws of the city charter.

zh.s: 1957年克利夫兰市长选举中，安东尼·J·塞莱布雷兹第二次连任。根据市宪章的规定，塞莱布雷兹在初选中获得多数票后，在大选中没有对手。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the 1957 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor Thomas B. Stanley, a Democrat, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. State Senator Theodore Roosevelt Dalton was again nominated by the Republican Party to run against former Democratic Attorney General J. Lindsay Almond. As of 2025, this is the last occasion when Rockingham County or Shenandoah County voted Democratic for Governor.

zh.s: 1957年弗吉尼亚州州长选举中，民主党籍现任州长托马斯·B·斯坦利因任期限制无法竞选连任。共和党再次提名州参议员西奥多·罗斯福·道尔顿，对阵前民主党籍州检察长J·林赛·阿尔蒙德。截至2025年，这是罗金厄姆县或谢南多厄县最后一次在州长选举中支持民主党候选人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1957 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 5. The elections coincided with the re-election of Governor Robert Meyner. Ten of New Jersey's 21 counties elected Senators. Democrats gained one seat in Passaic County, where Anthony J. Grossi unseated incumbent Republican Frank W. Shershin.

zh.s: 1957年新泽西州参议院选举于11月5日举行，与州长罗伯特·迈纳连任同时进行。新泽西州21个县中有10个县选举参议员。民主党在帕赛克县赢得一个席位，安东尼·J·格罗西击败了共和党籍现任议员弗兰克·W·谢尔申。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1957 Philadelphia municipal election, held on November 5, involved the election of the district attorney, city controller, and the remainder of a term for one city council seat, as well as several row offices and judgeships. Democrats were successful citywide, continuing a run of victories racked up after the passage of a new city charter in 1951 despite growing divisions between factions of the party.

zh.s: 1957年费城地方选举于11月5日举行，选举地方检察官、市审计长、一名市议员的剩余任期人选，以及若干基层公职人员和法官。民主党在全市获胜。自1951年通过新市宪章以来，民主党持续赢得选举，但党内派系分歧日益加深。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1961 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 5. The elections took place alongside the election of Governor Richard J. Hughes. Ten of New Jersey's 21 counties elected Senators; no seats changed hands.

zh.s: 1961年新泽西州参议院选举于11月5日举行，同时还举行了州长理查德·J·休斯的选举。新泽西州21个县中有10个县选举参议员；没有席位易手。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1963 occurred on Tuesday, November 5, 1963 between Mayor of Boston John F. Collins and Boston City Council member Gabriel Piemonte. Collins was elected to his second term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 24, 1963.

zh.s: 1963年波士顿市长选举于11月5日星期二举行，参选者是市长约翰·F·柯林斯和波士顿市议员加布里埃尔·皮耶蒙特。柯林斯当选，开始第二个任期。市政无党派初选于1963年9月24日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Columbus mayoral election of 1963 was the 72nd mayoral election in Columbus, Ohio. It was held on Tuesday, November 5, 1963. Incumbent Republican mayor Ralston Westlake was defeated by Democratic party nominee and former mayor Jack Sensenbrenner.

zh.t: 1963年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举
zh.s: 1963年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举是该市第72次市长选举，于1963年11月5日星期二举行。民主党提名人、前市长杰克·森森布伦纳击败共和党籍现任市长拉尔斯顿·韦斯特莱克。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1963 took place on November 5, 1963, and saw the election of John J. Barton. Barton won a hotly contested Democratic primary. Barton defeated Republican Clarence Drayer and independent candidate Samuel Unger in the general election. Barton's campaign platform promised to reform the Indianapolis Police Department, involve the community in decision making, seek federal assistance for Indianapolis whenever possible, practice slum clearance, and make infrastructure repairs.

zh.t: 1963年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1963年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于11月5日举行，约翰·J·巴顿当选。他在竞争激烈的民主党初选中获胜，随后在大选中击败共和党人克拉伦斯·德雷耶和独立候选人塞缪尔·昂格尔。巴顿竞选时承诺改革印第安纳波利斯警察局、让社区参与决策、尽可能争取联邦援助、清理贫民区并修缮基础设施。

en.s: The 1963 Mississippi House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 1963, in the U.S. State of Mississippi to elect members of the Mississippi House of Representatives for its 1964 session. The Democratic primaries were held on August 6, with runoffs held if necessary on August. 27. This was the first state house election after the 1963 referendum passing reapportionment of the state legislature, the first time the state had done so since 1890.

zh.s: 1963年密西西比州众议院选举于11月5日举行，选出州众议员，任期从1964年开始。民主党初选于8月6日举行，需要决选时则于8月27日进行。这是1963年公投通过州议会重新划分选区后的首次州众议院选举，也是该州自1890年以来首次重新划分选区。

en.s: The 1963 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1963. Democratic nominee Ned Breathitt defeated Republican nominee Louie Nunn with 50.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1963年肯塔基州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人内德·布雷西特以50.74%的得票率击败共和党候选人路易·纳恩。

en.s: The 1963 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1963, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Ross Barnett was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term.

zh.s: 1963年密西西比州州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出州长。民主党籍现任州长罗斯·巴内特受任期限制，无法竞选连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1963 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 5, 1963.

zh.s: 1963年旧金山市长选举于1963年11月5日举行。

en.s: The 1963 San Diego mayoral election was held on November 5, 1963, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent mayor Charles Dail did not stand for reelection. In the primary election, Frank Curran and Murray Goodrich received the most votes and advanced to the runoff. Curran was then elected mayor with a majority of the votes.

zh.s: 1963年圣迭戈市长选举于1963年11月5日举行，选出圣迭戈市长。现任市长查尔斯·戴尔没有竞选连任。初选中得票最高的是弗兰克·柯伦和默里·古德里奇，两人进入决选。柯伦随后以多数票当选市长。

en.s: The 1963 Philadelphia municipal election, held on November 5, involved contests for mayor, all seventeen city council seats, and several other executive and judicial offices. The Democrats lost vote share citywide and the Republicans gained one seat in City Council, but the Democratic acting mayor, James Tate, was elected to a full term and his party maintained their hold on the city government.

zh.s: 1963年费城地方选举于11月5日举行，选举市长、全部17个市议会席位，以及其他若干行政和司法职位。民主党在全市的得票率下降，共和党在市议会增加一个席位，但民主党籍代理市长詹姆斯·泰特当选完整任期，民主党也继续掌控市政府。

en.s: The 1963 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 5. The elections took place midway through the first term of Governor Richard J. Hughes. Eleven of New Jersey's 21 counties elected Senators. Republicans gained four seats by flipping one seat each in Burlington, Camden, Gloucester, and Essex counties.

zh.s: 1963年新泽西州参议院选举于11月5日举行，当时州长理查德·J·休斯的首个任期过半。新泽西州21个县中有11个县选举参议员。共和党在伯灵顿县、卡姆登县、格洛斯特县和埃塞克斯县各赢得一个席位，共增加四席。

en.t: Mayoral elections in South Bend, Indiana
en.s: Mayoral elections are held in South Bend, Indiana for the city's mayor every four years in the year immediately preceding that of United States presidential elections. South Bend held its first mayoral election in 1865, the year in which the city was incorporated (electing William G. George, its first mayor). This first mayoral election took place in early June 1865, only two weeks after the formal incorporation of the city.

zh.s: 南本德每四年举行一次市长选举，年份安排在美国总统选举的前一年。南本德于1865年举行首次市长选举，当时该市刚刚建制，威廉·G.·乔治当选首任市长。这次首次选举在1865年6月上旬举行，距该市正式建制仅两周。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1963 saw the re-election of Ralph S. Locher. Mayor Locher ran unopposed in the general election.

zh.s: 1963年克利夫兰市长选举中，拉尔夫·S·洛克尔连任。他在大选中没有对手。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1967 North Yemen coup d'état was a bloodless overthrow of President Abdullah al-Sallal on November 5, 1967, in the Yemen Arab Republic. Yemeni dissidents and tribal forces carried out the coup, acting with the quiet approval of Sallal's main backer Nasserist Egypt. This was due to a major shift in Egyptian foreign policy.

zh.s: 1967年11月5日，也门阿拉伯共和国发生不流血政变，总统阿卜杜拉·萨拉勒被推翻。也门反对派人士和部落武装发动政变，萨拉勒的主要支持者纳赛尔主义者埃及对此默许。政变发生的背景是埃及外交政策发生重大转变。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 5, 1968 as part of the 1968 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont was won by the Republican nominee, former Vice President Richard Nixon of California, and his running mate Governor Spiro Agnew of Maryland, defeating incumbent Democratic Vice President Hubert H. Humphrey of Minnesota and his running mate Senator Edmund Muskie of Maine.

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by Richard Nixon (R-California) with 45.3% of the popular vote against incumbent Vice President Hubert Humphrey (D-Minnesota) with 42.6%. Nixon ultimately won the national vote as well, defeating Humphrey and becoming the next President. Alaska has only voted Democratic once, and that was in the previous 1964 election for incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson, who did not run for re-election.

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 5, 1968 in Minnesota as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent Vice President Hubert Humphrey, the home-state favorite, won the state over former Vice President Richard Nixon by 199,095 votes, giving him one of his fourteen victories in the election. The American Independent Party candidate, former Alabama governor George Wallace, failed to make a substantial impact in Minnesota, as his base of support was primarily in the Deep South.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1968
en.s: The 1968 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 1968 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 5, 1968. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1968 United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. en.s: The 1968 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Governor of Montana Tim M. Babcock, who became Governor upon the death of previous Governor Donald Grant Nutter and was re-elected in 1964, ran for re-election. He faced serious competition in the Republican primary from his Lieutenant Governor, but managed to comfortably win renomination. Advancing to the general election, Babcock faced Forrest H. Anderson, the Attorney General of Montana and the Democratic nominee, and independent candidate Wayne Montgomery of the New Reform Party. Ultimately, Anderson managed to defeat Babcock by a solid margin, winning his first and only term as governor.

en.t: United States presidential election in Alabama, 1968
en.s: The United States presidential election in Alabama, 1968 was held on November 5, 1968. Southern populist and segregationist candidate George Wallace, the former Governor of Alabama running as a third party candidate with his American Independent Party, won his home state in a landslide. Wallace received the official Democratic Party ballot line in Alabama, while national Democratic Party nominee Hubert H. Humphrey was forced to run on the National Democratic party ballot line. Wallace won 65.86% to Democrat Hubert Humphrey's 18.72%, a 47.13% margin. Republican Richard Nixon, while narrowly winning the election nationally, finished a distant third in Alabama with only 13.99%.

en.t: United States presidential election in Ohio, 1968

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1968
en.s: The 1968 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 5, 1968. The incumbent, Republican Senator Milton Young, sought and received re-election to his fifth term, defeating North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party candidate Herschel Lashkowitz, the mayor of Fargo, North Dakota since 1954. Only Young filed as a Republican, and the endorsed Democratic candidate was Herschel Lashkowitz of Fargo, North Dakota, who was serving as the mayor of the city since 1954. Young and Lashkowitz won the primary elections for their respective parties. One independent candidate, Duane Mutch of Larimore, North Dakota, also filed before the deadline.

zh.t: 1968年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员米尔顿·扬竞选连任第五个任期，并击败北达科他州民主党—无党派联盟候选人、从1954年起担任法戈市长的赫歇尔·拉什科维茨。只有扬以共和党人身份登记参选；民主党认可的候选人是拉什科维茨。两人分别赢得本党初选。拉里莫尔居民杜安·马奇是唯一在截止日前登记的独立候选人。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 5, 1968. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent Vice President Hubert Humphrey, very narrowly carried Texas with 41.4% of the vote, giving him the state's 25 electoral votes. However he narrowly lost the general election to Republican candidate, former Vice President Richard Nixon. Former Alabama Governor George Wallace was a notable candidate in the 1968 presidential election, running as a candidate for the American Independent Party, a far-right political party. He was known for his pro-segregationist politics, which won him 5 southern states in the general election.

zh.t: 1968年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1968年得克萨斯州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人、现任副总统休伯特·汉弗莱以41.4%的选票险胜，拿下该州25张选举人票，但他在全国选举中败给共和党候选人、前副总统理查德·尼克松。前阿拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士也参加了1968年总统选举，代表右翼政党美国独立党参选。他以支持种族隔离的政治主张闻名，并在全国大选中赢得5个南方州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 5, 1968, throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana voted for the Republican nominee, former Vice President Richard Nixon, over the Democratic nominee, Vice President Hubert Humphrey. Nixon won Montana by a large margin of 9.01%. A third party candidate, former Alabama Governor George Wallace, played a significant role by winning 7.29% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年蒙大拿州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年在美国全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。蒙大拿州支持共和党候选人、前副总统理查德·尼克松，击败民主党候选人、现任副总统休伯特·汉弗莱。尼克松以9.01个百分点的较大优势赢得蒙大拿州。第三党候选人、前阿拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士获得7.29%的选票，对选举产生了重要影响。

en.s: The 1968 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1968, to elect the governor of West Virginia.

en.s: General elections were held in Puerto Rico on 5 November 1968. Luis A. Ferré of the New Progressive Party (PNP) was elected Governor. In the House of Representatives elections the PNP won a plurality of the vote, but the Popular Democratic Party won a majority of the seats. They also won a majority of seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 78.4%.

zh.s: 波多黎各于1968年11月5日举行大选。新进步党（PNP）的路易斯·A·费雷当选总督。在众议院选举中，PNP赢得最多选票，但人民民主党赢得过半席位；人民民主党也在参议院赢得过半席位。投票率为78.4%。

en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 5, 1968 to elect one of Illinois's members to the United States Senate. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator and Minority Leader Everett Dirksen won re-election to his fourth term.

zh.s: 1968年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行，选出一名该州联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员、参议院少数党领袖埃弗里特·德克森连任第四个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in South Carolina, 1968
en.s: The 1968 South Carolina United States Senate election was held on November 5, 1968 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of South Carolina. Incumbent Democratic Senator Fritz Hollings easily defeated Republican state senator Marshall Parker in a rematch of the election two years earlier.

zh.t: 1968年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行，选出该州联邦参议员。民主党籍现任参议员弗里茨·霍林斯轻松击败共和党州参议员马歇尔·帕克。这是两人继两年前的选举后再次交锋。

en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican George Aiken ran successfully for re-election to another term in the United States Senate; he was unopposed.

zh.s: 1968年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员乔治·艾肯成功竞选连任，且没有对手。

Incumbent Democratic Governor John Connally did not run for reelection to a fourth term, so the election pitted Democrat Preston Smith against Republican Paul Eggers. Smith was easily elected, winning 57% of the vote to Eggers' 43%.

zh.s: 1968年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出该州州长。民主党籍现任州长约翰·康纳利没有竞选第四个任期，因此选举由民主党人普雷斯顿·史密斯对阵共和党人保罗·埃格斯。史密斯轻松当选，得票率为57%，埃格斯为43%。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oregon, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Oregon was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Wayne Morse was seeking a fifth term, but narrowly lost re-election to 36 year-old Republican State Representative Bob Packwood in a very close race.

zh.t: 1968年俄勒冈州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年俄勒冈州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员韦恩·莫斯竞选第五个任期，但在势均力敌的选举中以微弱劣势败给36岁的共和党州众议员鲍勃·帕克伍德。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 5, 1968. Wisconsin voters chose twelve electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate Richard Nixon won the state with 48% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's twelve electoral votes.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在威斯康星州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在威斯康星州的投票于11月5日举行。威斯康星州选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人理查德·尼克松赢得该州48%的普选票，并获得威斯康星州的12张选举人票。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1968 took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democrat Philip H. Hoff did not run for re-election to another term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Deane C. Davis defeated Democratic candidate John J. Daley to succeed him.

zh.s: 1968年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长菲利普·H·霍夫没有竞选连任。共和党候选人迪恩·C·戴维斯击败民主党候选人约翰·J·戴利，接任州长。

en.s: The 1968 United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1968, concurrent with the 1968 Presidential Election on 5 November 1968. These were the last gubernatorial elections for Arizona, New Mexico, and Wisconsin to take place in a presidential election year, as all would extend their governor's terms from two to four years.

zh.s: 1968年美国各州州长选举于1968年11月5日举行，与1968年总统选举同日。这是亚利桑那州、新墨西哥州和威斯康星州最后一次在总统选举年举行州长选举，因为这三个州随后都把州长任期从两年延长到四年。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1968
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1968 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 5, 1968. The delegation remained unchanged, at 21 Democrats and 17 Republicans.

zh.s: 1968年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，是联邦众议院大选的一部分。加州代表团席位分布未变，民主党仍占21席，共和党17席。

en.s: The North Carolina United States Senate election of 1968 was held on 5 November 1968 as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate. zh.t: 1968年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举于1968年11月5日举行，是全国联邦参议院选举的一部分。大选由民主党籍现任参议员萨姆·欧文对阵共和党提名人罗伯特·萨默斯。欧文赢得第三个完整任期，得票率超过60%。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Joseph S. Clark, Jr. sought re-election to another term, but was defeated by Republican nominee Richard Schweiker.

zh.t: 1968年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员约瑟夫·S·克拉克二世竞选连任，但被共和党提名人理查德·施韦克击败。
