en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the overall 1968 United States presidential election. Illinois voters selected 26 electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which would then choose the president and vice president. Illinois had been consistently Republican during the "System of 1896," with the exception of a few areas in the southern part of the state that sympathized with the Confederacy during the American Civil War.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在伊利诺伊州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在伊利诺伊州的投票于11月5日举行。伊利诺伊州选民选出26名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。在“1896年体系”期间，伊利诺伊州一直稳定支持共和党，例外是该州南部的少数地区；这些地区在美国南北战争期间同情邦联。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 5, 1968. Primaries were held on June 11, 1968.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于1968年11月5日星期二举行选举。初选于1968年6月11日举行。

en.s: The 1968 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Democratic nominee William S. Morris defeated Republican nominee Lem T. Jones Jr. with 56.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年密苏里州副州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人威廉·S·莫里斯以56.97%的得票率击败共和党候选人小莱姆·T·琼斯。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Arkansas was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic Senator J. William Fulbright was re-elected to a fifth term, defeating Democratic and Republican challengers. However, Fulbright saw his margin of victory reduced by twenty points, following the national trend of the Republicans gaining ground in federal politics.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在阿肯色州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在阿肯色州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员J·威廉·富布赖特击败民主党和共和党候选人，连任第五个任期。不过，富布赖特的胜选优势缩小了20个百分点，反映出共和党在联邦政治中扩大影响力的全国趋势。

en.s: The 1968 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democrat Robert Docking narrowly defeated Republican nominee Rick Harman with 51.9% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长罗伯特·多金以微弱优势击败共和党候选人里克·哈曼，得票率为51.9%。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Thruston Morton retired from office. Jefferson County Judge (the equivalent of a County Executive) Marlow Cook won the open seat.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在肯塔基州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在肯塔基州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员瑟斯顿·莫顿退休。杰斐逊县法官（相当于县行政长官）马洛·库克赢得这一开放席位。

en.s: The 1968 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1968, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee John Danforth defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Norman H. Anderson.

zh.s: 1968年密苏里州检察长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州检察长。共和党候选人约翰·丹佛斯击败民主党候选人、现任检察长诺曼·H·安德森。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Carl Hayden, 91, decided not to run for reelection to an eighth term, ending his 57-year-long career in Congress. Hayden's longtime staff member, Roy Elson, ran as the Democratic Party nominee to replace him. Elson was defeated by a wide margin, however, by former U.S.

zh.t: 1968年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1968年美国联邦参议员选举于11月5日在亚利桑那州举行。91岁的民主党籍时任联邦参议员卡尔·海登决定不竞选连任，不再争取第八个任期，结束其长达57年的国会生涯。海登长期的幕僚罗伊·埃尔森获民主党提名接替他，但最终以较大差距落败。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 5, 1968. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 9 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president of the United States.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在肯塔基州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在肯塔基州于11月5日举行。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次总统选举。肯塔基州选民选出9名选举人，由选举人团投票选举美国总统和副总统。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Arkansas was held on November 5, 1968 as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. American Independent candidate George Wallace won the state of Arkansas with 235,627 votes, with Republican Richard Nixon winning 189,062 and Democrat Hubert Humphrey winning 184,901. With 38.87% of the popular vote, Arkansas would prove to be Wallace's weakest state that he carried in the 1968 election after Alabama, Mississippi, Louisiana and Georgia.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在阿肯色州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在阿肯色州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。美国独立党候选人乔治·华莱士赢得阿肯色州，获得235,627票；共和党候选人理查德·尼克松获得189,062票，民主党候选人休伯特·汉弗莱获得184,901票。华莱士在赢得的州中，只有阿拉巴马州、密西西比州、路易斯安那州和佐治亚州的得票率高于阿肯色州；在阿肯色州，他获得38.87%的选票。

en.s: The 1968 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican Governor Nils Boe did not stand for re-election. Republican nominee Frank Farrar defeated Democratic nominee Robert Chamberlin with 57.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年南达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长尼尔斯·博没有竞选连任。共和党候选人弗兰克·法勒以57.65%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伯特·张伯伦。

en.s: The 1968 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Republican nominee Robert D. Ray defeated Democratic nominee Paul Franzenburg with 54.06% of the vote. No Democrat would be elected Governor of Iowa until 1998.

zh.s: 1968年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人罗伯特·D·雷以54.06%的得票率击败民主党候选人保罗·弗兰岑伯格。直到1998年，民主党人才再次当选艾奥瓦州州长。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Birch Bayh was re-elected to a second consecutive term in office, defeating Republican State Representative William Ruckelshaus.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在印第安纳州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在印第安纳州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员伯奇·贝赫连任第二个连续任期，击败共和党州众议员威廉·鲁克尔斯豪斯。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Daniel Brewster ran for re-election to a second term in office but was defeated by Republican U.S. Representative Charles Mathias. Mathias may have benefited from the campaign of George P. Mahoney, the 1966 Democratic nominee for Governor of Maryland, who ran on the George Wallace American Independent ticket and garnered a significant chunk of the vote.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在马里兰州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在马里兰州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员丹尼尔·布鲁斯特竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党联邦众议员查尔斯·马蒂亚斯。马蒂亚斯可能受益于乔治·P·马奥尼的竞选。马奥尼曾是1966年马里兰州州长选举的民主党候选人，这次以乔治·华莱士的美国独立党候选人身份参选，获得了相当一部分选票。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Louisiana was held on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Along with four other contiguous southern states, former and future Alabama Governor George Wallace won the state for the American Party by a large margin against Democrat Hubert Humphrey and Republican Richard Nixon. As of the 2024 presidential election, this is the last election in which Jefferson Parish, St.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举：路易斯安那州
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举于11月5日在路易斯安那州举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。路易斯安那州与其他四个南方州一样，以较大优势支持前任及未来的阿拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士，使他代表美国党赢得该州，击败民主党候选人休伯特·汉弗莱和共和党候选人理查德·尼克松。截至2024年总统选举，杰斐逊堂区、圣……。

en.s: The 1968 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Democratic nominee Robert W. Scott defeated Republican nominee Jim Gardner with 52.70% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人罗伯特·W·斯科特以52.70%的得票率击败共和党候选人吉姆·加德纳。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent Vice President Hubert H.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举：康涅狄格州
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举于11月5日在康涅狄格州举行，全国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持民主党提名人、时任副总统。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 5, 1968. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 11 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在田纳西州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在田纳西州于11月5日举行。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次总统选举。田纳西州选民选出11名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1968 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Democratic incumbent Cal Rampton defeated Republican nominee Carl W. Buehner with 68.71% of the vote. Rampton's victory was despite Republican candidate Richard Nixon winning the state with over 56% of the vote in the concurrent presidential election. Rampton's share of the vote was the highest by any gubernatorial candidate in Utah to that point; Rampton would subsequently break his own record in the following election.

zh.s: 1968年犹他州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长卡尔·兰普顿以68.71%的得票率击败共和党候选人卡尔·W·比纳。尽管共和党候选人理查德·尼克松在同期总统选举中以超过56%的得票率赢得犹他州，兰普顿仍然获胜。他的得票率当时是犹他州州长候选人中最高的；在下次选举中，兰普顿又打破了自己的纪录。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Republican candidate former Vice President Richard Nixon, with 59.82% of the popular vote, against the Democratic candidate former Senator and incumbent Vice President Hubert Humphrey, with 31.81% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在内布拉斯加州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在内布拉斯加州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前副总统理查德·尼克松以59.82%的得票率赢得该州；民主党候选人、前参议员兼时任副总统休伯特·汉弗莱获得31.81%的选票。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 5, 1968. The Republican ticket of the former vice president of the United States Richard Nixon and the governor of Maryland Spiro Agnew defeated the Democratic ticket of the incumbent vice president Hubert Humphrey and the junior U.S. senator from Maine Edmund Muskie.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在印第安纳州举行
zh.s: 1968年11月5日，印第安纳州举行总统选举。共和党候选人、美国前副总统理查德·尼克松及其竞选搭档、马里兰州州长斯皮罗·阿格纽，击败了民主党候选人、时任副总统休伯特·汉弗莱及其竞选搭档、缅因州联邦参议员埃德蒙·马斯基。

en.s: The 1968 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Democratic nominee Hoyt Patrick Taylor Jr. defeated Republican nominee Don H. Garren with 55.36% of the vote.

zh.t: 1968年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1968年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人小霍伊特·帕特里克·泰勒以55.36%的得票率击败共和党候选人唐·H·加伦。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by the Democratic candidate, Vice President Hubert Humphrey, with 49.60 percent of the popular vote, against the Republican candidate, former Senator and Vice President Richard Nixon, with 40.78 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在西弗吉尼亚州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在西弗吉尼亚州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、副总统休伯特·汉弗莱以49.60%的得票率在西弗吉尼亚州获胜，共和党候选人、前参议员兼副总统理查德·尼克松获得40.78%的选票。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Delaware was held on November 5, 1968. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Republican former Vice President Richard Nixon, who won the state by 7,529 votes over Democratic incumbent Vice President Hubert Humphrey. Also running was former and future Alabama Governor George Wallace on the "American Independent" ticket.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在特拉华州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在特拉华州于11月5日举行。该州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党前副总统理查德·尼克松以7,529票的优势击败民主党籍现任副总统休伯特·汉弗莱，赢得特拉华州。前任及后来的阿拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士也以“美国独立党”候选人身份参选。

en.t: 1968 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 1968 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on November 5, 1968, to elect the state's two representatives. This was the first election in which New Mexico elected their members using single-member districts instead of at-large districts. This was because of the Uniform Congressional District Act, which dictates that members of the United States House of Representatives must be elected from geographical districts and that these must be single-member districts.

zh.t: 1968年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1968年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，选出该州两名联邦众议员。这是新墨西哥州首次通过单一选区而非全州选区选举联邦众议员。根据《统一国会选区法》，联邦众议员必须从地理选区选出，而且每个选区只能选出一名众议员。

en.s: The 1968 Wisconsin lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Republican Jack B. Olson won the election with 59% of the vote, winning his fourth term as Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin and defeating Democrat Taylor Benson. This was the last lieutenant gubernatorial election in Wisconsin where the lieutenant governor was elected to a two-year term separately from the Governor, when a constitutional amendment which made it so the two offices were elected on a single ticket for four years.

zh.s: 1968年威斯康星州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党人杰克·B·奥尔森以59%的得票率获胜，开始第四个副州长任期，并击败民主党人泰勒·本森。这是威斯康星州最后一次将副州长与州长分开选举，副州长任期为两年。之后宪法修正案规定，州长和副州长须搭档竞选，任期为四年。

en.s: The 1968 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democrat William L. Guy defeated Republican nominee Robert P. McCarney with 54.82% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年北达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长威廉·L·盖伊以54.82%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伯特·P·麦卡尼。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Michigan was held on November 5, 1968. All 50 states and the District of Columbia participated in the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose 21 electors to represent them in the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在密歇根州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在密歇根州于11月5日举行。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出21名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。

en.t: 1968 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The Alaska congressional election of 1968 was held on Tuesday, November 5, 1968. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 1969. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 1969, to January 3, 1971. Incumbent Republican Representative Howard W. Pollock defeated Democratic State Senator Nick Begich, by a margin of 8.4%, winning re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1968年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 阿拉斯加州国会选举于1968年11月5日星期二举行。该州唯一一名联邦众议员的任期于1969年1月3日届满，当选者将从1969年1月3日至1971年1月3日任职两年。共和党籍现任众议员霍华德·W·波洛克以8.4%的优势击败民主党州参议员尼克·比吉奇，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1968 Illinois gubernatorial election was held in Illinois on November 5, 1968. Democratic nominee, incumbent governor Samuel H. Shapiro (who had assumed the governorship in May 1968, after Otto Kerner Jr. resigned in order to accept a judicial appointment), lost reelection to Republican nominee Richard B. Ogilvie, who was the president of the Cook County Board of Commissioners and former sheriff of Cook County.

zh.s: 1968年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人、现任州长塞缪尔·H·夏皮罗于1968年5月上任，此前奥托·克纳二世为接受法官任命而辞职。夏皮罗竞选连任失败，共和党候选人理查德·B·奥格尔维当选。奥格尔维曾任库克县委员会主席和库克县警长。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Missouri took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic Senator Edward V. Long was defeated in the Democratic primary by Lieutenant Governor Thomas Eagleton. Eagleton narrowly defeated Republican U.S. Representative Thomas B. Curtis in the general election.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在密苏里州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在密苏里州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员爱德华·V·朗在民主党初选中败给副州长托马斯·伊格尔顿。伊格尔顿随后以微弱优势击败共和党联邦众议员托马斯·B·柯蒂斯，赢得大选。

en.s: The 1968 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1968, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Republican David Cargo ran for reelection to a second term. This election was the last in which the governor was elected to a two-year term, instead of to a four-year term. As of 2022, this is the last time that Mora County and San Miguel County have voted for the Republican candidate.

zh.s: 1968年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出州长。共和党籍现任州长大卫·卡戈竞选连任第二个任期。这是该州最后一次选举两年任期的州长，此后州长任期改为四年。截至2022年，这也是莫拉县和圣米格尔县最后一次投票支持共和党候选人。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by the Republican candidate, former Vice President Richard Nixon, with 53.01 percent of the popular vote, against the Democratic candidate, former Senator and incumbent Vice President Hubert Humphrey, with 40.82 percent.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在艾奥瓦州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在艾奥瓦州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前副总统理查德·尼克松以53.01%的得票率赢得艾奥瓦州；民主党候选人、前参议员兼时任副总统休伯特·汉弗莱获得40.82%的选票。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 5, 1968. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1968 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the Republican nominee, former vice president Richard Nixon, running with Governor of Maryland Spiro Agnew.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在怀俄明州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在怀俄明州于11月5日举行。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次总统选举。怀俄明州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前副总统理查德·尼克松及其竞选搭档、马里兰州州长斯皮罗·阿格纽赢得怀俄明州。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Kansas was held on November 5, 1968 as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Richard Nixon won Kansas against both Hubert Humphrey and George Wallace. Nixon carried every county except traditionally Democratic Wyandotte.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在堪萨斯州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在堪萨斯州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。理查德·尼克松击败休伯特·汉弗莱和乔治·华莱士，赢得堪萨斯州。除了传统上支持民主党的怀恩多特县，尼克松赢得了其他所有县。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 5, 1968. All fifty states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president of the United States.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在俄克拉何马州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在俄克拉何马州于11月5日举行。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出8名选举人，由选举人团投票选举美国总统和副总统。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. District of Columbia voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vice President Hubert Humphrey won Washington, D.C. by an overwhelming margin, receiving over 80% of the vote.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在哥伦比亚特区举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在哥伦比亚特区于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。哥伦比亚特区选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。副总统休伯特·汉弗莱以压倒性优势赢得华盛顿特区，得票率超过80%。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican Senator Wallace F. Bennett won re-election to a fourth term.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在犹他州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在犹他州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员华莱士·F·贝内特连任第四个任期。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 5, 1968. All fifty states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1968 United States presidential election. State voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by the Republican nominees, Richard Nixon of New York and his running mate Governor Spiro Agnew of Maryland.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在亚利桑那州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在亚利桑那州于11月5日举行。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次总统选举。该州选民选出5名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人理查德·尼克松来自纽约州，他与竞选搭档、马里兰州州长斯皮罗·阿格纽赢得该州。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 5, 1968. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在密苏里州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在密苏里州于11月5日举行。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出12名选举人，由选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado was won by former Vice President Richard Nixon (R–New York), with 50.46% of the popular vote, against Vice President Hubert Humphrey (D–Minnesota), with 41.32% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在科罗拉多州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在科罗拉多州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党前副总统理查德·尼克松来自纽约州，他以50.46%的得票率赢得科罗拉多州；副总统休伯特·汉弗莱来自明尼苏达州，获得41.32%的选票。

en.s: The 1968 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Governor Jack Williams ran for reelection to a second term as governor. Former Governor Samuel Pearson Goddard, who lost to Williams in 1966, again challenged Williams, losing to him in a repeat of the previous election cycle. Williams was sworn into his second term as governor on January 7, 1969.

zh.s: 1968年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长杰克·威廉姆斯竞选连任第二个州长任期。前州长塞缪尔·皮尔逊·戈达德曾在1966年败给威廉姆斯，这次再次挑战他，但重演上次选举的结果，再度落败。威廉姆斯于1969年1月7日宣誓就任第二个任期。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 5, 1968. Florida voters chose fourteen electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nixon obtained his support in Central Florida, Democratic candidate Hubert Humphrey got his support from Southern Florida, and third-party candidate George Wallace got his support from the Florida Panhandle, or Northern Florida.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在佛罗里达州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在佛罗里达州于11月5日举行。佛罗里达州选民选出14名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。尼克松在佛罗里达州中部获得支持，民主党候选人休伯特·汉弗莱得到佛罗里达州南部的支持，第三党候选人乔治·华莱士则在佛罗里达州狭长地带，也就是佛罗里达州北部获得支持。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Hawaii took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Daniel Inouye was re-elected to a second term in office, easily defeating Republican nominee Wayne Thiessen.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在夏威夷州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在夏威夷州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员丹尼尔·井上轻松击败共和党候选人韦恩·蒂森，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic Senator George McGovern ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by former Governor Archie M. Gubbrud, who was persuaded to enter the race by the South Dakota Republican establishment. McGovern defeated Gubbrud by a wide margin, even as Richard Nixon was defeating Hubert Humphrey in the state's presidential election in a landslide.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在南达科他州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在南达科他州于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员乔治·麦戈文竞选连任第二个任期。南达科他州共和党高层说服前州长阿奇·M·古布鲁德参选，挑战麦戈文。麦戈文以较大优势击败古布鲁德；与此同时，理查德·尼克松在该州总统选举中以压倒性优势击败休伯特·汉弗莱。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Mississippi was held on November 5, 1968. Mississippi voters chose seven electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-President. During the 1960s, the Civil Rights Movement dictated Mississippi's politics, with effectively the entire white population vehemently opposed to federal policies of racial desegregation and black voting rights.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在密西西比州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在密西西比州于11月5日举行。密西西比州选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。20世纪60年代，民权运动主导了密西西比州政治；几乎所有白人都强烈反对联邦政府推动种族隔离政策和保障黑人选举权的措施。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Maryland was held on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Maryland was won by Hubert Humphrey by a margin of 20,315 votes against Richard Nixon and by 359,576 votes against George Wallace. Maryland was the home state of Republican vice presidential nominee Spiro Agnew, who was the sitting Governor of Maryland at the time of the election.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在马里兰州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在马里兰州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。休伯特·汉弗莱赢得马里兰州，领先理查德·尼克松20,315票，领先乔治·华莱士359,576票。共和党副总统候选人斯皮罗·阿格纽当时担任马里兰州州长。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. North Dakota was won by former Vice President Richard Nixon (Republican Party, New York), with 55.94% of the popular vote, against Vice President Hubert Humphrey (Democratic Party, Minnesota), with 38.23% of the popular vote, a 17.71% margin of victory.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在北达科他州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在北达科他州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党前副总统理查德·尼克松来自纽约州，以55.94%的得票率在该州获胜；副总统休伯特·汉弗莱来自明尼苏达州，获得38.23%的选票，双方得票率相差17.71个百分点。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican Senator Norris Cotton won re-election to a third full term.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在新罕布什尔州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在新罕布什尔州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员诺里斯·科顿连任第三个完整任期。

en.s: The 1968 Arizona Senate election was held on November 5, 1968. Voters elected all 30 members of the Arizona Senate to serve two-year terms. Primary elections were held on September 10, 1968. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 16 seats over the 14 seats held by Democrats. Following the election, Republicans maintained control of the chamber and expanded their majority to 17 Republicans to 13 Democrats, a net gain of one seat for Republicans.

zh.s: 1968年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月5日举行，选民选出全部30名州参议员，任期两年。初选于1968年9月10日举行。选举前，共和党占16席，民主党占14席。选举后，共和党继续控制参议院，并将多数优势扩大到17席对13席，净增1席。

en.s: The 1968 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Republican nominee Russell W. Peterson defeated incumbent Democratic Governor Charles L. Terry Jr. with 50.51% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年特拉华州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人拉塞尔·W·彼得森以50.51%的得票率击败民主党籍现任州长小查尔斯·L·特里。

en.s: The 1968 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Democratic nominee Frank Licht defeated incumbent Republican John Chafee with 51.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年罗得岛州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党候选人弗兰克·利希特以51.02%的得票率击败共和党籍现任州长约翰·查菲。

en.s: The 1968 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Republican nominee Eugene Bookhammer narrowly defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Sherman W. Tribbitt.

zh.s: 1968年特拉华州副州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出副州长。共和党候选人尤金·布克哈默以微弱优势击败民主党候选人、现任副州长谢尔曼·W·特里比特。

en.s: The 1968 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic Governor Roger D. Branigin was term-limited. Republican nominee Edgar Whitcomb defeated Democratic nominee Robert L. Rock with 52.72% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年印第安纳州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长罗杰·D·布兰尼金受任期限制，无法连任。共和党候选人埃德加·惠特科姆以52.72%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗伯特·L·洛克。

en.s: The 1968 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 5, 1968, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee William Edmond Robinson defeated Republican nominee William T. Zimmerman.

zh.t: 1968年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1968年密苏里州州财政部长选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州州财政部长。民主党候选人威廉·埃德蒙·罗宾逊击败共和党候选人威廉·T·齐默尔曼。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island was won by the Democratic candidate, Vice President Hubert Humphrey, with 64.03% of the popular vote, against the Republican candidate, former Senator and Vice President Richard Nixon, with 31.78% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在罗得岛州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在罗得岛州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、副总统休伯特·汉弗莱以64.03%的得票率赢得罗得岛州，共和党候选人、前参议员兼副总统理查德·尼克松获得31.78%的选票。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 5, 1968, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Frank Carlson did not run for re-election.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在堪萨斯州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在堪萨斯州于11月5日举行，与总统选举、其他州的参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及多项州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员弗兰克·卡尔森没有竞选连任。

en.s: The 1968 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic Governor John W. King retired to run for the U.S. Senate. Republican nominee Walter R. Peterson Jr. defeated Democratic nominee Emile R. Bussiere with 52.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1968年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·W·金退休，转而竞选联邦参议员。共和党候选人小沃尔特·R·彼得森以52.53%的得票率击败民主党候选人埃米尔·R·比西耶。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bourke B. Hickenlooper retired. The open seat was won by Democratic Governor Harold E. Hughes, narrowly defeating Republican State Representative David M. Stanley.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在艾奥瓦州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在艾奥瓦州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员伯克·B·希肯卢珀退休。民主党籍州长哈罗德·E·休斯以微弱优势击败共和党州众议员戴维·M·斯坦利，赢得这一开放席位。

en.s: The 1968 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 1968. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 10, 1968.

zh.s: 1968年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月5日举行，选民选出全部60名州众议员，任期两年，议员由多议员选区选出。选举与州长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等职位的选举同时进行。初选于1968年9月10日举行。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in California took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. State voters chose 40 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California narrowly voted for the Republican nominee, former Vice President Richard Nixon of New York, over the Democratic nominee, Vice President Hubert Humphrey of Minnesota.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在加利福尼亚州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在加利福尼亚州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出40名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州以微弱优势支持共和党候选人、来自纽约州的前副总统理查德·尼克松，而非民主党候选人、来自明尼苏达州的副总统休伯特·汉弗莱。

en.s: The 1968 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1968, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state James Kirkpatrick defeated Republican nominee Murray C. Colbert.

zh.s: 1968年密苏里州州务卿选举于11月5日举行，以选出州务卿。民主党候选人、现任州务卿詹姆斯·柯克帕特里克击败共和党候选人默里·C·科尔伯特。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota was won by former Vice President Richard Nixon (R–New York), with 53.27 percent of the popular vote, against Vice President Hubert Humphrey (D–Minnesota), with 41.96 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1968年美国总统选举在南达科他州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国总统选举在南达科他州于11月5日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。共和党前副总统理查德·尼克松来自纽约州，以53.27%的得票率赢得南达科他州；副总统休伯特·汉弗莱来自明尼苏达州，获得41.96%的选票。

en.t: 1968 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1968 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican William Roth was challenged by Democrat Harris McDowell whom he had previously unseated in 1966. Roth won re-election by 17 points. Roth ran for the Republican nomination unopposed, while McDowell saw challenge from Democrats.

zh.t: 1968年特拉华州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1968年特拉华州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任众议员威廉·罗斯遭民主党人哈里斯·麦克道尔挑战；罗斯曾在1966年击败麦克道尔。罗斯以17个百分点的优势连任。罗斯在共和党初选中无人挑战，麦克道尔则在民主党初选中遭遇对手。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in California was held on November 5, 1968. Republican incumbent Thomas Kuchel ran for a fourth term in office but was defeated in the Republican primary by state superintendent of public instruction Max Rafferty. In the general election, Rafferty was defeated by former state controller Alan Cranston. Primary elections were held on June 4.

zh.t: 1968年美国参议院选举在加利福尼亚州举行
zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举在加利福尼亚州于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员托马斯·库切尔竞选第四个任期，但在共和党初选中败给州公共教育厅长马克斯·拉弗蒂。拉弗蒂随后在大选中败给前州审计长艾伦·克兰斯顿。初选于6月4日举行。

en.t: 1968 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada
en.s: The 1968 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada was held on Tuesday November 5, 1968, to elect the state's at-large representative. This election occurred during the 1968 United States presidential election. Incumbent Democrat, Walter S. Baring Jr. won re-election to a ninth term in congress by a landslide margin of 44.29% winning every county in the state with over 60% of the vote.

zh.t: 1968年内华达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1968年11月5日（星期二）举行内华达州美国众议院选举，选出该州唯一的众议员。这次选举与1968年美国总统选举同时举行。民主党现任议员沃尔特·S·巴林二世以44.29个百分点的巨大优势连任，开始第九个国会任期，并赢得该州每个县超过60%的选票。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Peter Dominick was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic ex-Governor Stephen McNichols. Peter Dominick defeated Stephen McNichols in a landslide despite Richard Nixon, a fellow Republican to Peter Dominick, winning the state by a somewhat smaller margin over Hubert Humphrey in the concurrent presidential election.

zh.t: 1968年科罗拉多州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年11月5日举行科罗拉多州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任联邦参议员彼得·多米尼克击败民主党人、前州长斯蒂芬·麦克尼科尔斯，连任第二个任期。尽管共和党总统候选人理查德·尼克松也赢得了科罗拉多州，但多米尼克的胜幅很大，且高于尼克松在同一场总统选举中的胜幅。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah was won by former Vice President Richard Nixon (R–California), with 56.49 percent of the popular vote, against Vice President Hubert Humphrey (D–Minnesota), with 37.07 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1968年11月5日，犹他州举行美国总统选举，作为1968年美国总统选举的一部分。州内选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。前副总统理查德·尼克松（共和党，来自加利福尼亚州）在犹他州获胜，得票率为56.49%；副总统休伯特·汉弗莱（民主党，来自明尼苏达州）得票率为37.07%。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by former Vice President Richard Nixon (R–New York), with 56.79% of the popular vote, against former Senator and incumbent Vice President Hubert Humphrey (D–Minnesota), with 30.66% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1968年11月5日，爱达荷州举行美国总统选举，作为1968年美国总统选举的一部分。州内选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。前副总统理查德·尼克松（共和党，来自纽约州）在爱达荷州获胜，得票率为56.79%；前参议员、现任副总统休伯特·汉弗莱（民主党，来自明尼苏达州）得票率为30.66%。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Alan Bible was re-elected to a third term in office over Republican Edward Fike despite Republican nominee Richard Nixon carrying the state in the concurrent presidential election in the state.

zh.t: 1968年内华达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年11月5日举行内华达州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员艾伦·拜布尔击败共和党人爱德华·菲克，连任第三个任期。尽管共和党总统候选人理查德·尼克松赢得了同日举行的内华达州总统选举，拜布尔仍然获胜。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Since William Jennings Bryan's three elections, Nevada had been a bellwether state voting for every winner since 1912.

zh.s: 1968年11月5日，内华达州举行美国总统选举，作为1968年美国总统选举的一部分。州内选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。自威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩三次参加总统选举以来，内华达州一直是风向标州：从1912年起，该州每次都投给最终获胜的候选人。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Alabama took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator J. Lister Hill retired. He was succeeded by Lieutenant Governor of Alabama James Allen, who won a hotly contested primary over Armistead I. Selden Jr. In the general election, Allen easily defeated Republican Probate Judge Perry O. Hooper Sr. and National Democratic nominee Robert Schwenn.

zh.t: 1968年阿拉巴马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年11月5日举行阿拉巴马州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员J·利斯特·希尔退休，没有寻求连任。阿拉巴马州副州长詹姆斯·艾伦接任参议员一职，他在竞争激烈的党内初选中击败了小阿米斯特德·I·塞尔登。大选中，艾伦轻松击败共和党候选人、遗嘱认证法官佩里·O·胡珀，以及全国民主党候选人罗伯特·施文。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by former Vice President Richard Nixon (R–New York), with 49.83% of the popular vote, against Vice President Hubert Humphrey (D–Minnesota), with 43.78% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1968年11月5日，俄勒冈州举行美国总统选举，作为1968年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。前副总统理查德·尼克松（共和党，来自纽约州）在俄勒冈州获胜，得票率为49.83%；副总统休伯特·汉弗莱（民主党，来自明尼苏达州）得票率为43.78%。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Alaska took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Ernest Gruening ran for a second full term in office but finished behind Speaker of the Alaska House of Representatives Mike Gravel in the Democratic primary. Gruening launched a write-in bid for the seat in the general election, but finished third to Gravel and Republican former Anchorage mayor Elmer Rasmuson.

zh.t: 1968年阿拉斯加州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年11月5日举行阿拉斯加州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员欧内斯特·格鲁宁竞选第二个完整任期，但在民主党初选中输给阿拉斯加州众议院议长迈克·格拉维。格鲁宁随后以写入选票的方式参加大选，但排名第三，落后于格拉维和共和党候选人、安克雷奇前市长埃尔默·拉斯穆森。

en.t: 1968 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1968 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives on November 5, 1968, to elect members to serve in the 91st United States Congress. They coincided with Richard M. Nixon's election as president. Nixon's narrow victory yielded only limited gains for his Republican Party, which picked up a net of five seats from the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1968年11月5日举行美国众议院选举，选出第91届美国国会议员。选举与理查德·M·尼克松当选总统同时举行。尼克松以微弱优势获胜，共和党只取得有限进展，从民主党手中净增5个席位。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 5, 1968, as part of the 1968 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by the Democratic candidate, Vice President Hubert Humphrey, with 47.23 percent of the popular vote, against the Republican candidate, former Senator and Vice President Richard Nixon, with 45.12 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1968年11月5日，华盛顿州举行美国总统选举，作为1968年美国总统选举的一部分。州内选民选出9名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、副总统休伯特·汉弗莱在华盛顿州获胜，得票率为47.23%；共和党候选人、前参议员兼前副总统理查德·尼克松得票率为45.12%。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Connecticut took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Abraham Ribicoff was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican U.S. Representative Edwin H. May Jr.

zh.t: 1968年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年11月5日举行康涅狄格州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员亚伯拉罕·里比科夫击败共和党籍联邦众议员埃德温·H·梅二世，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Senator Frank Lausche ran for re-election to a third term, but lost the Democratic primary to former U.S. Representative John J. Gilligan. Before losing the primary to the more solidly liberal Gilligan, Lausche had one of the most conservative voting record among Senate Democrats outside of The South, leaving the Democratic Party very disappointed.

zh.t: 1968年俄亥俄州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年11月5日举行俄亥俄州美国参议院选举。现任参议员弗兰克·劳舍竞选第三个任期，但在民主党初选中输给前联邦众议员约翰·J·吉利根。输给立场更偏自由派的吉利根之前，劳舍是南方以外立场最保守的民主党籍参议员之一，这使民主党内许多人非常失望。

en.s: The 1968 Washington gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1968, and resulted in the re-election of Republican incumbent Daniel J. Evans over state Attorney General John J. O'Connell. Martin Durkan, Albert F. Canwell, and John Patric unsuccessfully ran in the blanket primary.

zh.s: 1968年华盛顿州州长选举于1968年11月5日举行。共和党现任州长丹尼尔·J·埃文斯击败州检察长约翰·J·奥康奈尔，成功连任。马丁·杜尔肯、阿尔伯特·F·坎韦尔和约翰·帕特里克在不分党派初选中落败。

en.t: 1968 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1968 United States presidential election in Georgia was held on November 5, 1968. American Independent Party candidate George Wallace received the most votes, and won all twelve of the state's electoral college votes. Wallace, who ran a campaign based upon support for segregation, won all but seventeen of the state's 159 counties. Nixon won ten, all either suburban Atlanta, Athens, or Augusta area counties, or historically pro-Union counties of North Georgia.

zh.s: 1968年佐治亚州美国总统选举于1968年11月5日举行。美国独立党候选人乔治·华莱士获得最多选票，赢得该州全部12张选举人票。华莱士以支持种族隔离为竞选主张，在该州159个县中赢得142个。尼克松赢得10个县，这些县都位于亚特兰大郊区、雅典或奥古斯塔一带，或是北佐治亚州历史上支持联邦的县。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Georgia took place on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Herman Talmadge was re-elected to a third consecutive term in office, winning large victories in the primary and general elections. For the first time, Republicans held a primary election to nominate a candidate for U.S. Senate.

zh.t: 1968年佐治亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年佐治亚州联邦参议院选举于1968年11月5日举行。民主党现任参议员赫尔曼·塔尔马奇成功连任，进入第三个连续任期，并在初选和普选中都大幅领先。这是共和党首次举行联邦参议员候选人初选。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Warren Magnuson won a fifth term in office, defeating Republican State Senator Jack Metcalf, who only won Stevens County and San Juan County.

zh.t: 1968年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举于1968年11月5日举行。民主党现任参议员沃伦·马格努森击败共和党州参议员杰克·梅特卡夫，赢得第五个任期。梅特卡夫只在史蒂文斯县和圣胡安县获胜。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 5, 1968. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Jacob Javits defeated Democratic challenger Paul O'Dwyer and Conservative Party challenger James Buckley in a three-way race.

zh.s: 1968年纽约州联邦参议院选举于1968年11月5日举行。共和党现任参议员雅各布·贾维茨在三方竞选中击败民主党挑战者保罗·奥德怀尔和保守党候选人詹姆斯·巴克利。

en.s: The 1968 United States Senate elections were elections for the United States Senate. Held on November 5, the 34 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections. They coincided with the presidential election of the same year. The Republicans picked up five net seats in the Senate. This saw Republicans win a Senate seat in Florida for the first time since the Reconstruction era.

zh.s: 1968年美国参议院选举于11月5日举行，选出参议院第3组的34个席位，均为常规选举。这些选举与同年的总统选举同时举行。共和党净增5个参议院席位，并自南北战争重建时期以来首次在佛罗里达州赢得参议院席位。

en.s: The 1968 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1968 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 33 of the state senate's 61 districts. At this time, the Iowa Senate still had several multi-member districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 61 state Senate districts in the year 1968 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1968年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院61个选区中的33个选区选出参议员。当时，爱荷华州参议院仍设有几个多席位选区。州参议员任期为四年。爱荷华州议会提供了1968年这61个州参议院选区的全州地图。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on Tuesday, November 5. Democratic incumbent Frank Church was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Republican U.S. Representative George V. Hansen.

zh.t: 1968年美国爱达荷州参议院选举
zh.s: 1968年美国爱达荷州参议院选举于11月5日星期二举行。民主党籍现任参议员弗兰克·丘奇击败共和党候选人、美国众议员乔治·V·汉森，成功连任，开始第三个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1968 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held in the U.S. state on November 5, when incumbent Republican Winthrop Rockefeller defeated former speaker of the Arkansas House of Representatives Marion Crank by a small margin. Rockefeller was first elected in 1966, and was the first Republican to hold the office since Reconstruction. This was the first time a Republican was re-elected as governor of Arkansas, and would be the only time until 2002.

zh.s: 1968年阿肯色州州长选举于11月5日举行，共和党籍现任州长温思罗普·洛克菲勒以微弱优势击败阿肯色州众议院前议长、民主党人马里昂·克兰克。洛克菲勒于1966年首次当选，是南北战争重建时期以来首位担任该州州长的共和党人。这是阿肯色州首位共和党籍州长连任成功，此后直到2002年才再次出现。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: In the 1968 United States Senate election in Wisconsin, incumbent Democrat Gaylord A. Nelson defeated Republican Jerris Leonard.

zh.t: 1968年美国威斯康星州参议院选举
zh.s: 在1968年美国威斯康星州参议院选举中，民主党籍现任参议员盖洛德·A·纳尔逊击败共和党候选人杰里斯·伦纳德。

en.t: 1968 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1968 Florida United States Senate election was marked by the election of the first Republican to the United States Senate from Florida since Reconstruction. Democratic three-term incumbent George Smathers decided to not seek re-election. Popular former two-term Governor LeRoy Collins won the Democratic nomination by defeating State Attorney General Earl Faircloth, while Congressman Edward J. Gurney became the Republican candidate.

zh.t: 1968年美国佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1968年佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举中，共和党人自重建时期以来首次当选该州联邦参议员。民主党籍、已连任三届的时任参议员乔治·斯马瑟斯决定不再竞选。曾连任两届州长的热门人选勒罗伊·柯林斯赢得民主党提名，击败州总检察长厄尔·费尔克洛斯；联邦众议员爱德华·J.·格尼成为共和党候选人。

en.s: The 1974 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Governor Dolph Briscoe was easily reelected to a second term, winning 61% of the vote to Republican Jim Granberry's 31%. Raza Unida candidate Ramsey Muniz won 6%, while the remaining 2% were cast for other candidates. Briscoe was sworn in for his second term on January 21, 1975. As the Constitution of Texas had been amended in 1972 to extend the governor's term from 2 years to 4 years, Briscoe became the first governor to be sworn in for a four-year term since Edmund J.

zh.s: 1974年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出州长。民主党籍时任州长多尔夫·布里斯科轻松连任，获得61%的选票；共和党人吉姆·格兰伯里获得31%。团结种族党候选人拉姆齐·穆尼兹获得6%，其余候选人合计获得2%。布里斯科于1975年1月21日宣誓就任第二个任期。得克萨斯州宪法于1972年修订，将州长任期从两年延长至四年。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1974
en.s: The 1974 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 1974, to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections were held on July 16 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on July 30. Three incumbents were re-elected, Democrat John Jenrette defeated incumbent Republican Edward Lunn Young in the 6th district and the two open seats in the 3rd and 5th districts were retained by the Democrats. The composition of the state delegation after the elections was five Democrats and one Republicans.

zh.t: 1974年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1974年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，选出6名联邦众议员，任期两年。初选于7月16日举行，两周后的7月30日举行决选。3名现任议员成功连任；民主党人约翰·詹瑞特在第6选区击败共和党籍现任议员爱德华·朗·杨；第3和第5选区的两个空缺席位由民主党保住。选举后，该州代表团由5名民主党议员和1名共和党议员组成。

en.t: United States Senate election in Florida, 1974
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Senator Edward Gurney, a Republican, declined to seek a second term after being indicted for taking bribes in return for his influence with the Federal Housing Administration. The primary for the Republican nomination pitted Eckerd drug store owner Jack Eckerd against Florida Public Service Commissioner Paula Hawkins. Eckerd won handily, receiving approximately 67.5% of the vote. The Democratic primary, however, was a crowded field with eleven candidates vying for the nomination. Because no candidate received a majority of the votes, U.S.

zh.t: 1974年美国佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1974年美国联邦参议员选举于11月5日在佛罗里达州举行。共和党籍时任参议员爱德华·格尼因被控收受贿赂、利用其对联邦住房管理局的影响力谋利，决定不竞选连任。共和党初选由埃克德药店老板杰克·埃克德对阵佛罗里达州公共服务委员会委员保拉·霍金斯，埃克德以约67.5%的得票率轻松获胜。民主党初选有11名候选人角逐；由于无人获得过半选票，原文末尾句子在“U.S.”处中断，未译入残缺部分。

en.s: The 1974 Hawaii gubernatorial election was Hawaii's fifth gubernatorial election. The election was held on November 5, 1974, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic candidate, Lt. Gov. George Ariyoshi over Republican candidate, former State Senator Randolph Crossley. Ariyoshi received more votes than Crossley in every county in the state. Although he was by law Lieutenant Governor of Hawaii at the time of this election, George Ariyoshi had had all the power and responsibility of the Governorship since October 26, 1973, when Governor John A. Burns was incapacitated due to illness and Ariyoshi was made acting governor.

zh.s: 1974年夏威夷州州长选举是该州第五次州长选举，于11月5日举行。民主党候选人、副州长乔治·阿里约希击败共和党候选人、前州参议员兰道夫·克罗斯利，当选州长。阿里约希在该州每个县获得的选票都多于克罗斯利。选举时，阿里约希依法仍是副州长，但自1973年10月26日州长约翰·A·伯恩斯因病无法履职、阿里约希被任命为代理州长后，他实际上已承担州长的全部权力和责任。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1974
en.s: The 1974 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 5, 1974. The incumbent, Republican Senator Milton Young, sought and received re-election to his sixth term, defeating North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party candidate William L. Guy, a former Governor of North Dakota. Only Young filed as a Republican, and the endorsed Democratic candidate was William L. Guy of Bismarck, North Dakota, who had served as Governor of the state from 1961 to 1973; and had presumably left the office to seek the senate seat. Young and Guy won the primary elections for their respective parties.

zh.t: 1974年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年北达科他州美国联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员米尔顿·扬竞选连任第六个任期，击败北达科他州民主党—无党派联盟候选人、前州长威廉·L·盖伊。只有扬以共和党人身份登记参选；民主党认可的候选人是盖伊。他曾于1961年至1973年担任州长，据推测是为竞选参议员而离职。扬和盖伊分别赢得本党初选。

en.s: The 1974 California gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974. The primary elections occurred on June 4, 1974. Incumbent Governor and former actor Ronald Reagan was retiring after two terms. Democratic Secretary of State Jerry Brown, son of former Governor Pat Brown, defeated Republican Controller Houston I. Flournoy in the general election.

zh.s: 1974年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月5日举行，初选于同年6月4日举行。共和党籍现任州长、前演员罗纳德·里根在任满两届后退休。民主党籍州务卿杰里·布朗是前州长帕特·布朗之子，他在大选中击败共和党州财政长休斯顿·弗洛诺伊。

en.t: United States Senate election in Maryland, 1974
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 5, 1974 to elect one of Maryland's members to the United States Senate. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Charles Mathias won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1974年马里兰州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年马里兰州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行，选出一名该州联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员查尔斯·马赛厄斯成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1974
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican George Aiken did not run for re-election to another term in the United States Senate. Democratic candidate Patrick Leahy defeated Republican candidate Richard W. Mallary to succeed him.

zh.t: 1974年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员乔治·艾肯没有竞选连任。民主党候选人帕特里克·莱希击败共和党候选人理查德·W·马拉里，接替他担任参议员。

en.s: The 1974 gubernatorial election in Wisconsin was held on November 5, 1974. Democrat Patrick Lucey won the election with 53% of the vote, winning his second term as Governor of Wisconsin and defeating Republican William Dyke.

zh.s: 1974年威斯康星州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党人帕特里克·卢西以53%的得票率胜出，开始第二个州长任期，并击败共和党人威廉·戴克。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1974 took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democrat Thomas P. Salmon ran successfully for a second term as Governor of Vermont, defeating Republican candidate Walter L. Kennedy and Liberty Union candidate Martha Abbott.

zh.s: 1974年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长托马斯·P·萨蒙成功竞选连任第二个任期，击败共和党候选人沃尔特·L·肯尼迪和自由联盟候选人玛莎·阿博特。

en.s: The 1974 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 5, 1974, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 69th Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held on September 10, 1974. This was the first partisan election of the House since 1912. The Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won a majority of seats, followed by the Minnesota Republican Party.

zh.s: 1974年明尼苏达州众议院选举于11月5日举行，选出第69届明尼苏达州议会众议院议员。初选于1974年9月10日举行。这是该院自1912年以来首次举行党派选举。明尼苏达民主农民劳工党赢得过半席位，其次是明尼苏达州共和党。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1974
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Richard Schweiker won re-election, defeating Democratic nominee Peter F. Flaherty.

zh.t: 1974年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员理查德·施韦克成功连任，击败民主党提名人彼得·F·弗拉赫蒂。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1974 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974, to elect a Governor of South Dakota. This election was the first in South Dakota to elect the governor for a four-year term, after it was allowed by a constitutional amendment passed in 1972. Democratic nominee and Governor Richard F. Kneip was re-elected, defeating Republican nominee John E. Olson.

zh.s: 1974年南达科他州州长选举于11月5日举行。1972年通过的一项宪法修正案允许该州州长任期改为四年，这次是南达科他州首次举行四年任期的州长选举。民主党籍提名人、现任州长理查德·F·克奈普成功连任，击败共和党提名人约翰·E·奥尔森。
