en.s: The 1974 Maine gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic Governor Kenneth M. Curtis was term-limited and could not seek re-election. Independent candidate James B. Longley defeated Democratic Party challenger (and future Senate Majority Leader) George J. Mitchell and Republican James Erwin in a tight three-way contest. Longley's victory made him the first independent (non-party-affiliated) governor in Maine's history.

zh.s: 1974年缅因州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长肯尼思·M·柯蒂斯受任期限制，不能竞选连任。独立候选人詹姆斯·B·朗利在三方激烈竞争中击败民主党挑战者、后来成为参议院多数党领袖的乔治·J·米切尔，以及共和党人詹姆斯·欧文。朗利获胜后，成为缅因州历史上首位独立派（无党派）州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Nevada gubernatorial election of 1974 occurred on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democrat Mike O'Callaghan successfully ran for re-election to a second term as Governor of Nevada, defeating Republican candidate Shirley Crumpler.

zh.s: 1974年内华达州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长迈克·奥卡拉汉成功竞选连任第二个任期，击败共和党候选人雪莉·克朗普勒。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1974 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Michael Dukakis was elected to a four-year term, from January 4, 1975 until January 4, 1979. He defeated incumbent Governor of Massachusetts Francis W. Sargent in the general election.

zh.s: 1974年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月5日举行。迈克尔·杜卡基斯当选，任期为四年，从1975年1月4日至1979年1月4日。他在大选中击败了马萨诸塞州州长、共和党籍现任州长弗朗西斯·W·萨金特。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in North Carolina, 1974
en.s: The North Carolina United States Senate election of 1974 was held on 5 November 1974 as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate. The general election was fought between the Democratic nominee Robert Morgan and the Republican nominee William Stevens. The seat had been vacated by Democrat Sam Ervin.

zh.t: 1974年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举于1974年11月5日举行，是全国联邦参议院选举的一部分。大选由民主党提名人罗伯特·摩根和共和党提名人威廉·史蒂文斯角逐。该席位此前由民主党人萨姆·欧文担任，之后空缺。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Oregon, 1974
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Oregon was held on November 5, 1974.Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Packwood won re-election to a second term. Roberts was chosen to replace former U.S. Senator Wayne Morse, who won the Democratic primary but died before the general election.

zh.t: 1974年俄勒冈州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年俄勒冈州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员鲍勃·帕克伍德成功连任第二个任期。民主党初选胜者、前参议员韦恩·莫斯去世后，罗伯茨获选接替他参选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Alaska, 1974
en.s: The Alaska Congressional election of 1974 was held on Tuesday, November 5, 1974. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 1975. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 1975, to January 3, 1977.

zh.t: 1974年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1974年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举于1974年11月5日星期二举行。该州唯一一名联邦众议员的任期于1975年1月3日届满，当选者将从1975年1月3日至1977年1月3日担任两年任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Wisconsin, 1974
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Gaylord Nelson won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 1974年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员盖洛德·纳尔逊成功连任第三个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in South Carolina, 1974
en.s: The 1974 South Carolina United States Senate election was held on November 5, 1974 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of South Carolina. Incumbent Democratic Senator Fritz Hollings easily defeated Republican challenger Gwen Bush.

zh.t: 1974年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员弗里茨·霍林斯轻松击败共和党挑战者格温·布什。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1974 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974. The 1974 election was the first election where the Governor and Lieutenant Governor ran on the same ticket. Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party candidate Wendell Anderson defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger John W. Johnson.

zh.s: 1974年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月5日举行。这是州长和副州长首次以同一张选票搭档竞选。明尼苏达民主农民劳工党候选人温德尔·安德森击败明尼苏达州共和党挑战者约翰·W·约翰逊。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1974 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. William Milliken was elected to his second term as Governor of Michigan.

zh.s: 1974年密歇根州州长选举于1974年11月5日举行。威廉·米利肯当选，开始第二个州长任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1974 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic Governor George Wallace was reelected in a landslide over his Republican opponent, businessman Elvin McCary.

zh.s: 1974年阿拉巴马州州长选举于1974年11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长乔治·华莱士以压倒性优势击败共和党对手、商人埃尔文·麦凯里，成功连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1974 Alaska gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974 for the post of governor of Alaska. Republican challenger and mayor of Bristol Bay Borough Jay Hammond narrowly beat Democratic incumbent Bill Egan in a close race that was forced into a recount to verify the results. The formation of the new Alaskan Independence Party was considered to have a large impact on the race.

zh.s: 1974年阿拉斯加州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党挑战者、布里斯托尔湾自治市镇市长杰伊·哈蒙德在势均力敌的选举中以微弱优势击败民主党籍现任州长比尔·伊根。为核实结果，选举进行了重新计票。新成立的阿拉斯加独立党被认为对选情产生了重大影响。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: 1974–75 United States Senate elections in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1974–75 elections for United States Senator in New Hampshire, first held November 5, 1974 and held again September 16, 1975, were part of the longest contested election for the Congress in United States history.

zh.t: 1974至1975年新罕布什尔州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 新罕布什尔州联邦参议院选举于1974年11月5日首次举行，并于1975年9月16日再次举行。这是美国历史上持续时间最长的一场国会选举争议。

en.s: The 1974 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican Robert D. Ray defeated Democratic nominee James Schaben with 58.07% of the vote.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长罗伯特·D·雷击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·沙本，获得58.07%的选票。

en.s: The 1974 Alabama Supreme Court election was held on November 5, 1974 to elect three associate justices to the Alabama Supreme Court.

zh.t: 1974年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行阿拉巴马州最高法院选举，选出3名副法官。

en.s: The 1974 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Republican nominee Robert Frederick Bennett narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Vern Miller with 49.5% of the vote. As of 2022, this marks the last occasion in which the following counties have voted Democratic in a gubernatorial election: Clark, Morton, Seward, Stanton, and Stevens. This was also the first gubernatorial election for the state of Kansas to elect a governor for a four-year term.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党候选人罗伯特·弗雷德里克·贝内特以微弱优势击败民主党候选人弗恩·米勒，得票率为49.5%。截至2022年，这是克拉克县、莫顿县、苏厄德县、斯坦顿县和史蒂文斯县最后一次在州长选举中投票支持民主党候选人。这也是堪萨斯州首次选举任期为4年的州长。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 5, 1974 alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Wallace F. Bennett did not run for re-election to a fifth term, but retired. Republican nominee Jake Garn defeated Democratic nominee Wayne Owens.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日，犹他州举行美国参议院选举，与其他州的参议院选举、美国众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员小沃莱士·F·贝内特没有竞选第五个任期，选择退休。共和党候选人杰克·加恩击败民主党候选人韦恩·欧文斯。

en.s: Washington, D.C., held its first direct election for its mayor on November 5, 1974. It followed the passage of the District of Columbia Home Rule Act by the U.S. Congress in 1973. The election was won by Walter Washington, a Democrat. Washington won the Democratic nomination in a seven-candidate primary election in which his most significant opponent was Clifford Alexander Jr.

zh.t: 1974年华盛顿哥伦比亚特区市长选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日，华盛顿哥伦比亚特区举行首次市长直选。此前，美国国会于1973年通过《哥伦比亚特区自治法》。民主党人沃尔特·华盛顿赢得选举。他在有7名候选人参加的民主党初选中获得提名，最主要的对手是小克利福德·亚历山大。

en.s: The 1974 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican Governor Meldrim Thomson Jr. defeated Democratic nominee Richard W. Leonard with 51.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长梅尔德里姆·汤姆森二世击败民主党候选人理查德·W·伦纳德，获得51.15%的选票。

en.s: The 1974 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Texas. The Incumbent, William P. Hobby Jr. ran for re-election to his second term, he was elected against Republican, Gaylord Marshall. Hobby won the election with 74% of the vote to Marshall's 24%. Hobby was sworn in for his second term on January 21, 1975.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行得克萨斯州副州长选举。现任副州长小威廉·P·霍比竞选连任第二个任期，并击败共和党人盖洛德·马歇尔。霍比获得74%的选票，马歇尔获得24%。霍比于1975年1月21日宣誓就职，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 1974 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Due to term limits, incumbent Democrat Bruce King was ineligible to seek a second term as governor. Democrat Jerry Apodaca narrowly defeated Republican Joe Skeen. This election saw Hidalgo County vote for a Republican gubernatorial candidate for the first time ever.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行新墨西哥州州长选举。由于任期限制，民主党籍现任州长布鲁斯·金不能竞选连任第二个任期。民主党候选人杰里·阿波达卡以微弱优势击败共和党人乔·斯基恩。希达尔戈县此前从未在州长选举中投票支持过共和党候选人，这次首次如此。

en.s: The 1974 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Democratic nominee Mervyn Dymally narrowly defeated Republican incumbent John L. Harmer with 49.19% of the vote.

zh.t: 1974年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举。民主党候选人默文·戴马利以49.19%的选票，险胜共和党籍现任副州长约翰·L·哈默。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Birch Bayh was re-elected to a third consecutive term in office, defeating Mayor of Indianapolis Richard Lugar. Lugar would later win the state's other Senate seat in 1976 and would serve alongside Bayh until the latter's defeat in 1980. He would also serve alongside Birch's son Evan from 1999 from 2011.

zh.t: 1974年印第安纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行印第安纳州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员伯奇·贝赫连任，开始连续第三个任期，并击败印第安纳波利斯市长理查德·卢格。卢格后来在1976年赢得该州另一个参议员席位，与贝赫共事至1980年贝赫落选。卢格后来还与伯奇的儿子埃文共事，后者于1999年至2011年担任参议员。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Adlai Stevenson III, who was first elected in a special election in 1970, was re-elected to a full term in office, defeating Republican George Burditt by a landslide margin of 62% to 37%.

zh.t: 1974年伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员阿德莱·史蒂文森三世在1970年特别选举中首次当选，这次击败共和党人乔治·伯迪特，以62%对37%的得票率大胜，赢得完整任期。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater decided to run for reelection to a second consecutive term, after returning to the U.S. Senate in 1968 following his failed Presidential run in 1964 against Lyndon B. Johnson. Goldwater defeated Democratic Party nominee philanthropist Jonathan Marshall in the general election.

zh.t: 1974年亚利桑那州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行亚利桑那州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任联邦参议员巴里·戈德华特决定竞选连任，争取连续第二个任期。他在1964年竞选总统输给林登·B·约翰逊后，于1968年重返联邦参议院。戈德华特在大选中击败民主党候选人、慈善家乔纳森·马歇尔。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Hawaii took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Daniel Inouye was re-elected to a third term in office, easily defeating People's Party nominee James Kimmel.

zh.t: 1974年夏威夷州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行夏威夷州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员丹尼尔·井上击败人民党候选人詹姆斯·金梅尔，轻松连任，开始第三个任期。

en.s: The 1974 Massachusetts general election was held on November 5, 1974, throughout Massachusetts. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 10, 1974. The Democratic primary in this election was notably competitive, with formidable challenges to two incumbent Democrats (Secretary of the Commonwealth John Davoren, who lost, and Treasurer Robert Q. Crane, who narrowly won) and two open primaries (for Governor and Attorney General).

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行马萨诸塞州大选。民主党和共和党的候选人由1974年9月10日举行的党内初选选出。这次民主党初选竞争激烈，有两名在任民主党官员面临强劲挑战：联邦州务卿约翰·达沃伦落选，州财政部长罗伯特·Q·克兰险胜；州长和州检察长职位则开放竞选，没有现任者参选。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Alaska took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Mike Gravel was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Republican State Senator Clyde "C.R." Lewis. This is the last time that a member of the Democratic Party has won the Class 3 Senate seat in Alaska. It is also the last time a person not named Murkowski has won this seat.

zh.t: 1974年阿拉斯加州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行阿拉斯加州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员迈克·格拉维击败共和党籍州参议员克莱德·“C·R”·刘易斯，连任第二个任期。这是民主党人最后一次赢得阿拉斯加州第三类参议员席位，也是最后一次由姓穆考斯基以外的人赢得该席位。

en.s: The 1974 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Governor Jack Williams decided not to run for a fourth term as governor. Former United States Ambassador to Bolivia Raúl Héctor Castro, who was the Democratic nominee in 1970, won the Democratic nomination again in 1974, and narrowly won the general election, defeating Republican nominee Russell Williams by 0.85%.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行亚利桑那州州长选举。现任州长杰克·威廉姆斯决定不竞选第四个任期。前美国驻玻利维亚大使劳尔·埃克托·卡斯特罗曾在1970年获得民主党提名，1974年再次获提名，并在大选中以0.85个百分点的微弱优势击败共和党候选人拉塞尔·威廉姆斯。

en.s: The 1974 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 5, 1974, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Robert K. Killian did not seek re-election to a second term, instead opting to run for lieutenant governor. Democratic nominee and state representative Carl R. Ajello defeated Republican nominee and state representative James F. Bingham.

zh.t: 1974年康涅狄格州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行康涅狄格州州检察长选举。民主党籍现任州检察长罗伯特·K·基利安没有寻求连任第二个任期，而是转而竞选副州长。民主党候选人、州众议员卡尔·R·阿杰洛击败了共和党候选人、州众议员詹姆斯·F·宾厄姆。

en.s: The 1974 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Democratic nominee Ella Grasso defeated Republican nominee Robert H. Steele with 58.35% of the vote. Grasso thus became the first woman to be elected Governor of Connecticut and the first woman elected governor of a US state who was not the spouse or widow of a former Governor.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。民主党候选人埃拉·格拉索击败共和党候选人罗伯特·H·斯蒂尔，获得58.35%的选票。格拉索因此成为康涅狄格州首位当选州长的女性，也是美国各州中首位既不是前州长配偶、也不是前州长遗孀的女性州长。

en.t: 1974 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1974 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 5, 1974, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-four seats in the House apportioned according to the 1970 United States census. Texas underwent mid-decade redistricting as a result of the U.S. Supreme Court case White v. Weiser.

zh.t: 1974年得克萨斯州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行得克萨斯州美国众议院选举，选出该州派往联邦众议院的议员。根据1970年美国人口普查，得克萨斯州分得24个众议院席位。由于美国最高法院审理“怀特诉韦瑟案”，该州在十年中期重新划分了选区。

en.s: The 1974 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Francis B. Burch won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行马里兰州州检察长选举。民主党候选人、现任州检察长弗朗西斯·B·伯奇没有遇到对手，成功连任。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Dole was narrowly re-elected to a second term in office. Dole was considered vulnerable due to his close association with President Richard Nixon as chairman of the Republican National Committee in 1971 and 1972.

zh.t: 1974年堪萨斯州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行堪萨斯州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任联邦参议员鲍勃·多尔以微弱优势连任第二个任期。1971年至1972年担任共和党全国委员会主席期间，他与总统理查德·尼克松关系密切，因此被认为可能落选。

en.s: The 1974 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974, and featured incumbent governor J. James Exon, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee, state senator Richard D. Marvel. Independent state senator Ernie Chambers also captured 5% of the vote as a write-in candidate. This was the first gubernatorial election in Nebraska in which the nominees for Governor and Lieutenant Governor ran as a single ticket in the general election, though they were chosen in separate primary elections.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长J·詹姆斯·埃克森击败共和党候选人、州参议员理查德·D·马维尔。独立派州参议员厄尼·钱伯斯也以写入选票的候选人身份获得5%的选票。这是内布拉斯加州首次在大选中由州长和副州长候选人作为搭档竞选；两人此前分别通过党内初选产生。

en.t: 1974 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1974 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican Pete du Pont won re-election over Democrat candidate Norma Handloff with 58.52% of the vote against his opponent's 39.60% of the vote.

zh.t: 1974年特拉华州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行特拉华州美国众议院选举。共和党籍现任众议员皮特·杜邦击败民主党候选人诺玛·汉德洛夫，成功连任，得票率分别为58.52%和39.60%。

en.s: The 1974 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Republican governor Winfield Dunn was ineligible to run for re-election, as the Constitution of Tennessee prohibited governors from serving consecutive terms at the time. Democratic nominee Ray Blanton defeated Republican opponent Lamar Alexander with 55.4% of the vote.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行田纳西州州长选举，选出下一任州长。由于当时田纳西州宪法禁止州长连续任职，共和党籍现任州长温菲尔德·邓恩不能竞选连任。民主党候选人雷·布兰顿击败共和党对手拉马尔·亚历山大，获得55.4%的选票。

en.s: The 1974 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic Governor Dale Bumpers retired to run for the U.S. Senate. Democratic nominee David Pryor defeated Republican nominee Ken Coon with 65.57% of the vote.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行阿肯色州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长戴尔·邦珀斯退休，转而竞选美国参议员。民主党候选人大卫·普赖尔击败共和党候选人肯·库恩，获得65.57%的选票。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Harold E. Hughes retired. The open seat was won by U.S. Representative John C. Culver, defeating Republican State Representative David M. Stanley. As of 2022, this was the most recent election in which a Democrat, or anyone other than Chuck Grassley, has won the Class 3 Senate seat in Iowa.

zh.t: 1974年艾奥瓦州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行艾奥瓦州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员哈罗德·E·休斯退休。联邦众议员约翰·C·卡尔弗击败共和党籍州众议员戴维·M·斯坦利，赢得这个空缺席位。截至2022年，这是民主党人最后一次赢得艾奥瓦州第三类参议员席位，也是查克·格拉斯利以外的人最后一次赢得该席位。

en.s: The 1974 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 5, 1974, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. The result was an electoral shutout, as all 35 candidates elected were members of the Democratic Party. This election was notable for seeing the first two Black Americans elected to the chamber since the Reconstruction era, those being U. W.

zh.s: 1974年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于11月5日星期二举行，选出35名州参议员，任期四年。选举结果是民主党候选人包揽全部35席。自重建时期以来，这是首次有两名非裔美国人当选该州参议员。

en.s: The 1974 Arizona Senate election was held on November 5, 1974. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 10, 1974. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，选民从该州全部30个选区选出州参议员，任期两年。党内初选于1974年9月10日举行。选举前，共和党占18席，民主党占12席。

en.s: The 1974 California Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican Evelle J. Younger defeated Democratic nominee William Albert Norris with 55.00% of the vote.

zh.t: 1974年加利福尼亚州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行加利福尼亚州州检察长选举。共和党籍现任州检察长埃维尔·J·扬格击败民主党候选人威廉·艾伯特·诺里斯，获得55%的选票。

en.t: 1974 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 1974 United States Virgin Islands general election was held in large part on November 5, 1974, with a runoff for the gubernatorial election on November 19, 1974.

zh.s: 1974年美属维尔京群岛大部分选举于11月5日举行，州长选举的决选于1974年11月19日举行。

en.s: The 1974 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee George W. Lehr defeated Republican nominee and incumbent acting state auditor John Ashcroft.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行密苏里州审计长选举。民主党候选人乔治·W·莱尔击败共和党候选人、时任代理审计长约翰·阿什克罗夫特。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Connecticut took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Abraham Ribicoff was re-elected to a third term in office over Republican James H. Brannen III. Brannen, a state legislator and airline pilot, was the first African American nominated by either major party for statewide office in Connecticut.

zh.t: 1974年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行康涅狄格州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员亚伯拉罕·里比科夫击败共和党人詹姆斯·H·布兰嫩三世，连任第三个任期。布兰嫩曾任州议员和航空公司飞行员，是康涅狄格州首位获两大政党之一提名、竞选全州职位的非裔美国人。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democrat Thomas Eagleton defeated Republican nominee Thomas B. Curtis, a former U.S. Representative, with 60.07% of the vote. This was a rematch of the 1968 election, when Eagleton defeated Curtis by a narrow margin.

zh.t: 1974年密苏里州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行密苏里州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员托马斯·伊格尔顿击败共和党候选人、前联邦众议员托马斯·B·柯蒂斯，获得60.07%的选票。这是两人再次交手；在1968年的选举中，伊格尔顿以微弱优势击败柯蒂斯。

en.s: The 1974 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democrat Philip Noel defeated Republican nominee James W. Nugent with 78.48% of the vote.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行罗得岛州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长菲利普·诺埃尔击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·W·纽金特，获得78.48%的选票。

en.s: The 1974 Florida gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic Governor Reubin Askew won re-election to a second term. This was just the second time after 1956, and the first that the Governor of Florida was re-elected for the second four-year term. This was also the first time a candidate got over one million votes in a Florida governor election.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行佛罗里达州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长鲁宾·阿斯丘成功连任，开始第二个任期。自1956年以来，这是佛罗里达州州长第二次连任，也是首次有州长连任第二个四年任期。这也是佛罗里达州州长选举中首次有候选人获得超过100万张选票。

en.t: 1974 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 1974 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 5, 1974 to elect the state's two representatives to serve in the 94th United States Congress. Both districts retained their partisan control, with the Democrats retaining the 2nd district and Republicans holding on to the 1st district. This made the state's delegation remain evenly split, as it had been since 1970.

zh.t: 1974年新墨西哥州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日（星期二）举行新墨西哥州美国众议院选举，选出该州两名众议员，进入第94届美国国会。两个选区的政党归属都没有改变：民主党继续赢得第二选区，共和党守住第一选区。自1970年以来，该州代表团一直是两党各占一半，这次选举后仍然如此。

en.t: 1974 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada
en.s: The 1974 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada was held on Tuesday November 5, 1974, to elect the state's at-large representative. Primary elections were held on September 3, 1974. Democratic nominee James David Santini defeated incumbent Republican David Towell and Independent American Joel F. Hansen by 19.33%.

zh.t: 1974年内华达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日（星期二）举行内华达州美国众议院选举，选出该州唯一的众议员。党内初选于1974年9月3日举行。民主党候选人詹姆斯·戴维·桑蒂尼击败共和党籍现任众议员戴维·托威尔和美国独立党候选人乔尔·F·汉森，领先19.33个百分点。

en.s: The 1974 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democrat Marvin Mandel defeated Republican nominee Louise Gore with 63.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行马里兰州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长马文·曼德尔击败共和党候选人路易丝·戈尔，获得63.50%的选票。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in California was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democrat Alan Cranston defeated Republican nominee H. L. Richardson with 60.52% of the vote. Primary elections were held on June 4, 1974. In the general election, only Inyo County voted Republican. As of 2025, this was the last time Orange County voted Democratic in a Senate election contested by both political parties.

zh.t: 1974年加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员艾伦·克兰斯顿击败共和党候选人H·L·理查森，获得60.52%的选票。党内初选于1974年6月4日举行。大选中，只有因约县投票支持共和党。截至2025年，这是橙县最后一次在有两大党候选人参选的参议院选举中投票支持民主党。

en.s: The 1974 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974. Democratic nominee Robert Straub, endorsed by the outgoing governor Tom McCall, defeated Republican nominee Victor Atiyeh.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行俄勒冈州州长选举。即将卸任的州长汤姆·麦考尔支持民主党候选人罗伯特·斯特劳布，后者击败共和党候选人维克托·阿提耶。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 5, 1974. Primaries were held on March 19, 1974.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日（星期二）举行伊利诺伊州选举。党内初选于1974年3月19日举行。

en.s: The 1974 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent attorney general Warren Spannaus defeated Republican nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate Dean Nyquist and American Party nominee Allan W. Lamkin.

zh.t: 1974年明尼苏达州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行明尼苏达州州检察长选举。民主党—农民—劳工党候选人、现任州检察长沃伦·斯潘纳斯击败共和党候选人、前州参议员迪恩·尼斯奎斯特，以及美国党候选人艾伦·W·兰金。

en.s: The 1974 California Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1974. Democratic nominee March Fong Eu defeated Republican nominee Brian Van Camp with 57.93% of the vote.

zh.t: 1974年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行加利福尼亚州州务卿选举。民主党候选人马奇·方·尤击败共和党候选人布赖恩·范坎普，获得57.93%的选票。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Alan Bible decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth full term. Republican nominee Paul Laxalt won the open seat. Paul Laxalt, former Governor (1967–1971) and former Lieutenant Governor of Nevada (1963–1967), won by less than 700 votes over incumbent Lieutenant Governor Harry Reid, becoming one of the few bright spots in a bad year for Republicans.

zh.t: 1974年内华达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行内华达州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员艾伦·拜布尔决定退休，没有寻求第四个完整任期。共和党候选人保罗·拉克萨尔特赢得这个空缺席位。拉克萨尔特曾任内华达州州长（1967至1971年）和副州长（1963至1967年），以不到700票的优势击败现任副州长哈里·里德，成为共和党在糟糕选举年里少数的亮点之一。

en.s: The 1974 Montana House of Representatives election took place on November 5, 1974, with the primary election held on June 4, 1974. Montana voters elected all 100 members of the Montana House of Representatives. Following the landmark Reynolds v. Sims (1964) US Supreme Court decision, every state had to redraw state electoral districts to be approximately equal in population.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行蒙大拿州众议院选举，党内初选于1974年6月4日举行。蒙大拿州选民选出州众议院全部100名议员。根据美国最高法院1964年在“雷诺兹诉西姆斯案”中的重要裁决，各州都必须重新划分州选区，使各选区人口大致相等。

en.s: The 1974 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Robert W. Mattson Jr. defeated Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Rolland Hatfield.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行明尼苏达州审计长选举。民主党—农民—劳工党候选人小罗伯特·W·马特森击败共和党候选人、现任州审计长罗兰·哈特菲尔德。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Marlow Cook ran for a second term in office but was defeated by Democratic Governor of Kentucky Wendell Ford.

zh.t: 1974年肯塔基州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行肯塔基州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任联邦参议员马洛·库克竞选连任第二个任期，但被民主党籍肯塔基州州长温德尔·福特击败。

en.s: The 1974 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican Stanley Hathaway chose to retire than run for a third term as Governor of Wyoming. Former Democratic State Representative Edgar Herschler defeated former Republican State Senator Dick Jones.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行怀俄明州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长斯坦利·海瑟薇选择退休，没有竞选第三个任期。民主党籍前州众议员埃德加·赫施勒击败共和党籍前州参议员迪克·琼斯。

en.s: The 1974 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the Attorney General of Michigan. Democratic nominee and incumbent Attorney General Frank J. Kelley won re-election against Republican nominee Myron H. Wahls Sr., American Independent nominee Ray D. Markel and Human Rights nominee Clarice Jobes.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行密歇根州州检察长选举。民主党候选人、现任州检察长弗兰克·J·凯利成功连任，击败共和党候选人迈伦·H·沃尔斯、美国独立党候选人雷·D·马克尔和人权党候选人克拉丽丝·乔布斯。

en.s: The 1974 Montana Senate election took place on November 5, 1974, with the primary election held on June 4, 1974. Montana voters elected all 50 members of the Montana Senate. Following the landmark Reynolds v. Sims (1964) US Supreme Court decision, every state had to redraw state electoral districts to be approximately equal in population. Before Reynolds, the Montana Senate consisted of 50 members from a mix of single- and multi-member districts.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行蒙大拿州参议院选举，党内初选于1974年6月4日举行。蒙大拿州选民选出州参议院全部50名议员。根据美国最高法院1964年在“雷诺兹诉西姆斯案”中的重要裁决，各州都必须重新划分州选区，使各选区人口大致相等。在该案判决前，蒙大拿州参议院的50名议员来自单议员和多议员选区。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 1974 took place on November 5, 1974. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, and Prince George's County elected county executives.

zh.t: 1974年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行马里兰州县行政长官选举。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县和乔治王子县选出了县行政长官。

en.t: 1974 United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 5, 1974, the District of Columbia held an election for its non-voting House delegate representing the District of Columbia's at-large congressional district. The winner of the race was Walter E. Fauntroy (D), who won his second re-election. Independent candidate James G. Banks surprised many by taking second place, ahead of William R. Phillips (R) and D.C. Statehood Party candidate Anton V. Wood.

zh.t: 1974年哥伦比亚特区美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日，哥伦比亚特区举行选举，选出该区在联邦众议院没有投票权的众议院代表。民主党人沃尔特·E·方特罗伊胜选，连任第二届。独立候选人詹姆斯·G·班克斯意外排名第二，领先于共和党候选人威廉·R·菲利普斯和哥伦比亚特区建州党候选人安东·V·伍德。

en.s: The 1974 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Joan Growe defeated Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Arlen Erdahl and American Party nominee Daniel J. Slater.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。民主党—农民—劳工党候选人、现任州众议员琼·格罗夫击败共和党候选人、现任州务卿阿伦·厄达尔，以及美国党候选人丹尼尔·J·斯莱特。

en.s: The 1974 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Republican nominee Jim Rhodes narrowly defeated Democratic incumbent John J. Gilligan with 48.62% of the vote.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。共和党候选人吉姆·罗兹以微弱优势击败民主党籍现任州长约翰·J·吉利根，获得48.62%的选票。

en.s: The 1974 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 1974. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 10, 1974.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举，选民从多议员选区选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。选举与州长、美国参议院、美国众议院和州参议院等职位的选举同时举行。党内初选于1974年9月10日举行。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator George McGovern ran for reelection to a third term and won. McGovern's reelection was notable for the fact two years prior, in the 1972 presidential election, McGovern lost his home state by 9 points to Richard Nixon, yet won his Senate reelection bid by 6 points, marking a fifteen point swing in two years.

zh.t: 1974年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行南达科他州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员乔治·麦戈文竞选连任第三个任期并获胜。两年前的1972年总统选举中，麦戈文在自己的家乡州以9个百分点之差输给理查德·尼克松；这次参议员连任竞选却以6个百分点的优势获胜，两年间出现了15个百分点的转变。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 5, 1974. Senator Howard Metzenbaum, who had been appointed to the seat in 1974 by Ohio governor John J. Gilligan, lost the Democratic primary election to famed astronaut John Glenn. In the general election, Glenn won every county in the state against Cleveland mayor Ralph Perk. Metzenbaum would later be elected to Ohio's other U.S.

zh.t: 1974年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1974年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举于11月5日举行。俄亥俄州州长约翰·J·吉利根于1974年任命霍华德·梅岑鲍姆接任该席位；梅岑鲍姆在民主党初选中败给著名宇航员约翰·格伦。大选中，格伦赢得全州每个县，击败克利夫兰市长拉尔夫·珀克。梅岑鲍姆后来当选俄亥俄州另一联邦参议员席位；原文在“U.S.”处中断。

en.s: The 1974 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Democratic nominee Richard Lamm defeated incumbent Republican John D. Vanderhoof with 53.22% of the vote. This is the last time that an incumbent governor of Colorado lost re-election.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。民主党候选人理查德·拉姆击败共和党籍现任州长约翰·D·范德胡夫，获得53.22%的选票。这是科罗拉多州现任州长最后一次竞选连任失败。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator J. William Fulbright ran for re-election to a sixth term in office, but was defeated handily in the Democratic primary by Governor of Arkansas Dale Bumpers. Bumpers won the general election.

zh.t: 1974年阿肯色州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行阿肯色州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员J·威廉·富布赖特竞选连任第六个任期，但在民主党初选中被阿肯色州州长戴尔·邦珀斯轻松击败。邦珀斯赢得大选。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Peter Dominick ran for re-election to a third term in office, but was defeated by Democrat Gary Hart. As of 2026, this is the last time that an incumbent Senator from Colorado lost re-election for this seat, and the last time that El Paso County voted for the Democratic candidate in a Senate election.

zh.t: 1974年科罗拉多州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行科罗拉多州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任联邦参议员彼得·多米尼克竞选连任第三个任期，但被民主党人加里·哈特击败。截至2026年，这是科罗拉多州现任参议员最后一次竞选连任失败，也是埃尔帕索县最后一次在参议院选举中投票支持民主党候选人。

en.s: The 1974 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat David Boren defeated Clem McSpadden in a run-off to claim his party's nomination after embattled incumbent David Hall was eliminated in the initial primary. Boren won the general election handily over Republican Jim Inhofe., who later won a 1994 U.S.

zh.s: 1974年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党人戴维·博伦在决选中击败克莱姆·麦克斯帕登，获得本党提名；此前，深陷争议的时任州长戴维·霍尔已在初选中出局。博伦随后在大选中轻松击败共和党人吉姆·英霍夫。

en.t: 1974 United States House of Representatives elections in California
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1974 were elections for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 5, 1974. Democrats picked up five Republican-held districts.

zh.t: 1974年加利福尼亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行加利福尼亚州美国众议院选举，作为众议院大选的一部分。民主党从共和党手中赢得了5个选区。

en.s: The 1974 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1974年11月5日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党候选人、现任审计长路易斯·L·戈德斯坦没有遇到对手，成功连任。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Warren Magnuson won a sixth term in office, defeating Republican state senator Jack Metcalf, in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.t: 1974年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举于1974年11月5日举行。民主党现任参议员沃伦·马格努森击败共和党州参议员杰克·梅特卡夫，赢得第六个任期。这是两人继上次选举后的再次交锋。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Jacob Javits was re-elected to a fourth term in office against Democratic challenger Ramsey Clark and Conservative Barbara Keating.

zh.s: 1974年纽约州联邦参议院选举于1974年11月5日举行。共和党现任参议员雅各布·贾维茨击败民主党挑战者拉姆齐·克拉克和保守党候选人芭芭拉·基廷，连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 1974 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974. Under Georgia's constitution at the time, incumbent Democratic governor Jimmy Carter was ineligible to serve a second consecutive term, and was in the process of launching his presidential campaign. George Busbee was elected as the 77th Governor of Georgia.

zh.s: 1974年佐治亚州州长选举于1974年11月5日举行。根据当时佐治亚州宪法，民主党现任州长吉米·卡特不能连任第二个连续任期，并开始筹备竞选总统。乔治·巴斯比当选佐治亚州第77任州长。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Georgia took place on November 5, 1974. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Herman Talmadge was re-elected to a fourth consecutive term in office, winning large victories in the primary and general elections. This was the last time a Democrat won re-election to the Class 3 Seat in Georgia until 2022.

zh.t: 1974年佐治亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年佐治亚州联邦参议院选举于1974年11月5日举行。民主党现任参议员赫尔曼·塔尔马奇连任第四个连续任期，并在初选和普选中都大幅领先。这是民主党人最后一次在佐治亚州赢得该联邦参议院第三类席位的连任，直到2022年才再次获胜。

en.s: The 1974 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974 to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York. Incumbent Republican governor Malcolm Wilson, who had ascended to the governorship following Nelson Rockefeller's resignation to begin work with the Commission on Critical Choices for Americans in 1973, was defeated by Democratic Congressman Hugh Carey. Carey became the first Democratic Governor of New York since W.

zh.s: 1974年纽约州州长选举于11月5日举行，以选出州长和副州长。共和党籍时任州长马尔科姆·威尔逊在纳尔逊·洛克菲勒辞职、于1973年开始参与“美国重要抉择委员会”工作后接任州长；威尔逊败给民主党籍联邦众议员休·凯里。凯里成为自W. Averell Harriman于1958年败给洛克菲勒以来，首位民主党籍纽约州州长。

en.s: The 1974 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1974, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and former member of the Georgia State Senate Zell Miller defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Georgia House of Representatives John Savage.

zh.s: 1974年佐治亚州副州长选举于1974年11月5日举行，选出佐治亚州副州长。民主党候选人、佐治亚州前参议员泽尔·米勒击败共和党候选人、佐治亚州众议院现任议员约翰·萨维奇。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 5, 1974, in 35 states and two territories. The Democrats achieved a net gain of four seats, Republicans took a net loss of five seats, and one Independent was elected to the governorship of a state. This election coincided with the Senate and the House elections. In Iowa, Kansas, South Dakota and Texas, governors were elected to four-year terms for the first time, instead of two-year terms.

zh.s: 1974年美国有35个州和两个属地于11月5日举行州长选举。民主党净增4席，共和党净失5席，另有一名独立候选人当选州长。此次选举与联邦参议院和众议院选举同期举行。艾奥瓦、堪萨斯、南达科他和得克萨斯四州首次改为选举任期四年的州长，此前任期为两年。

en.s: The 1974 United States House of Representatives election in Georgia's 6th congressional district was the election for the Representative of Georgia's 6th district to the United States House of Representatives which was held on November 5, 1974. This election is notable for being the beginning of a political career of a then-little known professor from the University of West Georgia and future Speaker of the United States House of Representatives Newt Gingrich.

zh.t: 1974年佐治亚州第6国会选区选举
zh.s: 1974年佐治亚州第6国会选区联邦众议院选举于1974年11月5日举行，选出该选区的美国联邦众议员。这场选举开启了一位当时名不见经传的西佐治亚大学教授的政治生涯；他后来成为美国联邦众议院议长纽特·金里奇。

en.t: 1974 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on Tuesday, November 5. Democratic incumbent Frank Church was re-elected to a fourth term in office, defeating Republican Bob Smith. Church announced his presidential campaign in March 1976, off the strength of his victory as well as his high-profile chairmanship of the select Church Commission investigating American intelligence activity.

zh.t: 1974年美国爱达荷州参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年美国爱达荷州参议院选举于11月5日星期二举行。民主党籍现任参议员弗兰克·丘奇击败共和党候选人鲍勃·史密斯，成功连任，开始第四个任期。丘奇于1976年3月宣布竞选总统；他凭借这次胜利以及担任教会委员会主席调查美国情报活动而获得的关注，发起了竞选。

en.s: The 1974 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 5. Incumbent Democrat Cecil Andrus soundly defeated Republican nominee Jack Murphy, the lieutenant governor, with 70.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1974年爱达荷州州长选举于11月5日星期二举行。民主党籍现任州长塞西尔·安德鲁斯以70.92%的得票率大胜共和党候选人、时任副州长杰克·墨菲。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1974 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1974 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 26 of the state senate's districts—the 25 odd-numbered state senate districts and a special election in district 10. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for regularly scheduled election each cycle.

zh.s: 1974年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院的26个选区选出参议员，包括25个奇数编号选区，以及第10选区的一场特别选举。州参议员任期为四年，每轮选举按计划改选一半席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1974 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 5. Incumbent Democratic Governor Milton Shapp defeated Republican Drew Lewis. Under the state's 1968 constitution, Shapp was the first governor who was eligible to run for consecutive terms.

zh.s: 1974年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长米尔顿·沙普击败共和党候选人德鲁·刘易斯。根据该州1968年宪法，沙普是首位有资格竞选连任的州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1974 San Jose mayoral election was held to elect the mayor of San Jose, California. It saw an initial election held on June 4, 1974, followed by a runoff election on November 5, 1974, after no candidate managed to obtain a majority in the initial election. The runoff was won by Janet Gray Hayes, who became the first female mayor of the city, making San Jose the first United States city of more than 500,000 residents to elect a female mayor.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1974年圣何塞市长选举选出加利福尼亚州圣何塞市的市长。首轮选举于1974年6月4日举行，由于没有候选人获得多数票，11月5日举行了第二轮投票。珍妮特·格雷·海斯赢得第二轮选举，成为该市首位女市长，也使圣何塞成为美国首个选出女市长、人口超过50万的城市。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1974 Guamanian gubernatorial election was held on November 5, with a runoff on November 14. The Republican primary was hotly contested, with incumbent governor Carlos Camacho narrowly winning re-nomination with only 298 votes against future governor Paul McDonald Calvo. Despite this loss, Calvo ran a robust write-in campaign that was well-funded.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1974年关岛总督选举于11月5日举行，决选于11月14日举行。共和党初选竞争激烈，时任总督卡洛斯·卡马乔仅以298票险胜、获得连任提名，击败未来总督保罗·麦克唐纳·卡尔沃。尽管落败，卡尔沃仍组织了资金充足、势头强劲的写入候选人竞选。
zh.n: 此条记录的是原文资料框列出的首轮选举日期。

en.s: The 1975 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1975, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Bill Waller was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term. To date, this was the last time Washington County voted for the Republican candidate.

zh.s: 1975年11月5日举行密西西比州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长比尔·沃勒受任期限制，不能竞选连任第二个任期。迄今为止，这是华盛顿县最后一次投票支持共和党候选人。

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 1978 were the first ever W.A.K.O. World kickboxing championships introduced by the pioneer of German Karate Georg Brueckner and the third major event hosted by the W.A.K.O. organization – formerly known as the W.M.A.A. (World of Mixed Martial Arts Association). The W.A.K.O. championships were open to amateur men only from eighteen countries across the world and all bouts were fought under Full-Contact kickboxing rules - differing from modern rules in that there was a platform instead of a ring and fighters wore no protective clothing or head guards. Semi-Contact, which had been introduced at the 1978 European championships, would have no place at this event. At the end of the championships, the USA was the top nation, with West Germany a close second, and the Dominican Republic in third. The event was held in West Berlin on November 5, 1978.

zh.s: 1978年W.A.K.O.世界锦标赛是首届W.A.K.O.世界踢拳锦标赛，由德国空手道先驱格奥尔格·布吕克纳创办，也是W.A.K.O.组织举办的第三场大型赛事；该组织此前称为世界综合格斗协会（W.M.A.A.）。比赛只对来自18个国家的业余男子选手开放，所有比赛均按全接触踢拳规则进行。与现代规则不同，当时比赛在平台而非拳台上进行，选手不穿防护服，也不戴头盔。1978年欧洲锦标赛已设立的半接触项目没有纳入本届赛事。最终，美国排名第一，西德紧随其后，多米尼加共和国排名第三。赛事于1978年11月5日在西柏林举行。

en.t: United States Senate election in Nevada, 1982
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 5, 1982. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Howard Cannon ran for re-election to a fifth term, but lost to Republican Chic Hecht.

zh.t: 1982年内华达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1982年内华达州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员霍华德·坎农竞选第五个任期，但败给共和党人奇克·赫克特。

en.t: United States Senate election in Nebraska, 1982
en.s: The 1982 United States Senate election in Nebraska was held on November 5, 1982 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of Nebraska. Democratic U.S.

zh.t: 1982年美国内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1982年美国内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月5日举行，以选出该州的联邦参议员。原文在介绍民主党候选人时中断。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Moreton on 5 November 1983. This was triggered by the resignation of Liberal Party MP James Killen.

zh.s: 澳大利亚联邦众议院莫顿选区于1983年11月5日举行补选。此次补选因自由党议员詹姆斯·基伦辞职而举行。

en.t: United States Senate election in Mississippi, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Mississippi was held on November 5, 1984. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Thad Cochran won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1984年密西西比州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年密西西比州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员萨德·科克伦成功连任第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1985 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 5, 1985. Incumbent Republican Governor Thomas Kean sought reelection for a second term following his 1797-vote win in the 1981 election. Kean's 40-point landslide victory against the Democratic candidate, Essex County Executive Peter Shapiro, is the largest plurality in terms of percentage and raw votes in all modern New Jersey gubernatorial elections. Kean won 564 out of 567 municipalities (losing only Audubon Park, Chesilhurst, and Roosevelt) and his coattails led the Republicans to take over the General Assembly with a 50-seat majority.

zh.s: 1985年新泽西州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长托马斯·基恩竞选连任第二个任期；他在1981年的选举中仅以1,797票获胜。这次他以40个百分点的优势大胜民主党候选人、埃塞克斯县行政长官彼得·夏皮罗，获胜优势是现代新泽西州州长选举中无论按百分比还是票数计算的最大纪录。基恩赢得567个市镇中的564个，只在奥杜邦帕克、切西尔赫斯特和罗斯福落败。他的胜利还带动共和党取得州众议院50席多数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1985 occurred on Tuesday, November 5, 1985, with Democratic incumbent Mayor Ed Koch being re-elected to a third term by a landslide margin. Koch received an overwhelming 78.02% of the vote citywide. Koch also swept all five boroughs by landslide margins, breaking 70% of the vote in Manhattan and Queens and breaking 80% of the vote in Brooklyn, the Bronx, and Staten Island. Koch's closest competitor was the Liberal Party nominee, New York City Council President Carol Bellamy, who received 10.20% of the vote. Finishing in a distant third was the Republican nominee, Diane McGrath, who received 9.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 1985年纽约市市长选举于11月5日（星期二）举行。民主党籍现任市长埃德·科赫以压倒性优势连任第三个任期，全市得票率达78.02%。他在五个行政区都以巨大优势获胜：在曼哈顿和皇后区得票率超过70%，在布鲁克林、布朗克斯和史泰登岛超过80%。最接近科赫的对手是自由党候选人、纽约市议会议长卡罗尔·贝拉米，得票率为10.20%。远远落后的第三名是共和党候选人黛安·麦格拉思，得票率为9.14%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1985 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 5, 1985. The incumbent mayor, Richard Caliguiri of the Democratic Party chose to run for his third term. Calagiri won by over 50 points in a city where Democrats outnumber Republicans by a 5 to 1 margin. The Republican nominee was attorney Henry Sneath. A total of 81,997 votes were cast.

zh.s: 1985年宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1985年11月5日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长理查德·卡利吉里竞选第三个任期，并以超过50个百分点的优势获胜。该市民主党选民人数是共和党选民的5倍。共和党提名人是律师亨利·斯尼思。此次选举共投出81,997张选票。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1985 were held on November 5, 1985 in two states, New Jersey and Virginia. Both seats remained in their respective parties' controls.

zh.s: 1985年11月5日，美国新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。两州州长席位都由原有政党保住。

en.t: 1985 New York City Council presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 5, 1985 to elect the President of the New York City Council. Democratic incumbent Carol Bellamy ran for mayor against Ed Koch, leaving the seat vacant for the next term. Andrew J. Stein won the open race, defeating Kenneth Lipper in the Democratic primary. Stein won the general election in a landslide.

zh.s: 1985年11月5日举行选举，选出纽约市议会主席。民主党籍现任主席卡罗尔·贝拉米竞选市长，挑战埃德·科赫，离任后该职位将在下届任期空缺。安德鲁·J·斯坦赢得这个空缺职位，在民主党初选中击败肯尼思·利珀，并在大选中以压倒性优势获胜。

en.s: The 1985 New Jersey General Assembly election was held on November 5, 1985. The elections coincided with Governor Tom Kean's landslide re-election. The result was a historic victory for Kean's Republican Party, which gained 14 seats to retake the majority in the Assembly. As of 2026, this remains the only election since 1973 in which Republicans won any seats in the Senate or Assembly from Hudson County, where they carried four of six seats.

zh.s: 1985年11月5日举行新泽西州州议会选举，时间与州长汤姆·基恩以压倒性优势连任同时。基恩所属的共和党取得历史性胜利，增加14个席位，重新获得州议会多数。截至2026年，这是自1973年以来共和党最后一次在哈德逊县赢得州参议院或州众议院席位；当时共和党赢得了6个席位中的4个。

en.s: The 1985 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1985. Democratic nominee Douglas Wilder defeated Republican nominee John Chichester with 51.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 1985年11月5日举行弗吉尼亚州副州长选举。民主党候选人道格拉斯·怀尔德击败共和党候选人约翰·奇切斯特，获得51.84%的选票。

en.s: The 1985 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 5, 1985, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the October 1 primary advancing to the general election. Voinovich's top opponent was council member Gary Kucinich, brother of former mayor Dennis Kucinich.

zh.s: 1985年克利夫兰市长选举于1985年11月5日举行，选出俄亥俄州克利夫兰市市长。选举名义上不分党派；10月1日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入普选。沃伊诺维奇最主要的对手是市议员加里·库西尼奇，他是前市长丹尼斯·库西尼奇的兄弟。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 1985 was held on Tuesday, November 5. Primary elections were held on June 11, 1985.

zh.s: 1985年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月5日星期二举行。初选于1985年6月11日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the 1985 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor Chuck Robb, a Democrat, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. Jerry Baliles, the Attorney General of Virginia, was nominated by the Democratic Party to run against Republican, Wyatt B. Durrette in a re-match of the 1981 Attorney General election.

zh.s: 1985年弗吉尼亚州州长选举中，民主党籍现任州长查克·罗伯因任期限制无法竞选连任。民主党提名弗吉尼亚州检察长杰里·巴利尔斯，对阵共和党人怀亚特·B·杜雷特。这是两人继1981年检察长选举后的再次对决。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1987 New Jersey General Assembly election was held on November 5, 1987. The elections took place midway through Governor Tom Kean's second term in office. Democrats won back eight seats, narrowing the Republican majority to four. Democrats flipped one seat in districts 1 and 14, as well as flipping both seats in districts 32, 33, and 36.

zh.s: 1987年11月5日举行新泽西州州议会选举，时间在州长汤姆·基恩第二个任期的中间。民主党夺回8个席位，将共和党多数优势缩小到4席。民主党在第1和第14选区各赢得1席，并在第32、第33和第36选区赢得全部两个席位。

en.s: Early parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 5 November 1989. The liberal-conservative New Democracy party of Konstantinos Mitsotakis emerged as the largest party in Parliament, defeating PASOK of Andreas Papandreou. However, as in June 1989, Mitsotakis was unable to form a government since his party had failed to win a majority of seats.

zh.s: 1989年11月5日，希腊提前举行议会选举。康斯坦丁·米佐塔基斯领导的自由保守派新民主党成为议会第一大党，击败安德烈亚斯·帕潘德里欧领导的泛希腊社会主义运动。不过，与1989年6月的选举一样，新民主党没有赢得多数席位，米佐塔基斯无法组建政府。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in the Parliament of Lebanon on 5 November 1989, resulting in Deputy René Moawad being elected President of the Lebanese Republic. By convention, the presidency is always attributed to a Maronite Christian. Under the article 49 of the Lebanese Constitution, a qualified majority of two-thirds of the 72 alive members (no election had been held since 1970) of the then 99-seat Lebanese Parliament is required to elect the president in the first round.

zh.s: 1989年11月5日，黎巴嫩议会举行间接总统选举，选出议员勒内·穆阿瓦德担任黎巴嫩共和国总统。按惯例，总统职位始终由马龙派基督徒担任。根据黎巴嫩宪法第49条，总统首轮选举须获得72名在任议员中三分之二的多数。当时的黎巴嫩议会共有99个席位，自1970年以来一直没有举行选举。

en.t: 1989 New York City Council presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 5, 1989 to elect the President of the New York City Council. Democratic incumbent Andrew Stein was re-elected to a second term in office over token opposition in the Democratic primary and general election. This was the final election for New York City Council President, as the office was split into the offices of New York City Public Advocate and Speaker of the New York City Council following the 1993 elections.

zh.s: 1989年11月5日举行纽约市议会主席选举。民主党籍现任主席安德鲁·斯坦轻松连任第二个任期，在民主党初选和大选中都没有遇到有力竞争。这是纽约市议会主席职位的最后一次选举；1993年选举后，该职位拆分为纽约市公益维护人和纽约市议会议长两个职位。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1990
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Virginia took place on November 5, 1990. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John W. Warner won re-election to a third term. No Democrat filed to run against him as he won every single county and city in the state with over 60% of the vote. Independent Nancy B.

zh.t: 1990年美国弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1990年美国弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍时任联邦参议员约翰·W·华纳赢得连任，开始第三个任期。没有民主党人登记参选，华纳在弗吉尼亚州每个县和市都获得超过60%的选票。原文随后提及独立候选人南希·B.，但句子不完整。

en.t: United States Senate election in Nebraska, 1990
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Nebraska was held on November 5, 1990. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator J. James Exon won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 1990年内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员J·詹姆斯·埃克森成功连任第三个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 5 November 1990, Meir Kahane, an Israeli-American rabbi, ultranationalist politician, and convicted domestic terrorist, was assassinated by El Sayyid Nosair, an American Islamic extremist, at the New York Marriott East Side hotel (now named 525 Lexington Avenue) in Manhattan, New York City. On the second floor of the hotel, while Kahane was speaking to an audience, Nosair fatally shot him in the neck with a pistol, then escaped onto Lexington Avenue.

zh.s: 1990年11月5日，以色列裔美国拉比、极端民族主义政治人物、曾被判犯有国内恐怖主义罪的梅厄·卡哈尼，在纽约市曼哈顿的纽约万豪东区酒店（现名525 Lexington Avenue）遭美国伊斯兰极端分子埃尔·赛义德·诺赛尔刺杀。卡哈尼在酒店二楼向听众演讲时，诺赛尔用手枪击中他的颈部，随后逃往列克星敦大道。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: FMW 1st Anniversary Show was the first professional wrestling supercard produced by the Japanese professional wrestling promotion Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling (FMW). The event took place on November 5, 1990 at the Komazawa Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan and was held to celebrate the first anniversary of FMW, which was founded on July 28, 1989. This was the first edition of the Anniversary Show, FMW's biggest event of the year.

zh.s: FMW一周年纪念赛是日本职业摔角推广组织“格斗摔角联盟”（FMW）举办的首场职业摔角大型赛事。赛事于1990年11月5日在日本东京驹泽体育馆举行，庆祝FMW成立一周年。该组织于1989年7月28日创立。这是周年纪念赛的首届赛事，也是FMW一年中规模最大的活动。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Pennsylvania, 1991
en.s: The 1991 United States Senate Special election in Pennsylvania was held on November 5, 1991. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Harris Wofford won the special election that was held because of the death of Republican Senator John Heinz on April 4 of that year. Wofford was appointed by Governor Bob Casey to serve as Senator until the special election which he subsequently won. Major-party candidates for this election were chosen by party committees, as the vacancy had happened too late for a primary to be held.

zh.t: 1991年宾夕法尼亚州美国联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1991年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议院特别选举于11月5日举行。共和党参议员约翰·海因茨于当年4月4日去世后，民主党籍现任联邦参议员哈里斯·沃福德在特别选举中获胜。州长鲍勃·凯西任命沃福德接替海因茨，担任参议员直至特别选举，沃福德随后赢得选举。由于席位空缺出现得太晚，无法举行初选，两大党候选人由各自党委员会选出。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1991 Kentucky gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1991. Incumbent Governor Wallace G. Wilkinson was not eligible to seek a second term due to term limits established by the Kentucky Constitution, creating an open seat. At the time, Kentucky was one of two states, along with Virginia, which prohibited its governors from serving immediate successive terms. The Democratic nominee, Lieutenant Governor Brereton Jones, defeated Republican nominee and U.S. Congressman Larry J. Hopkins to win a term as governor.

zh.s: 1991年肯塔基州州长选举于11月5日举行。现任州长华莱士·G·威尔金森因肯塔基州宪法规定的任期限制，不能竞选第二个任期，州长职位因此开放。当时肯塔基州和弗吉尼亚州是仅有的两个禁止州长立即连任的州。民主党候选人、副州长布雷雷顿·琼斯击败共和党候选人、联邦众议员拉里·J·霍普金斯，当选州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1991 occurred on Tuesday, November 5, 1991 between Mayor Raymond Flynn and Edward J. Doherty, president of the Boston Teachers Union. Flynn was re-elected to his third term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 24, 1991.

zh.s: 1991年波士顿市长选举于11月5日星期二举行，参选者是市长雷蒙德·弗林和波士顿教师工会主席爱德华·J·多尔蒂。弗林成功连任第三个任期。市政无党派初选于1991年9月24日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1991 United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 5, 1991, in three states — Kentucky, Louisiana, and Mississippi. Prior to the elections, Democrats held two seats and Republicans one. The national balance of power did not change as a result of the elections, but the balance of power shifted in two states.

zh.s: 1991年11月5日，美国肯塔基州、路易斯安那州和密西西比州举行州长选举。选举前，民主党占有两个州长席位，共和党占有一个。选举结果没有改变全国的政党力量平衡，但两个州的政党力量发生变化。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Columbus mayoral election of 1991 was the 79th mayoral election in Columbus, Ohio. It was held on Tuesday, November 5, 1991. Republican party incumbent mayor Buck Rinehart retired from office after serving two consecutive terms. Republican party nominee Greg Lashutka defeated Democratic party nominee Ben Espy.

zh.t: 1991年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举
zh.s: 1991年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举是该市第79次市长选举，于1991年11月5日星期二举行。共和党籍现任市长巴克·莱因哈特连任两届后退休。共和党提名人格雷格·拉舒特卡击败民主党提名人本·埃斯皮。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1991 New Jersey General Assembly election was held on November 5, 1991. The elections took place midway through Jim Florio's term as Governor of New Jersey. As in the concurrent New Jersey Senate elections, the Republican Party won a historic landslide, gaining 21 seats to win veto-proof supermajorities in both chambers of the state legislature.

zh.s: 1991年11月5日举行新泽西州州议会选举，时间在州长吉姆·弗洛里奥任期的中间。与同日举行的新泽西州参议院选举一样，共和党取得历史性的大胜，增加21个席位，在州议会两院都赢得足以推翻州长否决的多数。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1991 took place on November 5, 1991, and saw the election of Republican Stephen Goldsmith.

zh.t: 1991年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1991年11月5日举行印第安纳波利斯市长选举，共和党人斯蒂芬·戈德史密斯当选。

en.s: The 1991 Kentucky lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1991, to elect the lieutenant governor of Kentucky. Incumbent Democratic Lieutenant Governor Brereton Jones chose not to seek re-election to a second term in office, instead running for governor. Pike County executive Paul E. Patton won the general election against attorney Eugene Goss, by a margin of 514,023 to 250,857 votes.

zh.s: 1991年11月5日举行肯塔基州副州长选举。民主党籍现任副州长布雷顿·琼斯没有寻求连任第二个任期，而是转而竞选州长。派克县县长保罗·E·巴顿在大选中击败律师尤金·戈斯，得票数分别为514,023票和250,857票。

en.s: The 1991 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1991 to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Ray Mabus unsuccessfully ran for reelection to a second term. This election marked the first time a Republican was elected Governor of Mississippi since Reconstruction, when Adelbert Ames won the office in 1873. This is the last gubernatorial election where the Democratic candidate carried any of three counties (Hancock, Harrison and Jackson) along the Mississippi Gulf Coast.

zh.s: 1991年11月5日举行密西西比州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长雷·马布斯竞选连任第二个任期，但未能获胜。这是自重建时期以来，共和党人首次当选密西西比州州长；上一次是阿德尔伯特·艾姆斯于1873年当选。这也是密西西比州墨西哥湾沿岸的汉考克县、哈里森县和杰克逊县最后一次都投票支持民主党候选人。

en.s: The 1991 Toledo mayoral election took place on November 5, 1991, to elect the mayor of Toledo, Ohio. Incumbent Mayor John McHugh ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by anti-tax activist Paula Pennypacker. McHugh campaigned on his Toledo values, noting that he was "practical and down-to-earth" and "a Toledo kind of person," while Pennypacker argued that city government needed "fundamental changes."

zh.t: 1991年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举
zh.s: 1991年11月5日举行俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举。民主党籍现任市长约翰·麦克休竞选连任第二个任期，反税收活动人士宝拉·彭尼帕克与他竞争。麦克休以托莱多的价值观为竞选主张，称自己“务实、脚踏实地”，是“托莱多人”；彭尼帕克则认为，市政府需要“根本性改变”。

en.s: The 1991 Tucson mayoral election occurred on November 5, 1991, to elect the mayor of Tucson, and occurred coinciding with the elections to the Tucson City Council wards 1, 2 and 4. It saw the election of George Miller. Incumbent mayor Thomas Volgy did not seek reelection.

zh.s: 1991年11月5日举行图森市长选举，同时选出图森市议会第1、第2和第4选区的议员。乔治·米勒当选市长。现任市长托马斯·沃尔吉没有寻求连任。

en.s: The 1991 Houston mayoral election took place on November 5, 1991. The race was officially non-partisan. Bob Lanier defeated five term incumbent mayor Kathy Whitmire. A run-off election was held on December 7, 1991. Most white voters of all economic levels voted for Lanier. His strongest tallies came from affluent neighborhoods like River Oaks, Meyerland, Uptown, Memorial and Sharpstown; in those areas he won with 60 to 65 percent or more of the vote.

zh.s: 1991年休斯敦市长选举于1991年11月5日举行，选举名义上不分党派。鲍勃·拉尼尔击败寻求连任第五届的现任市长凯西·惠特迈尔。决选于1991年12月7日举行。各收入阶层的大多数白人选民都投票支持拉尼尔。他在河橡树、梅耶兰、上城区、纪念区和夏普斯敦等富裕社区得票最高，在这些地区获得60%至65%或更高的选票。

en.s: The 1991 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 5, 1991, with a runoff election on December 10 that year. Incumbent mayor Art Agnos, after having won nearly 70% of the vote in 1987, scraped by with less than a third of the vote in the first round and was narrowly unseated by Chief of Police Frank Jordan in the runoff.

zh.s: 1991年旧金山市长选举于1991年11月5日举行，决选于当年12月10日举行。现任市长阿特·阿格诺斯曾在1987年获得近70%的选票，这次在首轮投票中仅以不到三分之一的得票勉强进入决选，随后被警察局长弗兰克·乔丹以微弱优势击败。

en.s: The 1991 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 5, 1991, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Willis Tucker declined to run for re-election to a fourth term. Four candidates ran to succeed Tucker: Democrats Bob Drewel, the President of Everett Community College, and farmer Bill Patrick, and Republicans Cliff Bailey, a State Senator, and Doug Smith, an attorney.

zh.t: 1991年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1991年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举于1991年11月5日举行，选出华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县行政长官。民主党现任行政长官威利斯·塔克没有竞选连任第四届。共有4名候选人竞选接替他：民主党人、埃弗里特社区学院院长鲍勃·德鲁埃尔和农民比尔·帕特里克；共和党人、州参议员克利夫·贝利和律师道格·史密斯。

en.s: The 1991 Durham mayoral election was held on November 5, 1991, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the return of past mayor Harry E. Rodenhizer Jr. to the office, as he unseated incumbent mayor Chester L. Jenkins.

zh.s: 1991年达勒姆市长选举于1991年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市市长。前市长小哈里·E·罗登海泽击败现任市长切斯特·L·詹金斯，重新当选。

en.s: The 1991 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 5. The election took place mid-way through the term of Governor James Florio. The results were a landslide victory for the Republican Party amidst a tax revolt by New Jersey voters. Democrats picked up only one seat, that of Senator Lee B. Laskin in District 6. Republicans picked up eleven Democrat seats, winning control of the Senate for the first time since 1974.

zh.s: 1991年新泽西州参议院选举于11月5日举行，时间在州长詹姆斯·弗洛里奥任期过半之际。选民对新泽西州的税收政策不满，共和党因此大胜。民主党只赢回一个席位，即第6选区议员李·B·拉斯金的席位；共和党赢得了民主党的11个席位，自1974年以来首次控制参议院。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the elections to the Senate of Virginia, United States in October 1991, the Republican Party gained 8 seats from the Democrats, but the Democrats retained a majority with 22 seats to the Republicans' 18. One electoral district was newly created and another two were merged into one.

zh.s: 1991年10月举行的美国弗吉尼亚州参议院选举中，共和党从民主党手中赢得8个席位，但民主党仍以22席对共和党的18席保持多数。选区新增一个，另有两个选区合并为一个。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 1991 was held on Tuesday, November 5. Just over a month earlier, on September 28, House Speaker A. L. Philpott died of cancer. Democratic floor leader Tom Moss led his party going into the election; Moss was elected Speaker two weeks later, after his conference maintained a majority in the chamber.

zh.s: 1991年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月5日星期二举行。一个多月前的9月28日，众议院议长A·L·菲尔波特因癌症去世。民主党议会领袖汤姆·莫斯带领该党参加选举；两周后，民主党党团在议院中保住多数席位，莫斯当选议长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1991 Philadelphia mayoral election saw the election of Democrat Ed Rendell.

zh.s: 1991年费城市长选举由民主党人埃德·伦德尔胜出。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Tropical Storm Thelma causes flash floods in the Philippine city of Ormoc, killing more than 4,900 people
en.s: Tropical Storm Thelma, named Uring by PAGASA, was one of the deadliest tropical cyclones in Philippine history, killing at least 5,081 people. Forming out of a tropical disturbance on November 1, 1991, several hundred kilometers north-northeast of Palau, the depression that would become Thelma tracked generally westward. After turning southwestward in response to a cold front, the system intensified into a tropical storm on November 4 as it approached the Philippines.

zh.t: 热带风暴“特尔玛”引发菲律宾奥尔莫克市山洪，造成4900多人死亡
zh.s: 菲律宾大气、地球物理和天文服务管理局将热带风暴“特尔玛”命名为“乌林”。它是菲律宾历史上破坏性最强的热带气旋之一，至少造成5,081人死亡。1991年11月1日，一个热带扰动在帕劳东北偏北数百公里处形成，后来发展为“特尔玛”的低压系统总体向西移动。系统受冷锋影响转向西南，11月4日逼近菲律宾时增强为热带风暴。

en.s: Operation Angela was the code name of the Croatian Defence Council (HVO) operation to retake Odžak from the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) on 5 November 1993 during the Bosnian War. The HVO operation was suspended due to a lack of soldiers and a counterattack by the Army of Republika Srpska. Long after the fall of Odžak, HVO fighters from Odžak were in Orašje stationed at the Orašije-Šamača front line.

zh.s: 安吉拉行动是克罗地亚国防委员会（HVO）于1993年11月5日在波斯尼亚战争期间发起的一项军事行动，目标是从塞族共和国军（VRS）手中夺回奥扎克。由于兵力不足且塞族共和国军发起反攻，HVO暂停了行动。奥扎克失守很久之后，来自奥扎克的HVO战士驻扎在奥拉谢，守卫奥拉谢—沙马茨前线。

en.s: November to Remember (1994) was the second November to Remember professional wrestling live event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) that took place on November 5, 1994, in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Nine professional wrestling matches were contested at the event. The event featured two main event matches. In the first main event, Shane Douglas defended the ECW World Heavyweight Championship against Ron Simmons.

zh.s: 《铭记十一月》（1994）是极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的第二届“铭记十一月”职业摔角现场赛事，于1994年11月5日在宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场举行。赛事共进行了9场职业摔角比赛，其中有两场主赛。第一场主赛中，谢恩·道格拉斯对阵罗恩·西蒙斯，捍卫ECW世界重量级冠军头衔。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Poland on 5 November 1995, with a second round on 19 November. Aleksander Kwaśniewski and Lech Wałęsa passed to the second round. Kwaśniewski won the election, collecting 51.7 percent of votes in the run-off, against 48.3 percent for Lech Wałęsa, the former Solidarity leader.

zh.s: 波兰于1995年11月5日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于11月19日举行。亚历山大·克瓦希涅夫斯基和莱赫·瓦文萨进入第二轮。克瓦希涅夫斯基在第二轮中获得51.7%的选票，当选总统；前团结工会领导人瓦文萨获得48.3%。

en.s: The 1995 Scottish Challenge Cup final was an association football match between Stenhousemuir and Dundee United on 5 November 1995 at McDiarmid Park in Perth. It was the sixth final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the Scottish Football League.

zh.s: 1995年苏格兰挑战杯决赛于1995年11月5日在珀斯的麦克迪尔米德公园举行，由斯滕豪斯缪尔队对阵邓迪联队。这是苏格兰挑战杯第六届决赛。该赛事于1990年首次举办，以纪念苏格兰足球联赛成立100周年。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Georgia on 5 November (or 6 November) 1995. The result was a victory for Eduard Shevardnadze of the Union of Citizens of Georgia, who received 77% of the vote, with a 68% turnout.

zh.s: 格鲁吉亚于1995年11月5日（或11月6日）举行总统选举。格鲁吉亚公民联盟的爱德华·谢瓦尔德纳泽获胜，得票率为77%，投票率为68%。

en.s: The 1996 Utah gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1996. Republican nominee and incumbent Governor Michael Leavitt won the election. Democrat Jim Bradley, who had been elected as a Salt Lake County Commissioner in 1990 and lost re-election in 1994, announced his candidacy on March 18, 1996, the last day for candidates to file. If he had not run, it was likely the Democratic party would not have had a candidate on the ballot. In a poll released in early April 1996, Bradley trailed Leavitt by 63 points. Leavitt, with high popularity ratings as the incumbent Governor, maintained a formidable lead in subsequent polls as well.

zh.s: 1996年犹他州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党候选人、现任州长迈克尔·利维特赢得选举。民主党人吉姆·布拉德利曾于1990年当选盐湖县委员，1994年竞选连任失败。他在1996年3月18日、候选人登记截止日当天宣布参选；如果他没有参选，民主党可能无法在选票上推出候选人。1996年4月初公布的一项民调显示，布拉德利落后利维特63个百分点。作为支持率很高的现任州长，利维特在之后的民调中也一直保持明显领先。

en.t: United States Senate election in Illinois, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Paul Simon opted to retire rather than seek a third term in the United States Senate. In the Democratic primary, United States Congressman Dick Durbin emerged victorious, while State Representative Al Salvi won the Republican primary. Though the election was initially anticipated to be close, Durbin ended up defeating Salvi by a comfortable double-digit margin of victory, allowing him to win what would be the first of several terms in the Senate.

zh.t: 1996年伊利诺伊州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员保罗·西蒙选择退休，没有竞选第三个参议员任期。民主党初选由联邦众议员迪克·德宾获胜；州众议员艾尔·萨尔维赢得共和党初选。选举原本预计竞争激烈，但德宾最终以两位数的明显优势击败萨尔维，赢得他的第一个参议员任期，之后还多次连任。

en.t: United States presidential election in California, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in California took place on November 5, 1996, as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Voters chose 54 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. California, was won by Incumbent President Bill Clinton (D) over Senator Bob Dole (R), with Clinton winning 51.1% to 38.21% by a margin of 12.89%. Billionaire businessman Ross Perot (Reform Party) finished in third with 6.96% of the popular vote. California is one of thirteen states where on the election ballot, James Campbell of California, Perot's former boss at IBM, was listed as a stand-in Vice-Presidential candidate.

zh.t: 1996年加利福尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1996年加利福尼亚州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出54名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州支持现任总统、民主党人比尔·克林顿，击败参议员、共和党人鲍勃·多尔。克林顿得票率为51.1%，多尔为38.21%，两人相差12.89个百分点。亿万富翁商人、改革党候选人罗斯·佩罗以6.96%的普选票排名第三。加州是13个在选票上将詹姆斯·坎贝尔列为佩罗竞选搭档、替补副总统候选人的州之一；坎贝尔曾是佩罗在IBM的上司。

en.t: United States presidential election in Connecticut, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 5, 1996 as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Voters chose 8 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Connecticut was won by incumbent Democratic President Bill Clinton, who took 52.83% of the vote over Republican Senator Bob Dole of Kansas, who took 34.69%, a victory margin of 18.14%. The Reform Party candidate, Texas Billionaire Ross Perot, finished in third with 10.02% of the popular vote. Clinton's decisive win was indicative of a major shift toward the Democratic Party throughout the Northeast in the 1990s.

zh.t: 1996年康涅狄格州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1996年康涅狄格州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍现任总统比尔·克林顿赢得康涅狄格州，得票率为52.83%；共和党参议员、堪萨斯州人鲍勃·多尔得票率为34.69%，两人相差18.14个百分点。改革党候选人、得克萨斯州亿万富翁罗斯·佩罗以10.02%的普选票排名第三。克林顿大胜，反映出20世纪90年代东北部地区对民主党的支持明显上升。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1996 was the 53rd quadrennial presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 5, 1996. The contest was between the Democratic national ticket of President Bill Clinton from Arkansas and Vice President Al Gore from Tennessee and the Republican national ticket of former Senator Bob Dole of Kansas for President and former Housing Secretary Jack Kemp from New York for Vice President. Businessman Ross Perot ran as candidate for the Reform Party with economist Pat Choate as his running mate; he received less media attention and was excluded from the presidential debates and, while still obtaining substantial results for a third-party candidate, by U.S. standards, did not renew his success of the 1992 election.

zh.s: 1996年美国总统选举是美国第53次四年一度的总统选举，于11月5日（星期二）举行。两大党候选人分别是民主党籍总统比尔·克林顿和副总统阿尔·戈尔，以及共和党前参议员鲍勃·多尔和前住房部长杰克·坎普。商人罗斯·佩罗代表改革党参选，竞选搭档是经济学家帕特·乔特。佩罗得到的媒体关注较少，也未能参加总统辩论。尽管他以第三党候选人的标准取得了可观成绩，但未能重现1992年的成功。

en.t: North Carolina Council of State election, 1996
en.s: The North Carolina Council of State election of 1996 was held on 5 November 1996, to elect the Council of State. On the same day, North Carolina held elections for Governor and for Lieutenant Governor, who also formally sit in the Council of State. All the races were won by Democrats, as were the posts of Governor and Lieutenant Governor. All were incumbents except for Elaine Marshall, who won the post of Secretary of State, and Michael E. Ward, who was elected Superintendent of Public Instruction. Both Marshall and Ward succeeded fellow Democrats.

zh.t: 1996年北卡罗来纳州州务委员会选举
zh.s: 1996年北卡罗来纳州州务委员会选举于11月5日举行，选出州务委员会成员。同日，该州还举行州长和副州长选举，两人也依法属于州务委员会成员。各职位均由民主党赢得，州长和副州长职位也由民主党赢得。除州务卿职位外，其他职位的现任者都成功连任。伊莱恩·马歇尔当选州务卿，迈克尔·E·沃德当选公共教育总监，两人都接替了民主党人。

en.s: The 1996 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Governor of Montana Marc Racicot, who was first elected in 1992, ran for re-election. After winning the Republican primary against a conservative activist, he moved on to the general election, where he was set to face Chet Blaylock, a former State Senator and the Democratic nominee. However, on October 23, 1996, Blaylock died of a heart attack, and the Montana Democratic Party selected his running mate, State Senator Judy Jacobson, to replace him as the gubernatorial nominee, and she therefore appeared on the ballot as both the gubernatorial nominee and the lieutenant gubernatorial nominee.

zh.s: 1996年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月5日举行。1992年首次当选的现任州长马克·拉西科特竞选连任。他在共和党初选中击败一名保守派活动人士，进入大选后原定对阵前州参议员、民主党候选人切特·布莱洛克。然而，布莱洛克于1996年10月23日因心脏病去世。蒙大拿州民主党选择由他的竞选搭档、州参议员朱迪·雅各布森接替他参选州长，因此她同时以州长候选人和副州长候选人的身份列在选票上。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 5, 1996, as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. A solidly blue state, Massachusetts was won by incumbent Democratic President Bill Clinton in a landslide. Clinton took 61.47% of the popular vote over Republican challenger Bob Dole, who took 28.09%, a victory margin of 33.39%. Reform Party candidate Ross Perot finished in third with 8.89% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1996年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1996年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州是坚定支持民主党的州，民主党籍现任总统比尔·克林顿以压倒性优势获胜。克林顿得票率为61.47%，共和党挑战者鲍勃·多尔为28.09%，两人相差33.39个百分点。改革党候选人罗斯·佩罗以8.89%的普选票排名第三。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 5, 1996. Incumbent United States Senator Max Baucus, who was first elected in 1978 and was re-elected in 1984 and 1990, ran for re-election. He was unopposed in the Democratic primary, and moved on to the general election, where he faced a stiff challenge in Denny Rehberg, the Lieutenant Governor of Montana and the Republican nominee. Despite Bob Dole's victory over Bill Clinton and Ross Perot in the state that year in the presidential election, Baucus managed to narrowly win re-election over Rehberg to secure a fourth term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1996年蒙大拿州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。现任参议员马克斯·鲍卡斯于1978年首次当选，并在1984年和1990年连任，这次再次竞选。他在民主党初选中没有对手。进入大选后，他面临共和党候选人、蒙大拿州副州长丹尼·雷伯格的强劲挑战。尽管鲍勃·多尔在该州总统选举中击败比尔·克林顿和罗斯·佩罗，鲍卡斯仍以微弱优势击败雷伯格，赢得第四个参议员任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Michigan, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 5, 1996. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Michigan voters chose 18 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. Michigan was won by incumbent United States President Bill Clinton of Arkansas, who was running against Kansas Senator Bob Dole. Clinton ran a second time with former Tennessee Senator and Al Gore as Vice President, and Dole ran with former New York Congressman Jack Kemp. Michigan weighed in for this election as 2% more Democratic than the national average.

zh.s: 1996年密歇根州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。当时美国全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。密歇根州选民选出18名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密歇根州支持现任总统比尔·克林顿，他对手是堪萨斯州参议员鲍勃·多尔。克林顿再次与前田纳西州参议员阿尔·戈尔搭档参选副总统，多尔则与前纽约州联邦众议员杰克·坎普搭档。密歇根州的民主党倾向比全国平均水平高2个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 5, 1996, as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Voters chose 33 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New York, a reliable blue state that no Republican has won since 1984, was won by incumbent Democratic President Bill Clinton of Arkansas and Vice President Al Gore of Tennessee, over the Republican ticket of Senator Bob Dole of Kansas and Representative Jack Kemp of New York.

zh.s: 1996年纽约州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出33名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。纽约州一向支持民主党，自1984年以来共和党候选人未曾赢得该州。这次民主党籍现任总统比尔·克林顿和副总统阿尔·戈尔击败了共和党候选人、参议员鲍勃·多尔及其竞选搭档、联邦众议员杰克·坎普，赢得纽约州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Ohio, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Ohio took place on November 5, 1996. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Ohio voters chose 21 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. Ohio was won by incumbent United States President Bill Clinton of Arkansas, who was running against Kansas Senator Bob Dole. Clinton ran a second time with former Tennessee Senator and Al Gore as Vice President, and Dole ran with former New York Congressman Jack Kemp. Ohio weighed in for this election as 2% more third-party than the national average.

zh.s: 1996年俄亥俄州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。当时美国全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。俄亥俄州选民选出21名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。俄亥俄州支持现任总统比尔·克林顿，他对手是堪萨斯州参议员鲍勃·多尔。克林顿再次与前田纳西州参议员阿尔·戈尔搭档竞选副总统，多尔则与前纽约州联邦众议员杰克·坎普搭档。俄亥俄州的第三党倾向比全国平均水平高2个百分点。
