en.t: United States Senate election in Louisiana, 1996
en.s: The 1996 Louisiana United States Senate election was held on November 5, 1996 to select a new U.S. Senator from the state of Louisiana to replace retiring John Bennett Johnston, Jr. of Shreveport. After the jungle primary election, state treasurer Mary Landrieu went into a runoff election with State Representative Woody Jenkins of Baton Rouge, a former Democrat who had turned Republican two years earlier. She prevailed by 5,788 votes out of 1.7 million cast, the narrowest national result of the thirty-three races for the U.S. Senate that year and one of the closest election margins in Louisiana history.

zh.t: 1996年路易斯安那州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年路易斯安那州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行，选出接替退休参议员约翰·贝内特·约翰斯顿的新人。丛林初选后，州财政部长玛丽·兰德里厄与州众议员伍迪·詹金斯进入决选；詹金斯此前是民主党人，1994年改投共和党。兰德里厄以1,700,000张选票中的5,788票之差获胜。这是当年33场联邦参议院选举中差距最小的一场，也是路易斯安那州历史上最接近的选举之一。

en.t: United States presidential election in Nebraska, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 5, 1996. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Nebraska voters chose 5 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. Nebraska was won by Kansas Senator Bob Dole, who was running against incumbent United States President Bill Clinton of Arkansas. Clinton ran a second time with former Tennessee Senator and Al Gore as Vice President, and Dole ran with former New York Congressman Jack Kemp. Nebraska weighed in for this election as 3% more third-party than the national average.

zh.t: 1996年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1996年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举于11月5日举行。当时美国全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了总统选举。内布拉斯加州选民选出5名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、堪萨斯州参议员鲍勃·多尔击败民主党籍现任总统比尔·克林顿，赢得内布拉斯加州。克林顿与前田纳西州参议员阿尔·戈尔搭档竞选副总统，多尔则与前纽约州联邦众议员杰克·坎普搭档。内布拉斯加州的第三党倾向比全国平均水平高3个百分点。

en.t: United States Senate election in Maine, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Maine was held November 5, 1996. Incumbent Republican United States Senator William Cohen decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth term. To replace him, United States Congressman and former Governor of Maine Joseph E. Brennan won the Democratic primary while political consultant and 1994 nominee for Governor of Maine Susan Collins won the Republican primary. A competitive general election ensued, but Collins ultimately won out over Brennan, keeping the seat in the Republican column.

zh.t: 1996年缅因州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年缅因州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员威廉·科恩决定退休，没有竞选第四个任期。接替他的民主党候选人是联邦众议员、缅因州前州长约瑟夫·E·布伦南，共和党候选人是政治顾问、1994年州长选举的提名人苏珊·柯林斯。大选竞争激烈，但柯林斯最终获胜，共和党保住了这个席位。

en.t: United States presidential election in the District of Columbia, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 5, 1996, as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. en.t: United States Senate election in Oregon, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Oregon was held on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Mark Hatfield decided to retire after thirty years in the Senate. Oregon State Senate President Gordon H. Smith, who had run for the Senate earlier that year, won the Republican primary, while businessman Tom Bruggere won a contested Democratic primary. The contest between Smith and Bruggere was one of the toughest that year, but ultimately, Smith was able to keep the seat in the Republican column and defeated Bruggere by a narrow margin.

en.t: United States presidential election in Arkansas, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 5, 1996, as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Voters chose 6 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arkansas was won by President Bill Clinton (D-AR) by a 17 percentage point margin of victory. The presidential election in the Natural State was a critical victory for the Democratic ticket, because Arkansas is Clinton's home state. Dole did not put up a challenge in Arkansas, and neither did billionaire businessman Ross Perot (Ref-TX), who had unsuccessfully run for president as an Independent in the previous election.

en.t: United States presidential election in Arizona, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 5, 1996 as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Arizona was won by President Bill Clinton (D) over Senator Bob Dole (R-KS), with Clinton winning 46.52% to 44.29% by a margin of 2.23%. This marks the only time after the 1948 election when a Democratic nominee carried this usually Republican state. Clinton had come fairly close to winning Arizona in the 1992 election.

en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Kansas was held November 5, 1996. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Nancy Kassebaum decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth term. Republican Pat Roberts won the open seat. zh.t: 1996年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1996年美国联邦参议员选举于11月5日在堪萨斯州举行。共和党籍时任参议员南希·卡斯鲍姆决定退休，不再竞选第四个任期。共和党人帕特·罗伯茨赢得这个空缺席位。竞选期间，任期限制问题受到关注。罗伯茨表示自己并非完全反对任期限制，但不赞成只限制部分议员的方案，认为限制应适用于所有人。汤普森签署了“有限任期美国人”组织发起的全国任期限制承诺书，罗伯茨则拒绝签署。原文末尾句子在“U.S.”处中断，未译入残缺部分。

en.t: United States Senate election in Iowa, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Tom Harkin sought re-election to a third term in the United States Senate, and he was challenged by United States Congressman Jim Ross Lightfoot from Iowa's 3rd congressional district. Lightfoot had won the Republican primary against two opponents, while Harkin had won his primary uncontested, so both moved on to the general election, where they engaged in a toughly-fought campaign. Ultimately, Harkin was successful in his bid, and defeated Lightfoot, albeit by the thinnest margin of his career.

en.t: United States presidential election in Maine, 1996

en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on 5 November 1996 as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. en.t: United States Senate election in Alaska, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Ted Stevens ran for re-election to a fifth term in the United States Senate. Stevens faced off against Democratic nominee Theresa Obermeyer, a former member of the Anchorage School Board, and Green Party nominee Jed Whittaker, a commercial fisherman. The race drew national attention for Obermeyer's erratic behavior: she blamed Stevens for her husband's failure to pass the bar exam and contended that he had passed the bar by fraud. She "trailed" him to campaign events, frequently wearing a prisoner's outfit and once dragging a ball and chain behind her.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina, 1996
en.s: The United States House of Representative elections of 1996 in North Carolina were held on 5 November 1996 as part of the biennial election to the United States House of Representatives. All twelve seats in North Carolina, and 435 nationwide, were elected. The Democrats made strong gains, recouping much of the losses sustained in the Republican Revolution of 1994, in which the Republicans had gained four districts. In 1996, parties won six representatives from the state. Two Republican incumbents first elected in 1994 – Fred Heineman in the 4th district and David Funderburk in the 2nd – failed to hold their seats.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 1996
en.s: The U.S. House election, 1996 was an election for the U.S. House of Representatives on November 5, 1996, which coincided with the re-election of Bill Clinton as President of the United States. Clinton's Democratic Party won by almost 60,000 votes (0.07%) and gained a net of two seats from the Republican Party, but the Republicans retained an overall majority of seats in the House for the first time since 1928. The election is similar to the 1952 House election, although this result remains one of the closest in U.S. history.

en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 5, 1996 as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Voters chose 8 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Kentucky was won by President Bill Clinton (D) over Senator Bob Dole (R-KS), with Clinton winning 45.84% to 44.88% by a margin of 0.96%. Billionaire businessman Ross Perot (Reform Party of the United States of America-TX) finished in third with 8.67% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1996年肯塔基州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。总统比尔·克林顿以45.84%的选票险胜参议员、共和党人鲍勃·多尔（44.88%），两人相差0.96个百分点。改革党候选人、亿万富翁商人罗斯·佩罗以8.67%的普选票排名第三。

en.t: United States presidential election in Oregon, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 5, 1996, as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Oregon was won by President Bill Clinton (D) over Senator Bob Dole (R-Kansas), with Clinton winning 47.2% to 39.1% by a margin of 8.1%. Billionaire businessman Ross Perot (Reform-Texas) finished in third with 8.8% of the popular vote. Oregon was one of thirteen states where on the election ballot, James Campbell of California, Perot's former boss at IBM, was listed as a stand-in Vice-Presidential candidate.

zh.s: 1996年俄勒冈州美国总统选举于11月5日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。总统比尔·克林顿击败堪萨斯州参议员鲍勃·多尔，赢得俄勒冈州。克林顿得票率为47.2%，多尔为39.1%，两人相差8.1个百分点。改革党候选人、得克萨斯州商人罗斯·佩罗以8.8%的普选票排名第三。俄勒冈州是13个在选票上将詹姆斯·坎贝尔列为佩罗竞选搭档、替补副总统候选人的州之一；坎贝尔曾是佩罗在IBM的上司。

en.t: United States presidential election in North Dakota, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 5, 1996. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1996 United States presidential election. North Dakota voters chose 3 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. North Dakota was won by Kansas Senator Bob Dole, who was running against incumbent United States President Bill Clinton of Arkansas. Clinton ran a second time with former Tennessee Senator and Al Gore as Vice President, and Dole ran with former New York Congressman Jack Kemp.

Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator and Senate Majority Leader Bob Dole, the Republican nominee for president, had resigned on June 11, 1996, in order to focus on his presidential campaign.

zh.t: 1996年堪萨斯州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行堪萨斯州美国参议院特别选举，与总统选举和该州第二类参议员席位的例行选举同时进行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员兼参议院多数党领袖鲍勃·多尔是共和党总统候选人，他于1996年6月11日辞去参议员职务，以专心竞选总统。

en.t: 1996 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Republican Senator Larry Pressler lost his bid for a fourth term to Democratic nominee Tim Johnson by 8,579 votes and a 2.64% margin. Pressler was the only incumbent U.S. Senator to lose a general election in the 1996 election cycle, of which this was the only Democratic flip.

zh.t: 1996年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行南达科他州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员拉里·普雷斯勒竞选第四个任期，但以8,579票之差、2.64个百分点的差距败给民主党候选人蒂姆·约翰逊。在1996年选举周期中，普雷斯勒是唯一在大选中落败的现任联邦参议员；这也是该周期唯一一次参议院席位由民主党夺回。

en.t: 1996 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in New Hampshire was held on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Smith won re-election to a second term. Smith had established himself as the most conservative senator from the Northeast, and Bill Clinton's coattails nearly caused his defeat. That was to the point that on the night of the election many American media networks incorrectly projected that Dick Swett had won.

zh.t: 1996年新罕布什尔州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行新罕布什尔州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任联邦参议员鲍勃·史密斯成功连任第二个任期。他已成为东北部立场最保守的参议员。比尔·克林顿带来的助选效应差点让他落败，以至于选举当晚，多家美国媒体误报迪克·斯韦特获胜。

en.t: 1996 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Democratic Senator Jay Rockefeller was re-elected by over three quarters of the vote to a third consecutive term. This was the best election performance of Rockefeller's career.

zh.t: 1996年西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员杰伊·洛克菲勒以超过四分之三的选票再次当选，开始连续第三个任期。这是洛克菲勒竞选生涯中成绩最好的一次。

en.t: 1996 United States House of Representatives election in Montana
en.s: The 1996 United States House of Representatives election in Montana was held on November 5, 1996 to determine who would represent the state of Montana in the United States House of Representatives. Montana had one, at-large district in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census, due to its low population. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1996年蒙大拿州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行蒙大拿州美国众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。由于人口较少，根据1990年美国人口普查，蒙大拿州在众议院只有一个全州选区。众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The 1996 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 1996, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent acting secretary of state Bekki Cook defeated Republican nominee John R. Hancock, Libertarian nominee LaDonna Higgins and Natural Law nominee Kerry Margolis.

zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行密苏里州州务卿选举。民主党候选人、现任代理州务卿贝基·库克击败共和党候选人约翰·R·汉考克、自由党候选人拉多娜·希金斯和自然法党候选人克里·马戈利斯。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on November 5, 1996. Primaries were held March 19, 1996.

zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行伊利诺伊州选举。党内初选于1996年3月19日举行。

en.s: The 1996 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 5, 1996, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state treasurer Bob Holden defeated Republican nominee Carl Bearden, Libertarian nominee Jacques E. Tucker, U.S. Taxpayers nominee David Young and Natural Law nominee Nicolas A. Ganim.

zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行密苏里州财政部长选举。民主党候选人、现任财政部长鲍勃·霍尔登击败共和党候选人卡尔·比尔登、自由党候选人雅克·E·塔克、美国纳税人党候选人大卫·杨和自然法党候选人尼古拉斯·A·加尼姆。

en.s: The 1996 Pennsylvania Auditor General election was held on November 5, 1996, in order to elect the Auditor General of Pennsylvania. Bob Casey Jr., Democratic nominee and son of former Pennsylvania Governor Bob Casey Sr., defeated Republican nominee Robert Nyce, Libertarian nominee Sharon Shepps, and Constitution nominee Robert Lord.

zh.t: 1996年宾夕法尼亚州审计长选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州审计长选举。民主党候选人小鲍勃·凯西是宾夕法尼亚州前州长老鲍勃·凯西的儿子，他击败共和党候选人罗伯特·尼斯、自由党候选人莎伦·谢普斯和宪法党候选人罗伯特·洛德。

en.t: 1996 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 5, 1996. It was held as part of the 1996 Puerto Rican general election. It saw the election of Sila María Calderón, a member of the Popular Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1996年波多黎各圣胡安市长选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日，波多黎各圣胡安市举行市长选举。这是1996年波多黎各大选的一部分。人民民主党成员西拉·玛丽亚·卡尔德龙当选市长。

en.s: The 1996 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1996, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Jay Nixon defeated Republican nominee Mark J. Bredemeier and U.S. Taxpayers nominee Kimberly Lowe.

zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行密苏里州州检察长选举。民主党候选人、现任州检察长杰伊·尼克松击败共和党候选人马克·J·布雷德迈尔和美国纳税人党候选人金伯利·洛。

en.s: The 1996 Arizona Senate election was held on November 5, 1996. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 10, 1996. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 19 seats over the Democrats' 11 seats.

zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，选民从该州全部30个选区选出州参议员，任期两年。党内初选于1996年9月10日举行。选举前，共和党占19席，民主党占11席。

en.s: The 1996 Pennsylvania Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1996, in order to elect the Attorney General of Pennsylvania. Republican nominee and member of the Pennsylvania Senate from the 37th district Mike Fisher defeated Democratic nominee Joe Kohn and Libertarian nominee Timothy William Collins.

zh.t: 1996年宾夕法尼亚州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州州检察长选举。共和党候选人迈克·费舍尔曾任宾夕法尼亚州参议院第37选区议员，他击败民主党候选人乔·科恩和自由党候选人蒂莫西·威廉·柯林斯。

en.s: The 1996 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1996, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Ruth Ann Minner defeated Republican nominee Sherman N. Miller and Libertarian nominee Danny Ray Beaver.

zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行特拉华州副州长选举。民主党候选人、现任副州长露丝·安·米纳击败共和党候选人谢尔曼·N·米勒和自由党候选人丹尼·雷·比弗。

en.s: The 1996 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 5, 1996, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 10, 1996. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. House, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 1996年11月5日（星期二）举行亚利桑那州众议院选举，党内初选于1996年9月10日（星期二）举行。亚利桑那州选民从多议员选区选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举及亚利桑那州选举同时举行，包括美国总统、美国众议院和亚利桑那州参议院选举。

en.s: The 1996 West Virginia Attorney General election took place on November 5, 1996, to elect the Attorney General of West Virginia. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Darrell McGraw won re-election to a second term, beating Republican nominee Charlotte Lane.

zh.t: 1996年西弗吉尼亚州州检察长选举
zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行西弗吉尼亚州州检察长选举。民主党籍现任州检察长达雷尔·麦格劳击败共和党候选人夏洛特·莱恩，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1996 Utah Attorney General election was held on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Jan Graham was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Iron County Attorney Scott Burns in a rematch of the 1992 race. As of 2026, this is the last time a Democrat won a statewide election in Utah.

zh.s: 1996年11月5日举行犹他州州检察长选举。民主党籍现任州检察长简·格雷厄姆击败铁县检察官斯科特·伯恩斯，成功连任第二个任期。这是两人继1992年后再次交手。截至2026年，这是民主党人最后一次赢得犹他州全州选举。

en.s: The 1996 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 1996. Though eligible for a second term, incumbent governor Mike Lowry chose not to run for reelection following a series of personal and public scandals, including allegations of sexual harassment. This gubernatorial race was especially significant in that it resulted in the first Asian American governor in the mainland United States (after George Ariyoshi of island state Hawaii), Democrat Gary Locke.

zh.s: 1996年华盛顿州州长选举于1996年11月5日举行。现任州长迈克·洛瑞虽然有资格竞选第二个任期，但在一系列个人和公开丑闻后决定不再竞选连任，其中包括性骚扰指控。这场州长选举意义重大：民主党人加里·洛克当选，成为美国本土首位亚裔州长；此前，夏威夷州的乔治·有吉已成为首位亚裔州长。

en.s: The 1996 Washington Secretary of State election took place on November 5, 1996. Incumbent secretary of state Ralph Munro was re-elected.

zh.s: 1996年华盛顿州州务卿选举于1996年11月5日举行。现任州务卿拉尔夫·芒罗成功连任。

en.t: 1996 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 1996 House elections in Georgia occurred on November 5, 1996, to elect the members of the State of Georgia's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Georgia had eleven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 1996 (including one election in Georgia), the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1996年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1996年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举于1996年11月5日举行，选出佐治亚州在美国联邦众议院的代表。根据1990年美国人口普查，佐治亚州分得11个联邦众议院席位。选举与1996年联邦参议院选举（包括佐治亚州的一场选举）、其他州的联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 5, 1996. Primaries were held March 19, 1996. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县普选于1996年11月5日举行。初选于1996年3月19日举行。本次选举选出巡回法院书记员、契据登记官、州检察官、芝加哥地区水资源管理委员会的3名成员，以及库克县巡回法院法官。

en.s: The 1996 United States Senate elections were held on November 5, 1996, with the 33 seats of Class 2 contested in regular elections. Special elections were also held to fill vacancies. They coincided with the presidential election of the same year, in which Democrat Bill Clinton was re-elected president. Republicans held a 54–46 majority going into 1996, but a January special election in Oregon resulted in Democrats reducing the majority to 53–47.

zh.s: 1996年美国联邦参议院选举于1996年11月5日举行，常规选举改选第二类的33个席位。选举还填补了一些空缺。选举与同年的总统选举同期举行，民主党人比尔·克林顿连任总统。1996年初，共和党在参议院以54席对46席占多数，但俄勒冈州1月举行的一场特别选举使其多数缩小为53席对47席。

en.t: 1996 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 1996 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 5, 1996. Six of the eleven seats were contested. Four incumbents and two open seats and were up for election. All seats were elected at-large. Each voter was allowed to cast at most six votes. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though most candidates in San Francisco do receive funding and support from various political parties.

zh.s: 1996年旧金山监事会选举于1996年11月5日举行，监事会11个席位中有6个席位进行竞选，其中4名现任者和2个空缺席位。所有席位都由全市选民选出，每名选民最多可投6票。加利福尼亚州的市政选举名义上不分党派，但旧金山大多数候选人都能获得各政党的资金和支持。

en.t: 1996 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 5, 1996, as part of the 1996 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia was won by Senator Bob Dole (R-KS) by a narrow 1.2% margin. Georgia was the third-closest contest that year, with only Kentucky and Nevada being closer, as well as Dole's closest race.

zh.s: 1996年佐治亚州美国总统选举于1996年11月5日举行，是1996年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名代表或选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、堪萨斯州联邦参议员鲍勃·多尔以1.2个百分点的微弱优势赢得佐治亚州。这是当年第三接近的州，仅次于肯塔基州和内华达州；佐治亚州也是多尔胜选优势最小的州。

en.t: 1996 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Sam Nunn decided to retire instead of seeking a fifth term. Democratic Secretary of State Max Cleland won the open seat over Republican businessman Guy Millner. Primary elections were held on July 9. Cleland won the Democratic primary unopposed.

zh.t: 1996年佐治亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年佐治亚州联邦参议院选举于1996年11月5日举行。民主党现任参议员萨姆·纳恩决定退休，不再竞选第五个任期。民主党州务卿马克斯·克利兰击败共和党商人盖伊·米尔纳，赢得空缺席位。初选于7月9日举行。克利兰在民主党初选中没有对手。

en.s: The 1996 Pierce County Executive election took place on November 5, 1996. Incumbent Republican County Executive Doug Sutherland ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by County Councilman Wendell Brown, a Democrat and his opponent from 1992. On election night, Brown held a narrow lead over Sutherland, but when absentee votes were tallied later in the week, Sutherland took the lead.

zh.s: 1996年皮尔斯县行政长官选举于1996年11月5日举行。共和党现任行政长官道格·萨瑟兰竞选连任第二届。他的对手是民主党人、县议员温德尔·布朗；布朗也曾在1992年与他竞争。投票当晚，布朗暂时领先，但本周稍后统计缺席选票后，萨瑟兰反超。

en.s: The 1996 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 75th Texas Legislature. State representatives serve for two-year terms. Republicans gained five seats from the Democrats, reducing the Democratic majority to 82 out of 150 seats.

zh.s: 1996年得克萨斯州众议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。得州选民在全部150个州众议院选区选出议员，当选者进入第75届得克萨斯州议会。州众议员任期为两年。共和党从民主党手中赢得五席，使民主党在150席中仍占82席多数。

en.t: 1996 North Carolina Secretary of State election
en.s: The 1996 North Carolina Secretary of State election was held on November 5, concurrently with that year's U.S. presidential election, as well as elections for Governor, U.S. Senator, and Council of State. Attorney and former Democratic State Senator Elaine Marshall ran for the open Secretary of State position against stock car racer and former Randolph County commissioner known as "The King", Richard Petty.

zh.t: 1996年北卡罗来纳州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1996年北卡罗来纳州州务卿选举于11月5日举行，与当年的美国总统选举、州长选举、联邦参议员选举及州行政委员会选举同时进行。律师、前民主党籍州参议员伊莱恩·马歇尔竞选这一空缺职位，对手是赛车手、兰道夫县前委员理查德·佩蒂，人称“车王”。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1996 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1996 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 even-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1996 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1996年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院一半选区选出参议员，即25个偶数编号选区。州参议员任期为四年，每轮选举改选一半席位。爱荷华州议会提供了1996年这50个州参议院选区的全州地图。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1996 elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate were held on November 5, with 25 of 50 districts being contested. Primary elections were held on April 23, 1996. The term of office for those elected in 1996 began when the Senate convened in January 1997. Pennsylvania State Senators are elected for four-year terms, with half of the seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 1996年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 1996年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举于11月5日举行，50个选区中的25个席位参与改选。初选于1996年4月23日举行。1996年当选者于州参议院1997年1月开会时开始任职。宾夕法尼亚州参议员任期为四年，每两年改选一半席位。

en.t: 1996 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 1996 United States presidential straw poll in Guam was held on November 5, 1996, Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, instead, the territory conducts a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election. It does not cast direct electoral votes for president and vice president.

zh.s: 关岛于1996年11月5日举行美国总统意向投票。关岛是美国领土而非州，因此无权选出总统选举人，但会在大选期间举行不具约束力的总统意向投票，不直接投票选举总统和副总统。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: General elections were held in Palau in 1996 to elect a president, vice president, Senate and House of Delegates. The first round of the presidential election took place on 24 September, whilst the run-off election and the election for the House of Delegates and Senate took place on 5 November. All candidates ran as independents, with 36 candidates contesting the 14 Senate seats and 35 for the 16 House of Delegates seats.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 帕劳于1996年举行大选，选举总统、副总统、参议院和众议院议员。总统选举首轮于9月24日举行，决选以及众议院和参议院选举则于11月5日举行。所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选：36名候选人角逐14个参议院席位，35人角逐16个众议院席位。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮日期。

en.t: 1998 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1998 congressional elections in New Hampshire were held on November 5, 1998, to determine who will represent the state of New Hampshire in the United States House of Representatives. It coincided with the state's gubernatorial elections. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 106th Congress from January 1999 until January 2001. New Hampshire has two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census.

zh.t: 1998年新罕布什尔州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月5日举行新罕布什尔州美国众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。选举与该州州长选举同时举行。众议员任期两年；当选议员于1999年1月至2001年1月在第106届国会任职。根据1990年美国人口普查，新罕布什尔州在众议院有两个席位。

en.s: The Raleigh mayoral election of 1999 was held on November 5, 1999, to elect a Mayor of Raleigh, North Carolina. The election was non-partisan. It was won by Paul Coble, who replaced Tom Fetzer after beating Stepanie Fanjul.

zh.s: 1999年罗利市长选举于1999年11月5日举行，选举名义上不分党派。保罗·科布尔击败斯蒂芬妮·范朱尔，当选市长，接替汤姆·费策。

en.s: PetroChina Company Limited (Chinese: 中国石油天然气股份有限公司) is a Chinese oil and gas company and is the listed arm of state-owned China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), headquartered in Dongcheng District, Beijing. The company is currently Asia's largest oil and gas producer. Traded in Hong Kong and New York, the mainland enterprise announced its plans to issue stock in Shanghai in November 2007, and subsequently entered the constituent of SSE 50 Index.

zh.t: 中国石油天然气股份有限公司成立
zh.s: 中国石油天然气股份有限公司（PetroChina Company Limited）是一家中国油气企业，也是国有中国石油天然气集团有限公司（CNPC）的上市子公司，总部位于北京市东城区。该公司目前是亚洲最大的油气生产商。公司在香港和纽约上市；中国内地企业于2007年11月宣布计划在上海发行股票，随后成为上证50指数成份股。

en.s: November to Remember (2000) was the eighth and final November to Remember professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). It took place on November 5, 2000, from the Odeum Expo Center in Villa Park, Illinois, US. This was the fourth November to Remember pay-per-view and the ante-penultimate ECW pay-per-view. The commentators for the event were Joey Styles, Joel Gertner and Cyrus.

zh.s: 《难忘的十一月》（2000）是极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的第八届、也是最后一届“难忘的十一月”职业摔角付费赛事。赛事于2000年11月5日在美国伊利诺伊州维拉帕克的奥迪姆展览中心举行。这是该系列第四届付费赛事，也是ECW倒数第三场付费赛事。解说员为乔伊·斯泰尔斯、乔尔·格特纳和赛勒斯。

en.s: The 2001 Durham mayoral election was held on November 5, 2001, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the election of Bill Bell, who unseated incumbent mayor Nick Tennyson.

zh.s: 2001年达勒姆市长选举于2001年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市市长。比尔·贝尔击败现任市长尼克·坦尼森，当选市长。

en.s: The 2001 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 6. The election took place alongside Jim McGreevey's landslide election as Governor of New Jersey and were held in the immediate aftermath of the September 11 attacks, which killed 750 New Jerseyans and impacted many others. Under a newly redrawn map, Democrats gained five seats to split control of the Senate evenly.

zh.s: 2001年新泽西州参议院选举于11月6日举行，与吉姆·麦格里维以压倒性优势当选州长同期进行。选举发生在9·11袭击后不久，袭击造成750名新泽西州居民死亡，并影响了许多人。按重新划定的选区地图，民主党增加5席，使参议院席位由两党均分。

en.s: California's state elections were held November 5, 2002. Necessary primary elections were held on March 5. Up for election were all the seats of the California State Assembly, 20 seats of the California Senate, seven constitutional officers, all the seats of the California Board of Equalization, as well as votes on retention of two Supreme Court justices and various appeals court judges. Seven ballot measures were also up for approval. Municipal offices were also included in the election. Incumbent governor Gray Davis won reelection with less than 50% of the vote over his Republican challenger Bill Simon.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州州级选举于2002年11月5日举行，必要的初选于3月5日举行。选举涉及加州众议院全部席位、州参议院20席、7个宪法官员职位、加州均等委员会全部席位，以及对两名最高法院法官和多名上诉法院法官的留任表决。另有7项提案供选民表决，市政职位也参与选举。现任州长格雷·戴维斯以不到50%的选票击败共和党挑战者比尔·西蒙，成功连任。

en.t: United States Senate election in Louisiana, 2002
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Mary Landrieu won re-election to a second term. During the run-off, Landrieu was out-spent three-to-one by Republican contender Suzanne Haik Terrell, the Louisiana Elections Commissioner. Terrell also had prominent Republicans including President George W. Bush and Vice President Dick Cheney visit Louisiana to campaign on her behalf. Republicans, confident of victory having gained seats in the elections to the House of Representatives and to the Senate, solidifying control of the former and taking control of the latter, publicly called the election "Operation Icing on the Cake".

zh.t: 2002年路易斯安那州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年路易斯安那州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员玛丽·兰德里厄成功连任第二个任期。决选期间，她的竞选开支只有共和党对手苏珊·海克·特雷尔的三分之一。特雷尔是路易斯安那州选举专员，还获得了多位知名共和党人的支持，包括来州助选的总统乔治·W·布什和副总统迪克·切尼。共和党在联邦众议院选举中增加席位，并重新控制参议院后，对胜选信心十足，公开将此次选举称为“锦上添花行动”。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota, 2002
en.s: The 2002 U.S. House of Representatives election for the state of North Dakota's At-large congressional district was held November 5, 2002. The incumbent, Democratic-NPL Congressman Earl Pomeroy was re-elected to his sixth term, defeating Republican candidate Rick Clayburgh. Only Pomeroy filed as a Dem-NPLer, and the endorsed Republican candidate was Rick Clayburgh, who was serving as the North Dakota State Tax Commissioner. Pomeroy and Clayburgh won the primary elections for their respective parties. The election was the closest for Pomeroy in all of his career as congressman; he won by just over 11,000 votes.

zh.t: 2002年北达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年北达科他州单一联邦众议院选区的选举于11月5日举行。民主党—无党派联盟籍现任众议员厄尔·波默罗伊击败共和党候选人里克·克莱伯格，连任第六个任期。只有波默罗伊以民主党—无党派联盟成员身份登记参选；共和党认可的候选人是北达科他州税务专员克莱伯格。两人分别赢得本党初选。这是波默罗伊担任众议员以来最接近的一次选举，他以略多于11,000票的优势获胜。

en.s: An Alabama gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002. The race pitted incumbent Governor Don Siegelman, a Democrat, against Representative Bob Riley, a Republican, and Libertarian nominee John Sophocleus. The result was an extremely narrow victory for Riley. The certified results showed Riley with 672,225 votes to Siegelman's 669,105 (a difference of 3,120 votes, or 0.23% of the 1,367,053 votes cast). Sophocleus garnered 23,272 votes, and 2,451 votes were for write-in candidates. Bob Riley defeated incumbent Governor Don Siegelman in a close and controversial election marked by high turnout. Riley was reelected in 2006.

zh.s: 2002年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长唐·西格尔曼与共和党众议员鲍勃·赖利、自由党候选人约翰·索福克勒斯竞争。赖利以极微弱优势获胜。认证结果显示，赖利获得672,225票，西格尔曼获得669,105票，差距为3,120票，占总计1,367,053张选票的0.23%。索福克勒斯获得23,272票，另有2,451票投给了自填候选人。赖利在投票率很高、结果引发争议的选举中击败现任州长西格尔曼，并于2006年成功连任。

en.s: The 2002 California gubernatorial election was an election that occurred on November 5, 2002. Democrat Gray Davis defeated Republican Bill Simon by 5% and was re-elected to a second four-year term as Governor of California. Davis would be recalled less than a year into his next term. The 2002 gubernatorial primary occurred in March 2002. Gray Davis faced no major competitor in the primary and won the nomination. Simon defeated former Los Angeles Mayor Richard Riordan in the Republican primary. Gray Davis ran a series of negative ads against Riordan in the primary.

zh.s: 2002年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党人格雷·戴维斯以5个百分点的优势击败共和党人比尔·西蒙，连任第二个四年任期。戴维斯在新任期开始不到一年后就被罢免。州长初选于2002年3月举行，戴维斯没有遇到有力对手并获得提名。西蒙则在共和党初选中击败洛杉矶前市长理查德·里奥丹。戴维斯在初选期间多次投放负面广告攻击里奥丹。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 2002
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 2002 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 5, 2002. California gained 1 seat because of Congressional apportionment following the Census, which Republicans won. Democrats gained the open 39th district. In the 18th district, Democrat Gary Condit, under fire from the Chandra Levy scandal, lost in the primary to his former chief of staff, Dennis Cardoza.

zh.t: 2002年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，是当年联邦众议院大选的一部分。根据人口普查后的国会席位分配，加州增加1个席位，该席由共和党赢得。民主党赢得了第39选区的空缺席位。在第18选区，民主党人加里·康迪特因钱德拉·利维案件承受舆论压力，在初选中败给了自己的前幕僚长丹尼斯·卡多萨。

en.s: The 2002 Hawaii gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002 to select the Governor of Hawaii. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Hawaii Ben Cayetano was term-limited and therefore could not run for re-election. Former Maui Mayor Linda Lingle, who had narrowly lost the 1998 election, was nominated once again by the Republicans while Lieutenant Governor Mazie Hirono earned the Democratic nomination in a tightly fought race. Lingle and Hirono duked it out in a toughly-fought campaign, with Hirono's campaign crippled by allegations of corruption within the Hawaii Democratic Party and many voters desiring a change.

zh.s: 2002年夏威夷州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长本·卡耶塔诺因任期限制不能竞选连任。毛伊岛前市长、1998年以微弱差距落败的琳达·林格尔再次获得共和党提名；副州长马齐·希罗诺则在竞争激烈的选举中获得民主党提名。林格尔和希罗诺展开激烈竞选，夏威夷州民主党被指腐败的指控重创了希罗诺的竞选，许多选民也希望改变现状。

en.s: The 2002 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Oregon John Kitzhaber was unable to seek a third consecutive term as governor, therefore creating an open seat. To replace him, former Oregon Supreme Court Associate Justice Ted Kulongoski won a crowded and competitive Democratic primary, while former State Representative Kevin Mannix emerged from an equally competitive Republican primary. The campaign between Kulongoski and Mannix, who were joined by Libertarian nominee Tom Cox, was close and went down to the wire.

zh.s: 2002年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·基茨哈伯因不能连续担任第三个任期，州长职位因此开放。为接替他，俄勒冈州最高法院前副法官特德·库隆戈斯基在竞争激烈的民主党初选中获胜；前州众议员凯文·曼尼克也在共和党竞争激烈的初选中胜出。库隆戈斯基和曼尼克与自由党候选人汤姆·考克斯一同参选，竞选十分胶着，结果直到最后阶段才见分晓。

en.s: The Oklahoma gubernatorial election of 2002 was held on November 5, 2002, and was a race for the Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Brad Henry won the election with 43 percent of the vote, beating Republican Steve Largent and conservative independent Gary Richardson. Henry's narrow win has been attributed to Richardson and Largent's split of the conservative vote and the inclusion of a cockfighting ban on the ballot, an issue which brought cockfighting supporters from Southeastern Oklahoma, a region that largely supported Henry, out to vote.

zh.s: 2002年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党人布拉德·亨利以43%的选票击败共和党人史蒂夫·拉金特和保守派独立候选人加里·理查森，当选州长。亨利以微弱优势获胜，原因被认为是理查森和拉金特分散了保守派选票，以及选票上有一项禁止斗鸡的提案。这项提案促使支持斗鸡的选民投票；他们来自东南俄克拉何马州，而该地区大多支持亨利。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 2002
en.s: The Elections for the United States House of Representatives on 5 November 2002 was in the middle of President George W. Bush's first term. Although it was a midterm election, the Republican Party gained a net eight seats, solidifying their majority. Together with gains made in the Senate, it was one of the few mid-term elections that the party in control of the White House increased their numbers in the House (the other such mid-term elections were in 1934 and 1998).

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行的美国联邦众议院选举正值乔治·W·布什第一个总统任期中段。虽然这是一次中期选举，共和党仍净增8席，巩固了其多数地位。连同在参议院的席位增长，这是少数几次执政党在中期选举中增加众议院席位的情况之一；另外两次发生在1934年和1998年。

en.t: United States Senate election in Minnesota, 2002
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Paul Wellstone was running for re-election to a third term, but died in a plane crash eleven days before the election. The Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party (DFL) chose former Vice President and 1984 Presidential candidate Walter Mondale to replace Wellstone on the ballot. Mondale lost to Republican Mayor of Saint Paul Norm Coleman. The day before the election, Independence Governor Jesse Ventura had appointed Dean Barkley (IP) to serve the rest of Wellstone's term.

zh.t: 2002年明尼苏达州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员保罗·韦尔斯通竞选第三个任期，但在选举前11天死于飞机失事。民主党—农民—劳工党（DFL）改提名1984年总统候选人、前副总统沃尔特·蒙代尔。蒙代尔败给共和党人、圣保罗市长诺姆·科尔曼。选举前一天，独立党籍州长杰西·文图拉任命迪安·巴克利接替韦尔斯通，完成其余任期。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Indiana, 2002
en.s: The 2002 congressional elections in Indiana were elections for Indiana's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred along with congressional elections nationwide on November 5, 2002. Republicans held a majority of Indiana's delegation, 6-4, before the elections. The districts were redrawn prior to the 2002 elections, reducing the number of districts by 1. Democrat Tim Roemer of the 2nd district retired, leaving the seat vacant. Republicans picked up the 2nd district seat, gaining a 6-3 advantage following the elections.

zh.t: 2002年印第安纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年印第安纳州联邦众议院选举与全国各地选举同时于11月5日举行。选举前，共和党在印第安纳州联邦众议员中占6席对4席的多数。2002年选举前重新划分选区，选区总数减少1个。民主党人蒂姆·罗默退休，第2选区席位因此空缺。共和党赢得该席，选举后在印第安纳州代表团中以6席对3席领先。

en.s: The Michigan gubernatorial election of 2002 was one of the 36 United States gubernatorial elections held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Republican John Engler, after serving three terms, had stepped down and was not running; his lieutenant governor Dick Posthumus, also a Republican, ran in his place. Jennifer Granholm, then Attorney General of Michigan, ran on the Democratic Party ticket. Douglas Campbell ran on the Green Party ticket, and Joseph M. Pilchak ran on the Constitution Party ticket. John D. Cherry ran on the Democratic party ballot for lieutenant governor.

zh.s: 2002年密歇根州州长选举是11月5日举行的36场美国州长选举之一。共和党籍现任州长约翰·恩格勒已任职三届，决定卸任不再参选；同为共和党人的副州长迪克·波斯特胡默代替他参选。密歇根州总检察长詹妮弗·格兰霍姆代表民主党参选。道格拉斯·坎贝尔代表绿党参选，约瑟夫·M·皮尔查克代表宪法党参选。约翰·D·切里则作为民主党副州长候选人列在选票上。

en.s: The Wyoming gubernatorial election of 2002 was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Republican Governor of Wyoming Jim Geringer was barred from seeking a third term in office, thereby creating an open seat. Former United States Attorney Dave Freudenthal and former Speaker of the Wyoming House of Representatives Eli Bebout both emerged from competitive Democratic and Republican primaries, respectively, and faced off against each other in the general election. Despite Wyoming's strong inclination to elect Republicans, a contentious race ensued, with Freudenthal ultimately edging out Bebout by fewer than 4,000 votes.

zh.s: 2002年怀俄明州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长吉姆·格林杰因任期限制不能竞选第三个任期，州长职位因此开放。前美国联邦检察官戴夫·弗洛伊登塔尔和怀俄明州众议院前议长伊莱·贝布特分别赢得民主党和共和党初选，在大选中对决。尽管怀俄明州通常支持共和党，这场选举仍竞争激烈，弗洛伊登塔尔最终以不到4,000票的优势击败贝布特。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2002 San Diego City Council election occurred on November 5, 2002. The primary election was held on March 5, 2002. Four of the eight seats of the San Diego City Council were contested. Two incumbent council members stood for reelection after having previously been elected to partial terms. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most candidates do identify a party preference. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with a primary in June followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates if no candidate received a majority of the votes in the first round.

zh.s: 2002年圣迭戈市议会选举于11月5日举行。初选于3月5日举行，市议会8个席位中有4席参与改选。两名现任议员此前曾通过特别选举当选，任期只有部分任期，这次竞选连任。加利福尼亚州市政选举在法律上不分党派，但大多数候选人会表明党派倾向。选举分两轮进行：6月初选后，如果无人获得过半数选票，11月由得票前两名候选人参加决选。

en.s: Elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate were held on November 5, 2002, with even-numbered districts being contested. State Senators are elected for four-year terms, with half of the Senate seats up for a vote every two years. The term of office for those elected in 2002 ran from January 3, 2003 until November 28, 2006. Necessary primary elections were held on May 21, 2002. This was the first Pennsylvania State Senate election held after the constitutionally-mandated decennial reapportionment plan. None of the seats of the three senators who did not run for re-election changed party hands. Robert C.

zh.t: 2002年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举于2002年11月5日举行，偶数编号选区进行改选。州参议员任期四年，每两年改选一半席位。2002年当选者的任期从2003年1月3日持续至2006年11月28日。必要的初选于2002年5月21日举行。这是宾夕法尼亚州根据宪法要求完成十年一次选区重划后的首次州参议院选举。三名未竞选连任的参议员所空出的席位，其所属政党均未改变。原文在后续人名处中断。

en.s: The Maine gubernatorial election of 2002 took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Independent Governor Angus King was term limited, and unable to seek re-election. United States Congressman John Baldacci won the Democratic primary uncontested, while former State Representative Peter Cianchette emerged from the Republican primary victorious. Baldacci and Cianchetti squared off in the general election, joined by Jonathan Carter, the Green Party nominee, and independent State Representative John Michael. Ultimately, Baldacci prevailed over Cianchette to win what would be his first of two terms as governor, with Carter taking an unusually high amount of the vote for a third-party candidate.

zh.s: 2002年缅因州州长选举于11月5日举行。任期受限的独立党籍现任州长安格斯·金无法竞选连任。联邦众议员约翰·巴尔达奇在民主党初选中没有对手；前州众议员彼得·恰内特赢得共和党初选。大选中，两人对决，绿党候选人乔纳森·卡特和独立党籍州众议员约翰·迈克尔也参选。巴尔达奇最终击败恰内特，当选州长，开始他的两个州长任期中的第一个；卡特作为第三党候选人获得了异常高的得票。

en.t: United States Senate election in Iowa, 2002
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic United States Senator Tom Harkin sought re-election to a fourth term in the United States Senate. Harkin was opposed in the general election by United States Congressman Greg Ganske, who fought off a surprisingly difficult challenger in the Republican primary. Though Harkin had narrowly defeated his opponent six years earlier, he was able to defeat Ganske by a fairly comfortable margin to win re-election.

zh.t: 2002年艾奥瓦州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任参议员汤姆·哈金竞选第四个参议员任期，对手是联邦众议员格雷格·甘斯克。甘斯克在共和党初选中击败了一名实力出乎意料地强的挑战者。六年前，哈金曾以微弱优势击败对手；这次他以较大优势击败甘斯克，成功连任。

en.t: United States Senate election in Alaska, 2002
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Ted Stevens ran for and won a sixth term in the United States Senate. He faced perennial candidate Frank Vondersaar, the Democratic nominee, journalist Jim Sykes, the Green Party nominee, and several other independent candidates in his bid for re-election. Ultimately, Stevens crushed his opponents to win what would be his last term in the Senate, allowing him to win with the largest margin of victory for any Senate election in Alaska, as well as the highest percentage of the vote in any of his elections.

zh.t: 2002年阿拉斯加州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年阿拉斯加州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任参议员特德·史蒂文斯竞选并赢得第六个参议员任期。他的对手包括民主党提名人、长期参选人弗兰克·冯德萨尔，绿党提名人、记者吉姆·赛克斯，以及几名独立候选人。史蒂文斯最终大胜对手，赢得他在参议院的最后一个任期；他在阿拉斯加州参议院选举中获得的胜差最大，得票率也创个人参选纪录。

en.s: The 2002 Nebraska gubernatorial election, held on November 5, 2002, featured incumbent Republican Governor of Nebraska Mike Johanns defeating his Democratic opponent Stormy Dean in a landslide. This was the first gubernatorial election in Nebraska where the winning primary candidates chose their running mates after the primary election. Prior to this, both the governor and the lieutenant governor were chosen at the primary election. This was also the first gubernatorial election in which a Republican was re-elected in more than forty years.

zh.s: 2002年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长迈克·约翰斯以压倒性优势击败民主党对手斯托米·迪恩。这是内布拉斯加州首次由初选胜出的州长候选人在初选后自行选择副州长竞选搭档。此前，州长和副州长候选人都在初选中一并选出。这也是40多年来首次有共和党州长成功连任。

en.s: The Iowa gubernatorial election of 2002 took place November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Iowa Tom Vilsack sought re-election to a second term as governor. Governor Vilsack won his party's nomination uncontested, while Doug Gross, an advisor to former Governor Terry Branstad, narrowly won the Republican Party's primary in a crowded and competitive election. In the general election, Vilsack was able to improve on his margin of victory four years earlier to win what would be his second and final term as governor.

zh.s: 2002年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任州长汤姆·维尔萨克竞选连任第二个任期。他在没有对手的情况下赢得民主党提名；前州长特里·布兰斯塔德的顾问道格·格罗斯则在竞争激烈的共和党初选中以微弱优势胜出。大选中，维尔萨克比四年前扩大了获胜优势，赢得他最后一个州长任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in New Jersey, 2002
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 5, 2002. The race was to originally feature Democrat Robert Torricelli, who was running for a second term in the seat he had won when former Senator Bill Bradley elected not to run for a fourth term in 1996 and who had been the state's senior Senator following Frank Lautenberg's retirement at the end of the 106th United States Congress, against former West Windsor Township mayor Douglas Forrester, who had won the Republican nomination. Torricelli, however, had been the target of an ethics probe and eventually dropped out of the race in late September 2002.

zh.t: 2002年新泽西州美国联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年新泽西州联邦参议院选举于11月5日举行。民主党原本提名罗伯特·托里切利竞选连任。他在1996年接替不再寻求第四个任期的前参议员比尔·布拉德利，之后在第106届国会结束时弗兰克·劳滕伯格退休，成为新泽西州资历较深的参议员。共和党提名了西温莎镇前市长道格拉斯·福雷斯特。不过，托里切利成为道德调查对象，并于2002年9月下旬退出竞选。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii, 2002
en.s: The 2002 House elections in Hawaii occurred on November 5, 2002 to elect the members of the State of Hawaii's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Hawaii had two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States Census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 2002, the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections. Of Hawaii's Congressional districts, the race in the 2nd district received the most attention. Representative Patsy Mink, despite her death following renomination, was posthumously re-elected, thus triggering a subsequent special election to fill the vacancy.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 2002
en.s: The 2002 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 2002 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections for the Democrats and the Republicans were held on June 11 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 25. All five incumbents who ran were re-elected and the open seat in the 3rd congressional district was retained by the Republicans. The composition of the state delegation remained four Republicans and two Democrats.

zh.t: 2002年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举

en.s: The 2002 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Republican Governor Rick Perry, who had ascended to the governorship after the resignation of George W. Bush, was elected to his first full term in office, winning 58% of the vote to Democrat Tony Sanchez's 40%. Perry carried 218 out of 254 counties, while Sanchez only carried 36. Exit polls showed Perry easily won Anglos (72% to 28%) while Sanchez won African Americans (85% to 15%) and Latinos (65% to 35%). His second inauguration for a first full four-year term began on January 21, 2003 on the Texas State Capitol South Grounds.

zh.s: 2002年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任州长里克·佩里在乔治·W·布什辞职后接任州长，这次首次赢得完整任期。他获得58%的选票，击败得票40%的民主党人托尼·桑切斯。佩里赢得254个县中的218个，桑切斯赢得36个。出口民调显示，佩里获得白人选民72%的支持，桑切斯则分别获得非裔选民85%和拉丁裔选民65%的支持。佩里首次完整四年任期的第二次就职仪式于2003年1月21日在得克萨斯州议会大厦南侧草坪举行。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina, 2002
en.s: The United States House of Representative elections of 2002 in North Carolina were held on 5 November 2002 as part of the biennial election to the United States House of Representatives. All thirteen seats in North Carolina, and 435 nationwide, were elected. The election saw the number of represented elected from North Carolina increase by one after the 2000 Census. The Republicans won seven seats, as in 2000, while the Democrats gained one to put them on six. It is not to be confused with the election to the North Carolina House of Representatives, which was held on the same day.

en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 5, 2002. en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland, 2002
en.s: The Maryland Congressional elections of 2002 were held on Tuesday, November 5, 2002. The winning candidates will serve a two-year term from January 3, 2003, to January 3, 2005.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona, 2002
en.s: The 2002 congressional elections in Arizona were elections for Arizona's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred along with congressional elections nationwide on November 5, 2002. en.s: The 2002 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 5, 2002, to elect members to the Senate of the 83rd and 84th Minnesota Legislatures. A primary election was held on September 10, 2002. The Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won a majority of seats, remaining the majority party, followed by the Republican Party of Minnesota. The new Legislature convened on January 7, 2003.

zh.s: 2002年明尼苏达州参议院选举于11月5日举行，选出第83届和第84届明尼苏达州议会参议院议员。初选于2002年9月10日举行。明尼苏达民主农民劳工党赢得多数席位并继续保持多数党地位，其次是明尼苏达州共和党。新一届议会于2003年1月7日召开。

en.s: The 2002 Michigan Secretary of State election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2002 to elect the Michigan Secretary of State for a four-year term. Incumbent Republican Candice Miller was term-limited and unable to seek a third term.

zh.s: 密歇根州州务卿选举于2002年11月5日星期二举行，选出任期四年的州务卿。共和党籍现任州务卿坎迪斯·米勒受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。
