en.s: The 2002 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Republican Governor Scott McCallum, who had assumed office upon the resignation of Tommy Thompson, ran for his first full term in office. McCallum won his party's nomination by defeating two minor candidates, while State Attorney General Jim Doyle won the Democratic primary with a little more than a third of the vote in a highly competitive primary election.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行威斯康星州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长斯科特·麦卡勒姆是在汤米·汤普森辞职后接任州长，这次竞选他的首个完整任期。麦卡勒姆击败两名小党候选人，赢得共和党提名；州检察长吉姆·多伊尔在竞争激烈的民主党初选中以略高于三分之一的得票赢得提名。

en.t: 2002 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jack Reed won re-election to a second term with nearly 80% of the vote, marking the best performance in his senatorial career as of 2026. Reed's best performance was in Providence County, where he won with over 80% of the vote.

zh.t: 2002年罗得岛州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行罗得岛州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员杰克·里德以近80%的选票连任第二个任期。截至2026年，这是他参议员竞选生涯中成绩最好的一次。他在普罗维登斯县表现最佳，得票率超过80%。

en.s: The 2002 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 5, 2002, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general J. Joseph Curran Jr. defeated Republican nominee Edwin MacVaugh.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行马里兰州州检察长选举。民主党候选人、现任州检察长小J·约瑟夫·柯伦击败共和党候选人埃德温·麦克沃。

en.t: 2002 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2002 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 5, 2002, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member was only recognized by the District of Columbia and was not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate.

zh.t: 2002年哥伦比亚特区美国影子参议员选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行哥伦比亚特区美国影子参议员选举，选出一名代表哥伦比亚特区的影子参议员。该职位仅获哥伦比亚特区承认，未由美国参议院正式宣誓就职，也没有在参议院取得席位。

en.s: The 2002 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 5, 2002, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller William Donald Schaefer defeated Republican nominee Eugene Robert Zarwell.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党候选人、现任审计长威廉·唐纳德·谢弗击败共和党候选人尤金·罗伯特·扎尔韦尔。

en.s: The 2002 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 5, 2002, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 57th session as part of the 2002 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 20. All odd-numbered seats were up for election. Neither party made any gains in the chamber. Of the fifteen seats up for election, only four saw Republicans and Democrats compete.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行怀俄明州参议院选举，选出第57届州参议员，作为2002年美国选举的一部分。党内初选于8月20日举行。所有奇数编号席位都需要改选。两党在州参议院的席位都没有增加。在需要改选的15个席位中，只有4个席位有共和党和民主党候选人竞争。

en.s: The 2002 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 5, 2002, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Claire McCaskill defeated Republican nominee Allen D. Hanson, Libertarian nominee Arnold J. Trembley and Green nominee Fred Kennell.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行密苏里州审计长选举。民主党候选人、现任州审计长克莱尔·麦卡斯基击败共和党候选人艾伦·D·汉森、自由党候选人阿诺德·J·特朗布莱和绿党候选人弗雷德·肯内尔。

en.t: 2002 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Nebraska was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Chuck Hagel won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 2002年内布拉斯加州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行内布拉斯加州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任联邦参议员查克·黑格尔成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2002 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 5, 2002, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Richard Blumenthal won re-election to a fourth term, easily defeating Republican nominee Martha Dean.

zh.t: 2002年康涅狄格州州检察长选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行康涅狄格州州检察长选举。民主党籍现任州检察长理查德·布卢门撒尔击败共和党候选人玛莎·迪恩，轻松连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 2002 Maryland Senate election were held on November 5, 2002, to elect senators in all 47 districts of the Maryland Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for Governor of Maryland.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行马里兰州参议院选举，选出该州参议院全部47个选区的议员。议员由单议员选区选出，任期四年。选举与多项联邦和州选举同时举行，包括马里兰州州长选举。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Wyoming on Tuesday, November 5, 2002. All of the state's executive officers—the Governor, Secretary of State, Auditor, Treasurer, and Superintendent of Public Instruction—were up for election.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日（星期二）举行怀俄明州大选。州内所有行政职位都进行选举，包括州长、州务卿、审计长、财政部长和公共教育总监。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 2002 took place on November 5, 2002, with the primary election occurring on September 10, 2002. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, and Prince George's County elected county executives.

zh.t: 2002年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行马里兰州县行政长官选举，党内初选于2002年9月10日举行。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县和乔治王子县选出了县行政长官。

en.s: General elections were held in Guam on November 5, 2002, in order to elect the governor, all 15 members of the Legislature and the Federal delegate to the US Congress. There was also a referendum on raising the age at which alcohol could be bought and consumed to 21. The proposal was rejected by voters.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行关岛大选，选出州长、立法机构全部15名议员，以及一名美国国会联邦代表。选民还就把购买和饮用酒类的法定年龄提高到21岁举行公投。选民否决了这项提案。

en.t: 2002 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 5, 2002, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. First-term incumbent Shadow Representative Ray Browne was reelected.

zh.t: 2002年哥伦比亚特区美国影子众议员选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日，哥伦比亚特区举行美国众议院选举，选出一名影子众议员。与没有投票权的国会代表不同，影子众议员仅获哥伦比亚特区承认，没有正式宣誓就职或取得席位。首届任期的现任影子众议员雷·布朗再次当选。

en.t: 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon
en.s: The 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon were held on November 5, 2002, to select Oregon's representatives to the United States House of Representatives. All five seats were up for election in 2002, as they are every two years. All five incumbents were re-elected, four of them by large margins; only the 5th district was somewhat competitive.

zh.t: 2002年俄勒冈州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行俄勒冈州美国众议院选举，选出该州派往联邦众议院的议员。州内全部5个席位都需要改选，与每两年一次的选举安排一致。5名现任议员全部连任，其中4人以较大优势获胜，只有第5选区竞争较为激烈。

en.s: An election was held on November 5, 2002, to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives and State Senate. The primary election was held on June 4, 2002. Republicans retained control of the House despite a net loss of five seats, winning 53 seats compared to 48 seats for the Democrats.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行选举，选出蒙大拿州众议院全部100名议员。选举还涉及其他职位，包括美国参议院、美国众议院和州参议院席位。党内初选于2002年6月4日举行。共和党虽然净减5席，仍保住众议院控制权，赢得53席，民主党赢得48席。

en.s: The 2002 Illinois gubernatorial election occurred on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Republican governor George Ryan, who was plagued by scandal, did not run for a second term. Democrat Rod Blagojevich, a U.S. Congressman, ran against Republican Jim Ryan (no relation to the incumbent), the Illinois Attorney General. Blagojevich won 52% to 45%, snapping a losing streak of seven elections, and becoming the first Democrat to win an election for governor in 30 years, since 1972.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。受丑闻困扰的共和党籍现任州长乔治·瑞安没有竞选第二个任期。民主党人、联邦众议员罗德·布拉戈耶维奇与共和党人、伊利诺伊州州检察长吉姆·瑞安竞选；两人没有亲属关系。布拉戈耶维奇以52%对45%的得票率获胜，结束了民主党连续7次败选的纪录。这也是自1972年以来，民主党人首次赢得伊利诺伊州州长选举。

en.t: 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey
en.s: The 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey were held on November 5, 2002, to determine who would represent the people of New Jersey in the United States House of Representatives. This election coincided with national elections for the U.S. House and U.S. Senate. New Jersey has thirteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census.

zh.t: 2002年新泽西州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行新泽西州美国众议院选举，选出代表新泽西州居民进入联邦众议院的议员。选举与美国众议院和参议院的全国选举同时举行。根据2000年美国人口普查，新泽西州在众议院有13个席位。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Vermont on November 5, 2002. All of Vermont's executive officers were up for election, as well as Vermont's at-large seat in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行佛蒙特州大选。州内所有行政职位都进行选举，联邦众议院的全州单一席位也进行选举。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 5, 2002. Primary elections were held on March 19, 2002. The Democratic Party made gains in these elections, while the Republican Party conversely saw losses. The Democratic Party retained their control of the State House and flipped control of the State Senate. The Democratic Party also won the Governorship and Lieutenant Governorship in their combined election, ending 26 years of Republican control of the state's executive branch.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日（星期二）举行伊利诺伊州选举。党内初选于2002年3月19日举行。民主党在选举中有所斩获，共和党则失去席位。民主党保住州众议院多数，并夺得州参议院控制权。民主党候选人还在州长和副州长联合选举中获胜，结束共和党对州行政部门长达26年的控制。

en.t: 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 2002 congressional elections in Tennessee was held on November 5, 2002, to determine who will represent the state of Tennessee in the United States House of Representatives. These elections were the first under Tennessee's new congressional map after redistricting was completed by the state government. Following the 2002 elections, while the Republican Party won a larger share of the statewide popular vote, Democratic nominee Lincoln Davis flipped the 4th congressional district, which was previously represented by Republican Van Hilleary.

zh.t: 2002年田纳西州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行田纳西州美国众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。这是州政府完成重新划分国会选区后的首次选举。共和党虽然赢得全州较多普选票，但民主党候选人林肯·戴维斯从共和党人范·希勒里手中赢得了第4国会选区。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 5, 2002 in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for U.S. Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 17, 2002.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日，马萨诸塞州举行大选。选民投票选出联邦参议员、州长、副州长、州检察长、州务卿、财政部长和审计长；选出联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长议员；并就州级和地方议题进行投票。民主党和共和党的候选人由2002年9月17日举行的党内初选选出。

en.s: The 2002 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 5, 2002, in order to elect the State Auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee Patricia Anderson defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent State Treasurer Carol C. Johnson, Independence nominee Dave Hutcheson and Green nominee Dave Berger. As of 2026, this is the last time a Republican was elected Minnesota State Auditor.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行明尼苏达州审计长选举。共和党候选人帕特里夏·安德森击败民主党—农民—劳工党候选人、现任州财政部长卡罗尔·C·约翰逊，以及独立党候选人戴夫·哈奇森和绿党候选人戴夫·伯杰。截至2026年，这是共和党人最后一次当选明尼苏达州审计长。

en.s: The 2002 Connecticut gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Republican governor John G. Rowland won reelection to a third consecutive term, defeating Democrat Bill Curry. Rowland became the first Connecticut governor to win a third term in office, but did not finish his term, resigning in 2004 due to allegations of corruption. Despite losing this election, Curry is to date the last Democratic gubernatorial candidate to carry Windham County.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长约翰·G·罗兰击败民主党人比尔·柯里，连任第三个任期，成为康涅狄格州首位三度当选的州长。但他未能完成任期：2004年，他因被指控腐败而辞职。尽管柯里败选，他至今仍是最后一位赢得温德姆县的民主党州长候选人。

en.t: 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota
en.s: The 2002 congressional elections in Minnesota, were held on November 5, 2002, to determine who would represent the state, in the United States House of Representative. Minnesota had eight seats in the House, and the 2002 congressional election was the first held pursuant to the apportionment made according to the 2000 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 108th Congress from January 3, 2003, until January 3, 2005.

zh.t: 2002年明尼苏达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行明尼苏达州美国众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。明尼苏达州有8个众议院席位；这是根据2000年美国人口普查重新分配席位后的首次国会选举。众议员任期两年；当选议员于2003年1月3日至2005年1月3日在第108届国会任职。

en.s: The 2002 Arizona Senate election was held on November 5, 2002. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. These were the first elections following the 2000 redistricting cycle, which moved many incumbents into new districts. Primary elections were held on September 10, 2002.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，选民从该州全部30个立法选区选出州参议员，任期两年。这是2000年选区重划后的首次选举，许多现任议员因此划入了新的选区。党内初选于2002年9月10日举行。

en.s: The 2002 Texas Attorney General election took place on November 5, 2002, to elect the attorney general of Texas. Republican state supreme court justice Greg Abbott defeated Democrat Kirk Watson, the former mayor of Austin, with 56.7% of the vote to win his first term as attorney general, he was sworn into office on December 2, 2002.

zh.t: 2002年得克萨斯州州检察长选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行得克萨斯州州检察长选举。共和党人、州最高法院法官格雷格·阿博特击败民主党人、奥斯汀前市长柯克·沃森，以56.7%的得票率首次当选州检察长。他于2002年12月2日宣誓就职。

en.s: The 2002 Delaware House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2002, to elect all 41 members of Delaware's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election was held on September 7, 2002.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行特拉华州众议院选举，选出州众议院全部41名议员。选举还涉及其他职位，包括美国参议院、美国众议院和州参议院席位。党内初选于2002年9月7日举行。

en.t: 2002 Connecticut Secretary of the State election
en.s: The 2002 Connecticut Secretary of the State election took place on November 5, 2002, to elect the Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Incumbent Democrat Susan Bysiewicz won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Ronald San Angelo.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行康涅狄格州州务卿选举。民主党籍现任州务卿苏珊·拜西维茨击败共和党候选人罗纳德·圣安杰洛，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky
en.s: The 2002 House elections in Kentucky occurred on November 5, 2002, to elect the members of the State of Kentucky's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Kentucky had six seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. All six incumbent representatives won reelection.

zh.t: 2002年肯塔基州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行肯塔基州美国众议院选举，选出代表肯塔基州进入联邦众议院的议员。根据2000年美国人口普查，该州在众议院有6个席位。6名现任众议员全部连任。

en.s: The 2002 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2002, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 10, 2002. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. House, Governor, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日（星期二）举行亚利桑那州众议院选举，党内初选于2002年9月10日（星期二）举行。亚利桑那州选民从多议员选区选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举及亚利桑那州选举同时举行，包括美国众议院、州长和亚利桑那州参议院选举。

en.t: 2002 United States Senate election in Montana
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Montana was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Max Baucus won re-election to a fifth term. This was one of the six Democratic-held Senate seats up for election in a state that George W. Bush won in the 2000 presidential election.

zh.t: 2002年蒙大拿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行蒙大拿州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任联邦参议员马克斯·鲍卡斯成功连任第五个任期。这是6个需要改选的民主党籍参议员席位之一；乔治·W·布什在2000年总统选举中赢得了蒙大拿州。

en.s: The 2002 United States state legislative elections were held on November 5, 2002, halfway through President George W. Bush's first term in office. This was a unique election in which the incumbent Republican party performed surprisingly well for a midterm election. Elections were held for 91 legislative chambers, with all states but Louisiana, Mississippi, New Jersey, and Virginia holding elections in at least one house.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行美国州议会选举，时间在乔治·W·布什总统第一个任期的中间。这次选举与往常的中期选举不同，共和党现任议员表现出人意料地好。全美91个州议会院举行选举；除路易斯安那州、密西西比州、新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州外，其他州至少有一个议院举行选举。

en.s: The 2002 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Jennifer Granholm chose not to seek re-election and instead successfully ran for governor. Republican nominee Mike Cox narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Gary Peters with 48.86% of the vote in a close race decided by 5,200 votes. Cox became the first Republican to win the Attorney General office in Michigan since Frank Millard did so in 1950.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行密歇根州州检察长选举。民主党籍现任州检察长詹妮弗·格兰霍姆没有寻求连任，转而成功竞选州长。共和党候选人迈克·考克斯以48.86%的选票险胜民主党候选人加里·彼得斯，两人票差为5,200票。自1950年弗兰克·米勒德当选以来，这是共和党人首次赢得密歇根州州检察长职位。

en.t: 2002 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 2002 U.S. Virgin Islands gubernatorial election took place on 5 November 2002 in order to elect the Governor of the United States Virgin Islands, 15 members of the Legislature and the Delegate to United States House of Representatives. The election was held concurrently with the 2002 United States midterm elections. Incumbent Democratic Governor Charles Wesley Turnbull won re-election with 50% of the vote over Independent candidate John de Jongh.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行美属维尔京群岛州长选举，选出州长、立法机构15名议员和一名美国联邦众议院代表。选举与2002年美国中期选举同时进行。民主党籍现任州长查尔斯·韦斯利·特恩布尔击败独立候选人约翰·德容，获得50%的选票并成功连任。

en.s: The 2002 Delaware Senate election was held on November 5, 2002, to elect all 21 of the 21 members to Delaware's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on September 7, 2002.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行特拉华州参议院选举，选出州参议院全部21名议员。选举还涉及其他职位，包括美国参议院、美国众议院和州众议院席位。党内初选于2002年9月7日举行。

en.s: The 2002 West Virginia Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2002, to elect members of the 76th Legislature. 17 of the 34 state senate seats were up for election. State senate seats in West Virginia are staggered, with senators serving 4-year terms. The election took place concurrently with the U.S. House elections.

zh.t: 2002年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日（星期二）举行西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举，选出第76届州议会议员。州参议院34个席位中的17个需要改选。西弗吉尼亚州参议员任期四年，席位分批改选。这次选举与美国众议院选举同时举行。

en.s: On November 5, 2002, Washington, D.C., held an election for its mayor, with incumbent Democratic mayor Anthony A. Williams easily defeating Carol Schwartz, the Republican nominee. Both the Democratic primary and the Republican primary elections were held on September 10, 2002. Williams not only won the Democratic primary but also received the most votes in the Republican primary.

zh.t: 2002年华盛顿哥伦比亚特区市长选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日，华盛顿哥伦比亚特区举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长安东尼·A·威廉姆斯轻松击败共和党候选人卡罗尔·施瓦茨。民主党和共和党的党内初选都于2002年9月10日举行。威廉姆斯不仅赢得民主党初选，还在共和党初选中获得最高票数。

en.s: The 2002 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Texas. The Incumbent, Bill Ratliff did not run for re-election. The Republican, Incumbent Land Commissioner; David Dewhurst was elected against former Democratic Comptroller; John Sharp. Dewhurst became the third Republican to be elected as lieutenant governor.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行得克萨斯州副州长选举。现任副州长比尔·拉特利夫没有竞选连任。共和党人、现任州土地专员戴维·杜赫斯特击败民主党人、前州审计长约翰·夏普，当选副州长。杜赫斯特成为第三位当选得克萨斯州副州长的共和党人。

en.s: The 2002 Florida Commissioner of Agriculture election took place on November 5, 2002, to elect the Florida Commissioner of Agriculture. Charles Bronson won and was in office from May 14, 2001 to January 4, 2011. Charles Bronson served under two governors, Jeb Bush And Charlie Crist.

zh.t: 2002年佛罗里达州农业专员选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行佛罗里达州农业专员选举。查尔斯·布朗森当选，并于2001年5月14日至2011年1月4日任职。他先后在杰布·布什和查理·克里斯特两位州长任内任职。

en.s: The 2002 Connecticut State Treasurer election took place on November 5, 2002, to elect the Connecticut State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Denise L. Nappier won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Ross Garber.

zh.t: 2002年康涅狄格州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行康涅狄格州财政部长选举。民主党籍现任财政部长丹妮丝·L·纳皮尔击败共和党候选人罗斯·加伯，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2002 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2002, to elect the Minnesota Attorney General for a four-year term. Incumbent DFL Attorney General Mike Hatch ran for reelection and won. The election marked the ninth attorney general race in a row won by the DFL since 1970.

zh.t: 2002年明尼苏达州州检察长选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日（星期二）举行明尼苏达州州检察长选举，选出任期四年的州检察长。民主党—农民—劳工党籍现任州检察长迈克·哈奇竞选连任并获胜。这是自1970年以来，民主党—农民—劳工党候选人连续第九次赢得州检察长选举。

en.s: The 2002 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 2002, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mary Kiffmeyer defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Hubert Horatio Humphrey IV, Independence nominee Dean Alger and Green nominee Andrew S. Koebrick. As of 2026, this is the last time a Republican was elected Minnesota Secretary of State.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。共和党候选人、现任州务卿玛丽·基夫迈尔击败民主党—农民—劳工党候选人休伯特·霍雷肖·汉弗莱四世、独立党候选人迪恩·阿尔杰和绿党候选人安德鲁·S·科布里克。截至2026年，这是共和党人最后一次当选明尼苏达州州务卿。

en.s: The 2002 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002. Three-term incumbent Democratic governor Jeanne Shaheen opted to unsuccessfully run for the United States Senate rather than seek a fourth term as governor. Republican Craig Benson, a self-funded businessman, defeated Democrat Mark Fernald, a state senator, in the general election after both won contested primary elections.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长珍妮·沙欣已连任三届，她决定竞选美国参议员，没有寻求第四个州长任期，但参议员竞选失败。共和党人克雷格·本森是一名自行出资竞选的商人，他在双方都经过竞争激烈的党内初选后，于大选中击败民主党人、州参议员马克·费尔南德。

en.s: Elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 5, 2002, with all districts being contested. State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with the entire House of Representatives up for a vote every two years. The term of office for those elected in 2002 ran from January 7, 2003 until November 30, 2004. Necessary primary elections were held on May 21, 2002.

zh.t: 2002年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举，所有选区都有竞选。州众议员任期两年，州众议院全部席位每两年改选一次。2002年当选议员的任期从2003年1月7日持续至2004年11月30日。党内初选于2002年5月21日举行。

en.s: The 2002 Maryland House of Delegates elections were held on November 5, 2002, as part of the 2002 United States elections, including the 2002 Maryland gubernatorial election . All 141 of Maryland's state delegates were up for reelection.

zh.s: 2002年11月5日举行马里兰州众议院选举，作为2002年美国选举和马里兰州州长选举的一部分。马里兰州众议院全部141个席位都进行改选。

en.s: The 2002 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic governor Roy Barnes sought re-election to a second term as governor. State Senator Sonny Perdue emerged as the Republican nominee from a crowded and hotly contested primary, and he faced off against Barnes, who had faced no opponents in his primary election, in the general election.

zh.s: 2002年佐治亚州州长选举于2002年11月5日举行。民主党现任州长罗伊·巴恩斯竞选连任第二届。共和党州参议员桑尼·珀杜从竞争激烈、候选人众多的初选中脱颖而出，成为共和党候选人。普选中，他与在民主党初选中没有对手的巴恩斯展开角逐。

en.t: 2002 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2002 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 5, 2002, with runoff elections held on December 10, 2002. Five of the eleven seats were contested in this election. Three incumbents ran for reelection, while two sought another office. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though most candidates in San Francisco do receive funding and support from various political parties.

zh.s: 2002年旧金山监事会选举于2002年11月5日举行，决选于2002年12月10日举行。监事会11个席位中有5个席位进行竞选。3名现任者竞选连任，另有2人转而竞选其他职位。加利福尼亚州的市政选举名义上不分党派，但旧金山大多数候选人都能获得各政党的资金和支持。

en.s: The 2002 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002. Republican Governor George Pataki was re-elected to a third term. As of 2026, this was the last statewide election won by a Republican in New York. Pataki faced Democrat Carl McCall and Rochester billionaire Tom Golisano, who ran on the Independence Party line. On Election Day, Pataki was easily re-elected with 49.40% of the vote.

zh.s: 2002年纽约州州长选举于2002年11月5日举行。共和党州长乔治·帕塔基连任第三届。截至2026年，这是共和党人最后一次赢得纽约州全州选举。帕塔基的对手包括民主党候选人卡尔·麦考尔，以及以独立党候选人身份参选的罗切斯特亿万富翁汤姆·戈利萨诺。选举日当天，帕塔基以49.40%的得票率轻松连任。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 5, 2002. Primaries were held on March 19, 2002. Elections were held for Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 3 seats of the Cook County Board of Review, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县普选于2002年11月5日举行。初选于2002年3月19日举行。本次选举选出评估官、书记员、警长、财政官、库克县委员会主席、库克县委员会全部17名成员、库克县复核委员会全部3名成员、芝加哥地区水资源管理委员会的3名成员，以及库克县巡回法院法官。

en.s: The 2002 United States Senate elections featured a series of fiercely contested elections that resulted in a victory for the Republican Party, which gained two seats and thus a narrow majority from the Democratic Party in the United States Senate. The Senate seats up for election, known as class 2 Senate seats, were last up for regular election in 1996. The election cycle was held on November 5, 2002, almost 14 months after the September 11, 2001, attacks.

zh.s: 2002年美国联邦参议院选举竞争激烈，最终共和党获胜并增加2席，从民主党手中取得微弱多数。本次改选的第二类席位上一次常规选举是在1996年。本轮选举于2002年11月5日举行，距离2001年9月11日袭击事件发生后不到14个月。

en.t: 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in New York
en.s: The 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in New York were held alongside the rest of the country on November 5, 2002. Out of the two districts lost in the decennial re-apportionment process, one was formerly held by the Democratic Party, and one was formerly held by the Republican Party.

zh.s: 2002年纽约州联邦众议院选举于2002年11月5日举行，与全国其他地方的选举同期进行。十年一次的国会选区重新划分导致纽约州失去两个席位；其中一个原由民主党人持有，另一个原由共和党人持有。

en.s: The 2002 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2002, to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia, concurrently with the 2002 gubernatorial election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Georgia is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.s: 2002年佐治亚州副州长选举于2002年11月5日举行，与2002年州长选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。佐治亚州是21个分别选举州长和副州长的州之一。

en.t: 2002 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 2002 United States Senate election in Georgia took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Max Cleland ran for re-election to a second term but was defeated by Republican Saxby Chambliss by nearly a seven-point margin, becoming the first Republican ever to win the state's Class 2 Senate seat. This was one of the six Democratic-held Senate seats up for election in a state that George W.

zh.t: 2002年美国佐治亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2002年美国佐治亚州联邦参议员选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员马克斯·克利兰竞选连任第二个任期，但以近7个百分点之差败给共和党人萨克斯比·钱布利斯。钱布利斯因此成为该州首位赢得第二类联邦参议员席位的共和党人。这是6个由民主党掌控、且乔治·W. 布什在2000年总统选举中获胜的州进行改选的参议院席位之一。

en.s: The 2002 New York State Comptroller election was held on November 5, 2002. New York City Comptroller Alan Hevesi, a Democrat, defeated former Assembly Minority Leader John Faso, a Republican.

zh.s: 2002年纽约州主计长选举于2002年11月5日举行。民主党人、纽约市主计长艾伦·赫维西击败共和党人、前州众议院少数党领袖约翰·法索。

en.s: The 2002 St. Louis County Executive election took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Buzz Westfall ran for re-election to a fourth term. He won the Democratic primary by a wide margin and then faced attorney and Monsanto consultant Craig Borchelt in the general election. Westfall defeated Borchelt in a landslide, winning his fourth term with 58 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2002年圣路易斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2002年圣路易斯县行政长官选举于2002年11月5日举行。民主党现任行政长官巴兹·韦斯特福尔竞选连任第四届。他以较大优势赢得民主党初选，随后在普选中对阵律师、孟山都公司顾问克雷格·博尔切尔特。韦斯特福尔以58%的得票率大胜，赢得第四个任期。

en.s: The 2002 Louisville mayoral election was held on November 5, 2002. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 28. This was the first election of the merged metro government of Louisville and Jefferson County. Incumbent Democratic mayor David L. Armstrong, who was elected by the voters of Louisville proper in 1998, declined to seek reelection. He was succeeded by former mayor Jerry Abramson.

zh.s: 2002年路易斯维尔市长选举于2002年11月5日举行。共和党和民主党初选于5月28日举行。这是路易斯维尔市与杰斐逊县合并后的新都会政府首次选举。民主党现任市长戴维·L·阿姆斯特朗于1998年由路易斯维尔市区选民选出，但没有竞选连任。他的继任者是前市长杰里·艾布拉姆森。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 5, 2002, in 36 states and two territories. The Republicans won eight seats previously held by the Democrats, as well as the seat previously held by Minnesota governor Jesse Ventura, who was elected on the Reform Party ticket but had since renounced his party affiliation.

zh.s: 2002年美国有36个州和两个属地于11月5日举行州长选举。共和党赢得了原由民主党掌控的8个州长席位，以及明尼苏达州州长杰西·文图拉原有的席位。文图拉当选时代表改革党，但此后已宣布退出该党。

en.s: The 2002 Anaheim mayoral election was held on November 5, 2002, to elect the mayor of Anaheim, California. It saw the election of Curt Pringle.

zh.s: 2002年阿纳海姆市长选举于2002年11月5日举行，选出加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市市长。柯特·普林格尔当选。

en.t: 2002 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2002 House elections in Georgia occurred on November 5, 2002, to elect the members of the State of Georgia's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Georgia has thirteen seats in the House, apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 2002 (including one in Georgia), the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2002年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2002年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举于2002年11月5日举行，选出佐治亚州在美国联邦众议院的代表。根据2000年美国人口普查，佐治亚州分得13个联邦众议院席位。选举与2002年联邦参议院选举（包括佐治亚州的一场选举）、其他州的联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2002 St. Charles County Executive election took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Republican County Executive Joe Ortwerth ran for re-election. He was challenged by Democrat Joe Koester, a high school teacher, who was supported by several prominent local Republicans. Orthwerth won re-election with 55 percent of the vote, his lowest margin of victory since first winning in 1994.

zh.t: 2002年圣查尔斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2002年圣查尔斯县行政长官选举于2002年11月5日举行。共和党现任行政长官乔·奥特沃思竞选连任。他的对手是民主党人乔·科斯特，后者是一名高中教师，并得到几位当地知名共和党人的支持。奥特沃思以55%的得票率连任，这是他自1994年首次当选以来胜选优势最小的一次。

en.t: 2002 Cook County Board of Commissioners election
en.s: The 2002 Cook County Board of Commissioners election was held on November 5, 2002. It was preceded by a primary election held on March 19, 2002. It coincided with other 2002 Cook County, Illinois, elections (including the election for president of the Cook County Board of Commissioners). It saw all seventeen seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners up for election to four-year terms.

zh.s: 2002年库克县委员会选举于2002年11月5日举行，此前初选于2002年3月19日举行。选举与伊利诺伊州库克县2002年的其他选举同期举行，包括库克县委员会主席选举。库克县委员会全部17个席位都进行改选，任期4年。

en.s: The 2002 Jackson County Executive election took place on November 5, 2002. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Katheryn Shields ran for re-election to a third term. Shields initially faced a challenge in the Democratic primary from State Senator Ronnie DePasco, but he ultimately withdrew from the race. Shields won the primary in a landslide, and faced Republican State Representative Pat Kelley in the general election.

zh.s: 2002年杰克逊县行政长官选举于2002年11月5日举行。民主党现任行政长官凯瑟琳·希尔兹竞选连任第三届。她起初在民主党初选中面对州参议员罗尼·德帕斯科的挑战，但德帕斯科最终退出竞选。希尔兹以明显优势赢得初选，并在普选中对阵共和党州众议员帕特·凯利。

en.s: The 2002 election was held on November 5 to elect the Attorney General of New York. Democratic incumbent Eliot Spitzer was reelected by a wide margin, defeating Republican Dora Irizarry. This is the most recent New York Attorney General election in which the winner won a majority of counties.

zh.s: 2002年纽约州检察长选举于11月5日举行。民主党籍现任检察长埃利奥特·斯皮策大胜共和党候选人多拉·伊里萨里。此后该州检察长选举中，胜选者都没有获得过半数县的支持。

en.s: The 2002 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 78th Texas Legislature, with seats apportioned according to the 2000 United States census. State representatives serve for two-year terms.

zh.s: 2002年得克萨斯州众议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。得州选民在全部150个州众议院选区选出议员。当选者进入第78届得克萨斯州议会，席位划分依据2000年美国人口普查结果。州众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The 2002 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2002 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 35 of the state senate's 50 districts—all 25 of the odd-numbered seats were up for regularly scheduled elections and, due to the oddities of redistricting following the 2000 Census, 10 of the even-numbered sears were up as well.

zh.s: 2002年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院50个选区中的35个选区选出参议员：25个奇数编号席位按计划改选，另有10个偶数编号席位因2000年人口普查后重新划分选区而改选。

en.s: The 2002 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in all 31 Senate districts. All of the seats up for this election, with half of the seats elected for two-year terms and the other half elected for four-year terms. The winners of this election served in the 78th Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 2002年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。得州选民在全部31个州参议院选区选出参议员。这次选举中，部分席位当选者任期为两年，其余席位当选者任期为四年。当选者进入第78届得克萨斯州议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2002 Connecticut State Senate elections took place as a part of the biennial 2002 United States elections. All 36 seats were up for re-election. Senators serve two year terms and are up for re-election every election cycle. The primary elections which took place on September 10, 2002, determined which candidates appeared on the ballot for the November 5th general election.

zh.s: 2002年康涅狄格州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分，全部36个席位都进行改选。州参议员任期为两年，每轮选举都要改选。初选于2002年9月10日举行，决定哪些候选人参加11月5日的大选。

en.s: United States airstrikes in Yemen started after the September 11 attacks in the United States, when the US military attacked the Islamist militant presence in Yemen, in particular Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula using drone warfare. With the Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen, the Saudi led coalition also attacked Houthi rebels using drone warfare. The Houthi military have as well used drone warfare to attack the Saudi led coalition and pro Yemen government troops.

zh.s: 美国在也门发动空袭始于九一一袭击之后，当时美军使用无人机打击也门境内的伊斯兰主义武装，尤其是阿拉伯半岛基地组织。沙特领导的也门军事干预期间，沙特领导的联军也使用无人机打击胡塞武装；胡塞武装也曾以无人机袭击沙特联军和亲也门政府部队。

en.s: The 2003 Saskatchewan general election was held on November 5, 2003, to elect the 58 members of the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan (MLAs). The election was called on October 8 by Lieutenant Governor of Saskatchewan Lynda Haverstock, on the advice of Premier Lorne Calvert.

zh.s: 2003年萨斯喀彻温省大选于2003年11月5日举行，选出萨斯喀彻温省议会58名议员。副省长琳达·哈弗斯托克在省长洛恩·卡尔弗特的建议下，于10月8日宣布举行选举。

en.s: General elections were held in the Northern Mariana Islands on 5 November 2005, electing the Governor and Legislature. There was also a referendum on calling a Constitutional Convention, which was approved by voters. The gubernatorial election was theclosest in the country's history, and resulted in the election of Benigno Fitial, narrowly defeating independent Heinz Hofschneider and incumbent Republican Governor Juan N.

zh.s: 北马里亚纳群岛于2005年11月5日举行大选，选出州长和立法机构成员。选民还就是否召开制宪会议举行公投，赞成票占多数。州长选举是该地区历史上竞争最激烈的一次，最终本尼格诺·菲蒂亚尔当选，他以微弱优势击败独立候选人海因茨·霍夫施耐德和共和党籍时任州长。

en.s: 2005 J.League Cup final was the 13th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on 5 November 2005. JEF United Chiba won the championship.

zh.s: 2005年J联赛杯决赛是J联赛杯第13届决赛，于2005年11月5日在东京国立竞技场举行。千叶市原队夺得冠军。

en.s: Cyber Sunday (2006) was the first annual Cyber Sunday professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It took place on November 5, 2006, at the U.S. Bank Arena in Cincinnati, Ohio with 7,000 fans attending. It was presented by Vivendi Universal Games' Scarface: The World Is Yours. It replaced the previous Taboo Tuesday event, and had the same concept. This event had the unique feature of being interactive, which other pay-per-views do not have. Fans could vote, via WWE's official website, for selective characteristics in the scheduled matches, including opponents, stipulations, match types, etc.

zh.s: 《网络星期日》（2006年）是世界摔角娱乐公司（WWE）制作的首届年度职业摔角付费电视赛事，于2006年11月5日在俄亥俄州辛辛那提的美国银行体育馆举行，现场观众为7,000人。赛事由维旺迪环球游戏的《疤面煞星：世界属于你》赞助。它取代了此前的《禁忌星期二》，沿用了相同的互动概念。观众可以通过WWE官方网站投票，决定比赛安排中的部分内容，包括对手、比赛条件和比赛类型等。

en.s: Nicaragua held a general election on November 5, 2006. The country's voters went to the polls to elect a new President of the Republic and 90 members of the National Assembly, all of whom will serve five-year terms. Daniel Ortega (FSLN) won the race with 37.99% of the vote, Eduardo Montealegre (ALN) trailing with 28.30%, José Rizo (PLC) with 27.1%, Edmundo Jarquín (MRS) with 6.29%, and Edén Pastora (AC) with just 0.29%.

zh.s: 尼加拉瓜于2006年11月5日举行大选，选出新总统和90名国民议会议员，任期均为五年。桑地诺民族解放阵线（FSLN）候选人丹尼尔·奥尔特加以37.99%的得票率获胜；全国自由联盟（ALN）候选人爱德华多·蒙特亚莱格雷得票28.30%，立宪自由党（PLC）候选人何塞·里索得票27.1%，桑地诺革新运动（MRS）候选人埃德蒙多·哈尔金得票6.29%，公民选择党（AC）候选人埃登·帕斯托拉得票0.29%。

en.s: General elections were held in Trinidad and Tobago on 5 November 2007. Nomination day was 15 October. The parties contesting the election were the incumbent People's National Movement, the official opposition United National Congress–Alliance (a coalition of the UNC and six smaller parties), the Congress of the People (a UNC splinter group), the Tobago United Front–Democratic Action Congress (a Tobago-based party) and the Democratic National Assembly (a new party based in Tobago).

zh.s: 特立尼达和多巴哥于2007年11月5日举行大选，提名日为10月15日。参选政党包括执政的人民民族运动、官方反对党联合国民大会联盟（由联合国民大会党和另外6个小党组成）、从联合国民大会党分裂出来的人民大会党、以多巴哥为基地的多巴哥联合阵线—民主行动大会，以及一个以多巴哥为基地的新政党民主国民议会党。

en.s: The 2007 Welsh Liberal Democrats leadership election took place following the resignation of Lembit Öpik at the 2007 Autumn Liberal Democrat Conference in Aberystwyth following his belief that the Welsh Liberal Democrat leader should be the group leader in the National Assembly. At the close of nominations only one candidate - Assembly group leader since 1999 Mike German was nominated and he was duly returned unopposed.

zh.t: 2007年威尔士自由民主党领袖选举
zh.s: 莱姆比特·奥皮克在2007年秋季自由民主党会议上辞职后，该党举行了2007年威尔士自由民主党领袖选举。奥皮克认为，威尔士自由民主党领袖应由威尔士国民议会党团领袖兼任。提名截止时，唯一获提名者是自1999年以来担任议会党团领袖的迈克·杰曼；他因此在无人竞争的情况下当选。

en.s: WEC 36: Faber vs. Brown was a mixed martial arts event held by World Extreme Cagefighting that took place on November 5, 2008 at the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel and Casino in Hollywood, Florida. The event aired live on the Versus Network.

zh.s: WEC 36：费伯对阵布朗是一场由世界极限笼斗（WEC）举办的综合格斗赛事，于2008年11月5日在佛罗里达州好莱坞的塞米诺尔硬石酒店及赌场举行。赛事通过Versus电视网直播。

en.s: The Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG; Sometimes referred to as Grupo Internacional Revolución in Mexico) produced and scripted a Ruleta de la Muerte (Spanish for "Roulette of Death") tournament on November 5, 2009. The show took place in Arena Naucalpan, in Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico, IWRG's main venue and the site of the majority of all their major shows and tournaments. The lucha libre concept of a Ruleta de la Muerte tournament sees tag teams battle it out, with the losing team in the match advancing in the tournament.

zh.s: 墨西哥职业摔角推广组织国际摔角革命集团（IWRG，有时在墨西哥也称Grupo Internacional Revolución）于2009年11月5日举办并编排了一场“死亡轮盘”锦标赛。赛事在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行，该场馆是IWRG的主场，也是其大多数重要赛事和锦标赛的举办地。“死亡轮盘”是摔角赛事的一种赛制：双打队伍交手，落败队伍进入锦标赛下一轮。

loc: 福克兰群岛（马尔维纳斯群岛）

en.s: The Falkland Islands general election of 2009 was held on Thursday 5 November 2009 to elect members to the Legislative Assembly. It was the first general election in the Falkland Islands since the new constitution came into force on 1 January 2009, which replaced the old Legislative Council with the Legislative Assembly. Chief Executive Tim Thorogood acted as Returning Officer. Eight MLAs were elected through universal suffrage using block voting, five from the Stanley constituency and three from the Camp constituency. Each elector in Stanley could vote for five candidates, and in Camp each elector could vote for three candidates.

zh.s: 2009年福克兰群岛大选于11月5日星期四举行，选出立法议会议员。这是2009年1月1日新宪法生效后举行的首次大选，新宪法以立法议会取代了旧立法委员会。首席执行官蒂姆·索罗古德担任选举主任。选举采用区块投票制，通过普选选出8名议员：斯坦利选区5名，坎普选区3名。斯坦利选民每人可投5名候选人，坎普选民每人可投3名候选人。

en.s: On November 5, 2009, a mass shooting took place at Fort Hood near Killeen, Texas, United States. Nidal Hasan, a U.S. Army major and psychiatrist, fatally shot 13 people and injured more than 30 others. It was the deadliest mass shooting on an American military base and the deadliest terrorist attack in the United States since the September 11 attacks until it was equalled by the San Bernardino attack in 2015.

zh.s: 2009年11月5日，美国得克萨斯州基林附近的胡德堡发生大规模枪击案。美国陆军少校、精神科医生尼达尔·哈桑开枪打死13人，打伤30多人。这是美国军事基地中死亡人数最多的大规模枪击案，也是美国自“9·11”袭击以来死亡人数最多的恐怖袭击；2015年圣贝纳迪诺袭击案发生后，死亡人数纪录被追平。

en.s: On 5 November 2010, JS Air Flight 201, a Beechcraft 1900 passenger aircraft on a charter service from Karachi to the Bhit Shah gas field in Sindh, Pakistan, crashed near Karachi's Jinnah International Airport, after suffering an engine malfunction at take-off. All 21 people on board were killed.

zh.s: 2010年11月5日，JS航空201号班机失事。这架比奇1900客机从巴基斯坦卡拉奇包机飞往信德省比特沙气田，起飞时发动机发生故障，随后在卡拉奇真纳国际机场附近坠毁。机上21人全部遇难。

en.s: UFC 138: Leben vs. Muñoz was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on November 5, 2011 at LG Arena in Birmingham, United Kingdom. The event aired on the same day, via tape delay, on Spike TV in the United States and live on Sportsnet in Canada.

zh.s: UFC 138：莱本对穆尼奥斯是一场综合格斗赛事，由终极格斗冠军赛于2011年11月5日在英国伯明翰LG体育馆举办。赛事于当天在美国Spike TV延迟播出，并在加拿大Sportsnet现场直播。

en.s: The 2011 Svenska Cupen final was a football match held at Olympia, Helsingborg on 5 November 2011. The match was the final of the 2011 Svenska Cupen and was played between Helsingborgs IF and Kalmar FF. Goals from Álvaro Santos, May Mahlangu and Christoffer Andersson saw Helsingborgs IF, the defending champions, win the match 3–1 to retain the trophy. Erik Israelsson scored for Kalmar FF.

zh.s: 2011年瑞典杯决赛于2011年11月5日在赫尔辛堡的奥林匹亚球场举行，由赫尔辛堡足球俱乐部对阵卡尔马足球俱乐部。赫尔辛堡凭借阿尔瓦罗·桑托斯、迈·马朗古和克里斯托弗·安德松的进球，以3比1获胜，作为卫冕冠军成功保住奖杯。卡尔马的埃里克·伊萨克松也取得进球。这是瑞典杯第13届决赛。

en.s: The 2011 AFC Champions League final was a football match which was played on Saturday, 5 November 2011, to determine the champion of the 2011 AFC Champions League. It was the final of the 30th edition of the top-level Asian club tournament organized by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC), and the 9th under the current AFC Champions League title.

zh.s: 2011年亚足联冠军联赛决赛于2011年11月5日星期六举行，决出2011年亚足联冠军联赛冠军。这是亚洲顶级俱乐部赛事第30届决赛，也是赛事使用现行“亚足联冠军联赛”名称后的第9届。赛事由亚洲足球联合会主办。

en.t: 2011 Social Democratic and Labour Party leadership election
en.s: An election for the leadership of the Social Democratic and Labour Party (SDLP) was held 4–5 November 2011. Alasdair McDonnell won the leadership election and was announced the new leader of the SDLP on 5 November 2011.

zh.t: 2011年社会民主党和工党领袖选举
zh.s: 社会民主党和工党于2011年11月4日至5日举行党领袖选举。阿拉斯代尔·麦克唐纳胜出，并于2011年11月5日宣布成为该党新任领袖。

en.s: The 2012 The Jewish Home leadership election was held on 5 November 2012 to elect the leader of The Jewish Home party. The election took place in advance of the 2013 Israeli legislative election. Naftali Bennett was elected as leader, defeating Zevulun Orlev. A month before the leadership election, incumbent leader Daniel Hershkowitz announced that he would not contend.

zh.s: 犹太家园党于2012年11月5日举行领导人选举，选出该党党魁。选举在2013年以色列议会选举前举行。纳夫塔利·贝内特击败泽武伦·奥尔列夫，当选党魁。选举前一个月，时任党魁丹尼尔·赫什科维茨宣布不参选。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 2013 took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the Governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Republican Governor Chris Christie ran for re-election to a second term in office. He faced Democratic nominee Barbara Buono and six others in the general election. He was re-elected by a wide margin, tallying over 60 percent of the vote Less than 40% of registered voters cast ballots, the lowest ever for a gubernatorial election. Christie became the first Republican gubernatorial candidate to win more than 50 percent of the vote since Tom Kean, Sr.'s landslide victory in 1985.

zh.s: 2013年新泽西州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出新泽西州州长。共和党籍现任州长克里斯·克里斯蒂竞选连任，争取第二个任期。他在大选中面对民主党提名人芭芭拉·布奥诺等6名候选人。克里斯蒂以较大优势连任，得票率超过60%。登记选民的投票率不足40%，是该州州长选举史上最低的一次。克里斯蒂也成为自汤姆·基恩于1985年大胜以来，首位得票率超过50%的共和党州长候选人。

en.s: The 2013 Minneapolis mayoral election was held on November 5, 2013 to elect the Mayor of Minneapolis for a four-year term. This was the second mayoral election in the city's history to use instant-runoff voting, popularly known as ranked choice voting, first implemented in the city's 2009 elections. Municipal elections in Minnesota are nonpartisan, although candidates are able to identify with a political party on the ballot. After incumbent Mayor R. T. Rybak announced in late 2012 that he would not seek a fourth term, 35 candidates began campaigns to replace him.

zh.s: 2013年明尼阿波利斯市长选举于11月5日举行，选出任期四年的市长。这是该市历史上第二次在市长选举中采用即时决选投票，也称排序选择投票；该制度首次用于2009年市选举。明尼苏达州的市政选举不设党派，但候选人可以在选票上注明党派。现任市长R·T·赖巴克在2012年底宣布不再竞选第四个任期后，共有35名候选人开始竞选接替他。

en.s: (See also: Virginia elections, 2013) The Virginia gubernatorial election of 2013 took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the Governor of Virginia. The incumbent Governor, Republican Bob McDonnell, was not eligible to run for re-election due to term limits established by the Virginia Constitution. Virginia is the only state that prohibits its Governor from serving immediate successive terms. Three candidates appeared on the ballot for Governor: Republican Ken Cuccinelli, the Attorney General of Virginia; Democrat Terry McAuliffe, a businessman and the former Chairman of the Democratic National Committee; and Libertarian Robert Sarvis, a lawyer and businessman.

zh.s: 2013年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月5日举行，选出弗吉尼亚州州长。共和党籍现任州长鲍勃·麦克唐纳因州宪法规定的任期限制，不能竞选连任。弗吉尼亚州是唯一禁止州长连续立即连任的州。共有3名州长候选人列入选票：共和党人肯·库奇内利（时任州总检察长）、民主党商人及民主党全国委员会前主席特里·麦考利夫，以及自由意志党律师和商人罗伯特·萨维斯。

en.s: The 2013 Minneapolis City Council elections were held on November 5, 2013 to elect the 13 members of the Minneapolis City Council for four-year terms. 10 races produced a winner in the first round and the remaining three in the second round. Candidates affiliated with the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won all 12 of the seats where they had fielded a candidate, and the Green Party of Minnesota won the remaining one seat. Members were elected from single-member districts via instant-runoff voting, popularly known as ranked choice voting. Voters had the option of ranking up to three candidates.

zh.t: 2013年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举
zh.s: 2013年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举于11月5日举行，选出13名任期四年的市议员。10个选区在第一轮投票中产生胜者，其余3个在第二轮产生胜者。明尼苏达民主农民劳工党（DFL）提名候选人的12个席位全部当选，明尼苏达州绿党赢得剩余的1个席位。议员通过即时决选投票（也称排序选择投票）从单一议员选区中选出，选民最多可以按偏好顺序排列3名候选人。

en.s: The 2013 New York City mayoral election occurred on November 5, 2013, along with elections for comptroller, public advocate, borough presidents, and members of the New York City Council. The incumbent Mayor of New York, Michael Bloomberg, a Republican-turned-Independent, was term-limited and thus unable to seek re-election to a fourth term in office. Primary elections were held on September 10, 2013. The Republican nominee was former Metropolitan Transportation Authority Chairman Joe Lhota. New York City Public Advocate Bill de Blasio was the Democratic nominee. De Blasio was elected mayor.

zh.s: 2013年纽约市市长选举于11月5日举行，同日还举行了市主计长、市公益维护人、各区区长和纽约市议会议员选举。共和党转为独立派的现任市长迈克尔·布隆伯格因任期限制，不能竞选第四个任期。初选于9月10日举行。共和党提名人是前大都会运输署主席乔·洛塔；纽约市公益维护人比尔·白思豪获得民主党提名。白思豪当选市长。

en.s: (See also: Virginia elections, 2013) The Virginia Attorney General election of 2013 took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the Attorney General of Virginia. The incumbent Attorney General, Republican Ken Cuccinelli, did not run for re-election. He was instead his party's nominee in the 2013 gubernatorial election. On May 18, 2013, a Republican state convention in Richmond nominated State Senator Mark Obenshain over State Delegate Rob Bell. The Democratic primary on June 11, 2013 was won by State Senator Mark Herring, who defeated former Assistant United States Attorney Justin Fairfax.

zh.t: 2013年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2013年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任总检察长肯·库奇内利没有竞选连任，而是转而参选该州州长。共和党于5月18日在里士满举行州代表大会，提名州参议员马克·奥本斯海因，胜过州众议员罗布·贝尔。6月11日举行的民主党初选由州参议员马克·赫林获胜，他击败了美国前助理联邦检察官贾斯汀·费尔法克斯。

en.t: New York City Public Advocate election, 2013
en.s: The 2013 New York City Public Advocate election was held on November 5, 2013, along with elections for the Mayor, Comptroller, Borough Presidents, and members of the New York City Council. Incumbent Democratic Public Advocate Bill de Blasio, serving his first term, ran for Mayor of New York City rather than seek re-election. The Democratic Party held its primary on September 10, and since no candidate reached 40%, a runoff was held on October 1 between the top two candidates, Councilwoman Letitia James and State Senator Daniel Squadron. James won the runoff to become the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 2013年纽约市公益维护人选举于11月5日举行，同日还举行了市长、市主计长、各区区长和市议会议员选举。民主党籍现任公益维护人比尔·白思豪任职第一个任期后转而竞选市长，没有寻求连任。民主党于9月10日举行初选，由于没有候选人得票达到40%，10月1日举行了第二轮投票，由市议员莱蒂西亚·詹姆斯和州参议员丹尼尔·斯夸德龙角逐。詹姆斯赢得第二轮投票，成为民主党提名人。

en.s: The Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election of 2013 took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Virginia. The incumbent Lieutenant Governor, Republican Bill Bolling, had originally planned to run for Governor of Virginia in the 2013 gubernatorial election, but withdrew upon the entry of Attorney General Ken Cuccinelli. On May 18, 2013, a Republican state convention in Richmond nominated minister and conservative activist E.W. Jackson over six others after four ballots. The Democratic primary on June 11, 2013 was won by State Senator Ralph Northam, who defeated Aneesh Chopra, former Chief Technology Officer of the United States.

zh.s: 2013年弗吉尼亚州副州长选举于11月5日举行。共和党籍现任副州长比尔·博林原本计划竞选州长，但在州总检察长肯·库奇内利宣布参选后退出。共和党于5月18日在州代表大会上举行4轮投票，最终提名牧师兼保守派活动人士E·W·杰克逊，击败另外6名候选人。6月11日举行的民主党初选由州参议员拉尔夫·诺瑟姆获胜，他击败了美国前首席技术官阿尼什·乔普拉。

en.s: The 2013 Cincinnati mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the Mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the September 10 primary advancing to the general election, regardless of party.

zh.s: 2013年辛辛那提市长选举于11月5日举行，选出俄亥俄州辛辛那提市市长。选举名义上不设党派，9月10日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选，不论其党派。

en.s: A general election was held in Minneapolis on November 5, 2013. Minneapolis's mayor was up for election as well as all the seats on the Minneapolis City Council, the two popularly elected seats on the Board of Estimate and Taxation, and all the seats on the Park and Recreation Board.

zh.s: 明尼阿波利斯于2013年11月5日举行大选，选举市长、全部市议会议席、税务和估价委员会两个民选席位，以及公园和娱乐委员会的全部席位。

en.s: The Houston Mayoral Election of 2013 took place on November 5, 2013. The incumbent Mayor Annise Parker was re-elected to a third, and final, two-year term in office.

zh.s: 2013年休斯敦市长选举于11月5日举行。现任市长安妮丝·帕克成功连任，开始第三个、也是最后一个两年任期。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 2013 occurred on Tuesday, November 5, 2013, between state representative Marty Walsh and city councilor John R. Connolly. Walsh was elected to his first term. A preliminary election was held on Tuesday, September 24, 2013. Incumbent Mayor Thomas Menino had declined to run for re-election to a sixth term.

zh.s: 2013年波士顿市长选举于2013年11月5日星期二举行，候选人是州众议员马蒂·沃尔什和市议员约翰·R·康诺利。沃尔什当选，开始第一个任期。初选于2013年9月24日星期二举行。民主党籍现任市长托马斯·梅尼诺已决定不竞选第六个任期。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 2013 were held on November 5, 2013, in the states of New Jersey and Virginia. These elections form part of the 2013 United States elections.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日，新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。这些选举是2013年美国选举的一部分。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on November 5, 2013. This included nine legislatively-referred ballot measures to amend the Constitution of Texas, along with special elections for the 50th district of the State House and the 6th district of the State Senate.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州于2013年11月5日举行选举，其中包括9项由州议会提交、用于修订得克萨斯州宪法的公投提案，以及州众议院第50选区和州参议院第6选区的特别选举。

en.s: St. Petersburg, Florida, held an election for mayor on August 27 and November 5, 2013. A non-partisan primary election was held on August 27, 2013. No candidate won a majority of the vote, so the top two finishers, incumbent Mayor Bill Foster and former State Representative Rick Kriseman, advanced to a runoff. After a campaign described as "nasty", "partisan", "contentious" and "the costliest in [St.

zh.t: 2013年佛罗里达州圣彼得堡市长选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州圣彼得堡于2013年8月27日和11月5日举行市长选举。8月27日举行不分党派的初选。由于无人获得过半选票，得票最高的两名候选人——时任市长比尔·福斯特和前州众议员里克·克里斯曼——进入决选。原文关于竞选活动的后续描述在引文中途截断，未译入。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Jersey on November 5, 2013. Primary elections were held on June 4. Every state position was up in this election cycle, which includes all 80 seats in the New Jersey General Assembly and all 40 seats in the Senate, as well as Governor and Lieutenant Governor.

zh.s: 新泽西州于2013年11月5日举行大选，初选于6月4日举行。这次选举改选所有州级职位，包括州众议院全部80个席位、州参议院全部40个席位，以及州长和副州长。

en.s: The 2013 mayoral election in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania was held on November 5, 2013, and resulted in Eric Papenfuse, a local bookstore owner and Democrat, being elected to his first term.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州哈里斯堡市长选举，当地书店老板、民主党人埃里克·帕彭福斯当选，开始第一个任期。

en.s: The 2013 election for New York City Comptroller was held on November 5, 2013, along with elections for Mayor, Public Advocate, Borough Presidents, and members of the New York City Council. The first-term incumbent Comptroller, John Liu, did not run for re-election, as he decided to run in the 2013 election for Mayor of New York City.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行纽约市审计长选举，同时举行市长、公益维护人、区长和市议会选举。首届任期的现任审计长约翰·刘决定竞选纽约市市长，因此没有寻求连任。

en.t: 2013 New York City borough president elections
en.s: The 2013 elections for borough presidents were held on November 5, 2013, and coincided with elections for Mayor, Public Advocate, Comptroller, and members of the New York City Council. Primary elections were held on September 10, 2013.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行纽约市区长选举，同时举行市长、公益维护人、审计长和市议会选举。党内初选于2013年9月10日举行。

en.s: The Apertura 2013 Copa MX final was the final of the Apertura 2013 Copa MX the third edition of the Copa MX under its current format and 70th overall organized by the Mexican Football Federation, the governing body of association football in Mexico. The final is contested in a single leg format between two Liga MX clubs, Morelia and Atlas both from group 7. The leg was hosted by Morelia at Estadio Morelos in Morelia, Michoacán on November 5, 2013.

zh.s: 2013年墨西哥杯秋季赛决赛是当时赛制下第三届、也是墨西哥足球联合会主办的第70届墨西哥杯决赛。决赛采取单场制，由第7组的两支墨西哥足球甲级联赛球队莫雷利亚和阿特拉斯对阵。比赛于2013年11月5日在米却肯州莫雷利亚的莫雷洛斯体育场举行，由莫雷利亚主场承办。

en.s: The 2013 Miami mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013. Incumbent Mayor Tomás Regalado ran for re-election to a second term. Though he was originally challenged by City Commissioner Francis Suarez, the son of former Mayor Xavier Suarez, Suarez dropped out of the race on August 26, 2013, blaming staffers for "mistakes we made" during the campaign.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行迈阿密市长选举。现任市长托马斯·雷加拉多竞选连任第二个任期。他最初的对手是市政委员弗朗西斯·苏亚雷斯，后者是前市长哈维尔·苏亚雷斯的儿子；但苏亚雷斯于2013年8月26日退出竞选，并将竞选期间的“错误”归咎于工作人员。

en.s: The 2013 Hialeah mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013. Incumbent Mayor Carlos Hernández, who became Mayor in 2011 upon the resignation of former Mayor Julio Robaina and was re-elected in a 2011 special election, ran for re-election to a full term. Though former Mayor Raúl Martínez initially filed to run, he ultimately declined to challenge Hernández.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行海厄利亚市长选举。现任市长卡洛斯·埃尔南德斯于2011年在前市长胡利奥·罗拜纳辞职后接任，并在2011年特别选举中再次当选。这次他竞选完整任期。前市长劳尔·马丁内斯最初登记参选，最终没有挑战埃尔南德斯。

en.s: The 2013 mayoral election in Allentown, Pennsylvania was held on November 5, 2013, and resulted in the incumbent mayor Ed Pawlowski, a member of the Democratic Party, being re-elected to a third term over Independent candidate William Michael Donovan.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举。民主党籍现任市长埃德·帕沃洛斯基击败独立候选人威廉·迈克尔·多诺万，连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2013 United States state legislative elections were held on November 5, 2013. Three legislative chambers in two states held regularly scheduled elections. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in two states. Legislative elections were held for the New Jersey Senate, New Jersey General Assembly, and the Virginia House of Delegates.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行美国州议会选举。两个州的3个州议会院举行了按计划进行的选举。这些非大选年份的选举与其他州和地方选举同时举行，包括两个州的州长选举。举行选举的议会院包括新泽西州参议院、新泽西州州议会和弗吉尼亚州众议院。

en.s: The Rochester Mayoral Election of 2013 took place on November 5, 2013, in the City of Rochester, New York, United States. Democratic Mayor Thomas Richards, who first took office following Robert Duffy's resignation to take office of Lieutenant-Governor of New York in 2011, ran for reelection and was defeated in both the Democratic Primary and the general election by former City Council President Lovely A.

zh.t: 2013年纽约州罗切斯特市长选举
zh.s: 纽约州罗切斯特市长选举于2013年11月5日举行。民主党籍市长托马斯·理查兹原是在罗伯特·达菲辞职、转任纽约州副州长后接任市长；达菲于2011年离职。理查兹竞选连任，但在民主党初选和大选中都败给前市议会主席洛夫利·A.。

en.s: The 2013 Atlantic City mayoral election was held in Atlantic City, New Jersey on November 5, 2013, to elect a mayor for the city of Atlantic City. Incumbent mayor Lorenzo Langford was seeking reelection to a second term. Langford was defeated by Republican Don Guardian, the resort town's first openly gay mayor.

zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行新泽西州大西洋城市长选举。现任市长洛伦佐·兰福德竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党人唐·加迪安。加迪安是这座度假城市首位公开同性恋身份的市长。

en.s: The 2013 Durham mayoral election was held on November 5, 2013, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Bill Bell.

zh.s: 2013年达勒姆市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市市长。现任市长比尔·贝尔成功连任。

en.s: The 2013 Lehigh County Executive election was held on November 5, 2013. In 2012, County Executive Don Cunningham resigned and former County Commissioner Bill Hansell was appointed to serve out the remainder of his term. Muller declined to run in the regular election, and Tom Muller, the County Director of Administration, ran for the Democratic nomination to succeed Hansell.

zh.s: 利哈伊县行政长官选举于2013年11月5日举行。2012年，行政长官唐·坎宁安辞职，前县委员比尔·汉塞尔获任命，完成其剩余任期。穆勒拒绝参加正式选举，县行政主任汤姆·穆勒则竞选民主党提名，接替汉塞尔。

en.s: The 2013 King County Executive election took place on November 5, 2013, following a primary on August 6, 2013. Incumbent County Executive Dow Constantine ran for re-election to a second term. He faced little-known opponents, including perennial candidates Alan Lobdell and Goodspaceguy, and placed first in the primary with 77 percent of the vote. Lobdell, who placed second with 12 percent, advanced to the general election.

zh.s: 2013年金县行政长官选举于2013年11月5日举行，初选于2013年8月6日举行。现任行政长官道·康斯坦丁竞选连任第二届。他面对几位名气不大的对手，包括多次参选的艾伦·洛布德尔和古德斯佩斯盖伊，并以77%的得票率在初选中排名第一。获得12%选票、排名第二的洛布德尔进入普选。

en.s: The 2013 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the election of Nat Robertson. Incumbent mayor Tony Chavonne did not seek reelection to a fifth term.

zh.t: 2013年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举
zh.s: 2013年费耶特维尔市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市市长。纳特·罗伯逊当选。现任市长托尼·沙沃恩没有竞选连任第五届。

en.s: The 2013 Lansing mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013. A primary election took place on August 6, 2013, which narrowed the field of candidates for the general election. Incumbent Mayor Virgil Bernero, the unsuccessful Democratic nominee for Governor of Michigan in 2010, ran for re-election to a third term. His main challenger was former City Councilman Harold J. Leeman, Jr.

zh.s: 2013年兰辛市长选举于2013年11月5日举行。初选于2013年8月6日举行，筛选出进入普选的候选人。现任市长维吉尔·贝尔内罗竞选连任第三届；他曾在2010年代表民主党竞选密歇根州州长，但未能当选。他的主要对手是前市议员哈罗德·J·利曼二世。

en.s: The 2013 Erie County Executive election was held on November 5, 2013. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Barry Grossman, who was first elected in 2009, ran for re-election to a second term. However, he was narrowly defeated in the Democratic primary by former Congresswoman Kathy Dahlkemper, losing renomination 52–48 percent. In the general election, she faced the Republican nominee, businessman and Tea Party activist Don Tucci.

zh.t: 2013年宾夕法尼亚州伊利县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2013年伊利县行政长官选举于2013年11月5日举行。民主党现任行政长官巴里·格罗斯曼于2009年首次当选，竞选连任第二届。但他在民主党初选中以52%比48%的结果，惜败于前国会议员凯西·达尔肯珀，未能获得提名。普选中，达尔肯珀对阵共和党候选人、商人兼茶党活动人士唐·图奇。

en.s: The 2013 Detroit mayoral election was held on November 5, 2013, following a primary election on August 6, 2013. Incumbent Mayor Dave Bing announced that he would not run for re-election, and instead opted to form an exploratory commission to run for Wayne County Executive in 2014. A crowded field of candidates emerged to succeed Bing, with Mike Duggan, the CEO of the Detroit Medical Center and the former Wayne County Prosecutor, emerging as the frontrunner.

zh.s: 2013年底特律市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，初选于2013年8月6日举行。现任市长戴夫·宾宣布不再竞选连任，而是成立探索委员会，考虑在2014年竞选韦恩县行政长官。许多候选人竞选接替宾，其中底特律医疗中心首席执行官、前韦恩县检察官迈克·杜根成为领先者。

en.s: The 2013 mayoral election in Atlanta, Georgia, took place on November 5, 2013, alongside other Atlanta municipal races. Incumbent Mayor Kasim Reed faced no serious opposition and was re-elected with 84% of the vote. He was sworn in for his second term on January 6, 2014.

zh.s: 佐治亚州亚特兰大市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，与亚特兰大其他市政选举同期进行。现任市长卡西姆·里德没有遇到有力对手，以84%的得票率连任。他于2014年1月6日宣誓就任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2013 Saint Paul mayoral election was held on November 5, 2013, to elect the Mayor of Saint Paul, Minnesota for a four-year term. Incumbent Chris Coleman won re-election for a third term in the first round with 78.23% of the vote. This was the first mayoral election in the city's history to use instant-runoff voting, popularly known as ranked choice voting, which was adopted by voters during the city's 2009 elections.

zh.s: 2013年圣保罗市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，选出明尼苏达州圣保罗市市长，任期4年。现任市长克里斯·科尔曼在首轮投票中以78.23%的得票率连任第三届。这是该市历史上首次使用即时决选投票（也称排序选择投票）举行市长选举；选民于2009年投票通过了这项制度。

en.s: The 2013 Northampton County Executive election was held on November 5, 2013. Incumbent Democratic County Executive John Stoffa declined to run for a third term. Bethlehem Mayor John B. Callahan won the Democratic primary over former County Executive Glenn Reibman, whom Stoffa defeated in 2005, and County Councilman Lamont McClure, with 50 percent of the vote. In the general election, he faced Bangor Mayor John Brown, the Republican nominee.

zh.t: 2013年北安普顿县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2013年北安普顿县行政长官选举于2013年11月5日举行。民主党现任行政长官约翰·斯托法没有竞选第三届。伯利恒市长约翰·B·卡拉汉在民主党初选中击败前行政长官格伦·赖布曼和县议员拉蒙特·麦克卢尔，以50%的得票率赢得提名。赖布曼曾在2005年被斯托法击败。普选中，卡拉汉将对阵共和党候选人、班戈市长约翰·布朗。

en.s: The 2013 Miami Beach mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the mayor of Miami Beach, Florida. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. Philip Levine secured election with over 50% of the vote, avoiding a runoff.

zh.s: 2013年迈阿密海滩市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，选出佛罗里达州迈阿密海滩市市长。选举与其他地方选举同期举行，名义上不分党派。菲利普·莱文获得超过50%的选票，当选市长，无需举行决选。

en.t: 2013 Washington's 26th state senate district special election
en.s: A special election was held on November 5, 2013, to elect a senator to fill the rest of Derek Kilmer's term in the Washington State Senate representing the 26th district.

zh.t: 2013年华盛顿州参议院第26选区特别选举
zh.s: 2013年11月5日举行特别选举，选出一名参议员，接替德里克·基尔默在华盛顿州参议院第26选区剩余任期的席位。

en.s: The 2013 Greensboro mayoral election was held on November 5, 2013, to elect the mayor of Greensboro, North Carolina. It saw the election of Nancy Vaughan, who unseated incumbent mayor Robbie Perkins.

zh.s: 2013年格林斯伯勒市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒市市长。南希·沃恩击败现任市长罗比·珀金斯，当选市长。

en.s: The 2013 election for Mayor of Buffalo, New York took place on November 5, 2013. Two-term incumbent Democrat Byron Brown won reelection, defeating Republican Sergio Rodriguez.

zh.s: 纽约州布法罗市市长选举于2013年11月5日举行。已任职两届的民主党现任市长拜伦·布朗击败共和党候选人塞尔希奥·罗德里格斯，成功连任。

en.s: The 2013 Winston-Salem mayoral election was held on November 5, 2013, to elect the mayor of Winston-Salem, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of Allen Joines.

zh.s: 2013年温斯顿-塞勒姆市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆市市长。艾伦·乔因斯成功连任。

en.s: The 2013 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. Usually a nonpartisan primary is held where the top two candidates move on to the general election, however, incumbent mayor Frank G. Jackson and businessman Kenneth A. Lanci were the only two candidates to file, so no primary election was held. While the race was officially nonpartisan, both candidates were Democrats.

zh.s: 2013年克利夫兰市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，选出俄亥俄州克利夫兰市市长。通常该市会举行不分党派初选，由得票最高的两名候选人进入普选；但现任市长弗兰克·G·杰克逊和商人肯尼斯·A·兰奇是仅有的两名报名候选人，因此没有举行初选。尽管选举名义上不分党派，两名候选人实际上都是民主党人。

en.s: The 2013 Seattle mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013, to elect the mayor of Seattle. Incumbent Mayor Michael McGinn ran for election to a second term in office. Municipal elections in Washington are officially non-partisan. A non-partisan primary was held on August 6, 2013. The top two finishers, State Senator Ed Murray, who received 30% of the vote, and incumbent Mayor McGinn, who received 29% of the vote, advanced to the November general election.

zh.s: 2013年西雅图市长选举于2013年11月5日举行，选出西雅图市长。现任市长迈克尔·麦金竞选第二个任期。华盛顿州的市政选举名义上不分党派。无党派初选于2013年8月6日举行。初选中排名前两位的州参议员埃德·默里获得30%的选票，现任市长麦金获得29%的选票，两人进入11月普选。

en.s: The 2013 Pittsburgh mayoral election took place on November 5, 2013. Democrat Bill Peduto was elected the 60th Mayor of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. The primary election was held on May 21, 2013. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Luke Ravenstahl, although eligible for a second full term, did not seek reelection as Mayor of Pittsburgh. Initially, Luke Ravenstahl had indicated an intention to seek reelection in the 2013 election and had led early Democratic primary polling.

zh.s: 2013年匹兹堡市长选举于2013年11月5日举行。民主党人比尔·佩杜托当选宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市第60任市长。初选于2013年5月21日举行。民主党现任市长卢克·雷文斯塔尔虽然有资格竞选第二个完整任期，但没有竞选连任。他最初曾表示打算在2013年竞选连任，并在早期民主党初选民调中领先。

en.s: All 80 seats in the General Assembly were up for election this year. In each Legislative district, there are two people elected; the top two winners in the general election are the ones sent to the Assembly. Typically, the two members of each party run as a team in each election. After the previous election, Democrats captured 48 seats while the Republicans won 32 seats.

zh.s: 2013年，新泽西州州议会全部80个席位均进行改选。每个立法选区选出两名议员，大选得票最高的两人进入州议会。通常，两党各自的两名候选人会组成竞选团队。上届选举后，民主党赢得48席，共和党赢得32席。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 2013 was held on Tuesday, November 5.

zh.s: 2013年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月5日星期二举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Elections for members of the New York City Council were held in 2013. Primary elections were held on September 10, 2013, for all 51 districts of the city council. Many incumbents are termed out of office, while others were defeated in the primary, resulting in the largest turnover of council members since 2001, when 36 new members were nominated and elected to office in the council.

zh.s: 2013年举行纽约市议会选举。全市51个市议会选区的初选于2013年9月10日举行。许多现任议员因任期限制无法继续任职，另有一些人在初选中落败，因此议员更替人数创2001年以来新高；2001年有36名新议员获提名并当选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2013 New Jersey Senate election coincided with Chris Christie's landslide re-election to a second term as Governor of New Jersey. 2013 was an election of remarkable stability in the Senate, as just one seat (that of gubernatorial nominee Buono) failed to return its incumbent to office. As a corollary, no seats changed party for the second consecutive election.

zh.s: 2013年新泽西州参议院选举与克里斯·克里斯蒂压倒性连任州长、开始第二个任期同时进行。这次参议院选举十分平稳：只有州长候选人芭芭拉·布奥诺的席位未能连任。连续第二轮选举没有席位易手。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Bento Rodrigues dam disaster occurred on 5 November 2015, when an iron ore tailings dam in Bento Rodrigues, a subdistrict of Mariana, Brazil, suffered a catastrophic failure, causing flooding and at least 17 deaths.At least 16 people have been injured. About 60 million cubic meters of iron waste flowed into the Doce River. Toxic brown mudflows reached the Atlantic Ocean 17 days later.The total impact and environmental consequences to the river and the beaches near its mouth, or to the wildlife are still unclear.This incident has been described as the worst environmental disaster in Brazil's history.

zh.t: 本托罗德里格斯水坝灾难
zh.s: 2015年11月5日，巴西马里亚纳市辖区本托罗德里格斯的一座铁矿尾矿坝发生灾难性溃坝，引发洪水，至少17人死亡，至少16人受伤。约6000万立方米含铁废料流入多西河。17天后，有毒的棕色泥流抵达大西洋。对河流、河口附近海滩和野生动物造成的总体影响及环境后果仍不清楚。这起事故被称为巴西历史上最严重的环境灾难。

en.s: Elections to local bodies (Panchayats, Municipalities and Corporations) in Kerala were held in two phrases, on 2 and 5 November 2015. The Left Democratic Front (LDF) won more than half of all gram panchayats and municipalities, and both they and the United Democratic Front (UDF) won majorities in seven out of fourteen district panchayats each. The LDF also won mayorship in four corporations and the UDF in two.

zh.s: 2015年11月2日和5日分两轮举行喀拉拉邦地方机构选举，包括乡村议会、市镇和市政公司。左翼民主阵线赢得了半数以上的乡村议会和市镇席位；左翼民主阵线和联合民主阵线分别在14个县级乡村议会中的7个取得多数。左翼民主阵线还赢得4个市政公司的市长职位，联合民主阵线赢得2个。

en.s: Election to Kolazhy Grama Panchayat was held on 5 November 2015 as part of Local Body Elections, Kerala.Counting was held on 7 November 2015. UDF secured majority by winning 10 out of 17 seats in the panchayath.

zh.s: 科拉日乡村议会选举于2015年11月5日举行，是喀拉拉邦地方选举的一部分。计票于2015年11月7日进行。联合民主阵线赢得17个席位中的10席，占据多数。

en.s: The 2015 Flint mayoral election took place on November 5, 2015, following the primary election that took place on August 4, 2015. Incumbent Mayor Dayne Walling ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged by two members of the City Council, Eric Mays and Wantwaz Diaz, as well as businesswoman Karen Weaver. Walling placed first in the primary, winning 44 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2015年弗林特市长选举于2015年11月5日举行，此前初选于2015年8月4日举行。现任市长戴恩·沃林竞选连任第三届。他的对手包括两名市议员埃里克·梅斯和旺特瓦兹·迪亚兹，以及商人凯伦·韦弗。沃林在初选中排名第一，获得44%的选票。

en.s: Local elections were held in all municipalities in Bulgaria on 25 October 2015 (first round) and on 1 November 2015 (second round). Voters elected municipal mayors, village mayors and members of municipal councils of 265 municipalities. They were held alongside a referendum on the electoral code.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 保加利亚所有市镇于2015年10月25日（第一轮）和11月1日（第二轮）举行地方选举。选民选出了265个市镇的市长、村长和市议会成员。选举同期还举行了一场关于选举法的公投。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件日期。
