en.s: The 2016 AFC Cup final was the final match of the 2016 AFC Cup, the 13th edition of the AFC Cup, a football competition organized by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) for clubs from 'developing countries' in Asia according to the Vision Asia plan. The final was contested as a single match between Iraqi team Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya and Indian team Bengaluru. The match was hosted by Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya at the Suheim Bin Hamad Stadium in Doha on 5 November 2016.

zh.s: 2016年亚足联杯决赛是2016年亚足联杯的决赛，该赛事是亚洲足球联合会为亚洲“发展中地区”俱乐部举办的足球赛事。决赛于2016年11月5日在多哈的苏海姆·本·哈马德体育场举行，由伊拉克球队空军体育俱乐部对阵印度球队班加罗尔队。比赛采用单场决胜制，由空军体育俱乐部承办。

en.s: On November 5, 2017, Devin Patrick Kelley shot and killed 26 people and wounded 22 others, including an unborn child, at the First Baptist Church in Sutherland Springs, Texas, United States. Kelley was subsequently shot and wounded, and drove away from the church. While being chased, Kelley killed himself with a gunshot to the head.

zh.t: 萨瑟兰斯普林斯教堂枪击案
zh.s: 2017年11月5日，德文·帕特里克·凯利在美国得克萨斯州萨瑟兰斯普林斯第一浸信会教堂开枪，打死26人、打伤22人，其中包括一名未出生的婴儿。凯利随后中枪受伤并驾车离开教堂。在被追捕期间，他用枪击中头部自杀。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The 2017 Bound for Glory was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Impact Wrestling. It took place on November 5, 2017, at the Aberdeen Pavilion in Ottawa, Ontario. It was the thirteenth event under the Bound for Glory chronology, the second and last Impact pay-per-view event of 2017.

zh.s: 2017年《荣耀之路》是Impact摔角举办的一场职业摔角付费观看赛事。赛事于2017年11月5日在加拿大安大略省渥太华的阿伯丁馆举行。这是“荣耀之路”系列第13场赛事，也是Impact在2017年举办的第二场、也是最后一场付费观看赛事。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the city of Montreal, Quebec, Canada, on November 5, 2017, as part of the 2017 Quebec municipal elections. Voters elected 65 positions on the Montreal City Council, including the mayor, borough mayors, and city councillors, as well as 38 borough councillors.

zh.s: 2017年11月5日，加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔市举行地方选举，作为2017年魁北克市政选举的一部分。选民选出蒙特利尔市议会的65个职位，包括市长、区长和市议员，以及38名区议员。

en.s: The 2017 Sicilian regional election for the renewal of the Sicilian Regional Assembly and the election of the President of Sicily was held on 5 November 2017. Incumbent President Rosario Crocetta was not his party's candidate due to his low popularity. Nello Musumeci, leader of the movement Diventerà Bellissima, was elected president.

zh.s: 2017年11月5日举行西西里大区选举，选出西西里大区议会议员和大区主席。现任主席罗萨里奥·克罗切塔因支持率低，没有获得所属政党的提名。美丽未来运动领袖内洛·穆苏梅奇当选主席。

en.s: The 2017 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 2017 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on Sunday 5 November 2017 at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin, and was contested by Cork City and Dundalk. The match was a repeat of the 2015, and 2016 finals.

zh.s: 2017年爱尔兰足协杯决赛是2017年爱尔兰足协杯的决赛，于2017年11月5日星期日在都柏林的英杰华体育场举行，由科克城队对阵邓多克队。这是两队继2015年和2016年之后再次在决赛相遇。

en.s: The Canadian province of Quebec held municipal elections in its municipalities on November 5, 2017.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省各市镇于2017年11月5日举行市政选举。

en.s: The 2017 Boucherville municipal election was an election that was held on the 5th of November 2017 to elect Boucherville's mayor and eight councillors as part of the 2017 Quebec municipal elections. Jean Martel and his party's eight candidates were elected. The voter turnout was 47.7%. The election results were made available on the website of Québec's Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing.

zh.s: 2017年布谢维尔市政选举于2017年11月5日举行，选出市长和8名市议员，属于魁北克2017年市政选举的一部分。让·马特尔和他所属政党的8名候选人均当选。投票率为47.7%。选举结果由魁北克市政事务与住房部发布。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on November 5, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年爱德华王子岛省市政选举
zh.s: 加拿大爱德华王子岛省于2018年11月5日举行市政选举。

en.s: The 2019 Flint mayoral election was held on November 5, 2019, following a primary election on August 6, 2019. Incumbent Mayor Karen Weaver, who was first elected in 2015 and retained in a recall election in 2017, ran for re-election to a second term. She was challenged by State Representative Sheldon Neeley, contractor Don Pfeiffer, and former city administrator Gregory Eason.

zh.s: 2019年弗林特市长选举于2019年11月5日举行，初选于同年8月6日举行。现任市长凯伦·韦弗于2015年首次当选，并在2017年罢免投票中留任，这次竞选连任第二个任期。她的对手包括州众议员谢尔登·尼利、承包商唐·普费弗，以及前市政管理人员格雷戈里·伊森。

en.s: The 2019 United States attorney general elections were held primarily on November 5, 2019, in 3 states. The previous attorney general elections for this group of states took place in 2015. One state attorney general ran for reelection and won, while Democrat Jim Hood of Mississippi and Andy Beshear of Kentucky did not run for re-election to run for governor.

zh.s: 2019年美国3个州主要于11月5日举行总检察长选举。这些州上一次举行同一组总检察长选举是在2015年。一名州总检察长竞选连任并获胜；密西西比州民主党人吉姆·胡德和肯塔基州的安迪·贝希尔则没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选州长。

en.s: The 2019 Wichita mayoral election took place on November 5, 2019, to elect the mayor of Wichita, Kansas. The election is officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Jeff Longwell ran for reelection and faced Brandon Whipple in the runoff election. Whipple defeated Longwell, who conceded on election night.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行堪萨斯州威奇托市长选举。这场选举不设党派。现任市长杰夫·朗韦尔竞选连任，并在决选中与布兰登·惠普尔对决。惠普尔击败朗韦尔；朗韦尔在选举当晚承认败选。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Kentucky on November 5, 2019, with all executive offices in the state up for election. Primary elections were held on May 21, 2019.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行肯塔基州大选，州内所有行政职位都进行选举。党内初选于2019年5月21日举行。

en.s: The 2019 Virginia municipal elections were held on November 5, 2019 to elect members of the County Board of Supervisors, Soil and Water Directors, and City School Board members.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行弗吉尼亚州地方选举，选出县监事会、土壤和水资源管理机构以及市立学校董事会成员。

en.s: Portland, Maine, held an election for mayor on November 5, 2019. It was the third election to be held since Portland voters approved a citywide referendum changing the city charter to recreate an elected mayor position in 2010. Kate Snyder, the newly citizen-elected mayor, won a four-year term in the full-time position, and will exercise the powers and duties enumerated in Article II Section 5 of the Portland City Charter.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日，缅因州波特兰市举行市长选举。这是波特兰选民于2010年通过全市公投、恢复直选市长职位后举行的第三次选举。凯特·斯奈德当选市长，任期四年。这是一个全职职位，市长将行使《波特兰市宪章》第二编第5条规定的权力和职责。

en.s: An election for Mayor of Indianapolis was held on November 5, 2019. Joe Hogsett, the incumbent mayor, sought and won reelection for a second term in office.

zh.t: 2019年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行印第安纳波利斯市长选举。现任市长乔·霍格塞特竞选连任，并成功赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 2019 Virginia Senate election was held on November 5, 2019, concurrently with the House election, to elect members to all 40 seats in the Senate of Virginia for the 161st Virginia General Assembly and the 162nd Virginia General Assembly. Primaries were held on June 11.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行弗吉尼亚州参议院选举，与众议院选举同时进行，选出第161届和第162届弗吉尼亚州议会的议员。弗吉尼亚州参议院全部40个席位都需要改选。党内初选于6月11日举行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Mississippi on November 5, 2019. All executive offices in the state were up for election. The primary election was held on August 6, 2019, and runoff elections were held on August 27, 2019. Although the Democrats came close to winning the governorship, they ultimately failed to do so.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行密西西比州大选，州内所有行政职位都进行选举。党内初选于2019年8月6日举行，决选于2019年8月27日举行。民主党人一度接近赢得州长职位，但最终未能胜出。

en.s: The 2019 Philadelphia mayoral election was held on November 5, 2019, to elect the mayor of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Incumbent mayor Jim Kenney, first elected in 2015, ran for reelection. Kenney's platform included raising the minimum wage to $15 per hour, providing city support for the maintenance of supervised injection sites, implementing a city soda tax, and ensuring the city's compliance with the Paris Climate Agreement.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州费城市长选举。现任市长吉姆·肯尼于2015年首次当选，这次竞选连任。他的竞选纲领包括把最低工资提高到每小时15美元、由市政府支持维护监督注射场所、开征城市汽水税，以及确保费城市遵守《巴黎气候协定》。

en.s: The 2019 Queens County District Attorney election was held on November 5, 2019, to elect the Queens County District Attorney. The incumbent, Richard Brown, had announced in January 2019 that he would not seek an eighth term; Brown then died in office that May at the age of 86. The Democratic primary election was held on June 25, 2019.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行皇后区地方检察官选举。现任地方检察官理查德·布朗于2019年1月宣布不竞选第八个任期。同年5月，他在任内去世，享年86岁。民主党初选于2019年6月25日举行。

en.s: The 2019 Elections for New Jersey's General Assembly was held on November 5, 2019. All 80 seats in the Assembly were up for election. The candidates who won were a part of the 219th New Jersey Legislature. All 80 seats of the New Jersey General Assembly were up for election. Democrats held a 54–26 supermajority in the lower house prior to the election.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行新泽西州州议会选举，州议会全部80个席位都进行改选。当选者将进入第219届新泽西州议会。选举前，民主党在州众议院以54席对26席占据足以推翻州长否决的多数。

en.s: The 2019 United States state legislative elections were held on November 5, 2019. Seven legislative chambers in four states held regularly scheduled elections. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in three states. Democrats gained majorities of both houses of the Virginia General Assembly, giving them complete control of the legislature for the first time since 1996, and the first trifecta since 1994.

zh.s: 2019年美国州议会选举于11月5日举行。4个州的7个州议会院举行定期选举。这些非总统选举年选举与其他州和地方选举同期举行，其中包括3个州的州长选举。民主党赢得弗吉尼亚州议会两院多数席位，首次自1996年以来完全控制州议会，并自1994年以来首次全面掌控州政府。

en.s: The 2019 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 2019, to choose the next governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Governor Phil Bryant was ineligible to run for a third term due to term limits. The Democratic Party nominated incumbent Attorney General Jim Hood, the only Democrat holding statewide office in Mississippi; the Republican Party nominated incumbent Lieutenant Governor Tate Reeves.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行密西西比州州长选举。由于任期限制，共和党籍现任州长菲尔·布莱恩特不能竞选第三个任期。民主党提名了现任州检察长吉姆·胡德，他是密西西比州唯一担任全州公职的民主党人；共和党提名了现任副州长泰特·里夫斯。

en.s: The 2019 Kentucky gubernatorial election took place on November 5, 2019, to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of Kentucky. The Democratic nominee, Andy Beshear, defeated Republican incumbent governor Matt Bevin. It was the closest gubernatorial election by votes since 1899, and was the closest race of the 2019 gubernatorial election cycle. This was the only statewide victory in 2019 for Democrats in Kentucky.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行肯塔基州州长和副州长选举。民主党候选人安迪·贝希尔击败共和党籍现任州长马特·贝文。按票数计算，这是自1899年以来差距最小的肯塔基州州长选举，也是2019年州长选举中竞争最激烈的一场。这是民主党人2019年在肯塔基州唯一赢得的全州选举。

en.s: The 2019 Orlando mayoral election took place on November 5, 2019. Incumbent Mayor Buddy Dyer ran for re-election to a fifth full term. He was challenged by City Councilman Sam Ings and nonprofit businesswoman Aretha Simons. Dyer was a favorite to win re-election, winning the endorsements of prominent local politicians and significantly outraising his opponents.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行奥兰多市长选举。现任市长巴迪·戴尔竞选第五个完整任期。市议员萨姆·英格斯和非营利机构女企业家阿瑞莎·西蒙斯向他发起挑战。戴尔是连任热门，获得当地知名政界人士支持，筹集的竞选资金也远超对手。

en.s: The 2019 Kentucky Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 2019, to elect the secretary of state of Kentucky. Primary elections were held on May 21, 2019. Incumbent Democratic secretary Alison Lundergan Grimes was ineligible to run for a third term due to term limits, creating the first open election for secretary of state since 2003. Republican nominee Michael Adams narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Heather French Henry.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行肯塔基州州务卿选举。党内初选于2019年5月21日举行。由于任期限制，民主党籍现任州务卿艾莉森·伦德根·格莱姆斯不能竞选第三个任期，因此这是自2003年以来首次没有现任者参选的州务卿选举。共和党候选人迈克尔·亚当斯以微弱优势击败民主党候选人希瑟·弗伦奇·亨利。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Jersey on November 5, 2019. Primary elections were held on June 4. The only state positions that were up in this election cycle were all 80 seats in the New Jersey General Assembly and one Senate special election in the 1st Legislative District. In addition to the State Legislative elections, numerous county offices and freeholders in addition to municipal offices were up for election.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行新泽西州大选，党内初选于6月4日举行。这一选举周期中，州级职位只有新泽西州州议会全部80个席位，以及第1选区的一场参议院特别选举需要改选。除了州议会选举外，许多县级公职、自由持有人职位和市政职位也进行选举。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 5, 2019, in Kentucky and Mississippi, and on October 12, 2019, with a runoff on November 16, in Louisiana. These elections formed part of the 2019 United States elections. The last regular gubernatorial elections for all three states were in 2015. The Democrats had to defend an incumbent in Louisiana, while the Republicans had to defend an incumbent in Kentucky plus an open seat in Mississippi.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日在肯塔基州和密西西比州举行美国州长选举。路易斯安那州选举于2019年10月12日举行，11月16日举行决选。这些选举是2019年美国选举的一部分。三个州上一次举行常规州长选举都在2015年。民主党需要守住路易斯安那州的现任席位；共和党需要守住肯塔基州的现任席位，并争夺密西西比州的空缺席位。

en.s: The 2019 Virginia House of Delegates election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2019, concurrently with the elections for the Senate of Virginia, to elect members to the 161st Virginia General Assembly. All 100 seats in the Virginia House of Delegates were up for election.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日（星期二）举行弗吉尼亚州众议院选举，与弗吉尼亚州参议院选举同时进行，选出第161届弗吉尼亚州议会议员。州众议院全部100个席位都需要改选。

en.s: The 2019 mayoral election in Charlotte, North Carolina, was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2019. A primary was held on September 10, 2019. A primary runoff, if needed, would have been October 8, 2019, but one was not needed because incumbent Mayor Vi Lyles handily won the Democratic primary. The filing deadline for this election was July 19, 2019. the Mayor Lyles, first elected for a two-year term in 2017, was eligible to seek re-election.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日（星期二）举行北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市长选举。初选于2019年9月10日举行。如有需要，初选决选原定于2019年10月8日举行，但现任市长维·莱尔斯在民主党初选中轻松获胜，因此不需要举行决选。候选人登记截止日期为2019年7月19日。莱尔斯于2017年首次当选，任期两年，这次有资格竞选连任。

en.t: 2019 New York City Public Advocate election
en.s: The 2019 New York City Public Advocate election was held on November 5, 2019. Incumbent Jumaane Williams, who won the special election earlier in the year, was elected.

zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行纽约市公益维护人选举。此前在当年特别选举中获胜的现任公益维护人朱马内·威廉姆斯当选。

en.s: The 2019 Mississippi Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2019, to elect the Attorney General of Mississippi. Incumbent Jim Hood declined to seek re-election to a fifth term, instead running unsuccessfully for Governor. State Treasurer Lynn Fitch won the Republican nomination in a primary runoff against Andy Taggart, and she defeated Democratic nominee Jennifer Riley Collins in the general election.

zh.t: 2019年密西西比州州检察长选举
zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行密西西比州州检察长选举。现任州检察长吉姆·胡德没有寻求第五个任期，而是转而竞选州长，但未能当选。州财政部长林恩·菲奇在党内决选中击败安迪·塔格特，赢得共和党提名；她随后在大选中击败民主党候选人詹妮弗·莱利·柯林斯。

en.s: The 2019 Indianapolis City–County Council elections took place on November 5, 2019, with all 25 seats up for election. Before the elections Democrats held a 14–11-seat majority. Primaries for the council were held May 7, 2019. Following the elections Democrats expanded their control of the council with a 20–5 majority. This marked the first time in Indianapolis history that Democrats would hold a super majority on the council.

zh.t: 2019年印第安纳波利斯市县议会选举
zh.s: 2019年11月5日举行印第安纳波利斯市县议会选举，全部25个席位都进行改选。选举前，民主党以14席对11席占多数。议会初选于2019年5月7日举行。选举后，民主党以20席对5席扩大了多数。这是印第安纳波利斯历史上民主党首次在议会取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2019 San Francisco District Attorney election was held on November 5, 2019, to elect the next District Attorney of San Francisco. The election, which was held alongside the 2019 mayoral election in which incumbent mayor London Breed won her first full term, was won by public defender Chesa Boudin. The incumbent district attorney, George Gascón, announced in October 2018 that he would not seek a third term.

zh.s: 2019年旧金山地方检察官选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出下一任旧金山地方检察官。选举与2019年市长选举同期举行，时任市长伦敦·布里德赢得首个完整任期。公设辩护人切萨·布丁赢得地方检察官选举。现任地方检察官乔治·加斯孔于2018年10月宣布不竞选第三届。

en.s: The election for mayor of the City and County of San Francisco was held on November 5, 2019. Incumbent mayor London Breed, who had previously been elected in a special election to fill the unexpired term of the late Mayor Ed Lee, was reelected to a first full term in office. All local elections in California are nonpartisan.

zh.s: 旧金山市市长选举于2019年11月5日举行。现任市长伦敦·布里德此前在特别选举中当选，接替已故市长李孟贤，完成其未满任期。这次她成功连任，开始首个完整任期。加利福尼亚州所有地方选举名义上都不分党派。

en.s: The 2019 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 5, 2019, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Dave Somers ran for re-election to a second term. However, no candidate announced a campaign against Somers by the candidate filing deadline, and he was re-elected unopposed.

zh.t: 2019年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2019年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县行政长官。民主党现任行政长官戴夫·萨默斯竞选连任第二届。候选人报名截止日期前，没有人宣布参选挑战萨默斯，因此他自动连任。

en.s: The 2019 South Bend, Indiana mayoral election was held on November 5, 2019, to determine the next mayor of South Bend, Indiana. On December 17, 2018, incumbent two-term Democratic mayor Pete Buttigieg announced that he would not seek reelection to a third term. Speculation arose that Buttigieg was considering a run for President of the United States, and Buttigieg would later announce his 2020 presidential campaign.

zh.s: 2019年印第安纳州南本德市长选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出该市下一任市长。2018年12月17日，已任职两届的民主党现任市长皮特·布蒂吉格宣布不竞选第三届。外界猜测他正考虑竞选美国总统；他后来宣布参加2020年总统选举。

en.s: The 2019 Boise mayoral election was held on November 5, 2019, to determine the mayor of Boise, Idaho. The election was officially nonpartisan. The election was won by Boise City Council the president Lauren McLean, who defeated the incumbent mayor Dave Bieter in a runoff election held on December 3, 2019.

zh.s: 2019年博伊西市长选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出爱达荷州博伊西市市长。选举名义上不分党派。博伊西市议会主席劳伦·麦克莱恩在2019年12月3日举行的决选中击败现任市长戴夫·比特，当选市长。

en.s: The 2019 Spokane mayoral election took place on November 5, 2019, to elect the mayor of Spokane, Washington. The previous mayor, David Condon was unable to run due to term limits. It saw former local news anchor Nadine Woodward defeat former Spokane City Council president Ben Stuckart by a margin of just over one percentage point.

zh.s: 2019年斯波坎市长选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出华盛顿州斯波坎市市长。前市长戴维·康登受任期限制，不能参选。前地方新闻主播纳丁·伍德沃德击败斯波坎市议会前主席本·斯图卡特，领先略多于1个百分点。

en.s: The 2019 Allegheny County Executive election was held on November 5, 2019. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Rich Fitzgerald ran for re-election to a third term. He faced no opposition in the primary and was opposed by former County Councilman Matt Drozd, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Fitzgerald defeated Drozd in a landslide, winning 68 percent of the vote to Drozd's 32 percent, winning his third and final term as County Executive.

zh.t: 2019年阿勒格尼县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2019年阿勒格尼县行政长官选举于2019年11月5日举行。民主党现任行政长官里奇·菲茨杰拉德竞选连任第三届。他在初选中没有对手，普选中对阵共和党候选人、前县议员马特·德罗兹。菲茨杰拉德以68%的得票率大胜，德罗兹获得32%，他赢得第三个、也是最后一个任期。

en.s: The 2019 Grand Rapids mayoral election took place on November 5, 2019. Incumbent Mayor Rosalynn Bliss ran for re-election to a second term. She was challenged by pastor Daniel Schutte, a 2018 Republican candidate for the State House. Because only two candidates filed, the August primary election was cancelled. Bliss defeated Schutte in a landslide, winning 84 percent of the vote to Schotte's 16 percent.

zh.s: 2019年大急流城市长选举于2019年11月5日举行。现任市长罗莎琳·布利斯竞选连任第二届。她的对手是牧师丹尼尔·舒特；舒特曾在2018年作为共和党候选人竞选州众议院。由于只有两名候选人报名，8月的初选取消。布利斯以84%的得票率大胜舒特，后者获得16%。

en.s: The 2019 Salt Lake City mayoral election took place on November 5, 2019, to elect the mayor of Salt Lake City, Utah. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and is officially nonpartisan. In what was regarded to be a surprise, first-term incumbent mayor Jackie Biskupski announced on March 16, 2019, that she would not be seeking a second term, citing a "serious and complex family situation".

zh.s: 2019年盐湖城市长选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出犹他州盐湖城市市长。选举与其他地方选举同期举行，名义上不分党派。出乎许多人意料的是，首届任期的现任市长杰基·比斯库普斯基于2019年3月16日宣布不竞选第二届，并称原因是“严重而复杂的家庭情况”。

en.s: The 2019 Seattle City Council election was held on November 5, 2019. Seven seats of the nine-member Seattle City Council were up for election. Four incumbent members of the city council did not run for reelection, while the remaining three incumbents all won reelection. Sally Bagshaw, Bruce Harrell, Rob Johnson, and Mike O'Brien all announced that they would not seek reelection to the city council.

zh.s: 2019年西雅图市议会选举于2019年11月5日举行。西雅图市议会9个席位中有7个席位改选。4名现任议员没有竞选连任，另外3名现任议员都成功连任。莎莉·巴格肖、布鲁斯·哈雷尔、罗布·约翰逊和迈克·奥布莱恩都宣布不再竞选市议会议员。

en.s: The 2019 Savannah mayoral election held an initial round on November 5, 2019, with a runoff held on December 3, 2019. Incumbent mayor Eddie DeLoach was defeated by longtime alderman Van R. Johnson.

zh.s: 2019年萨凡纳市长选举首轮投票于2019年11月5日举行，决选于2019年12月3日举行。长期担任市议员的范·R·约翰逊击败现任市长埃迪·德洛奇。

en.s: The 2019 Des Moines mayoral election had an initial round held on November 5, 2019, with a runoff scheduled for December 3 to elect the mayor of Des Moines, Iowa. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Frank Cownie. Cownie's margin of victory in the runoff was narrower than the margin of victory in any of his previous mayoral elections.

zh.s: 2019年得梅因市长选举首轮投票于2019年11月5日举行，决选原定于12月3日举行，以选出艾奥瓦州得梅因市市长。现任市长弗兰克·考尼成功连任。他在决选中的胜选优势小于此前任何一次市长选举。

en.s: The 2019 Henrico County Commonwealth's Attorney election was held on November 5, 2019, to elect the Commonwealth's Attorney of Henrico County, Virginia, concurrently with elections to the Senate of Virginia and Virginia House of Delegates. Incumbent Democratic Commonwealth's Attorney Shannon Taylor won reelection to a second term against Republican nominee Owen Conway, a former worker for the office, by a wide margin.

zh.t: 2019年亨利科县地方检察官选举
zh.s: 2019年亨利科县地方检察官选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出弗吉尼亚州亨利科县地方检察官，并与弗吉尼亚州参议院和众议院选举同期进行。民主党现任地方检察官香农·泰勒击败共和党候选人欧文·康韦，以较大优势连任第二届。康韦曾在该办公室工作。

en.s: The 2019 Durham mayoral election was held on November 5, 2019, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. Steve Schewel was elected to a second term as mayor. The only other candidate to file to run before the deadline was Sylvester Williams, a pastor who also ran for mayor in 2011, 2013, and 2017. Because only two candidates filed to run, the October primary election was cancelled.

zh.s: 2019年达勒姆市长选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市市长。史蒂夫·谢维尔当选并开始第二个任期。报名截止前，只有另一名候选人、西尔维斯特·威廉姆斯提交了参选申请；他是一名牧师，曾于2011年、2013年和2017年竞选市长。由于只有两人报名，原定10月举行的初选取消。

en.s: Bridgeport, Connecticut, held an election for mayor on November 5, 2019. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor and former 2018 gubernatorial candidate Joseph Ganim.

zh.t: 2019年康涅狄格州布里奇波特市长选举
zh.s: 康涅狄格州布里奇波特市于2019年11月5日举行市长选举。现任市长、2018年州长选举候选人约瑟夫·加尼姆成功连任。

en.s: The 2019 Tucson mayoral election was held on November 5, 2019. It saw the election of Regina Romero.

zh.s: 2019年图森市长选举于2019年11月5日举行。雷吉娜·罗梅罗当选市长。

en.s: The 2019 Columbus mayoral election took place on November 5, 2019, to elect the Mayor of Columbus, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan. Since there were fewer than three candidates, no primary was necessary. Incumbent mayor Andrew Ginther ran unopposed for reelection to a second term. However, write-in votes were allowed.

zh.t: 2019年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举
zh.s: 2019年哥伦布市长选举于2019年11月5日举行，选出俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长。选举名义上不分党派。由于候选人不足3人，无需举行初选。现任市长安德鲁·金瑟没有对手，竞选连任第二届。选民仍可投写入票。

en.s: The 2019 election for the Mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina was held on November 5, 2019. Mayor Mitch Colvin, who was first elected in 2017, ran for re-election to a second term. No other candidate filed to run. Colvin was re-elected with 94.8% of the vote, with 5.2% of the vote going to various write-in candidates.

zh.t: 2019年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市市长选举于2019年11月5日举行。市长米奇·科尔文于2017年首次当选，这次竞选连任第二届。没有其他候选人报名。科尔文以94.8%的得票率连任，另有5.2%的选票投给了不同的写入候选人。

en.s: The 2019 Kentucky Attorney General election was conducted on November 5. Primary elections occurred on May 21, 2019. The general election was held on November 5, 2019. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Andy Beshear declined to seek reelection to a second term to instead successfully run for Governor. Republican nominee Daniel Cameron won with 57.8% of the vote. He became the first Republican elected attorney general of Kentucky since Eldon S.

zh.s: 2019年肯塔基州总检察长选举于11月5日举行。初选于2019年5月21日举行，大选于2019年11月5日举行。民主党籍时任总检察长安迪·贝希尔没有竞选连任第二个任期，而是成功竞选州长。共和党候选人丹尼尔·卡梅伦以57.8%的得票率胜选。他成为自1943年埃尔登·S.·杜米特以来首位当选肯塔基州总检察长的共和党人，也是该州首位非裔总检察长。

en.s: The 2019 Houston mayoral election was decided by a runoff that took place on December 14, 2019. Incumbent mayor Sylvester Turner defeated attorney Tony Buzbee in the runoff by a margin of 56.04% to 43.96%. No candidate won a majority of the vote during the general election on November 5, 2019, when Turner received 46% of the vote and Buzbee received 29%.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2019年休斯敦市长选举由12月14日举行的第二轮投票决出胜者。现任市长西尔维斯特·特纳以56.04%对43.96%的得票率击败律师托尼·布兹比。11月5日的大选中，没有候选人获得多数票；特纳获得46%，布兹比获得29%。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第一轮日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines on 5 November 2020. Nomination day was 20 October 2020. The result was a victory for the Unity Labour Party, its fifth in a row; the party won nine of the fifteen seats, gaining one seat. These elections marked the first time since 1998 that the party which received the most votes did not win the most seats and the first time since 1994 that the New Democratic Party won the popular vote.

zh.t: 2020年圣文森特和格林纳丁斯大选
zh.s: 2020年11月5日，圣文森特和格林纳丁斯举行大选。候选人提名日为2020年10月20日。团结工党连续第五次获胜，赢得15个席位中的9席，比上次增加1席。这是自1998年以来，得票最多的政党未能赢得最多席位的首次选举；也是自1994年以来，新民主党首次赢得普选票多数。

en.s: On November 5, 2021, a fatal crowd crush occurred during the Astroworld Festival, a one time tour hosted by American rapper Travis Scott at NRG Park in Houston, Texas. Eight people were pronounced dead on the day of the incident, and two more died in the hospital in the following days. The Harris County medical examiner's office declared the cause of death to be compressive asphyxiation while the manner of death was ruled an accident.

zh.t: 阿斯特罗世界音乐节人群挤压事故
zh.s: 2021年11月5日，美国说唱歌手特拉维斯·斯科特在得克萨斯州休斯敦NRG公园举办的一次性巡演阿斯特罗世界音乐节期间，发生致命的人群挤压事故。事发当天有8人被宣布死亡，随后几天又有两人在医院去世。哈里斯县法医办公室认定死因是压迫性窒息，死亡方式判定为意外。

en.s: Bellator 270: Queally vs. Pitbull 2 (also known as Bellator Dublin) was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA that took place on November 5, 2021 at 3Arena in Dublin, Ireland. The event marked Bellator's first return to Irish soil since February 2020.

zh.s: Bellator 270：奎利对皮特布尔二番战（也称Bellator都柏林）是Bellator MMA举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2021年11月5日在爱尔兰都柏林的3Arena举行。这是Bellator自2020年2月以来首次重返爱尔兰。

en.s: The Crash X Aniversario, also known as The Crash Decimo Aniversario (Spanish for The Crash 10th Anniversary Show), was a professional wrestling supercard event, scripted and produced by the Mexican lucha libre promotion The Crash Lucha Libre, which took place on November 5, 2021 at Auditorio Fausto Gutierrez in The Crash's home town of Tijuana, Baja California. It was the fifth event under The Crash Aniversario chronology.

zh.s: The Crash十周年纪念赛又称“Crash十周年演出”，是一场职业摔角大型赛事，由墨西哥摔角联盟The Crash Lucha Libre编排并制作，于2021年11月5日在该联盟所在城市下加利福尼亚州蒂华纳的福斯托·古铁雷斯礼堂举行。这是The Crash周年纪念赛事系列的第5场。

en.s: The 2022 Crown Jewel was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE. It was the fourth annual Crown Jewel and took place on November 5, 2022, at Mrsool Park in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia as part of Riyadh Season, held for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw and SmackDown brand divisions.

zh.s: 2022年《皇冠之珠》是美国职业摔角公司WWE举办的付费观看和线上直播赛事。这是第四届年度《皇冠之珠》赛事，于2022年11月5日在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的穆尔索尔公园举行，属于利雅得季的一部分，参赛选手来自WWE的Raw和SmackDown两个品牌。

en.s: Battle Autumn '22 was a professional wrestling event produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW). It took place on November 5, 2022 in Osaka, Japan at Osaka Prefectural Gymnasium. Battle Autumn featured the return of Shota Umino, who returned after Will Ospreay called out any NJPW wrestler, after the successful defense of his IWGP United States Championship against Tetsuya Naito.

zh.s: 《秋季之战 ’22》是新日本职业摔角举办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2022年11月5日在日本大阪府立体育会馆举行。威尔·奥斯普雷卫冕IWGP美国冠军后，向任何新日本职业摔角选手发出挑战，海野翔太因此回归。

en.s: The 2022 Rising Phoenix World Championships was a professional bodybuilding competition for women that was held in conjunction with Arizona Women's Pro and the NPC Wings of Strength Arizona Women's Extravaganza. It was held on 5 November 2022 at the Gila River Resorts & Casinos – Wild Horse Pass in Chandler, Arizona, United States of America. It was the 8th Rising Phoenix World Championships to be held.

zh.s: 2022年凤凰崛起世界锦标赛是一项女子健美比赛，与亚利桑那女子职业赛和NPC力量之翼亚利桑那女子盛会同时举行。比赛于2022年11月5日在美国亚利桑那州钱德勒的吉拉河度假村与赌场——野马通道举行。这是第8届凤凰崛起世界锦标赛。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Rodriguez vs. Lemos
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Rodriguez vs. Lemos (also known as UFC Fight Night 214, UFC on ESPN+ 72 and UFC Vegas 64) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 5, 2022 at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：罗德里格斯对阵莱莫斯
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：罗德里格斯对阵莱莫斯又称UFC格斗之夜214、UFC on ESPN+ 72和UFC拉斯维加斯64，是一场由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）举办的综合格斗赛事，于2022年11月5日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行，该地属于拉斯维加斯大都会区。

en.s: The 2022 Supercoppa Italiana (branded as the 2022 Supercoppa Italiana Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane for sponsorship reasons) was the 26rd edition of the Supercoppa Italiana. It was contested by Juventus, the 2021–22 Serie A and 2021–22 Coppa Italia champions and Roma, the runners-up of the two competitions. The match was played in Parma at Stadio Ennio Tardini on 5 November 2022 and Roma won their first title.

zh.s: 2022年意大利女子超级杯因赞助冠名为“2022年意大利国家铁路超级杯”，是第26届赛事。参赛队伍是2021—22赛季意大利足球甲级联赛和意大利杯冠军尤文图斯，以及两项赛事的亚军罗马。比赛于2022年11月5日在帕尔马的恩尼奥·塔尔迪尼球场举行，罗马首次夺冠。

en.s: MLS Cup 2022 was the 27th edition of the MLS Cup, the championship match of Major League Soccer (MLS) at the conclusion of the 2022 MLS Cup Playoffs. The soccer match took place on November 5, 2022, at Banc of California Stadium in Los Angeles, California, United States. It was contested by hosts Los Angeles FC from the Western Conference and the Philadelphia Union of the Eastern Conference to determine the champion of the 2022 season.

zh.s: 2022年美国职业足球大联盟杯是该联赛季后赛结束后的第27届冠军赛。比赛于2022年11月5日在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的加州银行体育场举行，由西部联盟的主队洛杉矶足球俱乐部对阵东部联盟的费城联合队，决出2022赛季冠军。

en.s: The MAMI Mumbai Film Festival 2023 took place between 27 October and 5 November 2023 in Mumbai, India. It was the first in-person edition of the MAMI Mumbai Film Festival since the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, and it was also the final edition with Anupama Chopra serving as the Festival Director. Indian-American filmmaker Mira Nair was named the Head of Jury for the South Asia Competition.

zh.s: 2023年MAMI孟买电影节于2023年10月27日至11月5日在印度孟买举行。这是新冠疫情暴发后该电影节首次恢复线下举办，也是阿努帕玛·乔普拉担任电影节总监的最后一届。印度裔美国电影人米拉·奈尔获任南亚竞赛单元评审团主席。

en.s: The 2023 Dow Tennis Classic was a professional women's tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts. It was the twenty-ninth edition of the tournament which was also part of the 2023 WTA 125 tournaments. It took place at the Greater Midland Tennis Center in Midland, Michigan, United States between 30 October and 5 November 2023.

zh.s: 2023年道氏网球经典赛是一项在室内硬地球场举行的女子职业网球赛事，为赛事第29届，也是2023年WTA125巡回赛的一站。比赛于2023年10月30日至11月5日在美国密歇根州米德兰的大米德兰网球中心举行。

en.s: The 2023 Engie Open Nantes Atlantique was a professional tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts. It was the nineteenth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2023 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It took place in Nantes, France between 30 October and 5 November 2023.

zh.s: 2023年南特大西洋ENGIE公开赛是一项在室内硬地球场举行的女子职业网球赛事，为赛事第19届，也是2023年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛的一站。比赛于2023年10月30日至11月5日在法国南特举行。

en.s: The 2023 Sofia mayoral election was held on 29 October 2023, during the 2023 Bulgarian local elections, to elect the next mayor of Sofia.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2023年索非亚市长选举于2023年10月29日举行，是2023年保加利亚地方选举的一部分，旨在选出索非亚下一任市长。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的决选日期。

en.s: Local elections in Bulgaria were held on 29 October 2023. Mayors and municipal councillors across the country were elected.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the United States on November 5, 2024. The Republican ticket of former president Donald Trump and Ohio junior senator JD Vance defeated the Democratic ticket of incumbent vice president Kamala Harris and Minnesota governor Tim Walz. The incumbent president, Joe Biden of the Democratic Party, initially ran for re-election, easily sweeping aside a challenge from Democratic representative Dean Phillips of Minnesota in the Democratic primaries to become the party's presumptive nominee. However, what was broadly considered a poor debate performance in June 2024 intensified concerns about his age and health, and led to calls within his party for him to leave the race.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日，美国举行总统选举。共和党候选人、前总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄亥俄州资浅联邦参议员JD·万斯击败民主党候选人、现任副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯和明尼苏达州州长蒂姆·沃尔兹。民主党籍现任总统乔·拜登起初竞选连任，并在民主党初选中轻松击退明尼苏达州联邦众议员迪恩·菲利普斯的挑战，成为该党推定提名人。但2024年6月普遍被认为表现不佳的辩论加剧了外界对其年龄和健康状况的担忧，党内也因此有人呼吁他退出竞选。

en.s: The 2024 Texas House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024. The winners of this election will serve in the 89th Texas Legislature. It was held alongside numerous other federal, state, and local elections, including the 2024 U.S. presidential election and the 2024 Texas Senate election. Primary elections were held on March 5, 2024, with runoff primaries taking place, if necessary, on May 28, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年得克萨斯州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行。当选者将在第89届得克萨斯州议会任职。选举与多项联邦、州和地方选举同时举行，包括2024年美国总统选举和2024年得克萨斯州参议院选举。初选于2024年3月5日举行，必要时于5月28日举行第二轮初选。

en.s: The 2024 Vermont lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024. Republican former state Senator John Rodgers defeated incumbent Progressive Lieutenant Governor David Zuckerman who was running for re-election to a fourth non-consecutive term in office. The election was held concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日，佛蒙特州举行副州长选举。共和党籍前州参议员约翰·罗杰斯击败进步党现任副州长戴维·朱克曼；朱克曼曾中断任职，此次争取个人第四个任期。这场选举与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及多项州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Florida House of Representatives elections was held on November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections. Florida voters elected state representatives in all 120 of the state's house districts. Following the 2022 state House of Representatives elections, Republicans expanded their House majority to 85, up from 78 in the last election, giving them a supermajority in the House.

zh.s: 2024年佛罗里达州众议院选举于11月5日举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分。佛罗里达州选民选举州众议院全部120个选区的代表。2022年州众议院选举后，共和党把多数席位从78席扩大到85席，在众议院取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2024 United States lieutenant gubernatorial elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect lieutenant governors in 5 states. The previous lieutenant gubernatorial elections for this group of states took place in 2020, except in Vermont, where lieutenant governors serve two-year terms and elected their lieutenant governor in 2022.

zh.s: 2024年美国有5个州举行副州长选举，投票日为11月5日。这组州上一次举行副州长选举是在2020年；佛蒙特州副州长任期为两年，上次选举则在2022年举行。

en.s: The 2024 Los Angeles County elections were held on November 5, 2024, in Los Angeles County, California, with nonpartisan blanket primary elections for certain offices being held on March 5. Three of the five seats of the Board of Supervisors were up for election, as well as one of the countywide elected officials, the District Attorney. In addition, elections were held for the Superior Court, along with two ballot measures.

zh.s: 2024年洛杉矶县选举于2024年11月5日举行。部分职位的无党派综合初选于3月5日举行。县监事会5个席位中有3个改选，另有一项全县民选公职——地方检察官职位——进行选举。此外还举行了高等法院选举和两项公投。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in California took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. California voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. California has 54 electoral votes in the Electoral College, the most in the country.

zh.t: 2024年美国总统选举在加利福尼亚州举行
zh.s: 2024年美国总统选举在加利福尼亚州的投票于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。加州选民通过普选选出代表他们的选举人。加利福尼亚州有54张选举人票，是全美最多的州。

en.s: The 2024 California's 16th congressional district election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the United States representative for California's 16th congressional district. The election was held concurrently with elections for the other U.S. House districts in California and the rest of the country, as well as the 2024 U.S. Senate race in California, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州第16国会选区联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年加利福尼亚州第16国会选区联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出该选区的美国联邦众议员。选举与加州其他联邦众议院选区、全国其他地区的联邦众议院选举、2024年加州联邦参议院选举、其他联邦参议院选举，以及各项州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. North Carolina voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年美国总统选举在北卡罗来纳州举行
zh.s: 2024年美国总统选举在北卡罗来纳州的投票于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。北卡罗来纳州选民通过普选选出代表他们的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 Wisconsin fall general election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on November 5, 2024. One of Wisconsin's U.S. Senate seats and all of Wisconsin's eight seats in the U.S. House of Representatives were up for election, as well as sixteen seats in the Wisconsin Senate and all 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly.

zh.s: 威斯康星州于2024年11月5日举行秋季大选。该州一个联邦参议院席位和全部8个联邦众议院席位进行改选，州参议院16个席位以及州众议院全部99个席位也进行改选。

en.s: The 2024 Volusia County Chair election took place on November 5, 2024, following a primary election on August 20, 2024. Incumbent County Chair Jeff Brower ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by businessman Randy Dye; former County Councilmember Deb Denys, who ran against him in 2020; and Port Orange Mayor Don Burnett. Brower placed first in the primary, winning 42 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年沃卢西亚县县长选举于2024年11月5日举行，初选于同年8月20日举行。现任县长杰夫·布劳尔竞选连任第二个任期。他的对手包括商人兰迪·戴、曾在2020年与他竞争的前县议员黛布·丹尼斯，以及波特奥兰治市长唐·伯内特。布劳尔在初选中得票最多，获得42%的选票。

en.s: Mayoral and city council elections were held throughout Wyoming's towns and cities on November 5, 2024. As of 2022, there are 99 municipalities throughout the state, of which 19 are cities. Under Wyoming law, each town and city has one mayor and four councilors, all elected.

zh.s: 怀俄明州各城镇和城市于2024年11月5日举行市长和市议会选举。到2022年，该州共有99个自治市，其中19个是城市。根据怀俄明州法律，每个城镇和城市均设一名市长和四名议员，全部由选举产生。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the thirty-eight U.S. representatives from the State of Texas, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举于11月5日举行，选出38名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出1人。选举与2024年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举，以及各项州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The U.S. state of South Dakota held elections on November 5, 2024. Primary elections were held on June 4, 2024.

zh.s: 美国南达科他州于2024年11月5日举行选举。初选于2024年6月4日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Guam
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Guam was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives from Guam's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2024 Guamanian general election which will decide other federal and state offices, including elections to the Legislature of Guam. The non-voting delegate is selected for a two-year term.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行关岛美国众议院选举，选出代表关岛全州选区的无投票权联邦众议院代表。选举与2024年关岛大选同时举行，届时还将选出其他联邦和州级官员，包括关岛立法机构议员。无投票权代表任期两年。

en.s: Elections were held in Nevada on November 5, 2024. On that date, the state held elections for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Nevada Assembly, 10 of the 21 seats in the Nevada Senate, and various others. In addition, several measures were on the ballot.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行内华达州选举。当日，该州举行美国总统、美国参议院、美国众议院、内华达州众议院、州参议院21个席位中的10席，以及其他职位的选举。此外，选票上还有几项公投提案。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the State of Mississippi, one each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年密西西比州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行密西西比州美国众议院选举，选出该州4个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与2024年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Utah State Treasurer election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next state treasurer of Utah. Incumbent Republican treasurer Marlo Oaks won a special election after David Damschen resigned, and was re-elected.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行犹他州财政部长选举，选出下一任州财政部长。共和党籍现任财政部长马洛·奥克斯在戴维·丹姆申辞职后赢得特别选举，并成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the attorney general of the state of Missouri. It coincided with the concurrent presidential election, as well as various state and local elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor of Missouri. Primary elections took place on August 6, 2024. Incumbent Andrew Bailey won the Republican nomination, while Elad Gross won the Democratic nomination.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行密苏里州州检察长选举。选举与总统选举同时举行，也与美国参议院、美国众议院和密苏里州州长等州级和地方选举同时进行。党内初选于2024年8月6日举行。现任州检察长安德鲁·贝利赢得共和党提名，埃拉德·格罗斯赢得民主党提名。

en.s: The 2024 Maine House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行缅因州众议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Kansas, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年堪萨斯州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行堪萨斯州美国众议院选举，选出该州4个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in New Mexico
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. New Mexico voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年新墨西哥州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），新墨西哥州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国总统选举的一部分。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与了总统选举。新墨西哥州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in New York
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in New York was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. New York voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行纽约州美国总统选举，作为2024年美国总统选举的一部分。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与了总统选举。纽约州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 Indiana Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, as a part of the biennial elections in the U.S. state of Indiana, coinciding with other elections in the state, including for U.S. president, U.S. House, Indiana governor, and Indiana House, as well as various other state and local elections. The primary elections took place on May 7, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行印第安纳州参议院选举，作为该州两年一度的选举的一部分。选举与该州其他选举同时举行，包括美国总统、美国众议院、印第安纳州州长、印第安纳州众议院等职位。党内初选于2024年5月7日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024. The top-two primary was held on August 6. Incumbent Democratic Governor Jay Inslee was eligible to seek a fourth term but decided that he would not do so. The Democratic candidate, state Attorney General Bob Ferguson, defeated the Republican candidate, former Congressman Dave Reichert, who conceded defeat on November 19.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行华盛顿州州长选举。前两名初选于8月6日举行。民主党籍现任州长杰伊·英斯利有资格竞选第四个任期，但决定不参选。民主党候选人、州检察长鲍勃·弗格森击败共和党候选人、前联邦众议员戴夫·赖克特。赖克特于11月19日承认败选。

en.t: 2024 South Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2024 South Carolina House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. Primary elections took place on June 11, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年南卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行南卡罗来纳州众议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。党内初选于2024年6月11日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2024 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 5, 2024, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member is only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the U.S. Senate. Democratic candidate Ankit Jain defeated Republican candidate Nelson Rimensnyder to succeed Democrat Mike Brown in the position.

zh.t: 2024年哥伦比亚特区美国影子参议员选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行哥伦比亚特区美国影子参议员选举，选出一名代表哥伦比亚特区的影子参议员。该职位仅获哥伦比亚特区承认，没有由美国参议院正式宣誓就职或取得席位。民主党候选人安基特·杰恩击败共和党候选人纳尔逊·里门斯奈德，接替民主党人迈克·布朗。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Northern Mariana Islands
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives election in the Northern Mariana Islands was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect the territory's delegate to the United States House of Representatives in the 119th United States Congress. The Delegate, who is elected to a two-year term, represents the Northern Mariana Islands' at-large congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives.

zh.t: 2024年北马里亚纳群岛美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行北马里亚纳群岛美国众议院选举，选出该地区派往第119届美国国会的联邦众议院代表。该代表由选举产生，任期两年，代表北马里亚纳群岛的全州国会选区。

en.s: The 2024 Idaho Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. For the first time in thirty years, the Idaho Democratic Party ran candidates in each legislative district on the ballot.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行爱达荷州参议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。爱达荷州民主党30年来首次在所有列入选票的州议会选区都推出候选人。

en.s: The 2024 Montana Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next secretary of state of Montana, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the U.S. Senate and various state and local elections, including for U.S. House and governor of Montana. Incumbent Republican secretary of state Christi Jacobsen was re-elected to a second term, defeating Democratic challenger Jesse Mullen.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行蒙大拿州州务卿选举，与美国总统选举、参议院选举及包括联邦众议院和州长选举在内的州级和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任州务卿克里斯蒂·雅各布森击败民主党挑战者杰西·穆伦，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2024 West Virginia State Auditor election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next West Virginia state auditor. Incumbent Republican auditor JB McCuskey did not seek re-election, instead opting to run for attorney general. Primary elections took place on May 14, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州审计长选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行西弗吉尼亚州审计长选举，选出下一任州审计长。共和党籍现任审计长JB·麦卡斯基没有寻求连任，而是转而竞选州检察长。党内初选于2024年5月14日举行。

en.s: The 2024 United States state legislative elections were held on November 5, 2024, for 85 state legislative chambers in 44 states. Across the fifty states, approximately 65 percent of all upper house seats and 85 percent of all lower house seats were up for election. Nine legislative chambers in the five permanently inhabited U.S. territories and the federal district of Washington, D.C., also held elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日，美国44个州的85个州议会院举行选举。50个州中，约65%的州参议院席位和85%的州众议院席位需要改选。美国5个常住海外领土以及华盛顿哥伦比亚特区的9个议会院也举行了选举。

en.s: The 2024 Tennessee House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect 99 seats for the Tennessee House of Representatives. The elections coincided with the Presidential, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate elections. The primary election was held on August 1, 2024. Tennessee has open primaries, meaning that any voter can choose to vote on either a Republican or Democratic ballot during primary elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行田纳西州众议院选举，选出州众议院99个席位。选举与总统、美国参议院、美国众议院和州参议院选举同时进行。党内初选于2024年8月1日举行。田纳西州采用开放式初选，选民可在初选时选择参加共和党或民主党的投票。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Utah took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Utah voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），犹他州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国总统选举的一部分。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与了总统选举。犹他州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 Massachusetts House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 3, 2024. Massachusetts voters elected all 160 members of the State House to serve two-year terms in the Massachusetts General Court. The Democratic Party retained their majority in the chamber with no net change in seats.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行马萨诸塞州众议院选举，党内初选于2024年9月3日（星期二）举行。马萨诸塞州选民选出州众议院全部160名议员，任期两年。民主党保住多数，席位总数没有变化。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate elections in California
en.s: Two 2024 United States Senate elections in California were held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of California. There were two ballot items for the same Class 1 seat: a special election to fill the seat for the final month of the 118th United States Congress (ending on January 3, 2025), and a regular general election for a full term that began on January 3, 2025, in the 119th United States Congress.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行两场加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。同一个第一类参议员席位有两项选票：一场特别选举用于填补第118届美国国会最后一个月的席位，任期至2025年1月3日结束；另一场常规大选选出完整任期，从2025年1月3日开始，任职于第119届美国国会。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. New Jersey voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），新泽西州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国大选的一部分。新泽西州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the State of Tennessee, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年田纳西州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行田纳西州美国众议院选举，选出该州9个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Montana
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Montana were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Montana, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年蒙大拿州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行蒙大拿州美国众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 United States state auditor elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the state auditors of eight states and one territory. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2020, while Vermont's state auditor was last elected in 2022. These elections took place concurrently with the 2024 presidential election, elections to the Senate and House of Representatives, and various other state and local elections.

zh.s: 2024年美国州审计长选举于11月5日举行，选出8个州和一个属地的州审计长。这些州上次举行同组州审计长选举是在2020年；佛蒙特州的州审计长则于2022年改选。选举与2024年总统选举、联邦参议员和众议员选举以及其他州和地方选举同期举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Washington. Democratic incumbent Senator Maria Cantwell was elected to her fifth term, winning over Republican physician Raul Garcia. Cantwell improved on her prior 2018 performance despite the Republican national environment.

zh.t: 2024年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行华盛顿州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。民主党籍现任参议员玛丽亚·坎特韦尔成功连任第五个任期，击败共和党籍医生劳尔·加西亚。尽管全国共和党势头强劲，坎特韦尔的表现仍好于2018年。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the State of Nevada, one from all four of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections from the other 49 states to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年内华达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行内华达州美国众议院选举，选出该州4个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与2024年美国总统选举、其他49个州的联邦众议院选举、美国参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Delaware House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行特拉华州众议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Kansas House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. All 125 seats in the Kansas House of Representatives were up for election.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行堪萨斯州众议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。州众议院全部125个席位都需要改选。

en.t: 2024 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 2024 United States Virgin Islands general election took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect the non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives, all 15 seats in the Legislature of the Virgin Islands, members of the Virgin Islands Board of Elections, Board of Education, and the 15 delegates to the Sixth Constitutional Convention. Primary elections was held on August 3, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行美属维尔京群岛大选，选出一名没有投票权的联邦众议院代表、维尔京群岛立法机构全部15名议员、选举委员会和教育委员会成员，以及制宪会议第六届的15名代表。党内初选于2024年8月3日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Texas. Republican senator Ted Cruz was re-elected to a third term, defeating Democratic U.S. representative Colin Allred. The primary election took place on March 5, 2024, during Super Tuesday.

zh.t: 2024年得克萨斯州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行得克萨斯州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍参议员特德·克鲁兹击败民主党人、联邦众议员科林·奥尔雷德，连任第三个任期。党内初选于2024年3月5日超级星期二举行。

en.s: The 2024 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of Utah. Incumbent Governor Spencer Cox ran for a second term, winning the Republican primary against state representative Phil Lyman with 54.4% of the vote; Lyman later mounted a write-in campaign for the general election. Cox won the general election in November, defeating Democratic nominee and state representative Brian King as well as Lyman.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行犹他州州长选举。现任州长斯宾塞·考克斯竞选第二个任期，并在共和党初选中击败州众议员菲尔·莱曼，获得54.4%的选票。莱曼后来以写入选票的方式参加大选。考克斯在大选中击败民主党候选人、州众议员布赖恩·金和莱曼。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Texas was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Texas voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Texas had 40 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state gained two seats.

zh.t: 2024年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），得克萨斯州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后重新分配的席位，得克萨斯州在选举人团中有40票，比此前增加2票。

en.s: The 2024 Northern Mariana Islands general election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, corresponding with the 2024 United States general elections. Voters in the Northern Mariana Islands chose the non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives, 3 seats in the Northern Mariana Islands Senate, all twenty seats in the Northern Mariana Islands House of Representatives, seats for the municipal council, and seats for the board of education.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行北马里亚纳群岛大选，与2024年美国大选同时进行。选民选出一名没有投票权的联邦众议院代表、北马里亚纳群岛参议院的3名议员、众议院全部20名议员，以及市政委员会和教育委员会成员。

en.s: The 2024 Idaho House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. For the first time in thirty years, the Idaho Democratic Party ran candidates in each legislative district on the ballot.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行爱达荷州众议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。爱达荷州民主党30年来首次在所有列入选票的州议会选区都推出候选人。

en.s: The 2024 Vermont Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the attorney general of the state of Vermont. It coincided with the concurrent presidential election, as well as various state and local elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor of Vermont. Incumbent attorney general Charity Clark was re-elected to a second term two-year term after defeating Berlin Town Administrator Ture Nelson in the general election.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行佛蒙特州州检察长选举。选举与总统选举同时举行，也与美国参议院、美国众议院和州长等州级及地方职位的选举同时进行。民主党籍现任州检察长查丽蒂·克拉克击败柏林镇行政长官图尔·纳尔逊，连任第二个两年任期。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Wisconsin took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Wisconsin voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Wisconsin awarded ten electoral votes in the Electoral College.

zh.t: 2024年威斯康星州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），威斯康星州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国大选的一部分。威斯康星州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有10票。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Virginia
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Virginia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），弗吉尼亚州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。弗吉尼亚州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the State of Hawaii, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年夏威夷州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行夏威夷州美国众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the State of West Virginia, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行西弗吉尼亚州美国众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Iowa House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Iowa on November 5, 2024, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 91st Iowa General Assembly. Elections were held concurrently with the 2024 United States elections. Primaries were held on June 4, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日，艾奥瓦州举行众议院选举，选出第91届艾奥瓦州议会议员。选举与2024年美国大选同时进行。党内初选于2024年6月4日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Arkansas State Treasurer special election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next treasurer of Arkansas. Incumbent Republican treasurer Larry Walther was appointed by Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders on August 3, 2023, after the death of Mark Lowery. As an appointee, Walther cannot seek a full term, per the state constitution. Republican nominee John Thurston defeated Democrat John Pagan in the general election.

zh.t: 2024年阿肯色州财政部长特别选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行阿肯色州财政部长特别选举，选出下一任州财政部长。共和党籍现任财政部长拉里·沃尔特于2023年8月3日由州长萨拉·哈克比·桑德斯任命，此前马克·洛厄里去世。根据州宪法，受任命的沃尔特不能竞选完整任期。共和党候选人约翰·瑟斯顿在大选中击败民主党人约翰·帕根。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the U.S. representative for Wyoming's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections. The primary elections took place on August 20, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年怀俄明州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行怀俄明州美国众议院选举，选出代表该州全州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。选举还与其他联邦众议院、参议院以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。党内初选于2024年8月20日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the State of Wisconsin, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年威斯康星州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行威斯康星州美国众议院选举，选出该州8个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Connecticut State Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. Primary elections took place on August 13, 2024. Democrats won one new seat, increasing their supermajority to 25 of the 36 Senate seats.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行康涅狄格州参议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。党内初选于2024年8月13日举行。民主党新增1席，以36席中的25席扩大了足以推翻州长否决的多数。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Maryland. Democratic Prince George's County executive Angela Alsobrooks won her first term in office, defeating Republican former governor Larry Hogan. She succeeded Democratic incumbent Ben Cardin, who did not seek a fourth term.

zh.t: 2024年马里兰州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行马里兰州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。民主党籍乔治王子县县长安吉拉·奥尔索布鲁克斯当选，开始第一个任期，击败共和党人、前州长拉里·霍根。她接替了没有竞选第四个任期的民主党籍现任参议员本·卡丁。

en.s: The 2024 Puerto Rico Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the members of the 28th Senate of Puerto Rico, concurrently with the election of the Governor, the Resident Commissioner, the House of Representatives, and the mayors of the 78 municipalities, as well as the election events of a status referendum and a presidential straw poll.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行波多黎各参议院选举，选出波多黎各第28届参议院议员。选举与州长、常驻专员、众议院和78个市镇的市长选举同时举行，也与地位公投和总统模拟投票同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 San Mateo County elections were held on November 5, 2024, in San Mateo County, California, with nonpartisan blanket primary elections for certain offices being held on March 5. Three of the five seats of the Board of Supervisors are up for election. Municipal elections in California are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日在加利福尼亚州圣马特奥县举行选举。部分职位的无党派综合初选于3月5日举行。县监事会5个席位中有3个需要改选。加利福尼亚州地方选举依法不设党派，候选人的党派不会显示在选票上。

en.s: The 2024 elections for the Indiana House of Representatives took place on Tuesday November 5, 2024, to elect representatives from all 100 districts in the Indiana House of Representatives. The primary elections took place on May 7, 2024. The Republican Party has held a House majority since 2011. The elections for United States presidential election, Indiana's nine congressional districts, Indiana governor, and Indiana state senate were also held on this date.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行印第安纳州众议院选举，选出该州众议院全部100个选区的议员。党内初选于2024年5月7日举行。自2011年以来，共和党一直在州众议院占多数。美国总统选举、印第安纳州9个国会选区选举、州长选举和州参议院选举也在当天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Michigan elections were held on November 5, 2024. In addition to the 2024 United States presidential election, elections were held for all of the state's seats in the United States House of Representatives, the state's class 1 seat in the United States Senate, and for all the seats in the Michigan House of Representatives. Elections to various local offices were also held.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行密歇根州选举。除2024年美国总统选举外，还选出该州全部联邦众议员、美国参议院第一类席位议员以及密歇根州众议院全部议员。各地也举行了多项地方职位选举。

en.s: The 2024 Indiana Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the attorney general of the state of Indiana. It coincided with the concurrent presidential election, as well as various state and local elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor of Indiana. The Republican Convention took place on June 15. The Democratic Convention took place on July 13.

zh.t: 2024年印第安纳州州检察长选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行印第安纳州州检察长选举。选举与总统选举以及包括美国参议院、美国众议院和州长在内的各类州级和地方选举同时举行。共和党代表大会于6月15日举行，民主党代表大会于7月13日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Puerto Rican municipal election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayors of the 78 municipalities of Puerto Rico, concurrently with the election of the Governor, Resident Commissioner, the Senate, and the House of Representatives, as well as the election events of a status referendum and a presidential straw poll.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行波多黎各市镇选举，选出波多黎各78个市镇的市长。选举与州长、常驻专员、参议院和众议院选举同时举行，也与地位公投和总统模拟投票同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Montana House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. This was the first election under new legislative lines adopted by an independent, bipartisan commission in 2023. Although Republicans maintained the majority, Democrats had a 10-seat net gain, ending the Republicans' supermajority.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行蒙大拿州众议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。这是2023年由独立、跨党派委员会通过新的州议会选区划分后的首次选举。共和党虽然保住多数，民主党却净增10席，终结了共和党足以推翻州长否决的多数。

en.s: The 2024 Maryland's 6th congressional district election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the United States representative for Maryland's 6th congressional district, concurrently with elections for the other U.S. House districts in Maryland and the rest of the country, as well as the 2024 U.S. Senate race in Maryland, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年马里兰州第六国会选区选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行马里兰州第六国会选区选举，选出该选区的联邦众议员。选举与马里兰州其他联邦众议院选区和全国各地的选举、2024年马里兰州美国参议院选举、其他州的参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Arizona voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年亚利桑那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），亚利桑那州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。亚利桑那州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 United States Senate elections were held on November 5, 2024. Regularly scheduled elections were held for 33 out of the 100 seats in the U.S. Senate, and special elections were held in California and Nebraska. U.S. senators are divided into three classes whose six-year terms are staggered so that a different class is elected every two years. Class 1 senators faced election in 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行美国参议院选举。100个席位中有33席按计划改选，加利福尼亚州和内布拉斯加州还举行特别选举。美国参议员分为三类，任期六年，分批改选，每两年改选一类。2024年需要改选的是第一类参议员席位。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Florida was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Florida voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Florida has 30 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state gained a seat.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），佛罗里达州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。佛罗里达州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后重新分配的席位，佛罗里达州在选举人团中有30票，比此前增加1票。

en.s: The 2024 Arkansas House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections.

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Oregon, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），夏威夷州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。夏威夷州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

Voters in 18 out of the 35 districts of the state Senate elected their representative for a four-year term. This election coincided with other Colorado elections of the same year and the biennial United States elections.

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota were held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives to represent the state of North Dakota from its at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House, elections to the United States Senate, and various other state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年北达科他州美国众议院选举

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Pennsylvania. Republican businessman Dave McCormick won his first term in office, defeating Democratic three-term incumbent Bob Casey Jr. in what was considered a major upset. Most predictions gave Casey a slight advantage, and he led in most polls.

zh.t: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党商人戴夫·麦考密克击败民主党籍现任参议员小鲍勃·凯西，开始第一个任期。这场选举被视为一场重大冷门。大多数预测认为凯西略占优势，他在大多数民调中也领先。

en.s: The 2024 West Virginia Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, with 17 of the chamber's 34 seats up for election. This took place alongside elections to the House of Delegates, as well as a number of statewide elected positions and elections to Congress and the Presidency. Primary elections were held on May 14, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举，34个席位中的17席需要改选。选举与州众议院、多个全州选举职位、国会议员和总统选举同时举行。党内初选于2024年5月14日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Kansas voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Kansas has six electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），堪萨斯州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国大选的一部分。堪萨斯州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有6票；根据2020年美国人口普查后重新分配的席位，该州席位数没有变化。

en.s: The Illinois general election was held on November 5, 2024. Primary elections, held using an open primary system, took place on March 19, 2024.

en.s: The 2024 Oklahoma Senate election took place on November 5, 2024. The primary elections for the Republican, Democratic, and Libertarian parties' nominations took place on June 18, 2024. Oklahoma voters elected state senators to serve four-year terms in 24 of the 48 Senate districts.

zh.t: 2024年俄克拉何马州参议院选举

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota

Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives to serve two-year terms, with two members chosen from each of the state's 30 legislative districts. Primary elections were held on July 30, 2024. Prior to the elections, Republicans held a slim majority of 31 members over the 29 Democrats.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举，选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。该州30个立法选区各选出2名议员。党内初选于2024年7月30日举行。选举前，共和党以31席对29席占据微弱多数。

en.s: The 2024 South Dakota Senate elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect all 35 seats in the South Dakota Senate. The elections coincided with the presidential, U.S. House, and State House elections. The primary elections were held on June 4, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行南达科他州参议院选举，选出州参议院全部35名议员。选举与总统、美国众议院和州众议院选举同时举行。党内初选于2024年6月4日举行。

en.s: The Indiana general election was held on November 5, 2024. Primary elections took place on May 7, 2024.

en.s: The 2024 Vermont gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of Vermont, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican governor Phil Scott won re-election to a fifth term, defeating the Democratic nominee, Vermont Commission on Women co-chair Esther Charlestin.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行佛蒙特州州长选举，与2024年美国总统选举、美国参议院和众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任州长菲尔·斯科特击败民主党候选人、佛蒙特州妇女委员会联合主席埃丝特·夏莱斯坦，连任第五个任期。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas

The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年阿肯色州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行阿肯色州美国众议院选举，选出该州4个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Indiana was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Indiana. Republican congressman Jim Banks was elected to his first term, defeating Democratic psychologist Valerie McCray in the general election. Banks succeeded Republican incumbent Mike Braun, who opted instead to run for governor.

zh.t: 2024年印第安纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行印第安纳州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党人、联邦众议员吉姆·班克斯击败民主党人、心理学家瓦莱丽·麦克雷，当选并开始第一个任期。班克斯接替了转而竞选州长的共和党籍现任参议员迈克·布劳恩。

en.s: The 2024 California's 47th congressional district election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the United States representative for California's 47th congressional district, concurrently with elections for the other U.S. House districts in California and the rest of the country, as well as the 2024 U.S. Senate race in California, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州第47国会选区选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行加利福尼亚州第47国会选区选举，选出该选区的联邦众议员。选举与加利福尼亚州其他联邦众议院选区和全国各地的选举、2024年加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举、其他州的参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: A general election was held in Montana on November 5, 2024. Both of Montana's seats in the United States House of Representatives, all of the seats in the Montana House of Representatives, and half of the seats in the Montana Senate were up for election. The primary election was held on June 4, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行蒙大拿州大选。该州在联邦众议院的两个席位、蒙大拿州众议院全部席位和州参议院一半席位都需要改选。党内初选于2024年6月4日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate special election in Nebraska
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate special election in Nebraska was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Class 2 member of the United States Senate from Nebraska, to complete the term of Ben Sasse, who resigned on January 8, 2023, to become the president of the University of Florida. On January 12, 2023, Governor Jim Pillen appointed Republican former Governor Pete Ricketts to fill the seat until the election.

zh.t: 2024年内布拉斯加州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行内布拉斯加州美国参议院特别选举，选出该州第二类联邦参议员，完成本·萨斯的任期。萨斯于2023年1月8日辞职，出任佛罗里达大学校长。2023年1月12日，州长吉姆·皮伦任命共和党人、前州长皮特·里基茨填补席位，任职至此次选举。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Minnesota, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年明尼苏达州美国众议院选举
