en.s: The 2024 Vermont Auditor of Accounts election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Vermont State Auditor. It coincided with the concurrent presidential election, as well as various state and local elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor of Vermont. Incumbent state auditor Doug Hoffer was re-elected to a seventh and final two-year term, defeating Republican newsstand owner H. Brooke Paige.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行佛蒙特州审计长选举。选举与总统选举、美国参议院和众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任审计长道格·霍弗击败共和党候选人、报刊亭老板H·布鲁克·佩奇，连任第七个、也是最后一个两年任期。

en.s: Mayoral elections in Guam were held on November 5, 2024 as part of the 2024 Guamanian general election, to elect mayors of nineteen villages in Guam and vice mayors in six, with primaries taking place on August 3. The incumbent vice mayor of Sinajana, Rudy Don Iriarte, died on January 4, 2024. A special election to fill the office was planned for March 9, 2024, but was cancelled after the office was disestablished to save money.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行关岛市长选举，作为2024年关岛大选的一部分，选出19个村庄的市长以及6个村庄的副市长。党内初选于8月3日举行。辛纳哈纳村现任副市长鲁迪·唐·伊里亚特于2024年1月4日去世。原计划于2024年3月9日举行特别选举填补职位，但为节省开支，副市长职位被撤销后，特别选举取消。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Florida. Incumbent Republican Senator Rick Scott won a second term, defeating Democratic nominee Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. The primary election was held on August 20, 2024. Scott, then the governor of Florida, was first elected to the U.S.

zh.t: 2024年美国佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2024年美国佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举于11月5日举行，选出一名代表佛罗里达州的联邦参议员。共和党籍时任参议员里克·斯科特击败民主党提名人黛比·穆卡塞尔-鲍威尔，赢得第二个任期。初选于2024年8月20日举行。斯科特此前担任佛罗里达州州长，并首次当选联邦……。

en.s: The 2024 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of North Dakota. Incumbent Republican governor Doug Burgum decided to not seek a third term and ran for president. North Dakota is a Republican stronghold, and the Democratic–Nonpartisan League (NPL) Party has not won a gubernatorial race in the state since 1988.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行北达科他州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长道格·伯古姆决定不竞选第三个任期，并转而竞选总统。北达科他州是共和党的稳固票仓；民主党—无党派联盟党自1988年以来一直未能赢得该州州长选举。

en.s: The 2024 Hawaii Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections. 12 of the 25 seats in the Hawaii Senate were elected.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行夏威夷州参议院选举，作为2024年美国选举的一部分。夏威夷州参议院25个席位中的12席进行改选。

en.s: General elections were held in Guam on November 5, 2024. This was the first time since 2006 that the Republicans had won a majority in the legislature.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行关岛大选。这是共和党人自2006年以来首次在立法机构中赢得多数。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Delaware voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Delaware has 3 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），特拉华州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国大选的一部分。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与了选举。特拉华州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有3票；根据2020年美国人口普查后重新分配的席位，该州席位数没有变化。

en.s: The 2024 Alaska Senate elections took place on November 5, 2024, with the primary elections being held on August 20, 2024. State senators serve four-year terms in the Alaska State Senate, with half of the seats up for election every two years. Senators are elected by instant-runoff voting.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行阿拉斯加州参议院选举，党内初选于2024年8月20日举行。阿拉斯加州参议员任期四年，每两年改选一半席位。参议员通过即时决选投票选出。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a Class I member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Michigan. It was held concurrently with the 2024 United States presidential election, other elections to the U.S. Senate, and elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, as well as various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年密歇根州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行密歇根州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的第一类联邦参议员。选举与2024年美国总统选举、其他美国参议院和众议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 North Carolina Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next attorney general of North Carolina. Democratic congressman Jeff Jackson defeated Republican congressman Dan Bishop. Jackson succeeded Democratic incumbent Josh Stein, who did not seek re-election in order to successfully run for governor.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州州检察长选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行北卡罗来纳州州检察长选举，选出下一任州检察长。民主党人、联邦众议员杰夫·杰克逊击败共和党人、联邦众议员丹·毕晓普。杰克逊接替了没有寻求连任、转而成功竞选州长的民主党籍现任州检察长乔希·斯坦。

en.s: One justice of the seven-member North Carolina Supreme Court and three judges of the fifteen-member North Carolina Court of Appeals were elected by North Carolina voters on November 5, 2024, concurrently with other state elections. Terms for seats on each court are eight years. These elections were conducted on a partisan basis.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日，北卡罗来纳州选民投票选出州最高法院7名法官中的1名，以及州上诉法院15名法官中的3名。两个法院的法官任期均为8年。这些选举与其他州级选举同时举行，采用党派选举方式。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Washington took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Washington voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. It was held along a gubernatorial and U.S. Senate election.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），华盛顿州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。华盛顿州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。当天还举行州长和美国参议院选举。

en.s: The 2024 California State Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, with the primary election being held on March 5, 2024. Voters in the 20 odd-numbered districts of the California State Senate will elect their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including the state Assembly. There were 16 Democratic-held senate seats up for election in 2024, 3 Republican-held seats, and 1 open seat with no incumbent.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行加利福尼亚州参议院选举，党内初选于2024年3月5日举行。选民将从加利福尼亚州参议院20个奇数编号选区选出议员。选举还涉及州众议院等职位。2024年需要改选的席位中，16席由民主党现任议员占据，3席由共和党现任议员占据，另有1席没有现任议员。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Rhode Island, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年罗得岛州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行罗得岛州美国众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Maine
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Maine were held on November 5, 2024, to elect both U.S. representatives from the state of Maine, one from each of the state's congressional districts. These elections coincided with five referendum questions, including a referendum to change the state flag, as well as the presidential election, a U.S. Senate election, and various other state, county and local elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行缅因州美国众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与5项公投提案同时举行，包括更改州旗的提案，也与总统选举、美国参议院选举及各类州、县和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Massachusetts was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections. Massachusetts voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. Eleven members of the Electoral College came from Massachusetts. A New England state, Massachusetts has been a Democratic leaning state since 1928, and a Democratic stronghold since 1960, and is considered a deeply blue state today.

zh.t: 2024年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），马萨诸塞州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国大选的一部分。马萨诸塞州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人，该州有11名选举人。作为新英格兰州，马萨诸塞州自1928年以来一直倾向民主党，自1960年以来是民主党稳固票仓，如今被视为民主党优势明显的州。

en.s: The 2024 North Carolina Supreme Court election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court for an eight-year term. Democratic incumbent Allison Riggs was elected to her first full term, defeating Republican state Court of Appeals judge Jefferson Griffin. Due to a legal challenge over the results from Griffin, the election was not certified until May 13, 2025, 189 days later, making it the last of the 2024 cycle to be certified.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行北卡罗来纳州最高法院选举，选出一名任期8年的州最高法院法官。民主党籍现任法官艾莉森·里格斯击败共和党候选人、州上诉法院法官杰斐逊·格里芬，赢得第一个完整任期。由于格里芬对结果提出法律异议，选举直到2025年5月13日、即189天后才获认证，成为2024年选举周期中最后一场获认证的选举。

en.s: The 2024 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect members of the Wyoming Legislature for its 68th session. Partisan primaries were held on August 20. Part of the 2024 United States elections, the election was held alongside races for state house, U.S. House, U.S. Senate, and the presidential election.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行怀俄明州参议院选举，选出第68届州议会的议员。党内初选于8月20日举行。作为2024年美国选举的一部分，这次选举与州众议院、美国众议院、美国参议院和总统选举同时举行。

en.s: Elections to the Texas Senate were held on November 5, 2024, for 15 of the 31 Senate districts across the state of Texas. Numerous other federal, state, and local elections were held on this date. The winners of this election will serve full four-year terms covering the 89th Texas Legislature and the 90th Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行得克萨斯州参议院选举，全州31个选区中的15个需要改选。当日还举行了多项联邦、州和地方选举。此次当选者的完整四年任期将覆盖第89届和第90届得克萨斯州议会。

en.s: The 2024 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the lieutenant governor of North Carolina. Democratic state senator Rachel Hunt won her first term in office, defeating Republican state official Hal Weatherman. She succeeded Republican incumbent Mark Robinson, who did not seek re-election in order to unsuccessfully run for governor.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行北卡罗来纳州副州长选举。民主党籍州参议员瑞秋·亨特击败共和党州官员哈尔·韦瑟曼，当选并开始第一个任期。她接替了没有寻求连任、转而竞选州长但未成功的共和党籍现任副州长马克·罗宾逊。

en.s: Judicial retention elections in Wyoming were held throughout the state on November 5, 2024. A total of thirty judges were up for election, including two Supreme Court justices for 8-year terms, fourteen circuit court judges for 4-year terms, and fourteen district court judges for 6-year terms. Circuit Court judge Thomas Lee originally stood for retention, but retired before the election.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日，怀俄明州全州举行法官留任选举，共有30名法官需要参选，包括2名最高法院法官（任期8年）、14名巡回法院法官（任期4年）和14名地区法院法官（任期6年）。巡回法院法官托马斯·李原本参加留任选举，但在选举前退休。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections were held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of Puerto Rico, concurrently with the election of the Resident Commissioner, the Senate, the House of Representatives, and the mayors of the 78 municipalities, as well as the election events of a status referendum and a presidential straw poll. As a candidate in the 2024 general elections, the winner was elected to serve a four-year term from January 2, 2025 to January 2, 2029.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行波多黎各州长选举，选出州长。选举与常驻专员、参议院、众议院和78个市镇市长的选举同时举行，也与地位公投和总统模拟投票同时进行。大选获胜者将于2025年1月2日至2029年1月2日担任州长，任期四年。

en.s: Elections to the Nevada Assembly was held on November 5, 2024. Elections were also be held in the state for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and for the Nevada Senate. Primary elections were held on June 11, 2024. Republicans made a gain of one seat and broke the Democratic two-thirds supermajority, but they were unable to make further gains.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行内华达州众议院选举。当天该州还举行美国总统、参议院、众议院和州参议院选举。党内初选于2024年6月11日举行。共和党增加1席，打破了民主党在州众议院三分之二的绝对多数，但未能继续扩大席位。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Louisiana was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election, which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participated in. Louisiana voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Louisiana has eight electoral votes in the Electoral College.

zh.t: 2024年路易斯安那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），路易斯安那州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。路易斯安那州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有8票。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. North Dakota voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年北达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），北达科他州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。北达科他州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 Connecticut House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. Primary elections took place on August 14, 2024. Democrats gained a two-thirds majority in the state house, and along with expanding their Senate majority, were able to achieve a supermajority in both chambers of the state legislature. This allowed them to override any veto by governor Ned Lamont.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行康涅狄格州众议院选举，与2024年美国大选同时进行。党内初选于2024年8月14日举行。民主党在州众议院取得三分之二多数，并扩大了参议院多数，得以在州议会两院都占据绝对多数，可以推翻州长内德·拉蒙特的否决。

en.s: The 2024 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of Delaware. Incumbent Democratic governor John Carney was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a third term in office. Primary elections took place on September 10, 2024, in which Democratic New Castle County Executive Matt Meyer and Republican state representative Mike Ramone won their parties' nominations.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行特拉华州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长约翰·卡尼受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。党内初选于2024年9月10日举行，民主党候选人、新堡县县长马特·迈耶和共和党候选人、州众议员迈克·拉蒙赢得各自政党的提名。

en.s: The 2024 Utah State Auditor election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next state auditor of Utah. Incumbent Republican auditor John Dougall did not seek re-election, instead opting to run for U.S. House. Primary elections took place on June 25, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行犹他州审计长选举。共和党籍现任审计长约翰·道加尔没有寻求连任，而是转而竞选美国众议员。党内初选于2024年6月25日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Colorado voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Colorado has 10 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state gained a seat.

zh.t: 2024年科罗拉多州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），科罗拉多州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。科罗拉多州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后重新分配的席位，科罗拉多州在选举人团中有10票，比此前增加1票。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Idaho voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），爱达荷州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。爱达荷州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 5, 2024, with all districts up for election. The term of office for those elected in 2024 began when the House of Representatives convened in January 2025. Pennsylvania State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with all 203 seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举，所有选区都进行改选。2024年当选议员的任期从2025年1月众议院开会时开始。宾夕法尼亚州众议员任期两年，州众议院全部203个席位每两年改选一次。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Missouri voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Missouri has 10 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），密苏里州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国大选的一部分。密苏里州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有10票；根据2020年美国人口普查后重新分配的席位，该州席位数没有变化。

en.s: The 2024 Iowa Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行艾奥瓦州参议院选举，与2024年美国选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Tennessee State Senate elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect 16 of the 33 seats in the Tennessee State Senate. The elections coincided with the Presidential, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State House elections. The primary elections were held on August 1, 2024, with the exception of presidential primaries being held on March 5.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行田纳西州参议院选举，选出州参议院33个席位中的16席。选举与总统、美国参议院、美国众议院和州众议院选举同时举行。党内初选于2024年8月1日举行，总统初选则于3月5日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. West Virginia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），西弗吉尼亚州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。西弗吉尼亚州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 5, 2024, in 11 states and two territories. The previous gubernatorial elections for this group of states took place in 2020, except in New Hampshire and Vermont, where governors only serve two-year terms and elected their governors in 2022. In addition to state gubernatorial elections, the territories of American Samoa and Puerto Rico held elections for their governors.

zh.s: 2024年美国有11个州和两个属地于11月5日举行州长选举。这组州上一次举行州长选举是在2020年；新罕布什尔州和佛蒙特州的州长任期为两年，上次选举因此在2022年举行。除各州州长选举外，美属萨摩亚和波多黎各也举行州长选举。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Tennessee. Incumbent one-term Republican Senator Marsha Blackburn defeated state representative Gloria Johnson with 63.8% of the vote. Blackburn improved vastly from her 2018 performance by nearly 19 points. The primaries took place on August 1, 2024, with Blackburn and Johnson winning their respective party nominations.

zh.t: 2024年田纳西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行田纳西州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员玛莎·布莱克本击败州众议员格洛丽亚·约翰逊，获得63.8%的选票，成功连任。与2018年相比，布莱克本的得票率提高了近19个百分点。党内初选于2024年8月1日举行，布莱克本和约翰逊分别赢得本党提名。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the 17 U.S. representatives from the State of Pennsylvania, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州美国众议院选举，选出该州17个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 elections for the Florida Senate took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect state senators from 20 of 40 districts. The Republican Party has held a Senate majority since 1995.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行佛罗里达州参议院选举，选出该州40个选区中的20个州参议员。共和党自1995年以来一直在州参议院占多数。

en.s: The 2024 State Treasurer in Pennsylvania was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Pennsylvania state treasurer. Incumbent Republican treasurer Stacy Garrity was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democratic candidate Erin McClelland and outperforming (percentage wise) all other 2024 Republican statewide nominees in Pennsylvania. Garrity became the first Republican treasurer to win re-election since Barbara Hafer in 2000.

zh.t: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行宾夕法尼亚州财政部长选举。共和党籍现任财政部长斯泰西·加里蒂击败民主党候选人艾琳·麦克莱兰，连任第二个任期。按得票率计算，加里蒂的表现优于宾夕法尼亚州其他所有2024年共和党全州候选人。她成为自2000年芭芭拉·哈弗以来，首位成功连任的共和党籍州财政部长。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Arkansas voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Arkansas has six electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），阿肯色州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国大选的一部分。阿肯色州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有6票；根据2020年美国人口普查后重新分配的席位，该州席位数没有变化。

en.s: The 2024 North Dakota State Auditor election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the North Dakota state auditor. Primary elections took place on June 11, 2024. In the general contest, Republican incumbent Josh Gallion was handily re-elected for a third term, defeating Democratic–NPL candidate Timothy Lamb.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行北达科他州审计长选举。党内初选于2024年6月11日举行。大选中，共和党籍现任审计长乔什·加利恩轻松连任第三个任期，击败民主党—无党派联盟党候选人蒂莫西·兰姆。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Louisiana, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年路易斯安那州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行路易斯安那州美国众议院选举，选出该州6个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives to represent the state of Delaware from its at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House, elections to the United States Senate, and various other state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年特拉华州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行特拉华州美国众议院选举，选出代表该州全州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Wisconsin State Assembly election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, alongside elections for the State Senate. All 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly were up for election. The primary election was held on August 13, 2024. The filing deadline to appear on the ballot was June 3, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行威斯康星州州议会选举，与州参议院选举同时进行。州议会全部99个席位都需要改选。党内初选于2024年8月13日举行。候选人登记截止日期为2024年6月3日。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the 435 representatives of the United States House of Representatives, as well as 6 non-voting delegates from the District of Columbia and inhabited U.S. territories. The elections were held together with other federal, state, and local elections, including the U.S. presidential election and elections to the Senate, as part of the 2024 United States general election.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行美国众议院选举，选出联邦众议院全部435名有投票权的议员，以及来自哥伦比亚特区和有常住人口的美国海外领土的6名无投票权代表。选举与其他联邦、州和地方选举同时举行，包括美国总统和参议院选举，是2024年美国大选的一部分。

en.t: 2024 Rhode Island House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2024 Rhode Island House of Representatives elections took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 10, 2024. Rhode Island voters elected state representatives in all 75 seats of the House to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Rhode Island state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Rhode Island Senate.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二）举行罗得岛州众议院选举，党内初选于2024年9月10日（星期二）举行。罗得岛州选民选出众议院全部75名议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举和罗得岛州选举同时举行，包括美国总统、美国参议院、美国众议院和罗得岛州参议院选举。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Connecticut. Primary elections took place on August 13, 2024. Incumbent Democratic Senator Chris Murphy won re-election to a third term with 58.58% of the vote in a rematch with his 2018 opponent Matthew Corey.

zh.t: 2024年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行康涅狄格州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。党内初选于2024年8月13日举行。民主党籍现任参议员克里斯·墨菲以58.58%的选票击败2018年的对手马修·科里，连任第三个任期。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the State of New Mexico, one from all three of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年新墨西哥州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行新墨西哥州美国众议院选举，选出该州3个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Arizona Corporation Commission election was held on November 5, 2024. It elected three members of the Arizona Corporation Commission, a five-member body tasked with regulating public utilities in the state. Members are elected to four-year terms, with three seats up for election in presidential years and the other two up for election in midterm years. The elections use plurality block voting, and each party will nominate 3 candidates.

zh.t: 2024年亚利桑那州公司委员会选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行亚利桑那州公司委员会选举，选出委员会5名成员中的3人。该委员会负责监管州内公用事业。成员任期四年；总统选举年改选3席，中期选举年改选另外2席。选举采用区块投票制，各党将提名3名候选人。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the 28 U.S. representatives from the state of Florida, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年佛罗里达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行佛罗里达州美国众议院选举，选出该州28个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of North Carolina. It was held concurrently with the 2024 presidential election and other elections. Democratic state attorney general Josh Stein defeated Republican lieutenant governor Mark Robinson. He succeeded Democratic incumbent Roy Cooper, who was term-limited. Primary elections took place on March 5, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行北卡罗来纳州州长选举，与2024年总统选举和其他选举同时进行。民主党籍州检察长乔希·斯坦击败共和党籍副州长马克·罗宾逊，当选州长。他接替了受任期限制的民主党籍现任州长罗伊·库珀。党内初选于2024年3月5日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of New York. Democratic incumbent Kirsten Gillibrand was re-elected to a third full term, defeating Republican businessman Mike Sapraicone. Primary elections took place on June 25, 2024. Gillibrand's victory was significantly closer than her previous two, and followed Chuck Schumer's narrower victory in 2022.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行纽约州美国参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员柯尔斯滕·吉利布兰德击败共和党商人迈克·萨普莱科内，连任第三个完整任期。党内初选于2024年6月25日举行。与前两次相比，吉利布兰德这次的胜幅明显缩小；此前，查克·舒默在2022年的胜幅也较小。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Missouri. Republican incumbent Josh Hawley was re-elected to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee Lucas Kunce. Primary elections took place on August 6, 2024. Hawley was the favorite in the polls throughout the cycle due to the state's Republican lean, though some polls showed a close race.

zh.t: 2024年密苏里州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行密苏里州美国参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员乔什·霍利击败民主党候选人卢卡斯·昆斯，连任第二个任期。党内初选于2024年8月6日举行。整个选举周期的民调都看好霍利，因为该州整体倾向共和党，不过有些民调显示双方竞争激烈。

en.s: The 2024 United States attorney general elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the attorneys general of ten U.S. states. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2020, while Vermont's attorney general was last elected in 2022. These elections took place concurrently with the 2024 presidential election, elections to the Senate and House of Representatives, and various other state and local elections.

zh.s: 2024年美国有10个州于11月5日举行州总检察长选举。这些州上一次举行同组州总检察长选举是在2020年；佛蒙特州总检察长则于2022年改选。选举与2024年总统选举、联邦参议员和众议员选举以及其他州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Utah Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the attorney general of Utah. The election was held alongside various federal and state elections, including for governor. Incumbent Sean Reyes was eligible to run for re-election to a third full term in office, but instead decided to retire. The Republican primary election took place on June 25, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行犹他州州检察长选举，与州长选举等联邦和州级选举同时进行。现任州检察长肖恩·雷耶斯有资格竞选第三个完整任期，但决定退休。共和党初选于2024年6月25日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Montana State Auditor election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next state auditor of Montana. Incumbent Republican auditor Troy Downing did not seeking re-election, instead opting to run for U.S. House. Primary elections took place on June 4, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行蒙大拿州审计长选举，选出下一任州审计长。共和党籍现任审计长特洛伊·唐宁没有寻求连任，而是转而竞选美国众议员。党内初选于2024年6月4日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. South Carolina voters choose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of South Carolina has nine electoral votes in the Electoral College.

zh.t: 2024年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），南卡罗来纳州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国总统选举的一部分。南卡罗来纳州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有9票。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New York
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New York were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the 26 U.S. representatives from the State of New York, one from each of the state's 26 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行纽约州美国众议院选举，选出该州26个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Wyoming. Incumbent Senator John Barrasso was appointed to the Senate in 2007 after Craig Thomas died. Barrasso won a 2008 special election to complete Thomas' term and won full terms in 2012 and 2018.

zh.t: 2024年怀俄明州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行怀俄明州美国参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。现任参议员约翰·巴拉索于2007年克雷格·托马斯去世后被任命进入参议院。巴拉索在2008年特别选举中胜出，完成托马斯的任期，并在2012年和2018年赢得完整任期。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Rhode Island was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Rhode Island voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Rhode Island has four electoral votes in the Electoral College.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），罗得岛州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国大选的一部分。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与了选举。罗得岛州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有4票。

en.t: 2024 New Mexico House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2024 New Mexico House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行新墨西哥州众议院选举，与2024年美国大选同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Oregon Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Oregon secretary of state, the highest office in the state after the governor. Incumbent Democrat LaVonne Griffin-Valade was appointed by Governor Tina Kotek to replace Shemia Fagan, who resigned in May 2023 after revelations that she took a consulting job at a cannabis company while her office was auditing Oregon's marijuana industry, which many considered to be a conflict of interest.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行俄勒冈州州务卿选举。州务卿是该州仅次于州长的最高职位。民主党籍现任州务卿拉冯·格里芬-瓦拉德由州长蒂娜·科特克任命，接替了2023年5月辞职的谢米娅·费根。此前，费根接受了一家大麻公司的顾问工作，而她所在的办公室正审计俄勒冈州的大麻行业，许多人认为这构成利益冲突。

en.s: The 2024 Oklahoma House of Representative election took place on November 5, 2024. The primary elections for the Republican, Democratic, and Libertarian parties' nominations took place on June 18, 2024. All candidates had to file between the days of April 3–5, 2024. Oklahoma voters elected state representatives to serve two-year terms in all 101 House districts.

zh.t: 2024年俄克拉何马州众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行俄克拉何马州众议院选举。共和党、民主党和自由党的党内初选于2024年6月18日举行。所有候选人都必须在2024年4月3日至5日之间登记。俄克拉何马州选民选出州众议院全部101个选区的议员，任期两年。

en.s: The 2024 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of Missouri, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate, the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Mike Parson was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a second full term in office due to having served more than two years of predecessor Eric Greitens's unexpired term following his resignation in June 2018.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行密苏里州州长选举，与2024年美国总统、参议院、众议院以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任州长迈克·帕森受任期限制，不能竞选第二个完整任期；他接替前任埃里克·格雷滕斯后，已履行超过两年的未满任期。格雷滕斯于2018年6月辞职。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Montana
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Montana was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Montana. Republican businessman Tim Sheehy won his first term in office, defeating Democratic three-term incumbent Jon Tester. Despite the state's heavy partisan lean in favor of the Republican Party, Tester remained popular among his constituents.

zh.t: 2024年蒙大拿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行蒙大拿州美国参议院选举。共和党商人蒂姆·希希击败民主党籍现任参议员乔恩·泰斯特，首次当选参议员。尽管该州明显倾向共和党，泰斯特仍受到选民欢迎。

en.s: The 2024 Vermont Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the secretary of state of the state of Vermont. It coincided with the concurrent presidential election, as well as various state and local elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor of Vermont. Incumbent secretary of state Sarah Copeland Hanzas was re-elected to a second two-year term, defeating Republican newsstand owner H.

zh.t: 2024年美国佛蒙特州州务卿选举
zh.s: 2024年佛蒙特州州务卿选举于11月5日举行，选出该州州务卿。选举与总统选举以及联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州长等多项州级、地方选举同期举行。时任州务卿莎拉·科普兰·汉扎斯赢得连任，开始第二个两年任期，击败共和党候选人、报刊亭经营者H. Brooke Paige。

en.s: The 2024 West Virginia Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next attorney general of West Virginia, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as various state and local elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor of West Virginia. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Patrick Morrisey was eligible to run for re-election to a fourth term but decided instead to run for governor.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州州检察长选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行西弗吉尼亚州州检察长选举，与2024年美国总统选举以及美国参议院、美国众议院和州长等职位的州级和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任州检察长帕特里克·莫里西有资格竞选第四个任期，但决定转而竞选州长。

en.s: A general election was held in the state of Oklahoma on November 5, 2024. The primary elections for the Republican, Democratic, and Libertarian parties' nominations for offices other than president of the United States took place on June 18, 2024. All candidates were required to file between the days of April 3–5, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行俄克拉何马州大选。共和党、民主党和自由党针对美国总统以外职位的党内初选于2024年6月18日举行。所有候选人都必须在2024年4月3日至5日之间登记。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. county of Lee County, Alabama, on November 5, 2024, to elect various representatives for the county. Primary elections were held on March 5, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行美国阿拉巴马州李县大选，选出该县多名代表。党内初选于2024年3月5日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. New Hampshire voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of New Hampshire has four electoral votes in the Electoral College.

zh.t: 2024年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），新罕布什尔州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国大选的一部分。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与了选举。新罕布什尔州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有4票。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on November 5, 2024. Primary elections took place on March 5, 2024. Primary runoff elections took place on May 28, 2024. Seats up for election were all seats of the Texas Legislature, all 38 seats in the United States House of Representatives, and the Class I seat to the United States Senate, for which two-term incumbent Republican Senator Ted Cruz ran for and won re-election.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行得克萨斯州选举。党内初选于2024年3月5日举行，党内决选于5月28日举行。需要改选的席位包括得克萨斯州议会全部席位、美国众议院全部38席，以及美国参议院第一类席位。共和党籍现任参议员特德·克鲁兹已连任两届，这次竞选并成功连任。

en.s: The 2024 South Carolina Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. Primary elections took place on June 11, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年南卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行南卡罗来纳州参议院选举，与2024年美国大选同时进行。党内初选于2024年6月11日举行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Maryland on November 5, 2024. In addition to the U.S. presidential race, Maryland voters elected all of its seats in the United States House of Representatives, and one of its U.S. senators. Various municipal elections, including in Cecil County, Baltimore, and the city of Hagerstown, were also held. Polls were open from 7 AM to 8 PM EST.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行马里兰州大选。除总统选举外，选民还选出了该州全部联邦众议员和一名联邦参议员。塞西尔县、巴尔的摩市和黑格斯敦市等地也举行了市政选举。投票站于美国东部标准时间上午7时至晚上8时开放。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the 17 U.S. representatives from the State of Illinois, one from each of the state's 17 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年伊利诺伊州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行伊利诺伊州美国众议院选举，选出该州17个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Will County Executive election was held on November 5, 2024. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Jennifer Bertino-Tarrant ran for re-election to a second term. She was challenged by former County Board Member Chuck Maher, the Republican nominee. Bertino-Tarrant campaigned her success in her first term, pointing to her work in "building good, trusting relationships with local entities as well as departments within the county offices."

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行威尔县县行政长官选举。民主党籍现任县行政长官詹妮弗·贝蒂诺-塔兰特竞选连任第二个任期。共和党提名了前县委员会成员查克·马赫与她竞争。贝蒂诺-塔兰特在竞选中强调自己首个任期的成绩，提到她致力于“与地方单位以及县政府各部门建立良好、互信的关系”。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the State of South Carolina, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年南卡罗来纳州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行南卡罗来纳州美国众议院选举，选出该州7个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of New Hampshire, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. Primary elections took place on September 10, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年新罕布什尔州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行新罕布什尔州美国众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。党内初选于2024年9月10日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the State of Colorado, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年科罗拉多州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行科罗拉多州美国众议院选举，选出该州8个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Vermont were held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives to represent Vermont's at-large district. Democrat incumbent Becca Balint was re-elected to a second term, defeating Republican truck driver Mark Coester and independent Adam Ortiz. Primary elections took place on August 13, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年佛蒙特州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行佛蒙特州美国众议院选举，选出代表该州全州单一选区的联邦众议员。民主党籍现任众议员贝卡·巴林特击败共和党人、卡车司机马克·科斯特和独立候选人亚当·奥尔蒂斯，连任第二个任期。党内初选于2024年8月13日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Minnesota voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Minnesota has 10 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.t: 2024年明尼苏达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），明尼苏达州举行美国总统选举，作为2024年美国大选的一部分。当年50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与了选举。明尼苏达州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。该州在选举人团中有10票；根据2020年美国人口普查后重新分配的席位，该州席位数没有变化。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in California
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in California were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the 52 U.S. representatives from the State of California, one from all 52 of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行加利福尼亚州美国众议院选举，选出该州52个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the State of Nebraska, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年内布拉斯加州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行内布拉斯加州美国众议院选举，选出该州3个国会选区各自的一名联邦众议员。选举与美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Iowa was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Iowa voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日（星期二），艾奥瓦州举行美国总统选举，作为50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与的2024年美国大选的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 Maricopa County elections were held on November 5, 2024, in Maricopa County, Arizona, with partisan primary elections for county offices being held on July 30, 2024. All five seats of the Board of Supervisors were up for election, as well as all county-wide elected officials (except the Clerk of the Superior Court). Democrat Joe Biden won the county with 50.13% of the vote in the 2020 presidential election.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日在亚利桑那州马里科帕县举行选举。县级公职的党内初选于2024年7月30日举行。县监事会全部5个席位和县内所有民选职位都需要改选，县高等法院书记员职位除外。民主党人乔·拜登在2020年总统选举中以50.13%的选票赢得该县。

en.s: The 2024 Missouri House of Representatives election took place on November 5, 2024, as part of the biennial 2024 United States elections. It was held alongside numerous other federal, state, and local elections, including the 2024 U.S. presidential election and the 2024 Missouri Senate election. All 163 seats in the Missouri House of Representatives were up for election. Primary elections took place on August 6, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行密苏里州众议院选举，作为2024年美国两年一度选举的一部分。选举与多项联邦、州和地方选举同时举行，包括2024年美国总统选举和密苏里州参议院选举。州众议院全部163个席位都需要改选。党内初选于2024年8月6日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Louisville Metro Council election was held on November 5, 2024. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 21. Half of the council (all even-numbered seats) was up for election. Following the 2022 election, Democrats and Republicans held 17 and nine seats, respectively. The deadline for candidates to file was January 5, 2024. Democrats maintained their majority in the chamber, losing three seats.

zh.t: 2024年路易斯维尔市都会区议会选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行路易斯维尔市都会区议会选举。共和党和民主党的党内初选于5月21日举行。议会一半席位，即所有偶数编号席位，都需要改选。2022年选举后，民主党和共和党分别占17席和9席。候选人登记截止日期为2024年1月5日。民主党保住多数，但减少了3个席位。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Ohio was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Ohio. Republican businessman Bernie Moreno defeated Democratic three-term incumbent Sherrod Brown. Primary elections took place on March 19, 2024. This was the first U.S. Senate race in Ohio where the incumbent was defeated since 2006, when Brown defeated Mike DeWine.

zh.t: 2024年俄亥俄州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行俄亥俄州美国参议院选举。共和党商人伯尼·莫雷诺击败民主党籍现任参议员谢罗德·布朗。布朗已连任三届。党内初选于2024年3月19日举行。这是自2006年布朗击败迈克·德温以来，俄亥俄州首次有现任联邦参议员落败。

en.s: The 2024 California's 45th congressional district election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the United States representative for California's 45th congressional district, concurrently with elections for the other U.S. House districts in California and the rest of the country, as well as the 2024 U.S. Senate race in California, other elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州第45国会选区选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日举行加利福尼亚州第45国会选区选举，选出该选区的联邦众议员。选举与加利福尼亚州其他联邦众议院选区和全国各地的选举、2024年加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举、其他州的参议院选举，以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2024 Alaska House of Representatives election took place on November 5, 2024, as part of the biennial United States elections. All 40 seats in the Alaska House of Representatives were up for election.

zh.s: 2024年阿拉斯加州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，是美国两年一度选举的一部分。阿拉斯加州众议院的40个席位全部改选。

en.s: The 2024 Illinois House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. No seats were changed in this election.

zh.s: 2024年伊利诺伊州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国选举同期进行。本次选举没有席位易手。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Nevada. Incumbent Democratic Senator Jacky Rosen narrowly won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Sam Brown. Republican presidential nominee Donald Trump carried Nevada on the same ballot. Primary elections took place on June 11, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年内华达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年内华达州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表内华达州的美国联邦参议员。民主党现任参议员杰基·罗森以微弱优势连任，进入第二个任期，击败共和党候选人萨姆·布朗。同一张选票上，共和党总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普赢得内华达州。初选于2024年6月11日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Montana Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. This was the first election under new legislative lines adopted by an independent, bipartisan commission in 2023. Although Republicans maintained their majority, Democrats won new seats and ended Republicans' veto-proof supermajority.

zh.s: 2024年蒙大拿州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国选举同期进行。这是该州在2023年由独立、两党成员组成的委员会通过新选区划分后举行的首次选举。共和党保住多数席位，但民主党赢得了一些席位，使共和党失去足以阻止否决案被推翻的绝对多数。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Kentucky, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年肯塔基州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年肯塔基州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表肯塔基州的6名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Virginia
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the Commonwealth of Virginia. Democratic incumbent Tim Kaine won re-election to a third term, defeating Republican former U.S. Navy captain Hung Cao by an 8.93% margin. Primary elections took place on June 18, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表弗吉尼亚州的美国联邦参议员。民主党现任参议员蒂姆·凯恩击败共和党候选人、美国海军前上尉洪曹，连任第三个任期，领先8.93个百分点。初选于2024年6月18日举行。

en.t: 2024 South Dakota House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2024 South Dakota House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect all 70 seats in the South Dakota House of Representatives. The elections coincided with the presidential, U.S. House, and State Senate elections. The primary elections were held on June 4, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年南达科他州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，改选南达科他州众议院全部70个席位。选举与总统选举、联邦众议院选举和州参议院选举同期举行。初选于2024年6月4日举行。

en.s: Alaska state elections in 2024 were held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024. Primary elections were held on August 20, 2024.

zh.s: 阿拉斯加州选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行。初选于2024年8月20日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Nevada Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024. Voters in 10 districts of the Nevada Senate elected their senators. The elections coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and the State Assembly. Republicans needed to gain three seats to win control of the chamber. The primary elections were held on Tuesday, June 11, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年内华达州参议院选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行。内华达州参议院10个选区的选民选出了本区参议员。选举还与其他职位的选举同期举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州众议员选举。共和党需要赢得3个席位才能控制参议院。初选于2024年6月11日星期二举行。

en.t: 2024 West Virginia House of Delegates election
en.s: The 2024 West Virginia House of Delegates elections were on November 5, 2024, alongside elections to the presidency, governorship, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and other offices. Primary elections were held on May 14, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与总统、州长、联邦参议院、联邦众议院及其他职位的选举同期进行。初选于2024年5月14日举行。

en.s: The 2024 North Dakota State Treasurer election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next state treasurer of North Dakota. Incumbent Republican treasurer Thomas Beadle won a second term unopposed. Primary elections took place on June 11, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年北达科他州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2024年北达科他州州财政部长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出下一任北达科他州州财政部长。共和党现任财政部长托马斯·比德尔在没有对手的情况下连任第二届。初选于2024年6月11日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the secretary of state of the state of Missouri. It coincided with the concurrent presidential election, as well as various state and local elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor of Missouri. The primaries took place on August 6, 2024. Republican nominee, Denny Hoskins won the election and became the secretary of state in 2025.

zh.s: 2024年密苏里州州务卿选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出密苏里州州务卿。选举与同期举行的总统选举以及联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长等州和地方选举同时进行。初选于2024年8月6日举行。共和党候选人丹尼·霍斯金斯赢得选举，并于2025年就任州务卿。

en.s: The 2024 Utah House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 2024, as part of the biennial 2024 United States elections. All 75 seats in the Utah House of Representatives were up for election for the 66th Legislature. The filing deadline for candidates was January 8, 2024. Primary elections were held on June 24, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年犹他州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，是2024年美国两年一度选举的一部分。犹他州众议院全部75个席位都将改选，组成第66届州议会。候选人报名截止日期为2024年1月8日。初选于2024年6月24日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Hawaii was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Hawaii. Democratic two-term incumbent Mazie Hirono defeated Republican former state representative Bob McDermott. Primary elections took place on August 10, 2024. Hirono won the Democratic nomination with 90% of the vote, while McDermott won the Republican nomination with 51% of the vote in a six-way primary.

zh.t: 2024年夏威夷州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年夏威夷州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表夏威夷州的美国联邦参议员。已任职两届的民主党现任参议员梅齐·希罗诺击败共和党候选人、前州众议员鲍勃·麦克德莫特。初选于2024年8月10日举行。希罗诺以90%的得票率赢得民主党提名；麦克德莫特则在有6名候选人的初选中以51%的得票率赢得共和党提名。

en.s: The 2024 South Carolina elections were held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年南卡罗来纳州选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行。

en.s: The 2024 West Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of West Virginia, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Republican state Attorney General Patrick Morrisey was elected to his first term in office after defeating Democratic Huntington mayor Steve Williams in the general election.

zh.s: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州州长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期举行。共和党州总检察长帕特里克·莫里西在普选中击败民主党候选人、亨廷顿市长史蒂夫·威廉姆斯，当选州长，首次担任该职。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Kentucky voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Kentucky has 8 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.s: 2024年肯塔基州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。肯塔基州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，肯塔基州在选举人团中有8张选举人票，席位数没有增减。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. South Dakota voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年南达科他州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。南达科他州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 Oregon State Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Oregon on November 5, 2024, to elect 15 of the 30 members of the State Senate to the 83rd Oregon Legislature. Primary elections were held in several districts on May 21, 2024. The election coincided with the election of the other house of the Legislative Assembly, the Oregon House of Representatives, and other elections.

zh.s: 2024年俄勒冈州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，改选俄勒冈州参议院30个席位中的15个，组成第83届州议会。部分选区的初选于2024年5月21日举行。选举与俄勒冈州议会另一院——俄勒冈州众议院的选举以及其他选举同期举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. District of Columbia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年哥伦比亚特区美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年哥伦比亚特区美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。哥伦比亚特区选民通过普选选出代表本区参加选举人团的选举人。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Missouri, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年密苏里州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年密苏里州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表密苏里州的8名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Maine was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the U.S. Senate to represent the state of Maine. Incumbent independent Senator Angus King won re-election to a third term, defeating Democratic nominee David Costello, Republican nominee Demitroula Kouzounas, and independent Jason Cherry. Primary elections took place on June 11, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年缅因州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表缅因州的美国联邦参议员。现任无党籍参议员安格斯·金击败民主党候选人大卫·科斯特洛、共和党候选人迪米特鲁拉·库祖纳斯和无党籍候选人杰森·切里，连任第三个任期。初选于2024年6月11日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the twelve U.S. representatives from the State of New Jersey, one from all twelve of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年新泽西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年新泽西州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表新泽西州的12名美国联邦众议员，每人代表该州12个国会选区之一。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Ohio Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect senators in 16 even-numbered districts of the Ohio Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. In addition, there was a special election in District 33 for the remainder of that district's term ending in 2026. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for U.S. president and U.S.

zh.s: 2024年俄亥俄州参议院选举于11月5日举行，改选州参议院16个偶数编号选区的席位。州参议员由单一选区选出，任期四年。此外，第33选区举行特别选举，以填补截至2026年的剩余任期。此次选举与多项联邦和州级选举同期举行，包括美国总统和联邦参议院选举。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Kentucky on November 5, 2024. The primary election for all offices was held on May 21, 2024. The last day to register to vote in the primary election was April 22 and the last day to register to vote in the general election was October 7.

zh.s: 美国肯塔基州于2024年11月5日举行普选。各职位的初选于2024年5月21日举行。参加初选的选民登记截止日期为4月22日，参加普选的登记截止日期为10月7日。

en.s: The 2024 United States state treasurer elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the state treasurer and equivalents in nine states, plus a special election in Arkansas. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2020. The treasurer of Vermont serves two-year terms and was last elected in 2022. These elections took place concurrently with several other federal, state, and local elections.

zh.s: 2024年美国州财政部长选举于2024年11月5日举行，在9个州选出州财政部长或同等职位人员，阿肯色州另举行了一场特别选举。上一次这组州的选举于2020年举行。佛蒙特州财政部长任期为两年，上次选举在2022年举行。这些选举与其他联邦、州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Portland mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Portland, Oregon. Businessman Keith Wilson was elected, defeating three city council members and 15 other candidates. This was the first Portland mayoral election to use ranked-choice voting (Instant-runoff voting) after it was instituted by the passage of a 2022 ballot measure.

zh.t: 2024年俄勒冈州波特兰市长选举
zh.s: 2024年波特兰市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出俄勒冈州波特兰市市长。商人基思·威尔逊当选，击败3名市议员和另外15名候选人。这是波特兰市首次使用排序选择投票（即时决选投票）举行市长选举；该制度由2022年通过的一项公投措施设立。

en.s: The 2024 Oregon State Treasurer election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Oregon state treasurer. Incumbent Democratic state treasurer Tobias Read was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a third term in office; he instead successfully ran for Secretary of State. Primary elections took place May 21, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年俄勒冈州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2024年俄勒冈州州财政部长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出俄勒冈州州财政部长。民主党现任财政部长托拜厄斯·里德受任期限制，不能竞选连任第三届；他转而竞选州务卿并成功当选。初选于2024年5月21日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Hawaii House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections. All 51 seats in the Hawaii House of Representatives were elected.

zh.s: 2024年夏威夷州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分。夏威夷州众议院全部51个席位都进行改选。

en.s: The 2024 Kentucky Senate election was held on November 5, 2024. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 21. Half of the senate (all odd-numbered seats) was up for election. Following the 2022 election, Republicans and Democrats held 31 and seven seats, respectively. The deadline for candidates to file was January 5, 2024. Republicans maintained their majority in the chamber without gaining or losing any seats.

zh.s: 2024年肯塔基州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行。共和党和民主党初选于5月21日举行。参议院半数席位（所有奇数编号席位）进行改选。2022年选举后，共和党和民主党分别拥有31席和7席。候选人报名截止日期为2024年1月5日。共和党保住了参议院多数席位，席位数没有增减。

en.t: 2024 United States secretary of state elections
en.s: The 2024 United States Secretary of State elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Secretaries of State in seven states. These elections took place concurrently with several other federal, state, and local elections. The elections for Secretary of State had taken on heightened importance due to former President Donald Trump's claims that the 2020 election was stolen.

zh.s: 2024年美国有7个州于11月5日举行州务卿选举。选举与其他联邦、州和地方选举同期举行。由于前总统唐纳德·特朗普声称2020年选举遭到窃取，州务卿选举受到更多关注。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Illinois voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.t: 2024年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年伊利诺伊州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。伊利诺伊州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Connecticut, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表康涅狄格州的5名美国联邦众议员，每人代表该州5个国会选区之一。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024 to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Republican Gov. Chris Sununu did not seek election to a fifth term. Primary elections took place on September 10, 2024. Republican former U.S. Senator Kelly Ayotte won the Republican nomination with 63% of the vote over former state senate president Chuck Morse, and Democratic former Manchester mayor Joyce Craig won the Democratic nomination with 48% of the vote over state executive councilor Cinde Warmington.

zh.s: 2024年新罕布什尔州州长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出该州州长。共和党现任州长克里斯·苏努努没有竞选第五个任期。初选于2024年9月10日举行。共和党候选人、前联邦参议员凯莉·阿约特以63%的得票率赢得共和党提名，击败前州参议院议长查克·莫尔斯；民主党候选人、前曼彻斯特市长乔伊斯·克雷格以48%的得票率赢得民主党提名，击败州行政委员会成员辛德·沃明顿。

en.t: 2024 San Diego County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2024 San Diego County Board of Supervisors election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect members of the San Diego County Board of Supervisors. Three of the five seats on the board were up for election, with all three incumbents winning re-election. The election resulted in the continuation of a 3-2 Democratic majority.

zh.s: 2024年圣迭戈县监事会选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，选出圣迭戈县监事会成员。监事会5个席位中有3个改选，3名现任者全部连任。选举后，民主党仍以3比2占多数。

en.s: The 2024 Fort Lauderdale mayoral election took place on November 5, 2024. Incumbent Mayor Dean Trantalis ran for re-election to a third term. He faced a crowded field of challengers, including attorney Barbra Stern and Kenneth Cooper, his 2020 opponent. Trantalis won re-election, but with a plurality of the vote, receiving 38 percent of the vote to Stern's 33 percent and Cooper's 14 percent.

zh.s: 2024年劳德代尔堡市长选举于2024年11月5日举行。现任市长迪恩·特兰塔利斯竞选连任第三届，面对多名对手，包括律师芭芭拉·斯特恩和他在2020年的对手肯尼斯·库珀。特兰塔利斯成功连任，但只获得相对多数票：斯特恩得票33%，库珀得票14%，他本人得票38%。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections. Vermont voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Vermont has 3 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.s: 2024年佛蒙特州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分。佛蒙特州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，佛蒙特州在选举人团中有3张选举人票，席位数没有增减。

en.s: The 2024 North Dakota Senate election took place on November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections. Senators serve four-year terms. Elections are staggered such that half the senate districts have elections every two years (even-numbered seats are up on presidential election years.) In the 2022 North Dakota elections, a ballot measure created term limits of eight years in the North Dakota Senate, which was put into effect starting January 2023.

zh.s: 2024年北达科他州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分。参议员任期为4年。选举分批举行，因此每两年有一半的参议院选区进行选举（偶数编号席位在总统选举年改选）。在2022年北达科他州选举中，一项公投通过了限制州参议员任期的措施，每人最多可任职8年，该规定自2023年1月起生效。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Wisconsin. Incumbent Democratic Senator Tammy Baldwin won re-election to a third term by a narrow 0.85% margin, defeating Republican nominee Eric Hovde. Third-party candidates Phil Anderson and Thomas Leager were seen as potential spoiler candidates for Hovde in a state that had voted for Republican presidential nominee Donald Trump.

zh.t: 2024年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表威斯康星州的美国联邦参议员。民主党现任参议员塔米·鲍德温以微弱优势连任第三个任期，领先0.85个百分点，击败共和党候选人埃里克·霍夫德。在这个投票支持共和党总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普的州，第三党候选人菲尔·安德森和托马斯·利杰被视为可能分走霍夫德选票的人。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Indiana voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Indiana has 11 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.t: 2024年印第安纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 印第安纳州于2024年11月5日星期二举行总统选举，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。印第安纳州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，印第安纳州在选举人团中有11张选举人票，席位数没有增减。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Nebraska was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Nebraska. Republican incumbent Deb Fischer was re-elected to a third term, defeating independent union leader Dan Osborn. This was the first time since 1954 when both of Nebraska's U.S.

zh.t: 2024年美国内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2024年美国内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月5日举行，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍时任参议员黛布·费舍尔击败独立候选人、工会领袖丹·奥斯本，赢得第三个任期。这是自1954年以来，内布拉斯加州两个联邦参议院席位首次同时进入改选，因为该州另一席位举行了特别选举。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states, plus the District of Columbia, participated. Nevada voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.s: 2024年内华达州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。内华达州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: The 2024 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various other state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Lieutenant Governor Bethany Hall-Long is term-limited and cannot seek re-election to a third term in office; she instead unsuccessfully ran for governor.

zh.s: 2024年特拉华州副州长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。民主党现任副州长贝瑟妮·霍尔-朗受任期限制，不能竞选连任第三届；她转而竞选州长，但未能当选。

en.t: 2024 Maricopa County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2024 Maricopa County Board of Supervisors elections were held on November 5, 2024. Primary elections were held on August 6. All five seats of the Maricopa County, Arizona Board of Supervisors were up for election. After the elections, the Republican Party won four seats on the board, while the Democratic Party won one.

zh.s: 2024年马里科帕县监事会选举于2024年11月5日举行。初选于8月6日举行。亚利桑那州马里科帕县监事会全部5个席位都进行改选。选举后，共和党赢得4席，民主党赢得1席。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the State of Massachusetts, one from all nine of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表马萨诸塞州的9名美国联邦众议员，每人代表该州9个国会选区之一。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The Chicago Board of Education election took place on November 5, 2024, alongside the statewide general elections. This was the first ever election to the Board, which has been an appointed body since its formation in 1837. The election was planned after the state passed a law in 2021 that would create an elected school board.

zh.s: 芝加哥教育委员会选举于2024年11月5日举行，与全州普选同期进行。这是教育委员会首次举行选举；自1837年成立以来，委员会成员一直由任命产生。伊利诺伊州于2021年通过一项法律，决定设立民选学区委员会，此后筹备了这次选举。

en.s: The 2024 Montana gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Montana, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Primary elections took place on June 4, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年蒙大拿州州长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。初选于2024年6月4日举行。

en.t: 2024 Alabama State Board of Education election
en.s: The 2024 Alabama State Board of Education election was held on November 5, 2024 to elect four of nine members of the Alabama State Board of Education. Primary elections were held on March 5, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年阿拉巴马州教育委员会选举
zh.s: 2024年阿拉巴马州教育委员会选举于2024年11月5日举行，改选阿拉巴马州教育委员会9名成员中的4人。初选于2024年3月5日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of West Virginia. Republican governor Jim Justice won his first term in office, defeating Democratic Wheeling mayor Glenn Elliott. He succeeded independent incumbent Joe Manchin, who did not seek a third full term.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表西弗吉尼亚州的美国联邦参议员。共和党州长吉姆·贾斯蒂斯击败民主党候选人、惠灵市长格伦·埃利奥特，当选联邦参议员，首次担任该职。他接替了没有竞选完整第三个任期的无党籍现任参议员乔·曼钦。

en.s: The 2024 Oregon Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the attorney general of Oregon. Incumbent Democratic attorney general Ellen Rosenblum was originally appointed to the role by former Governor John Kitzhaber on June 29, 2012, to finish the term of her predecessor John Kroger, who resigned from office. She was elected to a full term in 2012 and re-elected in 2016 and 2020.

zh.s: 2024年俄勒冈州州检察长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出俄勒冈州州检察长。民主党现任州检察长埃伦·罗森布卢姆最初于2012年6月29日由前州长约翰·基茨哈伯任命，接替辞职的前任约翰·克罗格，完成其任期。她于2012年当选完整任期，并于2016年和2020年连任。

en.s: Elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate were held on November 5, 2024, with 25 of 50 districts being contested. The term of office for those elected in 2024 will begin when the Senate convenes in January 2025. Pennsylvania State Senators are elected for four-year terms, with half of the seats up for election every two years. The election coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, elections to the U.S.

zh.t: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，改选50个选区中的25席。2024年当选议员的任期于2025年1月州参议院开会时开始。州参议员任期四年，每两年改选一半席位。此次选举与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及宾夕法尼亚州众议院全体席位选举同期举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Vermont
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Vermont was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Vermont. Primary elections took place on August 13, 2024. Incumbent independent Senator Bernie Sanders won re-election to a fourth term, defeating the Republican nominee, businessman Gerald Malloy. Sanders filed paperwork to run for re-election in 2019.

zh.t: 2024年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年佛蒙特州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表佛蒙特州的美国联邦参议员。初选于2024年8月13日举行。现任无党籍参议员伯尼·桑德斯击败共和党候选人、商人杰拉尔德·马洛伊，连任第四个任期。桑德斯于2019年提交了竞选连任的文件。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the State of Arizona, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2024年肯塔基州最高法院第5选区选举于11月5日举行。肯塔基州最高法院由7名法官组成，法官通过不分党派的选举产生，任期八年并错开轮替。第5选区包括列克星敦地区的8个县，是2024年唯一举行选举的选区。2023年9月，时任法官劳伦斯·B.·范米特宣布不寻求连任。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Ohio voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. Ohio had 17 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state lost a seat.

en.s: West Virginia held elections on November 5, 2024. Primary elections were held on May 14, 2024. Each partisan statewide election was won by Republicans with more than 61% of votes, while the Republican supermajorities in both state legislative chambers increased. This resulted in every state-level and federal-level office in West Virginia being held by Republicans for the first time since the 1920s.
