en.s: The 2024 Montana Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the attorney general of the state of Montana. It coincided with the concurrent presidential election, as well as various state and local elections, including for U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and governor of Montana. Incumbent attorney general Austin Knudsen was re-elected to a second term, defeating Democratic challenger Ben Alke.

zh.s: 2024年蒙大拿州州检察长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出该州州检察长。选举与总统选举同期举行，也与联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州长等州及地方选举同时进行。现任州检察长奥斯汀·克努森击败民主党挑战者本·阿尔克，连任第二届。

en.s: The 2024 West Virginia State Treasurer election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next state treasurer of West Virginia. Incumbent Republican treasurer Riley Moore chose not to seek re-election, instead successfully running for U.S. House. Primary elections took place on May 14, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州州财政部长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出下一任西弗吉尼亚州州财政部长。共和党现任财政部长莱利·摩尔没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选联邦众议员并成功当选。初选于2024年5月14日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 5, 2024, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 94th Minnesota Legislature. Primaries took place on August 13, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年明尼苏达州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出明尼苏达州第94届州议会众议院议员。初选于2024年8月13日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Pennsylvania voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Pennsylvania has 19 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census.

zh.t: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。宾夕法尼亚州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，该州在选举人团中有19张选举人票。

en.s: The 2024 Alabama Supreme Court election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect five of the nine members to the Supreme Court of Alabama, including the Chief Justice. The justices will serve six-year terms.

zh.t: 2024年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2024年阿拉巴马州最高法院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出阿拉巴马州最高法院9名成员中的5人，其中包括首席大法官。大法官任期为6年。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Massachusetts took place on November 5, 2024. Democratic incumbent Senator Elizabeth Warren successfully ran for a third term, securing 59.81% of the vote. Warren was challenged by Republican attorney John Deaton. Primary elections took place on September 3, 2024. This election marked the first time that Warren had lost Bristol County while running for the office.

zh.t: 2024年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行。民主党现任参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦成功竞选第三个任期，获得59.81%的选票。她的对手是共和党律师约翰·迪顿。初选于2024年9月3日举行。这是沃伦竞选该职位以来首次在布里斯托尔县落败。

en.s: The 2024 Washington House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections, to elect representatives from all 98 legislative districts to the Washington House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on August 6, 2024. Washington uses a jungle primary system and the candidates with the two highest vote counts proceed to the general election.

zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国选举同期进行，改选华盛顿州众议院全部98个立法选区的议员。初选于2024年8月6日举行。华盛顿州采用丛林式初选，得票最高的两名候选人进入普选。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in New Mexico
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in New Mexico was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of New Mexico. Democratic incumbent Martin Heinrich won re-election to a third term, defeating Republican financier Nella Domenici. Primary elections took place on June 4, 2024, with both Heinrich and Domenici winning their respective party's nomination unopposed.

zh.t: 2024年新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表新墨西哥州的美国联邦参议员。民主党现任参议员马丁·海因里希击败共和党金融家内拉·多梅尼奇，连任第三个任期。初选于2024年6月4日举行，海因里希和多梅尼奇都未遇到党内对手，分别赢得本党提名。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the fifteen U.S. representatives from the state of Ohio, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, an election to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia

zh.t: 2024年弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表弗吉尼亚州11个国会选区的美国联邦众议员。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Pennsylvania Auditor General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Pennsylvania auditor general. Incumbent one-term Republican auditor general Timothy DeFoor won reelection defeating Malcolm Kenyatta. The Associated Press called the election for DeFoor at 3:18 am on November 6. DeFoor's re-election victory was attributed to his strong performance in conservative-rural areas and overperforming Donald Trump's margins in the Philadelphia suburbs.

zh.t: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州审计长选举
zh.s: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州审计长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出宾夕法尼亚州审计长。共和党现任审计长蒂莫西·德福尔已任职一届，他击败马尔科姆·肯雅塔，成功连任。美联社于11月6日凌晨3点18分宣布德福尔胜选。他的连任被归因于在保守派占多数的农村地区表现出色，以及在费城郊区的得票率高于唐纳德·特朗普。

en.t: 2024 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2024 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia took place on November 5, 2024, to elect a shadow member to the United States House of Representatives to represent the District of Columbia. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Incumbent Shadow Representative Oye Owolewa is running for a third term.

en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Tennessee voters have chosen electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.s: 2024年田纳西州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。田纳西州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。

en.s: General elections were held in Palau on 5 November 2024 to elect a President and the National Congress. Incumbent President Surangel Whipps Jr. faced former president Tommy Remengesau Jr. in the election, and was reelected. This was the first presidential election where Remengesau lost.

zh.s: 帕劳于2024年11月5日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。现任总统苏朗格尔·惠普斯二世与前总统汤米·雷门格绍二世角逐总统职位，惠普斯成功连任。这是雷门格绍首次在总统选举中落败。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Minnesota was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Minnesota. Democratic incumbent Amy Klobuchar won a fourth term in office, defeating Republican former basketball player Royce White by a 15.7% margin. Primary elections took place on August 13, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年明尼苏达州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表明尼苏达州的美国联邦参议员。民主党现任参议员艾米·克洛布彻击败共和党候选人、前篮球运动员罗伊斯·怀特，领先15.7个百分点，赢得第四个任期。初选于2024年8月13日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various other state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor Mike Kehoe did not run for reelection for a second full term, and instead ran successfully for Governor of Missouri.

zh.s: 2024年密苏里州副州长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及其他州和地方选举同期进行。共和党现任副州长迈克·基奥没有竞选连任第二个完整任期，而是转而竞选州长并成功当选。

en.s: The 2024 North Carolina State Treasurer election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the North Carolina State Treasurer, concurrently with elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, governor, and other state and local elections. Incumbent Republican treasurer Dale Folwell declined to seek re-election a third term and instead ran for governor. Primary elections were held on March 5, 2024, also known as Super Tuesday.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2024年北卡罗来纳州州财政部长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州州财政部长，并与联邦众议院、州长等职位的选举以及其他州和地方选举同期进行。共和党现任财政部长戴尔·福尔韦尔没有竞选连任第三届，而是转而竞选州长。初选于2024年3月5日，也就是“超级星期二”举行。

en.t: 2024 West Virginia Commissioner of Agriculture election
en.s: The 2024 West Virginia Commissioner of Agriculture election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next commissioner of agriculture. Incumbent Republican commissioner Kent Leonhardt was re-elected with 69% of the vote.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州农业专员选举
zh.s: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州农业专员选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出下一任农业专员。共和党现任专员肯特·莱昂哈特以69%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 2024 Portland City Council elections were held on November 5, 2024. It was the first election under Portland's new form of government, the first election to elect a city council instead of a city commission, the first without a primary, the first where every seat was up for election, and the first under a proportional ranked-choice voting system (single transferable voting) as opposed to a first-past-the-post voting system with a primary.

zh.t: 2024年俄勒冈州波特兰市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年波特兰市议会选举于2024年11月5日举行。这是波特兰市采用新政府架构后的首次选举，也是首次选举市议会（此前选举的是市政委员会）、首次不举行初选、首次所有席位都改选，并首次采用比例排序选择投票制（单记可让渡投票），取代先得票者胜出的投票制和初选。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Oregon on November 5, 2024. Primary elections were held on May 21, 2024. In the early hours of October 28 an incendiary device was placed in a ballot drop box in Portland damaging 3 ballots.

zh.s: 美国俄勒冈州于2024年11月5日举行普选。初选于2024年5月21日举行。10月28日凌晨，有人在波特兰一个投票箱中放置燃烧装置，造成3张选票受损。

en.s: The 2024 Oregon House of Representatives elections were held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024. Primary elections were held on Tuesday, May 21, 2024. All of the 60 seats of the Oregon House of Representatives were to be elected. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for State Senate, as part of the 2024 Oregon elections.

zh.s: 2024年俄勒冈州众议院选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行。初选于2024年5月21日星期二举行。俄勒冈州众议院全部60个席位都将改选。选举与州参议院等其他职位的选举同期举行，属于2024年俄勒冈州选举的一部分。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the State of Oklahoma, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The primary elections for the Republican, Democratic, and Libertarian parties' nominations took place on June 18, 2024. All candidates had to file between the days of April 3–5, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表俄克拉何马州的5名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。共和党、民主党和自由意志党提名候选人的初选于2024年6月18日举行。所有候选人都必须在2024年4月3日至5日期间提交报名材料。

en.s: The 2024 Vermont House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. Although the Democrats retained the House, they lost their veto-proof majority, dwindling to 87 seats. Republicans attained their best House result since 2004, coming away with 56 representatives.

zh.s: 2024年佛蒙特州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国选举同期进行。民主党保住了众议院，但失去了足以推翻州长否决的多数席位，席位减至87席。共和党赢得自2004年以来在众议院的最好成绩，取得56席。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Mississippi voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. Mississippi's six votes in the Electoral College were unaffected by reapportionment after the 2020 United States census.

zh.t: 2024年密西西比州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年密西西比州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。密西西比州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。密西西比州在选举人团中有6张选举人票，2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配没有影响票数。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Montana
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Montana took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Montana voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Montana has four electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state gained a seat.

zh.s: 2024年蒙大拿州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。蒙大拿州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，蒙大拿州在选举人团中有4张选举人票，该州因此增加一个国会席位。

en.s: The 2024 Dane County Executive special election took place on November 5, 2024, following a primary election on August 13, 2024. County Executive Joe Parisi, who won re-election to a four year term in 2021, announced that he would resign from office. Following Parisi's resignation, former County Supervisor Jamie Kuhn was appointed as interim County Executive, and served until the special election.

zh.t: 2024年丹恩县行政长官特别选举
zh.s: 2024年丹恩县行政长官特别选举于2024年11月5日举行，初选于2024年8月13日举行。县行政长官乔·帕里西于2021年连任，任期4年，之后宣布辞职。帕里西辞职后，前县监事杰米·库恩获任临时行政长官，一直任职至特别选举。

en.s: The 2024 Delaware Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections.

zh.s: 2024年特拉华州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国选举同期进行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of Alabama, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表阿拉巴马州的7名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Kentucky House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 21. Following the 2022 election, Republicans and Democrats held 80 and 20 seats, respectively. The deadline for candidates to file was January 5, 2024. Republicans maintained their majority in the chamber without gaining or losing any seats.

zh.s: 2024年肯塔基州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行。共和党和民主党初选于5月21日举行。2022年选举后，共和党和民主党分别拥有80席和20席。候选人报名截止日期为2024年1月5日。共和党保住了众议院多数席位，席位数没有增减。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of New Jersey. Democratic U.S. representative Andy Kim won his first term in office, defeating Republican real estate developer Curtis Bashaw. He succeeded Democrat George Helmy, who served as an interim appointee for the remainder of Bob Menendez's third term.

zh.t: 2024年新泽西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年新泽西州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表新泽西州的美国联邦参议员。民主党联邦众议员安迪·金击败共和党候选人、房地产开发商柯蒂斯·巴沙，当选并首次担任联邦参议员。他接替了民主党人乔治·赫尔米；赫尔米作为临时任命的参议员，完成了鲍勃·梅嫩德斯第三个任期的剩余时间。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the State of Idaho, one from both of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年爱达荷州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年爱达荷州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表爱达荷州的2名美国联邦众议员，每人代表该州两个国会选区之一。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the ten U.S. representatives from the State of Washington, one from each of the state's 10 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年华盛顿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表华盛顿州10个国会选区的10名美国联邦众议员。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 5, 2024. All seats in the Minnesota House of Representatives were up for election as well as several judicial seats, Minnesota's 10 presidential electors, a United States Senate seat, Minnesota's eight seats in the United States House of Representatives, one seat of the Minnesota Senate, and several positions for local offices.

zh.s: 美国明尼苏达州于2024年11月5日举行普选。明尼苏达州众议院全部席位、若干司法职位、该州10名总统选举人、一个联邦参议院席位、联邦众议院的8个席位、一个州参议院席位以及若干地方职位都进行选举。

en.t: 2024 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2024 North Carolina House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for the U.S. President, U.S. House of Representatives, Council of State, and State Senate. The primary election was held on March 5, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，改选该州众议院全部120名议员。选举与美国总统、联邦众议院、州行政委员会和州参议院等职位的选举同期举行。初选于2024年3月5日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Missouri State Treasurer election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the next Missouri state treasurer. Incumbent Republican treasurer Vivek Malek was appointed to the position in 2023 by Governor Mike Parson. He replaced Scott Fitzpatrick, who resigned after being elected state auditor. Malek was elected to a full term.

zh.t: 2024年密苏里州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2024年密苏里州州财政部长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出下一任密苏里州州财政部长。共和党现任财政部长维韦克·马利克于2023年由州长迈克·帕森任命，接替因当选州审计长而辞职的斯科特·菲茨帕特里克。马利克随后赢得完整任期。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia will participate. Alabama chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Alabama has nine electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.t: 2024年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都将参加选举。阿拉巴马州通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，阿拉巴马州在选举人团中有9张选举人票，席位数没有增减。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Utah was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Utah. Republican congressman John Curtis won his first term in office, succeeding Republican incumbent Mitt Romney, who did not seek a second term. Utah has been represented in the U.S. Senate exclusively by Republicans since 1977.

zh.s: 2024年犹他州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表犹他州的美国联邦参议员。共和党联邦众议员约翰·柯蒂斯当选并首次担任联邦参议员，接替没有竞选连任的共和党现任参议员米特·罗姆尼。自1977年以来，犹他州在美国联邦参议院中的代表一直都是共和党人。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Oklahoma voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Oklahoma has seven electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.t: 2024年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。俄克拉何马州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，俄克拉何马州在选举人团中有7张选举人票，席位数没有增减。

en.s: The 2024 elections for the Illinois Senate were held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024. The general primary election for established political parties was held on March 19, 2024. Elections were held for 23 out of 59 seats in the Illinois Senate. No seats were changed in this election.

zh.s: 2024年伊利诺伊州参议院选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行。已成立政党的普选初选于2024年3月19日举行。伊利诺伊州参议院59个席位中有23个改选。本次选举没有席位易手。

en.s: The 2024 Pennsylvania Attorney General election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the attorney general of the U.S. state of Pennsylvania. Republican York County District Attorney Dave Sunday defeated former auditor general Eugene DePasquale in the general election, becoming the first Republican to be elected state attorney general since 2008. This was the only attorney general seat to change parties in 2024.

zh.t: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州州检察长选举
zh.s: 2024年宾夕法尼亚州州检察长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出宾夕法尼亚州州检察长。共和党候选人、约克县地方检察官戴夫·森迪在普选中击败前州审计长尤金·德帕斯夸莱，当选州检察长；这是自2008年以来首次由共和党人当选该州州检察长。2024年只有这一个州检察长职位易手。

en.t: 2024 New Hampshire House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2024 New Hampshire House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside other state and federal elections, including the 2024 United States presidential election and the 2024 United States House of Representatives elections. Republicans picked up 21 seats, expanding their narrow one-seat majority. New Hampshire elects many of its state legislators using first-past-the-post voting but uses 2-seat to 11-seat districts to elect other state legislators.

zh.t: 2024年新罕布什尔州众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年新罕布什尔州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与其他州和联邦选举同期进行，包括2024年美国总统选举和联邦众议院选举。共和党增加21个席位，扩大了原本只有1席的微弱多数。新罕布什尔州许多州议员由得票最高者当选，但该州也采用每区选出2至11名议员的多席选区制度。

en.s: The 2024 Vermont Senate election took place on November 5, 2024, as part of the biennial United States elections. The election coincided with elections for other offices including the U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Governor, and State House. State senators serve two-year terms in the Vermont Senate. Primary elections were held on August 13, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年佛蒙特州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，是美国两年一度选举的一部分。选举还与美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长和州众议院等职位的选举同期举行。佛蒙特州参议员任期为两年。初选于2024年8月13日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Wisconsin Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, at the Fall general election in Wisconsin, alongside the election for the State Assembly. Sixteen of the 33 seats in the Wisconsin Senate were up for election—the even-numbered districts. Before the election, 22 Senate seats were held by Republicans, 11 seats were held by Democrats.

zh.s: 2024年威斯康星州参议院选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是威斯康星州秋季普选的一部分，并与州众议院选举同期进行。威斯康星州参议院33个席位中有16个改选，即所有偶数编号选区。选举前，共和党拥有22席，民主党拥有11席。

en.s: The 2024 Michigan House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States presidential election. All 110 seats in the Michigan House of Representatives were elected.

zh.s: 2024年密歇根州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举同期进行。密歇根州众议院全部110个席位都进行改选。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives to represent the state of Alaska from its at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House, elections to the United States Senate, and various other state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表阿拉斯加州单一国会选区的美国联邦众议员。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 New Hampshire Senate elections were held on November 5, 2024, to elect all 24 seats in the New Hampshire Senate. Primary elections were held on September 10, 2024. The elections coincided with the Presidential, U.S. House, and State House elections. Republicans expanded on their 14-10 majority and earned a 16-8 supermajority after the elections.

zh.t: 2024年新罕布什尔州参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年新罕布什尔州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，改选州参议院全部24个席位。初选于2024年9月10日举行。选举与总统、联邦众议院和州众议院选举同期进行。选举后，共和党扩大了原本14比10的多数席位，赢得16比8的绝对多数。

en.s: The 2024 Vermont State Treasurer election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the Vermont state treasurer. Incumbent Democratic treasurer Mike Pieciak won a second two-year term. He defeated Republican nominee Joshua Bechhoefer in the general election.

zh.t: 2024年佛蒙特州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2024年佛蒙特州州财政部长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出佛蒙特州州财政部长。民主党现任财政部长迈克·皮耶恰克击败共和党候选人乔舒亚·贝克霍弗，赢得第二个两年任期。

en.s: On November 5, 2024, an election was held to elect all 8 members to the Massachusetts Governor's Council. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including Electors of President and Vice President, U.S. Senator, U.S. House of Representatives, State Senators, State Representatives, Register of Deeds, Clerk of Courts, and County Commissioners (only certain counties). The previous election saw Democrats maintain all 8 seats on the council.

zh.t: 2024年马萨诸塞州州长委员会选举
zh.s: 2024年11月5日，马萨诸塞州举行选举，选出州长委员会全部8名成员。选举与总统和副总统选举人、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州参议员、州众议员、契据登记官、法院书记员以及县专员（仅部分县）等职位的选举同期举行。上次选举中，民主党保住了委员会全部8个席位。

en.s: The 2024 Kansas Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. All 40 seats in the Kansas Senate were up for election and the primary was held on August 6, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年堪萨斯州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国选举同期进行。堪萨斯州参议院全部40个席位都进行改选，初选于2024年8月6日举行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan were held on November 5, 2024 to elect 13 U.S. representatives from the state of Michigan, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年密歇根州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年密歇根州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表密歇根州的13名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Maine Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, with the primary election using instant-runoff voting held on June 11, 2024, to elect the 132nd Maine Senate. Voters in all 35 districts of the Maine Senate elected their senators. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House and the Maine House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2024年缅因州参议院选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，初选采用即时决选投票，于2024年6月11日举行，选出第132届缅因州参议院议员。缅因州参议院全部35个选区的选民都选出了本区参议员。选举还与美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和缅因州众议院等职位的选举同期举行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Mississippi was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Mississippi. Incumbent Senator Roger Wicker took office on December 31, 2007, as an interim appointee after Trent Lott resigned 13 days prior. Wicker retained his Senate seat in the subsequent 2008 special election, won full terms in 2012 and 2018, and sought a third full term.

zh.t: 2024年密西西比州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年密西西比州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表密西西比州的美国联邦参议员。现任参议员罗杰·威克于2007年12月31日获临时任命，接替13天前辞职的特伦特·洛特。威克随后在2008年特别选举中保住席位，并于2012年和2018年赢得完整任期，这次竞选第三个完整任期。

en.t: 2024 North Carolina Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2024 North Carolina Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the secretary of state of North Carolina, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various other state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Secretary of State Elaine Marshall won re-election to an eighth term in office.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州州务卿选举
zh.s: 2024年北卡罗来纳州州务卿选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及其他州和地方选举同期进行。民主党现任州务卿伊莱恩·马歇尔连任，进入第八个任期。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the fourteen U.S. representatives from the State of North Carolina, one from all fourteen of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表北卡罗来纳州14个国会选区的14名美国联邦众议员。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 New Mexico Senate elections were held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections. A primary election on June 4, 2024 determined which candidates appeared on the November 3 general election ballot.

zh.s: 2024年新墨西哥州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国选举同期进行。6月4日举行的初选决定了哪些候选人进入11月3日的大选选票。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Iowa
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Iowa were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the State of Iowa, one from all four of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年艾奥瓦州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年艾奥瓦州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表艾奥瓦州的4名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 North Carolina Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect all 50 members to North Carolina's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for the U.S. President, U.S. House of Representatives, Council of State, and state house. The primary election was held on March 5, 2024. Ahead of the election, districts were redrawn and passed the General Assembly in Senate Bill 758.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，改选北卡罗来纳州参议院全部50名议员。选举与美国总统、联邦众议院、州行政委员会和州众议院等职位的选举同期举行。初选于2024年3月5日举行。选举前，选区经过重新划分，并由州议会通过第758号参议院法案予以批准。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Rhode Island was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Rhode Island. The primary election took place on September 10, 2024. Incumbent Democratic Senator Sheldon Whitehouse was re-elected to a fourth term in office, defeating Republican state representative Patricia Morgan by a 20.05% margin.

zh.t: 2024年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表罗得岛州的美国联邦参议员。初选于2024年9月10日举行。民主党现任参议员谢尔登·怀特豪斯击败共和党州众议员帕特里夏·摩根，领先20.05个百分点，连任第四个任期。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participated. Nebraska voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. Nebraska has five electoral votes.

zh.t: 2024年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。内布拉斯加州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。内布拉斯加州有5张选举人票。

en.t: 2024 North Carolina Council of State elections
en.s: Elections were held in North Carolina were held on November 5, 2024, to select the ten officers of the North Carolina Council of State. These elections coincided with the presidential election, elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the North Carolina General Assembly and top state courts. Primary elections took place on March 5, 2024, for offices for which more than one candidate filed per party.

zh.t: 2024年北卡罗来纳州州行政委员会选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于2024年11月5日举行选举，选出州行政委员会的10名官员。选举与总统、联邦众议院、北卡罗来纳州议会和州最高法院等职位的选举同期举行。需要党内初选的职位（即每个政党报名候选人超过1人的职位）于2024年3月5日举行初选。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Alaska
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 5, 2024, as part of the broader 2024 United States presidential election. Former President Donald Trump, the Republican nominee, defeated Democratic Vice President Kamala Harris to secure Alaska's three votes in the Electoral College. This was the first presidential election following the state's adoption of ranked-choice voting for all statewide general elections, though a second round was not triggered because Trump secured a majority of the vote outright.

zh.t: 2024年阿拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2024年阿拉斯加州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日举行。共和党候选人、前总统唐纳德·特朗普击败民主党候选人、副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯，赢得阿拉斯加州的3张选举人票。这是阿拉斯加州在全州普选中采用排序选择投票后的首次总统选举；特朗普直接获得过半数选票，因此没有进入第二轮计票。

en.s: The 2024 Arizona Senate election was held on November 5, 2024. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on July 30, 2024. Prior to the elections, the Republican Party held a narrow majority over the Democratic Party, controlling 16 seats to their 14 seats.

zh.s: 2024年亚利桑那州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行。选民在该州全部30个立法选区选出州参议员，任期两年。初选于2024年7月30日举行。选举前，共和党以16席对民主党的14席保持微弱多数。

en.s: The 2024 Rhode Island State Senate elections took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024. The primary election was held on Tuesday, September 10, 2024. Rhode Island voters elected state senators in all 38 seats of the Senate to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Rhode Island state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Rhode Island House.

zh.s: 2024年罗得岛州参议院选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行。初选于2024年9月10日星期二举行。罗得岛州选民选出了州参议院全部38个席位的议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举和罗得岛州选举同期举行，包括美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和罗得岛州众议院选举。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Maryland voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Maryland has 10 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which the state neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.s: 2024年马里兰州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。马里兰州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，马里兰州在选举人团中有10张选举人票，席位数没有增减。

en.s: The 2024 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next governor of Indiana, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Republican Senator Mike Braun won his first term in office, defeating Democrat former state Superintendent of Public Instruction Jennifer McCormick.

zh.s: 2024年印第安纳州州长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。共和党参议员迈克·布劳恩击败民主党候选人、前州公共教育主管詹妮弗·麦考密克，当选州长，首次担任该职。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Maryland, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年马里兰州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年马里兰州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表马里兰州的8名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in North Dakota was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of North Dakota. Republican incumbent Kevin Cramer was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democratic–NPL educator Katrina Christiansen in the general election with more than 66% of the vote.

zh.t: 2024年北达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年北达科他州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表北达科他州的美国联邦参议员。共和党现任参议员凯文·克莱默击败民主党—北达科他无党派联盟党候选人、教育工作者卡特里娜·克里斯蒂安森，连任第二个任期，在普选中的得票率超过66%。

en.t: 2024 West Virginia Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2024 West Virginia Secretary of State election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next secretary of state of West Virginia, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the U.S. Senate and various state and local elections, including for U.S. House and governor of West Virginia.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州州务卿选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出下一任西弗吉尼亚州州务卿，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院选举以及州和地方选举（包括联邦众议院和州长选举）同期进行。

en.s: The 2024 Wyoming House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect members of the Wyoming Legislature for its 68th session. Partisan primaries were held on August 20. Part of the 2024 United States elections, the election was held alongside races for state senate, U.S. House, U.S. Senate, and the presidential election.

zh.s: 2024年怀俄明州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出怀俄明州第68届州议会的议员。党派初选于8月20日举行。该选举是2024年美国选举的一部分，与州参议院、联邦众议院、联邦参议院和总统选举同期举行。

en.s: Elections were held in California on November 5, 2024, with the statewide direct primary election being held on March 5, 2024. California voters elected all of California's seats to the United States House of Representatives, one seat to the United States Senate, all of the seats of the California State Assembly, and all odd-numbered seats of the California State Senate.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2024年11月5日举行选举，全州直接初选于2024年3月5日举行。加州选民选出了代表该州的全部联邦众议员、1名联邦参议员、加州州众议院全部议员以及加州州参议院所有奇数编号席位的议员。

en.s: A general election was scheduled in the U.S. state of Idaho on November 5, 2024. Along with the presidential election, all seats in both chambers of the Idaho Legislature were up for election, as well as both of Idaho's two seats in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections elections were held on May 21, 2024.

zh.s: 美国爱达荷州原定于2024年11月5日举行普选。除总统选举外，爱达荷州议会两院的所有席位以及该州在美国联邦众议院的两个席位都进行改选。初选于2024年5月21日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Texas's 18th congressional district special election was a special election that was held on November 5, 2024, to choose a new member of the U.S. House of Representatives. The seat became vacant when incumbent Rep. Sheila Jackson Lee died on July 19, 2024. The special election only filled the remainder of Jackson Lee's unexpired term, from November 2024 until January 2025.

zh.t: 2024年得克萨斯州第18国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2024年得克萨斯州第18国会选区特别选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名新的美国联邦众议员。现任众议员希拉·杰克逊·李于2024年7月19日去世后，该席位空缺。特别选举只填补杰克逊·李未完成的剩余任期，即2024年11月至2025年1月。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Delaware was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Delaware. Democratic congresswoman Lisa Blunt Rochester won her first term in office, defeating Republican businessman Eric Hansen. She succeeded Democratic incumbent Tom Carper, who declined to seek a fifth term. This was the first open race for this seat since 1970.

zh.t: 2024年特拉华州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年特拉华州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表特拉华州的美国联邦参议员。民主党联邦众议员丽莎·布朗特·罗切斯特击败共和党商人埃里克·汉森，当选并首次担任联邦参议员。她接替了不再竞选第五个任期的民主党现任参议员汤姆·卡珀。这是该席位自1970年以来首次出现开放竞争。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Puerto Rico
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives election in Puerto Rico to elect the Resident Commissioner of Puerto Rico were held on November 5, 2024. The election of the Resident Commissioner was held concurrently with the larger 2024 United States House of Representatives elections, the 2024 Puerto Rico gubernatorial election, and other U.S. federal and Puerto Rican general election races.

zh.t: 2024年波多黎各美国联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2024年波多黎各美国联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出波多黎各常驻专员。常驻专员选举与规模更大的2024年美国联邦众议院选举、2024年波多黎各州长选举以及其他美国联邦和波多黎各普选项目同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Alabama Public Service Commission election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the president of the Alabama Public Service Commission. This was the last election for the position, as the commission changed to elect seven members by congressional district following the 2026 election.

zh.t: 2024年阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会主席选举
zh.s: 2024年阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会主席。这是该职位的最后一次选举；2026年选举后，委员会将改为按国会选区选出7名成员。

en.t: 2024 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 2024 United States Senate election in Arizona was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Arizona. Democratic Congressman Ruben Gallego won his first term in office, defeating Republican former news anchor Kari Lake. He succeeded independent incumbent Kyrsten Sinema, who did not seek a second term.

zh.t: 2024年亚利桑那州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2024年亚利桑那州联邦参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出一名代表亚利桑那州的美国联邦参议员。民主党联邦众议员鲁本·加列戈击败共和党候选人、前新闻主播卡丽·莱克，当选并首次担任联邦参议员。他接替了没有竞选连任的无党籍现任参议员克尔斯滕·西内马。

en.s: The 2024 Arkansas Senate election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections.

zh.s: 2024年阿肯色州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国选举同期进行。

en.t: 2024 North Dakota House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2024 North Dakota House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 2024, as part of the biennial 2024 United States elections.

zh.s: 2024年北达科他州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，是美国两年一度选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2024 California State Assembly election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, with the primary election being held on March 5, 2024. All of the seats of the California State Assembly were elected as part of the 2024 California elections.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州州众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年加利福尼亚州州众议院选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，初选于2024年3月5日举行。加利福尼亚州州众议院全部席位都进行改选，属于2024年加利福尼亚州选举的一部分。

en.s: General elections were held in Puerto Rico on November 5, 2024, alongside the 2024 United States elections, to elect the officials of the Puerto Rican government who will serve from January 2025 to January 2029, most notably the position of Governor and Resident Commissioner. A non-binding status referendum and a straw poll for the 2024 United States presidential election were held.

zh.s: 波多黎各于2024年11月5日举行大选，与2024年美国选举同期进行，选出2025年1月至2029年1月任职的波多黎各政府官员，主要职位包括州长和常驻专员。选举还举行了一场不具约束力的地位公投，以及一场2024年美国总统选举的民意模拟投票。

en.s: The 2024 New Hampshire Executive Council elections took place on November 5, 2024, to elect all five members of the Executive Council of New Hampshire. Party primaries were held on September 10. Republicans have held a majority on the executive council since 2021.

zh.t: 2024年新罕布什尔州行政委员会选举
zh.s: 2024年新罕布什尔州行政委员会选举于2024年11月5日举行，改选行政委员会全部5名成员。党内初选于9月10日举行。自2021年以来，共和党一直在行政委员会中占多数。

en.t: 2024 Puerto Rico House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2024 Puerto Rico House of Representatives election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the members of the 32nd House of Representatives of Puerto Rico, concurrently with the election of the Governor, the Resident Commissioner, the Senate, and the mayors of the 78 municipalities, as well as the election events of a status referendum and a presidential straw poll.

zh.s: 2024年波多黎各众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出第32届波多黎各众议院议员。选举与州长、常驻专员、参议院、78个市镇的市长选举，以及地位公投和总统选举民意模拟投票同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Massachusetts State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 3, 2024. Massachusetts voters elected all 40 members of the State Senate to serve two-year terms in the Massachusetts General Court. The election coincided with United States national elections and Massachusetts state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, U.S. President, and Massachusetts House.

zh.s: 2024年马萨诸塞州参议院选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，初选于2024年9月3日星期二举行。马萨诸塞州选民选出了州参议院全部40名议员，任期两年，议会称为马萨诸塞州普通法院。选举与美国全国选举和马萨诸塞州选举同期举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院、美国总统和马萨诸塞州众议院选举。

en.s: The 2024 Colorado House of Representatives elections took place on November 5, 2024, with the primaries being held on June 25, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年科罗拉多州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，初选于2024年6月25日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Richmond mayoral election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Richmond, Virginia. The election was won by Danny Avula who took office as the city's 81st mayor in January 2025. He became the city's first immigrant mayor. Incumbent Democratic mayor Levar Stoney was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a third term in office; he instead ran for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia in 2025, but lost in the primary.

zh.t: 2024年弗吉尼亚州里士满市长选举
zh.s: 2024年里士满市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出弗吉尼亚州里士满市市长。丹尼·阿武拉当选，并于2025年1月就任该市第81任市长。他成为该市首位移民市长。民主党现任市长勒瓦尔·斯托尼受任期限制，不能竞选连任第三届；他转而在2025年竞选副州长，但在初选中落败。

en.s: The 2024 San Francisco mayoral election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of San Francisco, California. It was originally scheduled for November 7, 2023, but following the passage of Proposition H in 2022, mayoral elections were rescheduled to coincide with presidential elections. The election used ranked-choice voting. Incumbent mayor London Breed ran for re-election to a second term in office; she was considered vulnerable, as polls had consistently shown her with low approval ratings.

zh.s: 2024年旧金山市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出加利福尼亚州旧金山市市长。原定选举日期为2023年11月7日，但2022年第H号提案通过后，市长选举改为与总统选举同期举行。本次选举采用排序选择投票。现任市长伦敦·布里德竞选连任第二届；民调持续显示她的支持率偏低，因此被认为选情不利。

en.s: The 2024 San Diego mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of San Diego, California. The primary election was held on Tuesday, March 5, 2024, after which incumbent mayor Todd Gloria and police officer Larry Turner advanced to the general election. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most members do identify a party preference.

zh.s: 2024年圣迭戈市长选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，选出加利福尼亚州圣迭戈市市长。初选于2024年3月5日星期二举行，现任市长托德·格洛里亚和警官拉里·特纳进入普选。加利福尼亚州市政选举名义上不分党派，但大多数参选人会表明自己的政党倾向。

en.s: Washington state elections in 2024 were held on November 5, 2024. Primary elections were held on August 6, 2024. This was the first time since 1965 that Republicans have not held at least one executive office going into the election. In the early hours of October 28, a ballot drop box in Vancouver was found to be on fire damaging a number of ballots.

zh.s: 华盛顿州于2024年11月5日举行选举。初选于2024年8月6日举行。这是自1965年以来，共和党首次在选举前没有至少一个州行政职位。10月28日凌晨，温哥华一个投票箱起火，造成一些选票受损。

en.s: The 2024 Jonesboro mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next mayor of Jonesboro, Arkansas. The election was nonpartisan, meaning the candidates' party affiliations did not appear on the ballot. Incumbent Harold Copenhaver defeated LJ Bryant in a runoff election on December 3, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年琼斯伯勒市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出阿肯色州琼斯伯勒市下一任市长。选举名义上不分党派，候选人的党派不显示在选票上。现任市长哈罗德·科本哈弗在2024年12月3日举行的决选中击败LJ·布莱恩特。

en.s: The 2024 Austin mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next mayor of Austin, Texas. The election was nonpartisan; the candidates' party affiliations did not appear on the ballot. Incumbent mayor Kirk Watson was running for re-election, after returning to the position of mayor following the 2022 election. On November 15, over a week after election day, Watson was declared the apparent winner of the race after securing 50.0041% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年奥斯汀市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出得克萨斯州奥斯汀市下一任市长。选举名义上不分党派，候选人的党派不显示在选票上。现任市长柯克·沃森竞选连任；他在2022年选举后重返市长职位。11月15日，也就是选举日一周多后，沃森以50.0041%的得票率被宣布为暂时胜选者。

en.s: Elections to the Georgia State Senate were held on November 5, 2024, alongside the other 2024 United States elections. All 56 seats were up for election.

zh.s: 佐治亚州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国其他选举同期进行。参议院全部56个席位都进行改选。

en.s: Several elections took place in the U.S. state of Georgia in 2024. The general election was held on November 5, 2024. A presidential primary took place on March 12, 2024, while the primary for the U.S. Houses and other offices were on the ballot on May 21, 2024. Primary runoffs took place on June 18, 2024, if no candidate reaches under 50% threshold.

zh.s: 美国佐治亚州于2024年举行多项选举。普选于2024年11月5日举行。总统初选于2024年3月12日举行，联邦众议院和其他职位的初选于2024年5月21日举行。如果没有候选人达到50%的门槛，党内初选的决选于2024年6月18日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Mesa mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next mayor of Mesa, Arizona. Incumbent Republican mayor John Giles was term limited and could not run for re-election. A primary election for candidates was held on July 30, 2024, from which city councilor Mark Freeman and former mayor Scott Smith advanced to a runoff, in which Freeman defeated Smith with 52.9 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年梅萨市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出亚利桑那州梅萨市下一任市长。共和党现任市长约翰·贾尔斯受任期限制，不能竞选连任。候选人初选于2024年7月30日举行，市议员马克·弗里曼和前市长斯科特·史密斯进入决选。弗里曼以52.9%的得票率击败史密斯，当选市长。

en.s: The 2024 Washington Public Lands Commissioner election was held on November 5, 2024. Democrat Dave Upthegrove, a King County councilmember, defeated Republican Jaime Herrera Beutler, a former U.S. Representative from Washington's 3rd congressional district. The top-two primary was held on August 6. Incumbent Public Lands Commissioner Hilary Franz, elected in 2016 and re-elected in 2020, did not seek a third term, opting to run instead for governor.

zh.t: 2024年华盛顿州公共土地专员选举
zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州公共土地专员选举于2024年11月5日举行。民主党人、金县议员戴夫·厄普特格罗夫击败共和党人、前华盛顿州第3国会选区联邦众议员杰米·埃雷拉·比特勒。两名得票最高者初选于8月6日举行。2016年当选并于2020年连任的现任公共土地专员希拉里·弗兰茨没有竞选第三届，而是转而竞选州长。

en.s: The 2024 New York State Senate election was held on November 5, 2024. Primary elections were held on June 25, 2024. In this election, the Democratic Party retained its State Senate majority, but lost its veto-proof (two-thirds) majority after it lost one seat in the election for the 17th Senate district.

zh.s: 2024年纽约州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行。初选于2024年6月25日举行。民主党保住了州参议院多数席位，但在第17选区选举中失去1席，因而不再拥有足以推翻否决的三分之二多数。

en.s: The 2024 Scottsdale mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Scottsdale, Arizona. Incumbent mayor David Ortega ran for a second term and was defeated in the general election by Lisa Borowsky.

zh.s: 2024年斯科茨代尔市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔市市长。现任市长戴维·奥尔特加竞选连任第二届，但在普选中败给丽莎·博罗夫斯基。

en.s: The 2024 Bay County Executive election was held on November 5, 2024. Incumbent County Executive James Barcia ran for re-election. He was challenged by Bay County Road Commissioner Kevin Shark, who defeated Charles Juers, Barcia's 2020 opponent, in the Republican primary. Barcia defeated Shark by a narrow margin, winning a third term with just 50.7 percent of the vote, despite Donald Trump's landslide win in the county in the presidential election.

zh.s: 2024年贝县行政长官选举于2024年11月5日举行。现任行政长官詹姆斯·巴西亚竞选连任。他的对手是贝县道路专员凯文·沙克；沙克在共和党初选中击败了巴西亚2020年的对手查尔斯·尤尔斯。巴西亚以微弱优势击败沙克，以50.7%的得票率赢得第三个任期，尽管唐纳德·特朗普在该县总统选举中以压倒性优势获胜。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election were held on November 5, 2024. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, State's Attorney, Board of Commissioners district 1, Cook County Board of Review district 1, four seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County. Primary elections, held using the open primary system, took place on March 19, 2024.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县普选于2024年11月5日举行。本次选举选出巡回法院书记员、州检察官、库克县委员会第1选区和复核委员会第1选区的代表、芝加哥地区水资源管理委员会的4名成员，以及库克县巡回法院法官。采用开放式初选，初选于2024年3月19日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Oakland County Executive election was held on November 5, 2024. Incumbent County Executive David Coulter ran for re-election to a second full term. He was challenged by businessman Nik Gjonaj, the Republican nominee. Coulter defeated Gjonaj in a landslide, winning 57 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年奥克兰县行政长官选举于2024年11月5日举行。现任行政长官戴维·库尔特竞选连任第二个完整任期。他的对手是共和党候选人、商人尼克·乔纳杰。库尔特以57%的得票率大胜，击败乔纳杰。

en.s: The 2024 Grand Rapids mayoral election took place on November 5, 2024, following a primary election on August 6, 2024. Incumbent Mayor Rosalynn Bliss was ineligible to run for re-election to a third term. Former State Representative David LaGrand ran to succeed her, and placed first in the primary by a wide margin, winning 60 percent of the vote to former City Commissioner Senita Lenear's 20 percent.

zh.s: 2024年大急流城市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，此前初选于2024年8月6日举行。现任市长罗莎琳·布利斯受任期限制，不能竞选第三届。前州众议员戴维·拉格兰竞选接替她，并以较大优势在初选中排名第一，获得60%的选票；前市政委员塞尼塔·利尼尔获得20%。

en.s: The 2024 Washington State Senate elections were held on November 5, 2024, with a nonpartisan blanket primary election held on August 6, 2024. Voters in 25 of the 49 state legislative districts elected Senators to the Washington State Senate. The elections will coincide with other elections for federal, state, and local offices.

zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州参议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，无党派不分区初选于2024年8月6日举行。州参议院49个立法选区中有25个选区的选民选出参议员。这些选举将与其他联邦、州和地方职位选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Seattle City Council special election was held on November 5, 2024, following a primary election on August 6. The election occurred to fill a vacancy for the 8th district due to the resignation of Teresa Mosqueda, who was elected to the King County Council in the 2023 election. Tanya Woo was appointed in January 2024 by the City Council to the seat until the general election occurred to fill the seat for the remainder of the term.

zh.s: 2024年西雅图市议会特别选举于2024年11月5日举行，此前初选于8月6日举行。选举旨在填补第8选区的空缺。特雷莎·莫斯克达在2023年选举中当选金县议会议员后辞去市议员职务。2024年1月，市议会任命坦娅·吴暂代该席位，直至普选选出一名议员完成剩余任期。

en.s: The 2024 Pierce County Executive election took place on November 5, 2024, to elect the county executive of Pierce County, Washington. Incumbent Republican County Executive Bruce Dammeier was term limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. Democratic County Councilman Ryan Mello and Republican State Representative Kelly Chambers ran to succeed him in a campaign that revolved around the high price of housing.

zh.s: 2024年皮尔斯县行政长官选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出华盛顿州皮尔斯县行政长官。共和党现任行政长官布鲁斯·达米尔受任期限制，不能连任第三个连续任期。民主党县议员瑞安·梅洛和共和党州众议员凯莉·钱伯斯竞选接替他，竞选议题围绕房价高昂展开。

en.t: 2024 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2024 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections were held on November 5, 2024. Six of the eleven seats on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors were up for election. The election was conducted with ranked-choice voting.

zh.s: 2024年旧金山监事会选举于2024年11月5日举行。监事会11个席位中有6个席位改选。本次选举采用排序选择投票。

en.s: The 2024 Washington Secretary of State election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect the Washington Secretary of State, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the U.S. Senate and various state and local elections, including for U.S. House and governor of Washington.

zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州州务卿选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院选举以及州和地方选举（包括联邦众议院和州长选举）同期进行。

en.t: 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the fourteen U.S. representatives from the State of Georgia, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2024年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2024年佐治亚州联邦众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出代表佐治亚州的14名美国联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2024年美国总统选举同期举行，也与其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2024 Washington attorney general election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the next attorney general of Washington, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the U.S. Senate and various state and local elections, including for U.S. House and governor of Washington. Incumbent Democratic attorney general Bob Ferguson was eligible to seek re-election to a fourth term but had chosen instead to run successfully for governor.

zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州州检察长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院选举以及包括联邦众议院和州长选举在内的州和地方选举同期进行。民主党现任州检察长鲍勃·弗格森原本有资格竞选第四个任期，但他转而竞选州长并成功当选。

en.t: 2024 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election
en.s: The 2024 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election took place on November 5, 2024. Incumbent CEO Michael Thurmond was term-limited and could not run for re-election to a third term. Three county commissioners—Steve Bradshaw, Lorraine Cochran Johnson, and Larry Johnson—ran to succeed him. Because Cochran Johnson and Johnson's terms on the County Commission would have overlapped with the CEO's term, they had to resign their seats upon qualifying.

zh.t: 2024年佐治亚州迪卡尔布县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2024年佐治亚州迪卡尔布县行政长官选举于2024年11月5日举行。现任行政长官迈克尔·瑟蒙德受任期限制，不能竞选连任第三届。3名县委员——史蒂夫·布拉德肖、洛林·科克伦·约翰逊和拉里·约翰逊——竞选接替他。由于科克伦·约翰逊和约翰逊在县委员会的任期会与行政长官任期重叠，两人在提交参选材料时必须辞去县委员职务。

en.s: The 2024 Oakland mayoral recall election was a successful special recall election to remove Oakland mayor Sheng Thao from office less than two years into her first four-year term. It was held on November 5, 2024 concurrent with the statewide and nationwide general elections.

zh.s: 2024年奥克兰市长罢免选举成功罢免了奥克兰市长盛桃。她的第一个四年任期还不到两年就被免职。选举于2024年11月5日举行，与加利福尼亚州全州选举和美国全国选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2024 Baton Rouge mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, with a runoff for December 7 to elect the mayor-president of Baton Rouge, Louisiana. With no candidate receiving a majority of votes in the initial round of the election, a runoff election was held on December 7. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Sharon Weston Broome was seeking re-election to a third term and placed second in the first round behind Republican Sid Edwards.

zh.s: 2024年巴吞鲁日市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，决选定于12月7日举行，选出路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日市长兼市政总负责人。首轮选举中没有候选人获得过半数选票，因此举行决选。民主党现任市长莎伦·韦斯顿·布鲁姆竞选连任第三届，她在首轮投票中排名第二，落后于共和党候选人希德·爱德华兹。

en.s: The 2024 New York State Assembly election was held on November 5, 2024. This election coincided with elections for U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, the U.S. presidential election, and state senate, among others. Districts for this election were redrawn pursuant to court order in Nichols v. Hochul, though the lines passed by the Independent Redistricting Commission and the state legislature on April 28, 2023, were nearly identical to the 2022 districts.

zh.s: 2024年纽约州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行。选举与联邦参议院、联邦众议院、美国总统和州参议院等职位的选举同期举行。根据法院在尼科尔斯诉霍楚尔案中的命令，本次选举重新划定了选区；但独立选区划分委员会和州议会于2023年4月28日通过的新选区，与2022年选区几乎相同。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, as part of the 2024 United States elections in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Georgia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote. The state of Georgia has 16 electoral votes in the Electoral College, following reapportionment due to the 2020 United States census in which it neither gained nor lost a seat.

zh.s: 2024年佐治亚州美国总统选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行，是2024年美国选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。佐治亚州选民通过普选选出代表本州参加选举人团的选举人。根据2020年美国人口普查后的席位重新分配，佐治亚州在选举人团中有16张选举人票，席位数没有增减。

en.s: The 2024 Queensland Labor Party leadership election was held on 5 November 2024 to elect the leader of the Queensland Labor Party and ex officio, Leader of the Opposition, following Labor's loss at the 2024 state election. Former premier Steven Miles was re-elected unopposed to the leadership, with Cameron Dick also re-elected as deputy leader.

zh.s: 昆士兰工党于2024年11月5日举行党魁选举，选出党魁，并由其兼任反对党领袖。此前，工党在2024年州选举中落败。前州长史蒂文·迈尔斯没有对手，连任党魁；卡梅伦·迪克也连任副党魁。

en.t: 2024 Alameda County District Attorney recall election
en.s: The 2024 Alameda County District Attorney recall election was a successful special recall election to remove Alameda County District Attorney Pamela Price. It was held on November 5, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年阿拉米达县地方检察官罢免选举
zh.s: 2024年阿拉米达县地方检察官罢免选举成功罢免了阿拉米达县地方检察官帕梅拉·普莱斯。选举于2024年11月5日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Raleigh mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024 to elect the next mayor of Raleigh, North Carolina. Municipal elections in Raleigh are officially nonpartisan and use the plurality vote system, with no possibility of a runoff. Incumbent mayor Mary-Ann Baldwin chose to retire rather than seek re-election to a third term in office. Former state treasurer Janet Cowell was elected mayor with 59.78 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年罗利市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州罗利市下一任市长。罗利市的市长选举名义上不分党派，采用得票最多者当选制，不设决选。现任市长玛丽-安·鲍德温决定退休，没有竞选连任第三届。前州财政部长珍妮特·考威尔以59.78%的得票率当选市长。

en.s: The 2024 Winston-Salem mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Winston-Salem, North Carolina.

zh.s: 2024年温斯顿-塞勒姆市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆市市长。

en.s: The 2024 Fayetteville mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, Arkansas. The Fayetteville mayor serves a 4-year term and there are no term limits on this position. Incumbent mayor Lioneld Jordan ran for re-election to serve a fifth term in office. Jordan, along with Experience Fayetteville CEO Molly Rawn, advanced to a runoff election to be held on December 3, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年阿肯色州费耶特维尔市长选举
zh.s: 2024年费耶特维尔市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出阿肯色州费耶特维尔市市长。市长任期为4年，没有任期限制。现任市长莱昂内尔·乔丹竞选连任第五届。乔丹和费耶特维尔体验公司首席执行官莫莉·劳恩进入将于2024年12月3日举行的决选。

en.s: The 2024 California City mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Mayor of California City, California. It saw the election of Marquette Hawkins, who unseated incumbent mayor Kelly Kulikoff.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚城（加州）市长选举
zh.s: 2024年加利福尼亚城（加州）市长选举于2024年11月5日举行。马奎特·霍金斯当选，击败现任市长凯利·库利科夫。

en.s: The 2024 Austin, Texas municipal elections took place on Tuesday, November 5, 2024. Five city council seats (District 2, District 4, District 6, District 7, and District 10) and the mayor have regular elections. All positions are nominally non-partisan, though most candidates choose to affiliate with a party given Austin's strong Democratic lean.

zh.s: 2024年得克萨斯州奥斯汀市政选举于2024年11月5日星期二举行。市议会10个席位中的5席（第2、4、6、7和10选区）以及市长职位都进行常规选举。所有职位名义上不分党派，但奥斯汀民主党倾向明显，大多数候选人会表明自己的党派。

en.s: The 2024 election for mayor of Stockton, California was held on November 5, 2024. Incumbent Republican mayor Kevin Lincoln did not seek reelection, instead running for the United States House of Representatives in California's 9th congressional district against incumbent Democrat Josh Harder. In the first round held on March 5, Republican Tom Patti and Democrat Christina Fugazi advanced to the runoff in November.

zh.t: 2024年加利福尼亚州斯托克顿市长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州斯托克顿市市长选举于2024年11月5日举行。共和党现任市长凯文·林肯没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选加州第9国会选区的联邦众议员，挑战民主党现任议员乔希·哈德。3月5日举行的首轮选举中，共和党人汤姆·帕蒂和民主党人克里斯蒂娜·富加齐进入11月的决选。

en.s: The 2024 Washington State Treasurer election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Washington State Treasurer, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the U.S. Senate and various state and local elections, including for U.S. House and governor of Washington. Washington is one of two states that holds a top-two primary, meaning that all candidates are listed on the same ballot regardless of party affiliation, and the top two move on to the general election.

zh.t: 2024年华盛顿州州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州州财政部长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院选举以及包括联邦众议院和州长选举在内的州和地方选举同期进行。华盛顿州是采用前两名初选制度的两个州之一：所有候选人不分党派列在同一张选票上，得票最高的两人进入普选。

en.s: The 2024 San Francisco District Attorney election was held on November 5, 2024, concurrent with the election for San Francisco mayor and the 2024 statewide general elections. Incumbent District Attorney Brooke Jenkins was originally appointed to the position in 2022 by mayor London Breed after the successful recall of her predecessor Chesa Boudin. That year, Jenkins was elected to serve out the remaining two years of Boudin's term with 53.7% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年旧金山地方检察官选举于2024年11月5日举行，与旧金山市长选举和2024年加利福尼亚州全州普选同期进行。现任地方检察官布鲁克·詹金斯最初于2022年由市长伦敦·布里德任命，接替被成功罢免的前任切萨·布丁。同年，詹金斯又以53.7%的得票率当选，完成布丁任期剩余的两年。

en.s: The 2024 Washington State Auditor election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the Washington State Auditor, concurrently with the 2024 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the U.S. Senate and various state and local elections, including for U.S. House and governor of Washington. Washington is one of two states that holds a top-two primary, meaning that all candidates are listed on the same ballot regardless of party affiliation, and the top two move on to the general election.

zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州州审计长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与2024年美国总统选举、联邦参议院选举以及包括联邦众议院和州长选举在内的州和地方选举同期进行。华盛顿州是采用前两名初选制度的两个州之一：所有候选人不分党派列在同一张选票上，得票最高的两人进入普选。

en.s: The 2024 Georgia House of Representatives elections were held on November 5, 2024. Voters in each of Georgia's 180 legislative districts elected a state representative to the Georgia House of Representatives. All 180 seats were up for election. Candidate qualifying ended on March 8, 2024. Primary elections were held on May 21, 2024.

zh.s: 2024年佐治亚州众议院选举于2024年11月5日举行。佐治亚州全部180个立法选区的选民都选出一名州众议员，佐治亚州众议院全部180个席位都进行改选。候选人登记于2024年3月8日结束。初选于2024年5月21日举行。

en.s: The 2024 Washington lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 5, 2024. The top-two primary was held on August 6. Washington is one of two states that holds a top-two primary, meaning that all candidates are listed on the same ballot regardless of party affiliation, and the top two move on to the general election.

zh.s: 2024年华盛顿州副州长选举于2024年11月5日举行。前两名初选于8月6日举行。华盛顿州是采用前两名初选制度的两个州之一：所有候选人不分党派列在同一张选票上，得票最高的两人进入普选。

en.s: Elections were held in the State of New York on November 5, 2024. On this date, the state held elections for the following offices: all 26 seats in the U.S. House of Representatives, all 63 seats in the New York State Senate and all 150 seats in the New York State Assembly. The 2024 United States presidential election and the 2024 election for U.S.

zh.s: 2024年纽约州选举于11月5日举行。州内当天改选美国联邦众议院26席、纽约州参议院63席和纽约州众议院150席。2024年美国总统选举和联邦参议院选举也在同一天举行。此外，选票上还列有一项公投。

en.s: The 2024 Wilmington mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Wilmington, Delaware. Following Incumbent mayor Mike Purzycki's decision to not seek re-election, term limited Governor John Carney and former Wilmington treasurer Velda Jones-Potter ran for the Democratic nomination. Jones-Potter had previously challenged Purzycki's 2020 reelection bid. On September 10, 2024, Carney defeated in the primary Jones-Potter by 743 votes.

zh.s: 2024年威尔明顿市长选举于2024年11月5日（星期二）举行，以选出特拉华州威尔明顿市长。时任市长迈克·珀泽基决定不寻求连任后，任期将满的州长约翰·卡尼和前威尔明顿财务主管维尔达·琼斯-波特角逐民主党提名。琼斯-波特此前曾挑战珀泽基在2020年的连任。2024年9月10日，卡尼在初选中以743票优势击败琼斯-波特。

en.s: The 2024 Baltimore mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Baltimore, Maryland. Incumbent Brandon Scott was first elected in 2020 with 70.5% of the vote and ran re-election to a second term in 2024. Scott was considered vulnerable, as polls found that Baltimore residents were split on his performance as mayor.

zh.s: 2024年巴尔的摩市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出马里兰州巴尔的摩市市长。现任市长布兰登·斯科特于2020年首次当选，获得70.5%的选票；他在2024年竞选连任第二届。民调显示巴尔的摩居民对他的施政看法不一，因此他被认为选情不稳。

en.s: The 2024 Huntington, West Virginia municipal election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect members of the city council and mayor.

zh.t: 2024年西弗吉尼亚州亨廷顿市选举
zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州亨廷顿市于2024年11月5日举行市政选举，选出市议会议员和市长。

en.s: The 2024 Phoenix mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Phoenix, Arizona. Incumbent Mayor Kate Gallego ran for reelection as the favored candidate and won reelection in a landslide. A runoff would have been held on March 11, 2025, if no candidate received a majority of the vote. The election was held alongside elections to the city council, several city initiatives, and other Arizona elections.

zh.s: 2024年菲尼克斯市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，选出亚利桑那州菲尼克斯市市长。现任市长凯特·加列戈作为热门候选人竞选连任，并以较大优势获胜。如果没有候选人获得过半数选票，决选原定于2025年3月11日举行。选举还与市议会席位、若干市级公投提案以及亚利桑那州其他选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2024 Salt Lake County mayoral election was held on November 5, 2024, alongside elections to the Salt Lake County Council. Incumbent Democratic mayor Jenny Wilson was re-elected to a second full term, defeating Republican challenger Erin Rider.

zh.s: 2024年盐湖县市长选举于2024年11月5日举行，与盐湖县议会选举同期进行。民主党现任市长珍妮·威尔逊击败共和党挑战者艾琳·赖德，连任第二个完整任期。

en.s: The 2024 New Castle County Executive election was held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, to elect the County Executive of New Castle County, Delaware. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Matt Meyer was re-elected in 2020 in an unopposed general election after defeating a primary challenge. Meyer announced on June 6, 2023, that he would not seek a third term as County Executive and would instead run for governor.

zh.t: 2024年新卡斯尔县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2024年新卡斯尔县行政长官选举于2024年11月5日（星期二）举行，选出特拉华州新卡斯尔县行政长官。民主党籍时任行政长官马特·迈耶在2020年击败初选挑战者后，于无人竞争的大选中连任。2023年6月6日，迈耶宣布不寻求第三个任期，转而竞选州长。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential election in Michigan took place that November 5 as part of the 2024 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Michigan voters chose electors for Donald Trump and JD Vance to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote.

zh.s: 2024年美国密歇根州总统选举于11月5日举行，是2024年美国总统选举的一部分，全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与了选举。密歇根州选民通过普选选出代表唐纳德·特朗普和JD·万斯的选举人，进入选举人团。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in San Diego in 2024 for mayor, city attorney, and city council. The primary election occurred Tuesday, March 5, 2024, and the general election occurred Tuesday, November 5, 2024. Five of the nine city council seats were up for election, with all five incumbents winning re-election.

zh.s: 2024年圣迭戈举行市政选举，选出市长、市检察官和市议会议员。初选于2024年3月5日星期二举行，大选于2024年11月5日星期二举行。9个市议会席位中有5席改选，5名现任议员均成功连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: North Dakota held two statewide elections in 2024: a primary election on June 11, and a general election on November 5.

zh.s: 2024年北达科他州举行了两场全州选举：6月11日的初选和11月5日的大选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2024 Sacramento mayoral election was held on March 5, 2024, with a runoff scheduled for November 5 because no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in the primary election. It will elect the mayor of Sacramento, California. Municipal elections in California are officially nonpartisan. Epidemiologist Flojaune Cofer took the first spot in the general election, with state assemblyman Kevin McCarty narrowly beating out former state senator Richard Pan and former city councilor Steve Hansen for the second spot.
en.n: This entry records the general, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2024年萨克拉门托市长选举于2024年3月5日举行；由于初选中没有候选人得票超过50%，决选定于11月5日举行，以选出萨克拉门托市长。加州市政选举不分党派。流行病学家弗洛让·科弗在初选中排名第一；州众议员凯文·麦卡蒂以微弱优势击败前州参议员理查德·潘和前市议员史蒂夫·汉森，获得第二名。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的普选日期。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential straw poll in Puerto Rico
en.s: Although Puerto Rico does not participate in U.S. presidential general elections because it is an unincorporated territory and not a state, and therefore cannot send members to the U.S. Electoral College, Puerto Ricans are citizens of the United States and are able to participate in the U.S. presidential primaries.

zh.t: 2024年波多黎各美国总统意向投票
zh.s: 波多黎各不是美国的州，而是未合并属地，因此不参加美国总统大选的普选，也不能向美国选举人团派出成员。不过，波多黎各居民是美国公民，可以参加美国总统党内初选。

en.t: 2024 Arkansas Supreme Court Chief Justice election
en.s: The 2024 Arkansas Supreme Court Chief Justice election was held in the U.S. state of Arkansas on March 5, 2024 to elect the chief justice, also known as position 1, of the Arkansas Supreme Court. Karen Baker and Rhonda Wood defeated Barbara Webb and Jay Martin in the first round. No candidate received a majority of the vote, so a runoff election took place on November 5, 2024.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2024年阿肯色州最高法院首席大法官选举
zh.s: 2024年阿肯色州最高法院首席大法官选举于3月5日举行，选出该州最高法院首席大法官，也称第1号职位。第一轮中，凯伦·贝克和朗达·伍德击败芭芭拉·韦布和杰伊·马丁。由于没有候选人获得多数票，第二轮选举于2024年11月5日举行。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.t: 2024 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 2024 United States presidential straw poll in Guam took place on November 5, 2024. Guam is a territory and not a state, making it ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College. However, Guam does conduct a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election. In the 2024 presidential election, incumbent Democratic president Joe Biden initially ran for re-election and became the party's presumptive nominee.

zh.s: 关岛于2024年11月5日举行美国总统意向投票。关岛是美国领土而非州，因此无权选出总统选举人，但会在大选期间举行不具约束力的总统意向投票。2024年总统选举中，民主党籍现任总统乔·拜登最初参选连任，并成为该党推定提名人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2024 Tulsa mayoral election was held on August 27, 2024, and November 5, 2024, to elect the mayor of Tulsa, Oklahoma. Monroe Nichols won the runoff election, becoming the first Black Mayor of Tulsa. Since no candidate received over 50% of the vote in the August election, Tulsa County commissioner Karen Keith and Nichols advanced to a runoff scheduled for November 5, 2024.

en.s: The 2024 Las Vegas mayoral election took place on June 11, 2024, with a runoff on November 5, to elect the mayor of Las Vegas, Nevada. Incumbent independent mayor Carolyn Goodman was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a fourth term in office. This was the first mayoral election in Las Vegas since 1995 where no candidates were from the Goodman family.

en.t: 2024 Council of the District of Columbia election
en.s: The 2024 general election for the Council of the District of Columbia was held on November 5, with primary elections taking place on June 4, 2024. Elections were held for the seats of four out of the eight wards and two of the four at-large seats. The Democratic Party retained its control of the city council, with only one new member elected to the council out of the six total seats.
